    leaf("Scroll acceleration", Owner::Screen, "faster on repeat", Leaf::Setting { path: "scroll.acceleration" }),
    leaf("Mouse", Owner::Screen, "capture clicks + wheel", Leaf::Setting { path: "mouse" }),
    leaf("Editor context", Owner::Screen, "send active file", Leaf::Setting { path: "prompt.editor" }),
    leaf("Large pastes", Owner::Screen, "compact / full", Leaf::Setting { path: "prompt.paste" }),
    leaf("Image previews", Owner::Screen, "above the prompt", Leaf::Setting { path: "prompt.image_preview" }),
    leaf("Leader timeout", Owner::Screen, "key sequence wait", Leaf::Setting { path: "leader.timeout" }),
    leaf("Copy behavior", Owner::Screen, "manual / select", Leaf::Setting { path: "terminal.copy" }),
];

const ALERTS: &[Node] = &[
    leaf("Notifications", Owner::Screen, "desktop alerts", Leaf::Setting { path: "attention.notifications" }),
    leaf("Sounds", Owner::Screen, "alert sounds", Leaf::Setting { path: "attention.sound" }),
    leaf("Volume", Owner::Screen, "0 - 100%", Leaf::Setting { path: "attention.volume" }),
];

const AI_SERVER: &[Node] = &[
    leaf("Models", Owner::Brain, "saved + active model", Leaf::Dest(Dest::SelectModel)),
    leaf("Providers", Owner::Brain, "API keys · known + custom", Leaf::Dest(Dest::OpenProviders)),
    leaf("Tools", Owner::Brain, "38 builtin + MCP", Leaf::Dest(Dest::OpenTools)),
    leaf("Config file", Owner::Brain, "where settings live", Leaf::Dest(Dest::OpenConfigFile)),
];

const ADVANCED: &[Node] = &[
    leaf("Developer tools",  Owner::Screen, "debug overlay",       Leaf::Setting { path: "debug.devtools" }),
    leaf("Effective config", Owner::Brain,  "current values",       Leaf::Dest(Dest::PrintEffectiveConfig)),
    leaf("Reset settings",   Owner::Brain,  "restore every default", Leaf::Dest(Dest::ResetSettings)),
];

// shorthand constructors
const fn leaf(label: &'static str, owner: Owner, hint: &'static str, leaf_kind: Leaf) -> Node {
    Node { label, kind: NodeKind::Leaf { leaf: leaf_kind, owner, hint } }
}

// ── the flat page model ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// The full flat leaf list: `(section heading, node)` in display order.
/// One row per setting across every section — the whole Settings page.
pub fn leaves() -> Vec<(&'static str, &'static Node)> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for g in ROOT {
        if let NodeKind::Group { children } = &g.kind {
            for n in children.iter() {
                out.push((g.label, n));
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

/// One visible row of the flat Settings screen.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum VRow {
    /// A section heading (APPEARANCE, …) — drawn bold orange, not selectable.
    Heading(&'static str),
    /// A selectable leaf. The value is the position in the *visible* leaf
    /// list (which is what `Tree::sel` indexes).
    Leaf(usize),
}

/// Runtime state for the flat Settings page.
///
/// `sel` is the cursor over the *visible* leaves; `top` is the first visible
/// visual row (headings + leaves) so the cursor never scrolls off-screen.
/// Typing filters leaves by label or section.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Tree {
    pub sel: usize,
    pub top: usize,
    /// Filter query (typed directly on the page).
    pub query: String,
}

impl Tree {
    pub fn root() -> Self { Self::default() }

    /// The visible leaves: `(position-in-full-list, node, section)`, filtered
    /// by the query (empty query = everything).
    pub fn visible_leaves(&self) -> Vec<(usize, &'static Node, &'static str)> {
        let q = self.query.to_lowercase();
        leaves()
            .into_iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, (sec, n))| {
                q.is_empty()
                    || n.label.to_lowercase().contains(&q)
                    || sec.to_lowercase().contains(&q)
            })
            .map(|(i, (sec, n))| (i, n, sec))
            .collect()
    }

    /// The visual rows of the page: for every section that has visible leaves,
    /// the heading followed by its leaf rows. With an empty query this is the
    /// whole page — every heading with its subsettings right below it.
    pub fn rows(&self) -> Vec<VRow> {
        let vis = self.visible_leaves();
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(vis.len() + ROOT.len());
        let mut last: Option<&'static str> = None;
        for (pos, (_, _, sec)) in vis.iter().enumerate() {
            if last != Some(sec) {
                out.push(VRow::Heading(sec));
                last = Some(sec);
            }
            out.push(VRow::Leaf(pos));
        }
        out
    }

    /// The leaf under the cursor (if any).
    pub fn selected(&self) -> Option<&'static Leaf> {
        let vis = self.visible_leaves();
        let n = vis.get(self.sel.min(vis.len().saturating_sub(1)))?.1;
        match &n.kind {
            NodeKind::Leaf { leaf, .. } => Some(leaf),
            NodeKind::Group { .. } => None,
        }
    }

    pub fn up(&mut self) {
        self.sel = self.sel.saturating_sub(1);
    }
    pub fn down(&mut self) {
        let n = self.visible_leaves().len();
        if n > 0 {
            self.sel = (self.sel + 1).min(n - 1);
        }
    }

    /// The visual row index (inside [`Tree::rows`]) the cursor sits on.
    fn selected_visual_row(&self) -> usize {
        for (i, r) in self.rows().iter().enumerate() {
            if let VRow::Leaf(pos) = r {
                if *pos == self.sel {
                    return i;
                }
            }
        }
        0
    }

    /// Clamp the viewport so the selected row is always visible. `avail` is
    /// the number of visual rows the renderer can show. Call every draw.
    pub fn clamp_viewport(&mut self, avail: usize) {
        if avail == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let vrow = self.selected_visual_row();
        if vrow < self.top {
            self.top = vrow;
        } else if vrow >= self.top + avail {
            self.top = vrow + 1 - avail;
        }
    }
}

// ── slash menu ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// One flattened leaf with its full path (section / leaf label).
#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct FlatLeaf {
    pub path: String,
    pub label: &'static str,
    pub leaf: &'static Leaf,
    pub owner: Owner,
}

/// Flatten the whole page into leaves with their full dotted paths.
pub fn flatten() -> Vec<FlatLeaf> {
    fn walk(nodes: &'static [Node], prefix: &mut Vec<&'static str>, out: &mut Vec<FlatLeaf>) {
        for n in nodes {
            match &n.kind {
                NodeKind::Leaf { leaf, owner, .. } => {
                    prefix.push(n.label);
                    out.push(FlatLeaf {
                        path: prefix.join(" / "),
                        label: n.label,
                        leaf,
                        owner: *owner,
                    });
                    prefix.pop();
                }
                NodeKind::Group { children } => {
                    prefix.push(n.label);
                    walk(children, prefix, out);
                    prefix.pop();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut prefix = Vec::new();
    walk(ROOT, &mut prefix, &mut out);
    out
}

/// The `/` slash-menu state in chat.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct SlashMenu {
    pub query: String,
    pub sel: usize,
    pub top: usize,
    pub items: Vec<FlatLeaf>,
}

impl SlashMenu {
    pub fn open() -> Self {
        Self { items: flatten(), ..Default::default() }
    }
    pub fn refresh(&mut self) {
        let q = self.query.to_lowercase();
        self.items = flatten()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|f| q.is_empty() || f.path.to_lowercase().contains(&q) || f.label.to_lowercase().contains(&q))
            .collect();
        self.sel = self.sel.min(self.items.len().saturating_sub(1));
        self.top = 0;
    }
    pub fn up(&mut self) { self.sel = self.sel.saturating_sub(1); self.top = 0; }
    pub fn down(&mut self) { self.sel = (self.sel + 1).min(self.items.len().saturating_sub(1)); }
    pub fn selected(&self) -> Option<&FlatLeaf> {
        self.items.get(self.sel.min(self.items.len().saturating_sub(1)))
    }
    /// Clamp the slash-menu viewport (same idea as Tree::clamp_viewport).
    pub fn clamp_viewport(&mut self, avail: usize) {
        if avail == 0 || self.sel < self.top {
            self.top = self.sel;
        } else if self.sel >= self.top + avail {
            self.top = self.sel.saturating_sub(avail.saturating_sub(1));
        }
    }
}

// ── mouse hit-testing ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// One mouse-hit-testable row. Plain u16 quartet, same shape as
/// `settings::HitRow`, so the App's hit logic stays uniform.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
pub struct TreeHit {
    pub x: u16,
    pub y: u16,
    pub w: u16,
    pub h: u16,
    pub kind: TreeHitKind,
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum TreeHitKind {
    /// A leaf row; the value is the position in the *visible* leaf list
    /// (what `Tree::sel` indexes).
    TreeRow(usize),
    SlashRow(usize),
    /// The panel background: swallows the click, activates nothing.
    Panel,
}

impl TreeHit {
    pub fn contains(&self, x: u16, y: u16) -> bool {
        x >= self.x && x < self.x.saturating_add(self.w) && y >= self.y && y < self.y.saturating_add(self.h)
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use romacode_shared::catalog;

    /// The one-page structure: eight sections, APPEARANCE first, and every
    /// section's leaves sit directly under its heading.
    #[test]
    fn eight_sections_with_appearance_first() {
        let labels: Vec<&str> = ROOT.iter().map(|n| n.label).collect();
        assert_eq!(labels.len(), 8);
        assert_eq!(
            labels,
            ["APPEARANCE", "AI & SERVER", "PERMISSIONS", "SESSION", "TABS & DIFFS", "INPUT", "ALERTS", "ADVANCED"],
        );
        // AI & SERVER is deliberately the second section (index 1).
        assert_eq!(labels[1], "AI & SERVER");
        // every root node is a plain section of leaves (no nested submenus —
        // the drill-down is gone)
        for n in ROOT {
            match &n.kind {
                NodeKind::Group { children } => {
                    assert!(!children.is_empty(), "{} must not be empty", n.label);
                    for c in children.iter() {
                        assert!(
                            matches!(c.kind, NodeKind::Leaf { .. }),
                            "{} must not nest further groups (no drilling)",
                            n.label
                        );
                    }
                }
                _ => panic!("root must only contain section groups"),
            }
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_page_is_headings_with_leaves_below() {
        let t = Tree::root();
        let rows = t.rows();
        // first visual row is the APPEARANCE heading, the next one is Theme
        assert_eq!(rows[0], VRow::Heading("APPEARANCE"));
        assert_eq!(rows[1], VRow::Leaf(0));
        // every section appears as a heading, in order
        let headings: Vec<&str> = rows
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|r| match r {
                VRow::Heading(s) => Some(*s),
                _ => None,
            })
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(
            headings,
            ["APPEARANCE", "AI & SERVER", "PERMISSIONS", "SESSION", "TABS & DIFFS", "INPUT", "ALERTS", "ADVANCED"],
        );
        // leaf count matches the flat leaf list
        assert_eq!(rows.len() - headings.len(), leaves().len());
    }

    #[test]
    fn permissions_are_manual_and_auto_accept() {
        let (_, node) = leaves()
            .into_iter()
            .find(|(sec, n)| *sec == "PERMISSIONS" && n.label == "Manual")
            .expect("Manual must exist");
        match &node.kind {
            NodeKind::Leaf { leaf: Leaf::Preset { path, value }, .. } => {
                assert_eq!(*path, "session.permissions");
                assert_eq!(*value, "prompt");
            }
            _ => panic!("Manual must be a Preset leaf"),
        }
        let (_, node) = leaves()
            .into_iter()
            .find(|(sec, n)| *sec == "PERMISSIONS" && n.label == "Auto accept")
            .expect("Auto accept must exist");
        match &node.kind {
            NodeKind::Leaf { leaf: Leaf::Preset { path, value }, .. } => {
                assert_eq!(*path, "session.permissions");
                assert_eq!(*value, "autoaccept");
            }
            _ => panic!("Auto accept must be a Preset leaf"),
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_setting_leaf_maps_to_a_catalog_row() {
        use romacode_shared::tui_settings::{def, parse_wire};
        for f in flatten() {
            match f.leaf {
                Leaf::Setting { path } => {
                    assert!(def(path).is_some(), "{path} is not in the settings catalog");
                }
                Leaf::Preset { path, value } => {
                    let d = def(path).expect("preset path must be in the catalog");
                    assert!(parse_wire(d, value).is_ok(), "{path} rejects {value}");
                }
                Leaf::Dest(_) => {}
            }
        }
    }

    /// The AI & SERVER section is exactly the four flow rows, one Enter away
    /// from the same page — no "Providers > Known Providers > OpenAI" chain.
    #[test]
    fn ai_and_server_rows_are_the_four_flows() {
        let t = Tree::root();
        let rows: Vec<&'static str> = t
            .visible_leaves()
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|(_, _, sec)| *sec == "AI & SERVER")
            .map(|(_, n, _)| n.label)
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(rows, ["Models", "Providers", "Tools", "Config file"]);
        for (_, n, sec) in t.visible_leaves() {
            if sec != "AI & SERVER" {
                continue;
            }
            match &n.kind {
                NodeKind::Leaf { leaf: Leaf::Dest(d), .. } => {
                    assert!(
                        matches!(d, Dest::SelectModel | Dest::OpenProviders | Dest::OpenTools | Dest::OpenConfigFile),
                        "{:?} must route to a flow screen",
                        n.label
                    );
                }
                _ => panic!("AI & SERVER rows must be Dest leaves"),
            }
        }
    }

    /// The Providers row opens the full provider picker: every catalog
    /// provider is reachable from the ONE Settings page.
    #[test]
    fn providers_dest_reaches_the_whole_catalog() {
        // The bundled fallback catalog carries the core providers; the live
        // network catalog is richer. The threshold is the bundled count so
        // the test passes offline.
        assert!(romacode_shared::catalog::known_len() >= 300, "the full provider catalog must be reachable");
        for id in ["anthropic", "openai", "openrouter", "google", "groq", "deepseek",
                   "mistral", "xai", "zai", "ollama", "lmstudio", "cerebras",
                   "together", "fireworks"] {
            assert!(catalog::find(id).is_some(), "{id} must be in the catalog");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn flatten_includes_every_leaf() {
        let flat = flatten();
        assert!(flat.iter().any(|f| f.label == "Manual"));
        assert!(flat.iter().any(|f| f.label == "Theme"));
        assert!(flat.iter().any(|f| f.label == "Providers"));
        assert!(flat.iter().any(|f| f.label == "Reset settings"));
        assert!(flat.iter().all(|f| !f.path.is_empty()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn slash_menu_filters_by_label_and_path() {
        let mut m = SlashMenu::open();
        m.query = "permission".into();
        m.refresh();
        assert!(m.items.iter().any(|f| f.label == "Manual" || f.label == "Auto accept"));
        m.query = "model".into();
        m.refresh();
        assert!(m.items.iter().any(|f| f.label == "Models"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn viewport_keeps_selection_visible() {
        let mut t = Tree::root();
        // page is long: ~43 leaves + 8 headings; a 3-row viewport must scroll
        let avail = 3;
        t.sel = 0;
        t.clamp_viewport(avail);
        let mut vrow = t.selected_visual_row();
        assert!(t.top <= vrow && vrow < t.top + avail, "cursor row inside the viewport");
        t.sel = t.visible_leaves().len() - 1; // last leaf (Reset settings)
        t.clamp_viewport(avail);
        vrow = t.selected_visual_row();
        assert!(t.top <= vrow && vrow < t.top + avail, "cursor row must be inside the viewport");
        t.sel = 0;
        t.clamp_viewport(avail);
        vrow = t.selected_visual_row();
        assert!(t.top <= vrow && vrow < t.top + avail, "cursor row inside the viewport again");
        // scrolling back up parks the viewport exactly on the cursor's row
        assert_eq!(t.top, vrow);
    }

    #[test]
    fn filter_jumps_across_sections() {
        let mut t = Tree::root();
        t.query = "volume".into();
        let vis = t.visible_leaves();
        assert_eq!(vis.len(), 1, "Volume is the only match");
        assert_eq!(vis[0].2, "ALERTS", "the match carries its section");
        // filtering hides empty sections: no APPEARANCE heading on the page
        let headings: Vec<&str> = t
            .rows()
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|r| match r {
                VRow::Heading(s) => Some(*s),
                _ => None,
            })
            .collect();
        assert_eq!(headings, ["ALERTS"]);
    }
}

//! Bronze "sun morning noon" background, sampled from the reference image.
use ratatui::{buffer::Buffer, layout::Rect, style::Color};

// 9x9 grid sampled from sun-morning-bronze-noon.png (row-major, top→bottom).
const GRID: [[u32; 9]; 9] = [
    [
        0x2c2012, 0x2b1f11, 0x2e2214, 0x2a1e10, 0x2c2012, 0x2a1e10, 0x2c2113, 0x2b1f11, 0x291e10,
    ],
    [
        0x2f2212, 0x302314, 0x2e2214, 0x291d0f, 0x2c2012, 0x2b2012, 0x2b1f12, 0x2b2012, 0x2a1e11,
    ],
    [
        0x352615, 0x332514, 0x322415, 0x2d2112, 0x2a1e10, 0x2d2113, 0x2c2012, 0x2c2113, 0x2b1f11,
    ],
    [
        0x392815, 0x362614, 0x352615, 0x332514, 0x2f2212, 0x2e2214, 0x2c2012, 0x2c2113, 0x291d0f,
    ],
    [
        0x3d2b16, 0x3b2a16, 0x3a2916, 0x372815, 0x342614, 0x302212, 0x2f2213, 0x2b1f10, 0x2a1e11,
    ],
    [
        0x3b2a15, 0x3f2c16, 0x3f2d18, 0x3d2c18, 0x3a2916, 0x342513, 0x332514, 0x312313, 0x2d2011,
    ],
    [
        0x362614, 0x3a2916, 0x3d2b16, 0x3f2d17, 0x3d2b17, 0x3b2a17, 0x372714, 0x362615, 0x342615,
    ],
    [
        0x302313, 0x312312, 0x362714, 0x3c2b17, 0x3d2b16, 0x402d18, 0x3b2915, 0x3c2b18, 0x382815,
    ],
    [
        0x291e11, 0x2a1e0f, 0x312414, 0x332413, 0x372815, 0x3b2a16, 0x3f2d18, 0x3e2c16, 0x3e2d18,
    ],
];

fn unpack(c: u32) -> [f32; 3] {
    [
        ((c >> 16) & 0xff) as f32,
        ((c >> 8) & 0xff) as f32,
        (c & 0xff) as f32,
    ]
}

/// Colour of the background at normalised coordinates (u, v ∈ 0..1).
pub fn sample(u: f32, v: f32) -> Color {
    let fx = (u.clamp(0.0, 1.0)) * 8.0;
    let fy = (v.clamp(0.0, 1.0)) * 8.0;
    let (x0, y0) = (fx.floor() as usize, fy.floor() as usize);
    let (x1, y1) = ((x0 + 1).min(8), (y0 + 1).min(8));
    let (tx, ty) = (fx - x0 as f32, fy - y0 as f32);
    let mut out = [0f32; 3];
    let (a, b, c, d) = (
        unpack(GRID[y0][x0]),
        unpack(GRID[y0][x1]),
        unpack(GRID[y1][x0]),
        unpack(GRID[y1][x1]),
    );
    for k in 0..3 {
        let top = a[k] * (1.0 - tx) + b[k] * tx;
        let bot = c[k] * (1.0 - tx) + d[k] * tx;
        out[k] = top * (1.0 - ty) + bot * ty;
    }
    // gentle vignette so edges settle into the UI background
    let dx = u - 0.5;
    let dy = v - 0.5;
    let vig = 1.0 - (dx * dx + dy * dy).min(0.5) * 0.35;
    Color::Rgb(
        (out[0] * vig) as u8,
        (out[1] * vig) as u8,
        (out[2] * vig) as u8,
    )
}

/// Paint the whole area with the gradient. `t` (seconds) drives a very slow
/// breathing of the warm glow near the bottom.
pub fn paint(buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect, t: f32) {
    let w = area.width.max(1) as f32;
    let h = area.height.max(1) as f32;
    let breath = 1.0 + (t * 0.35).sin() * 0.03;
    for y in area.y..area.bottom() {
        for x in area.x..area.right() {
            let u = (x - area.x) as f32 / w;
            let v = (y - area.y) as f32 / h;
            let c = sample(u, v);
            let c = match c {
                Color::Rgb(r, g, b) => {
                    let k = 1.0 + (v - 0.4).max(0.0) * (breath - 1.0) * 6.0;
                    Color::Rgb(
                        ((r as f32) * k).min(255.0) as u8,
                        ((g as f32) * k).min(255.0) as u8,
                        ((b as f32) * k).min(255.0) as u8,
                    )
                }
                o => o,
            };
            let cell = buf.get_mut(x, y);
            cell.set_symbol(" ");
            cell.set_bg(c);
        }
    }
}

```rust
//! Chat screen: tab bar, transcript, chatbox, sidebar and device panel.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use super::{inputbox, panels, queue, sidebar, tabs, transcript, waterfall};
use crate::app::{Action, App, Device};
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

pub fn draw(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    fill(buf, area, BG);
    tabs::draw(
        app,
        buf,
        Rect::new(area.x, area.y, area.width, tabs::HEIGHT),
    );
    let body = Rect::new(
        area.x,
        area.y + tabs::HEIGHT,
        area.width,
        area.height.saturating_sub(tabs::HEIGHT),
    );

    let mut main = body;
    if app.panel && area.width >= 90 {
        let sb = Rect::new(
            body.right() - sidebar::WIDTH,
            body.y,
            sidebar::WIDTH,
            body.height,
        );
        sidebar::draw(app, buf, sb);
        main.width -= sidebar::WIDTH;
    }

    let mut chat_col = main;
    let mut device_rect = None;
    let mut narrow = false;
    if app.device != Device::None && main.width >= 80 {
        let cw = (main.width as u32 * app.cfg.chat_width_pct as u32 / 100) as u16;
        let cw = cw.clamp(34, main.width.saturating_sub(38));
        chat_col = Rect::new(main.x, main.y, cw, main.height);
        device_rect = Some(Rect::new(
            main.x + cw + 1,
            main.y + 1,
            main.width - cw - 2,
            main.height.saturating_sub(2),
        ));
        narrow = true;
    }
    draw_column(app, buf, chat_col, narrow);
    if let Some(r) = device_rect {
        panels::draw(app, buf, r);
    }
}

fn draw_column(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, col: Rect, narrow: bool) {
    if col.width < 20 || col.height < 8 {
        return;
    }
    let x = col.x + 2;
    let w = col.width - 4;
    let clip = col;
    let t = app.t();

    // footer (cwd + key hints)
    let fy = col.bottom() - 1;
    let busy = app.sessions[app.active].is_running();
    let hints: [(&str, &str); 3] = if busy {
        [("enter", "queue"), ("ctrl+s", "send now"), ("esc", "stop")]
    } else {
        [("enter", "send"), ("esc", "interrupt"), ("ctrl+p", "commands")]
    };
    let tw: usize = hints
        .iter()
        .map(|(k, l)| k.width() + 1 + l.width())
        .sum::<usize>()
        + 3 * 2;
    // the cwd is cut to the room the hints leave (it used to run right under
    // them, or past the column edge on a long path)
    let room = if !narrow && tw + 8 < w as usize {
        w as usize - tw - 3
    } else {
        w as usize
    };
    let cwd = truncate(&app.cwd, room);
    put(buf, x, fy, &cwd, dim(), clip);
    if !narrow {
        if (tw + cwd.width() + 3) as u16 <= w {
            let mut hx = x + w - tw as u16;
            for (i, (k, l)) in hints.iter().enumerate() {
                hx = put(buf, hx, fy, k, bold(), clip);
                hx = put(buf, hx + 1, fy, l, dim(), clip);
                if i < 2 {
                    hx += 3;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // chatbox — never so tall that it eats the transcript on a short terminal
    let ih = inputbox::height(&app.sessions[app.active].input, w)
        .min(col.height.saturating_sub(7))
        .max(4);
    let input_y = fy.saturating_sub(1 + ih);

    // queued queries (typed while the agent works) sit right above the chatbox
    let qn = app.sessions[app.active].queue.len();
    let room_q = input_y.saturating_sub(col.y + 6); // keep >= 4 transcript rows
    let qh = if qn > 0 && room_q >= 3 {
        queue::height(qn).min(room_q)
    } else {
        0
    };
    let queue_y = input_y - qh;
    if qh > 0 {
        let (sel, hover) = (app.sessions[app.active].queue_sel, app.hover);
        let q = app.sessions[app.active].queue.clone();
        queue::draw(buf, Rect::new(x, queue_y, w, qh), &q, sel, hover, &mut app.hits);
    }
    {
        let s = &app.sessions[app.active];
        let hover_mode = app.hover == Some(Action::ToggleMode);
        inputbox::draw(
            buf,
            Rect::new(x, input_y, w, ih),
            &inputbox::Ctx {
                input: &s.input,
                mode: s.mode,
                cfg: &app.cfg,
                t,
                running: s.is_running(),
                placeholder: if s.messages.is_empty() {
                    "Ask anything…"
                } else {
                    "Ask a follow-up…"
                },
                inset_bg: (28, 19, 15),
                hover_mode,
            },
            &mut app.hits,
        );
    }

    // transcript
    let tr = Rect::new(x, col.y + 1, w, queue_y.saturating_sub(col.y + 2));
    app.transcript_rect = tr;
    if tr.height == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let empty = app.sessions[app.active].messages.is_empty();
    if empty {
        let msg = "Start a conversation";
        let mx = tr.x + tr.width.saturating_sub(msg.width() as u16) / 2;
        let my = tr.y + tr.height / 2;
        put(buf, mx, my.saturating_sub(1), msg, bold(), tr);
        let sub = "ctrl+p commands  ·  tab switch mode  ·  ctrl+n new session";
        let sx = tr.x + tr.width.saturating_sub(sub.width() as u16) / 2;
        put(buf, sx, my + 1, sub, dimmer(), tr);
        return;
    }

    transcript::ensure(&mut app.sessions[app.active], &app.cfg, w);
    let s = &mut app.sessions[app.active];
    let running = s.started.as_ref().map(|t| t.elapsed().as_secs());
    let live_rows = if running.is_some() {
        1 + waterfall::HEIGHT as usize
    } else {
        0
    };
    let rows_len = s.cache.as_ref().map_or(0, |c| c.2.len());
    let total = rows_len + live_rows;
    let h = tr.height as usize;
    let max_scroll = total.saturating_sub(h);
    s.scroll_back = s.scroll_back.min(max_scroll);
    let sb = s.scroll_back;
    let start = total.saturating_sub(h + sb);

    for (vy, idx) in (start..(start + h).min(total)).enumerate() {
        let y = tr.y + vy as u16;
        if idx < rows_len {
            let row = &s.cache.as_ref().unwrap().2[idx];
            if let Some((c, a, b)) = row.bg {
                let bx = tr.x + a.min(tr.width);
                let bw = b.min(tr.width).saturating_sub(a);
                tint(buf, Rect::new(bx, y, bw, 1), c);
            }
            put_spans(buf, tr.x, y, &row.spans, tr);
        }
    }
    if let Some(secs) = running {
        // live area: blank row, then the working box + state label. Drawn
        // into a scratch buffer and copied row by row so it scrolls in and
        // out of view smoothly (the old code popped it in and out whole).
        let live = s.live();
        let lh = waterfall::HEIGHT;
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, tr.width, lh);
        let mut sc = Buffer::empty(area);
        fill(&mut sc, area, BG);
        waterfall::draw_box(&mut sc, 0, 0, t, &live, area);
        let lx = waterfall::BOX_W + 2;
        let (_, star_col) = waterfall::star(&live, t);
        let state = waterfall::state_word(&live);
        let mut x1 = put(&mut sc, lx, 1, &state, Style::new().fg(star_col).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD), area);
        x1 = put(&mut sc, x1, 1, "…", Style::new().fg(star_col), area);
        let _ = x1;
        let mode = s.mode.label();
        let mx = put(&mut sc, lx, 2, mode, accent_bold(), area);
        put(&mut sc, mx, 2, &format!("  ·  {secs}s"), dim(), area);
        let hint = if s.queue.is_empty() {
            "enter queues a query · ctrl+s sends it now"
        } else {
            "ctrl+s sends the selected queued query"
        };
        put(&mut sc, lx, 3, hint, dimmer(), area);
        let top = rows_len + 1;
        for r in 0..lh as usize {
            let idx = top + r;
            if idx < start || idx >= start + h {
                continue;
            }
            let y = tr.y + (idx - start) as u16;
            for xx in 0..tr.width {
                *buf.get_mut(tr.x + xx, y) = sc.get(xx, r as u16).clone();
            }
        }
    }
    if sb > 0 {
        let msg = format!(" ↓ {sb} rows below · ctrl+end ");
        let mx = tr.right().saturating_sub(msg.width() as u16);
        put(
            buf,
            mx,
            tr.bottom() - 1,
            &msg,
            Style::new()
                .fg(TEXT)
                .bg(PANEL_HI)
                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            tr,
        );
    }
}

```rust
//! Low-level drawing helpers that write straight into the ratatui buffer.
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Style},
};
use unicode_width::{UnicodeWidthChar, UnicodeWidthStr};

/// A pre-styled, pre-wrapped transcript row.
#[derive(Clone, Default)]
pub struct Row {
    pub spans: Vec<(String, Style)>,
    /// Optional background: (colour, from column, to column exclusive).
    pub bg: Option<(Color, u16, u16)>,
}

impl Row {
    pub fn blank() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }
    pub fn from(spans: Vec<(String, Style)>) -> Self {
        Self { spans, bg: None }
    }
}

/// Write `s` at (x, y) clipped to `clip`. Returns the x after the last cell.
pub fn put(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, s: &str, style: Style, clip: Rect) -> u16 {
    // Popups are sized for a comfortable terminal; on a small one their rect
    // spills past the buffer, and writing there panics. Clip to the buffer too.
    let clip = clip.intersection(buf.area);
    if y < clip.y || y >= clip.bottom() || x >= clip.right() {
        return x;
    }
    let max = (clip.right() - x) as usize;
    let (nx, _) = buf.set_stringn(x, y, s, max, style);
    nx
}

pub fn put_spans(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, spans: &[(String, Style)], clip: Rect) -> u16 {
    let mut cx = x;
    for (s, st) in spans {
        cx = put(buf, cx, y, s, *st, clip);
    }
    cx
}

/// Fill a rect with spaces and a background colour.
pub fn fill(buf: &mut Buffer, r: Rect, bg: Color) {
    let r = r.intersection(buf.area);
    for y in r.y..r.bottom() {
        for x in r.x..r.right() {
            let c = buf.get_mut(x, y);
            c.set_symbol(" ");
            c.set_bg(bg);
        }
    }
}

/// Paint only the background colour, keeping any glyphs.
pub fn tint(buf: &mut Buffer, r: Rect, bg: Color) {
    let r = r.intersection(buf.area);
    for y in r.y..r.bottom() {
        for x in r.x..r.right() {
            buf.get_mut(x, y).set_bg(bg);
        }
    }
}

pub fn hline(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, w: u16, ch: &str, style: Style, clip: Rect) {
    for i in 0..w {
        put(buf, x + i, y, ch, style, clip);
    }
}

/// Rounded border box.
pub fn rounded_box(buf: &mut Buffer, r: Rect, style: Style) {
    if r.width < 2 || r.height < 2 {
        return;
    }
    let clip = buf.area;
    let (x0, y0, x1, y1) = (r.x, r.y, r.right() - 1, r.bottom() - 1);
    put(buf, x0, y0, "╭", style, clip);
    put(buf, x1, y0, "╮", style, clip);
    put(buf, x0, y1, "╰", style, clip);
    put(buf, x1, y1, "╯", style, clip);
    for x in x0 + 1..x1 {
        put(buf, x, y0, "─", style, clip);
        put(buf, x, y1, "─", style, clip);
    }
    for y in y0 + 1..y1 {
        put(buf, x0, y, "│", style, clip);
        put(buf, x1, y, "│", style, clip);
    }
}

pub fn pad_to(s: &str, w: usize) -> String {
    let cur = s.width();
    if cur >= w {
        s.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{}{}", s, " ".repeat(w - cur))
    }
}

/// Truncate to `w` display cells, adding an ellipsis if cut.
pub fn truncate(s: &str, w: usize) -> String {
    if s.width() <= w {
        return s.to_string();
    }
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut cur = 0;
    for ch in s.chars() {
        let cw = ch.width().unwrap_or(0);
        if cur + cw + 1 > w {
            break;
        }
        out.push(ch);
        cur += cw;
    }
    out.push('…');
    out
}

/// Greedy word-wrap of plain text to `w` cells.
pub fn wrap_plain(s: &str, w: usize) -> Vec<String> {
    let w = w.max(1);
    let mut lines = Vec::new();
    for src in s.split('\n') {
        let mut line = String::new();
        let mut lw = 0;
        for word in src.split(' ') {
            let ww = word.width();
            if lw > 0 && lw + 1 + ww > w {
                lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut line));
                lw = 0;
            }
            if lw > 0 {
                line.push(' ');
                lw += 1;
            }
            // hard-split very long words
            if ww > w {
                for ch in word.chars() {
                    let cw = ch.width().unwrap_or(0);
                    if lw + cw > w {
                        lines.push(std::mem::take(&mut line));
                        lw = 0;
                    }
                    line.push(ch);
                    lw += cw;
                }
            } else {
                line.push_str(word);
                lw += ww;
            }
        }
        lines.push(line);
    }
    lines
}

```rust
//! Tiny C-family / Rust / Python / shell-ish syntax highlighter.
use super::theme::*;
use ratatui::style::Style;

const KEYWORDS: &[&str] = &[
    "fn", "let", "mut", "for", "in", "match", "return", "if", "else", "async", "await", "use",
    "pub", "struct", "enum", "impl", "trait", "const", "static", "while", "loop", "break",
    "continue", "mod", "type", "where", "move", "as", "ref", "self", "Self", "def", "class",
    "import", "from", "function", "var", "export", "new", "try", "catch", "throw", "true", "false",
    "None", "null", "unsafe", "dyn", "yield", "with", "lambda",
];

pub fn line(src: &str) -> Vec<(String, Style)> {
    let chars: Vec<char> = src.chars().collect();
    let mut out: Vec<(String, Style)> = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    let push = |out: &mut Vec<(String, Style)>, s: String, st: Style| {
        if s.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(last) = out.last_mut() {
            if last.1 == st {
                last.0.push_str(&s);
                return;
            }
        }
        out.push((s, st));
    };
    let base = Style::new().fg(TEXT);
    while i < chars.len() {
        let c = chars[i];
        // comments
        if (c == '/' && chars.get(i + 1) == Some(&'/'))
            || c == '#' && (i == 0 || chars[..i].iter().all(|x| x.is_whitespace()))
        {
            push(
                &mut out,
                chars[i..].iter().collect(),
                Style::new().fg(DIMMER),
            );
            break;
        }
        // strings
        if c == '"' || c == '\'' && is_string_quote(&chars, i) {
            let q = c;
            let mut j = i + 1;
            while j < chars.len() {
                if chars[j] == '\\' {
                    j += 2;
                    continue;
                }
                if chars[j] == q {
                    j += 1;
                    break;
                }
                j += 1;
            }
            let j = j.min(chars.len());
            push(
                &mut out,
                chars[i..j].iter().collect(),
                Style::new().fg(GREEN),
            );
            i = j;
            continue;
        }
        // numbers
        if c.is_ascii_digit() {
            let mut j = i;
            while j < chars.len()
                && (chars[j].is_ascii_alphanumeric() || chars[j] == '_' || chars[j] == '.')
            {
                if chars[j] == '.' && chars.get(j + 1) == Some(&'.') {
                    break;
                }
                j += 1;
            }
            push(
                &mut out,
                chars[i..j].iter().collect(),
                Style::new().fg(ORANGE),
            );
            i = j;
            continue;
        }
        // identifiers
        if c.is_alphabetic() || c == '_' {
            let mut j = i;
            while j < chars.len() && (chars[j].is_alphanumeric() || chars[j] == '_') {
                j += 1;
            }
            let word: String = chars[i..j].iter().collect();
            let st = if KEYWORDS.contains(&word.as_str()) {
                Style::new().fg(AMBER)
            } else if chars.get(j) == Some(&'!') {
                j += 1;
                Style::new().fg(AMBER)
            } else if word.chars().next().map_or(false, |f| f.is_uppercase()) {
                Style::new().fg(YELLOW)
            } else {
                base
            };
            let word: String = chars[i..j].iter().collect();
            push(&mut out, word, st);
            i = j;
            continue;
        }
        push(&mut out, c.to_string(), base);
        i += 1;
    }
    out
}

/// A `'` starts a string only if a closing quote follows on the same line
/// shortly after (avoids treating Rust lifetimes as strings).
fn is_string_quote(chars: &[char], i: usize) -> bool {
    let rest = &chars[i + 1..];
    match rest.iter().position(|&c| c == '\'') {
        Some(p) => {
            p <= 40
                && !(p >= 1
                    && rest[0].is_alphabetic()
                    && rest
                        .get(1)
                        .map_or(false, |c| c.is_alphanumeric() || *c == '_')
                    && p > 3)
        }
        None => false,
    }
}

//! Home screen: bronze background, ROMACODE wordmark, chatbox.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use super::{bg, inputbox, logo};
use crate::app::{Action, App, Hit};
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

pub fn draw(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let t = app.t();
    bg::paint(buf, area, t);
    let clip = area;

    let compact = area.height < 20 || area.width < 56;
    let logo_cols = (area.width as u32 * 55 / 100).clamp(40, 78) as u16;
    let logo_cols = logo_cols.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));
    let (_, lh) = logo::size_for(logo_cols);

    let box_w = (area.width as u32 * 60 / 100).clamp(44, 88) as u16;
    let box_w = box_w.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));
    let s = &app.sessions[app.active];
    let box_h = inputbox::height(&s.input, box_w);

    let logo_h = if compact { 0 } else { lh };
    let gap = if compact { 0 } else { 3 };
    let total = logo_h + gap + box_h + 2;
    let top = area.y + area.height.saturating_sub(total) / 2;
    let top = top.saturating_sub(area.height / 14);

    if !compact {
        logo::draw(buf, Rect::new(area.x, top, area.width, lh), logo_cols, t);
    }
    let by = top + logo_h + gap;
    let bx = area.x + (area.width.saturating_sub(box_w)) / 2;
    let rect = Rect::new(bx, by, box_w, box_h);
    let hover_mode = app.hover == Some(Action::ToggleMode);
    inputbox::draw(
        buf,
        rect,
        &inputbox::Ctx {
            input: &s.input,
            mode: s.mode,
            cfg: &app.cfg,
            t,
            running: s.is_running(),
            placeholder: "Ask anything…  \"fix the failing test in src/client.rs\"",
            inset_bg: (24, 17, 11),
            hover_mode,
        },
        &mut app.hits,
    );

    // key hints under the box
    let hints: [(&str, &str); 3] = [
        ("tab", "switch mode"),
        ("ctrl+p", "commands"),
        ("ctrl+n", "new session"),
    ];
    let total_w: usize = hints
        .iter()
        .map(|(k, l)| k.width() + 1 + l.width())
        .sum::<usize>()
        + 3 * (hints.len() - 1);
    let mut x = area.x + (area.width.saturating_sub(total_w as u16)) / 2;
    let hy = by + box_h + 1;
    for (i, (k, l)) in hints.iter().enumerate() {
        x = put(
            buf,
            x,
            hy,
            k,
            Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            clip,
        );
        x = put(buf, x + 1, hy, l, Style::new().fg(DIM), clip);
        if i + 1 < hints.len() {
            x += 3;
        }
    }

    // bottom status line
    let fy = area.bottom().saturating_sub(1);
    put(buf, area.x + 2, fy, &app.cwd, Style::new().fg(DIM), clip);
    let v = concat!("v", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    put(
        buf,
        area.right().saturating_sub(v.width() as u16 + 2),
        fy,
        v,
        Style::new().fg(DIM),
        clip,
    );
    let _ = Hit {
        rect: area,
        action: Action::Refresh,
        tip: None,
    };
}

//! The orange chatbox shared by the home and chat screens.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use crate::app::{Action, Hit};
use crate::app::ClientState;
use crate::input::Input;
use crate::session::Mode;
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

const MAX_TEXT_LINES: usize = 6;

pub fn height(input: &Input, width: u16) -> u16 {
    let (lines, _) = input.layout(width.saturating_sub(6) as usize);
    lines.len().clamp(1, MAX_TEXT_LINES) as u16 + 1 + 2
}

pub struct Ctx<'a> {
    pub input: &'a Input,
    pub mode: Mode,
    pub cfg: &'a ClientState,
    pub t: f32,
    pub running: bool,
    pub placeholder: &'a str,
    pub inset_bg: (u8, u8, u8),
    pub hover_mode: bool,
}

pub fn draw(buf: &mut Buffer, r: Rect, cx: &Ctx, hits: &mut Vec<Hit>) {
    if r.width < 12 || r.height < 4 {
        return;
    }
    let clip = r;
    // inset background with a warm glow toward the lower right
    let (br, bgc, bb) = cx.inset_bg;
    let base = ratatui::style::Color::Rgb(br, bgc, bb);
    let glow = ratatui::style::Color::Rgb(64, 32, 16);
    for y in r.y + 1..r.bottom() - 1 {
        for x in r.x + 1..r.right() - 1 {
            let u = (x - r.x) as f32 / r.width as f32;
            let v = (y - r.y) as f32 / r.height as f32;
            let k = (u * u) * 0.6 * (0.35 + 0.65 * v);
            let c = buf.get_mut(x, y);
            c.set_symbol(" ");
            c.set_bg(mix(base, glow, k));
        }
    }
    let pulse = if cx.running {
        ((cx.t * 3.0).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.45
    } else {
        0.0
    };
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(mix(ORANGE, DIMMER, pulse)));

    let text_x = r.x + 3;
    let text_w = r.width.saturating_sub(6);
    let (lines, (crow, ccol)) = cx.input.layout(text_w as usize);
    let rows_avail = (r.height - 3) as usize;
    let first = if lines.len() > rows_avail {
        (crow + 1)
            .saturating_sub(rows_avail)
            .min(lines.len() - rows_avail)
    } else {
        0
    };
    let blink_on = ((cx.t * 1.9) as u32) % 2 == 0 || cx.input.is_empty();

    if cx.input.is_empty() {
        put(buf, text_x, r.y + 1, "▌", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
        let ph = if cx.running {
            "Working… esc to interrupt"
        } else {
            cx.placeholder
        };
        put(buf, text_x + 2, r.y + 1, ph, Style::new().fg(DIM), clip);
    } else {
        for (i, line) in lines.iter().skip(first).take(rows_avail).enumerate() {
            put(
                buf,
                text_x,
                r.y + 1 + i as u16,
                line,
                Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
                clip,
            );
        }
        let row = crow.saturating_sub(first);
        if blink_on && row < rows_avail {
            let cxp = text_x + ccol as u16;
            if cxp < r.right() - 1 {
                let cell = buf.get_mut(cxp, r.y + 1 + row as u16);
                let sym = if cell.symbol() == " " || cell.symbol().is_empty() {
                    " ".to_string()
                } else {
                    cell.symbol().to_string()
                };
                cell.set_symbol(&sym);
                cell.set_style(Style::new().fg(BG).bg(ORANGE));
            }
        }
    }

    // mode / model / provider line
    let y = r.bottom() - 2;
    let label = cx.mode.label();
    let hov = if cx.hover_mode {
        Modifier::UNDERLINED
    } else {
        Modifier::empty()
    };
    let mut x = put(buf, text_x, y, label, accent_bold().add_modifier(hov), clip);
    hits.push(Hit {
        rect: Rect::new(text_x, y, label.width() as u16, 1),
        action: Action::ToggleMode,
        tip: Some(("Switch mode", "tab")),
    });
    x = put(buf, x + 2, y, &cx.cfg.effective_model(), bold(), clip);
    put(buf, x + 2, y, &cx.cfg.provider, dim(), clip);
}

//! ROMACODE wordmark rendered natively with half-block cells.
//! Glyph geometry comes from the original `romacode.rs` generator; the colour
//! ramp is re-tuned (cream → amber → bronze) to sit on the bronze background.
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Style},
};
use std::sync::OnceLock;

const W: usize = 797;
const GH: usize = 114;
const ORIGINS: [i32; 8] = [12, 108, 205, 300, 397, 492, 589, 684];
const LETTERS: [char; 8] = ['R', 'O', 'M', 'A', 'C', 'O', 'D', 'E'];

type Rect4 = (i32, i32, i32, i32);

fn rects(c: char) -> Vec<Rect4> {
    match c {
        'R' => vec![
            (0, 0, 24, 114),
            (0, 0, 68, 24),
            (60, 14, 84, 54),
            (0, 46, 68, 70),
        ],
        'O' => vec![
            (0, 0, 84, 24),
            (0, 0, 24, 114),
            (60, 0, 84, 114),
            (0, 92, 84, 114),
        ],
        'M' => vec![
            (0, 0, 39, 39),
            (45, 0, 84, 39),
            (39, 14, 45, 39),
            (0, 0, 24, 114),
            (60, 0, 84, 114),
            (30, 39, 54, 84),
        ],
        'A' => vec![
            (0, 0, 84, 24),
            (0, 0, 24, 114),
            (61, 0, 84, 114),
            (0, 46, 84, 68),
        ],
        'C' => vec![(0, 0, 24, 114), (0, 0, 83, 24), (0, 92, 83, 114)],
        'D' => vec![
            (0, 0, 24, 114),
            (0, 0, 68, 24),
            (0, 92, 68, 114),
            (60, 16, 82, 97),
        ],
        'E' => vec![
            (0, 0, 24, 114),
            (0, 0, 82, 24),
            (0, 46, 68, 68),
            (0, 91, 82, 114),
        ],
        _ => vec![],
    }
}

/// Summed-area table of the glyph mask, (W+1) x (GH+1).
fn sat() -> &'static Vec<u32> {
    static SAT: OnceLock<Vec<u32>> = OnceLock::new();
    SAT.get_or_init(|| {
        let mut mask = vec![0u8; W * GH];
        for (i, &ch) in LETTERS.iter().enumerate() {
            for (x0, y0, x1, y1) in rects(ch) {
                for y in y0..y1 {
                    for x in x0..x1 {
                        let (px, py) = (ORIGINS[i] + x, y);
                        if px >= 0 && (px as usize) < W && py >= 0 && (py as usize) < GH {
                            mask[py as usize * W + px as usize] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // R's diagonal leg (parallelogram), as in the original generator
        for y in 70..GH {
            let t = (y as f32 - 70.0) / 44.0;
            let (l, r) = (42.0 + 18.0 * t, 65.0 + 18.0 * t);
            for x in l.floor() as i32..r.ceil() as i32 {
                let px = ORIGINS[0] + x;
                if px >= 0 && (px as usize) < W {
                    mask[y * W + px as usize] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        let mut s = vec![0u32; (W + 1) * (GH + 1)];
        for y in 0..GH {
            let mut row = 0u32;
            for x in 0..W {
                row += mask[y * W + x] as u32;
                s[(y + 1) * (W + 1) + x + 1] = s[y * (W + 1) + x + 1] + row;
            }
        }
        s
    })
}

fn coverage(x0: f32, y0: f32, x1: f32, y1: f32) -> f32 {
    let s = sat();
    let cl = |v: f32, m: usize| (v.round().max(0.0) as usize).min(m);
    let (ax, bx) = (cl(x0, W), cl(x1, W));
    let (ay, by) = (cl(y0, GH), cl(y1, GH));
    if bx <= ax || by <= ay {
        return 0.0;
    }
    let g = |x: usize, y: usize| s[y * (W + 1) + x] as f32;
    let sum = g(bx, by) - g(ax, by) - g(bx, ay) + g(ax, ay);
    sum / ((bx - ax) as f32 * (by - ay) as f32)
}

fn hash(x: i32, y: i32) -> f32 {
    let mut h = (x as u32)
        .wrapping_mul(374761393)
        .wrapping_add((y as u32).wrapping_mul(668265263));
    h = (h ^ (h >> 13)).wrapping_mul(1274126177);
    h ^= h >> 16;
    (h & 0xFFFF) as f32 / 65535.0
}

/// Warm ramp: cream highlight → amber → bronze, plus a faint left→right drift.
fn ramp(yf: f32, xf: f32, sweep: f32) -> [f32; 3] {
    const STOPS: [(f32, [f32; 3]); 4] = [
        (0.0, [252.0, 232.0, 200.0]),
        (0.38, [246.0, 178.0, 96.0]),
        (0.74, [226.0, 118.0, 52.0]),
        (1.0, [168.0, 78.0, 38.0]),
    ];
    let y = yf.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    let mut c = STOPS[3].1;
    for i in 0..3 {
        let (a, ca) = STOPS[i];
        let (b, cb) = STOPS[i + 1];
        if y <= b {
            let t = ((y - a) / (b - a)).clamp(0.0, 1.0);
            for k in 0..3 {
                c[k] = ca[k] + (cb[k] - ca[k]) * t;
            }
            break;
        }
    }
    // horizontal drift toward amber on the right
    c[1] += (xf - 0.5) * 10.0;
    c[2] -= (xf - 0.5) * 8.0;
    // slow sheen sweeping across the letters
    let d = (xf - sweep).abs();
    let glow = (1.0 - d * 7.0).max(0.0);
    for k in 0..3 {
        c[k] += glow * 38.0;
    }
    c
}

/// Size in cells (cols, rows) the logo occupies when drawn `cols` wide.
pub fn size_for(cols: u16) -> (u16, u16) {
    let s = W as f32 / cols.max(1) as f32;
    let half_rows = (GH as f32 / s).ceil();
    (cols, ((half_rows / 2.0).ceil() as u16).max(1))
}

/// Draw the wordmark centred in `area`, `cols` cells wide. `t` is seconds.
pub fn draw(buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect, cols: u16, t: f32) {
    let cols = cols.min(area.width).max(8);
    let (cw, ch) = size_for(cols);
    let ox = area.x + (area.width.saturating_sub(cw)) / 2;
    let oy = area.y + (area.height.saturating_sub(ch)) / 2;
    let s = W as f32 / cw as f32; // source px per cell column == per half-row
    let sweep = ((t * 0.16) % 1.6) - 0.3;
    for cy in 0..ch {
        for cx in 0..cw {
            let (x, y) = (ox + cx, oy + cy);
            if x >= buf.area.right() || y >= buf.area.bottom() {
                continue;
            }
            let sx0 = cx as f32 * s;
            let sx1 = sx0 + s;
            let top = coverage(sx0, (cy * 2) as f32 * s, sx1, (cy * 2 + 1) as f32 * s);
            let bot = coverage(sx0, (cy * 2 + 1) as f32 * s, sx1, (cy * 2 + 2) as f32 * s);
            if top < 0.02 && bot < 0.02 {
                continue;
            }
            let cell = buf.get_mut(x, y);
            let bg = match cell.bg {
                Color::Rgb(r, g, b) => [r as f32, g as f32, b as f32],
                _ => [30.0, 22.0, 14.0],
            };
            let xf = sx0 / W as f32;
            let grain = (hash(x as i32, y as i32) - 0.5) * 14.0;
            let paint = |cov: f32, row: f32| -> [f32; 3] {
                let yf = (row * s) / GH as f32;
                let mut c = ramp(yf, xf, sweep);
                for k in 0..3 {
                    c[k] = (c[k] + grain).clamp(0.0, 255.0);
                }
                let mut o = [0f32; 3];
                for k in 0..3 {
                    o[k] = bg[k] * (1.0 - cov) + c[k] * cov;
                }
                o
            };
            let tc = paint(top, (cy * 2) as f32 + 0.5);
            let bc = paint(bot, (cy * 2 + 1) as f32 + 0.5);
            let rgb = |c: [f32; 3]| Color::Rgb(c[0] as u8, c[1] as u8, c[2] as u8);
            cell.set_symbol("▀");
            cell.set_style(Style::new().fg(rgb(tc)).bg(rgb(bc)));
        }
    }
}

````rust
//! Markdown-lite renderer for assistant text → wrapped transcript rows.
//! Supports paragraphs (line breaks kept), `inline code`, **bold**, bullets,
//! headings and fenced code / diff blocks with line numbers.
use super::draw::{pad_to, truncate, Row};
use super::{highlight, theme::*};
use ratatui::style::{Modifier, Style};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

fn body() -> Style {
    Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
}

pub fn render(text: &str, width: usize, indent: usize, out: &mut Vec<Row>) {
    let width = width.max(8);
    let lines: Vec<&str> = text.split('\n').collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut last_blank = true;
    while i < lines.len() {
        let l = lines[i];
        if let Some(info) = l.trim_start().strip_prefix("```") {
            let info = info.trim().to_string();
            let mut code = Vec::new();
            i += 1;
            while i < lines.len() && !lines[i].trim_start().starts_with("```") {
                code.push(lines[i]);
                i += 1;
            }
            i += 1; // closing fence (or end of stream)
            if !last_blank {
                out.push(Row::blank());
            }
            code_block(&info, &code, width, indent, out);
            last_blank = false;
            continue;
        }
        if l.trim().is_empty() {
            if !last_blank {
                out.push(Row::blank());
                last_blank = true;
            }
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        last_blank = false;
        let (prefix, content, hang) =
            if let Some(r) = l.strip_prefix("- ").or_else(|| l.strip_prefix("* ")) {
                ("• ", r, 2)
            } else if l.starts_with('#') {
                ("", l.trim_start_matches('#').trim_start(), 0)
            } else {
                ("", l, 0)
            };
        let heading = l.starts_with('#');
        let words = inline(content, heading);
        wrap_styled(
            prefix,
            &words,
            width.saturating_sub(indent),
            hang,
            indent,
            out,
        );
        i += 1;
    }
}

/// Split inline markup into styled words (spaces preserved as separate tokens).
fn inline(s: &str, heading: bool) -> Vec<(String, Style)> {
    let mut toks: Vec<(String, Style)> = Vec::new();
    let base = if heading {
        Style::new().fg(AMBER).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
    } else {
        body()
    };
    let chars: Vec<char> = s.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut bold = false;
    let flush = |toks: &mut Vec<(String, Style)>, cur: &mut String, st: Style| {
        if !cur.is_empty() {
            toks.push((std::mem::take(cur), st));
        }
    };
    while i < chars.len() {
        if chars[i] == '`' {
            if let Some(end) = chars[i + 1..].iter().position(|&c| c == '`') {
                let st = if bold {
                    base.fg(ratatui::style::Color::Rgb(255, 255, 255))
                } else {
                    base
                };
                flush(&mut toks, &mut cur, st);
                let code: String = chars[i + 1..i + 1 + end].iter().collect();
                toks.push((code, Style::new().fg(AMBER).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)));
                i += end + 2;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if chars[i] == '*' && chars.get(i + 1) == Some(&'*') {
            let st = if bold {
                base.fg(ratatui::style::Color::Rgb(255, 255, 255))
            } else {
                base
            };
            flush(&mut toks, &mut cur, st);
            bold = !bold;
            i += 2;
            continue;
        }
        cur.push(chars[i]);
        i += 1;
    }
    let st = if bold {
        base.fg(ratatui::style::Color::Rgb(255, 255, 255))
    } else {
        base
    };
    flush(&mut toks, &mut cur, st);
    toks
}

fn wrap_styled(
    prefix: &str,
    toks: &[(String, Style)],
    width: usize,
    hang: usize,
    indent: usize,
    out: &mut Vec<Row>,
) {
    // explode tokens into words, keeping style
    let mut words: Vec<(String, Style)> = Vec::new();
    for (t, st) in toks {
        let mut cur = String::new();
        for ch in t.chars() {
            if ch == ' ' {
                if !cur.is_empty() {
                    words.push((std::mem::take(&mut cur), *st));
                }
                words.push((" ".into(), *st));
            } else {
                cur.push(ch);
            }
        }
        if !cur.is_empty() {
            words.push((cur, *st));
        }
    }
    let pad = " ".repeat(indent);
    let mut row: Vec<(String, Style)> = vec![(format!("{pad}{prefix}"), body())];
    let mut w = prefix.width();
    let first_w = w;
    let mut line_has = false;
    for (word, st) in words {
        let ww = word.width();
        if word == " " {
            if line_has {
                row.push((word, st));
                w += 1;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if line_has && w + ww > width {
            // drop trailing space
            if let Some(last) = row.last() {
                if last.0 == " " {
                    row.pop();
                }
            }
            out.push(Row::from(std::mem::take(&mut row)));
            row = vec![(format!("{pad}{}", " ".repeat(hang)), body())];
            w = hang;
            line_has = false;
        }
        // hard split very long tokens
        if ww > width.saturating_sub(w) && !line_has {
            let mut part = String::new();
            let mut pw = 0;
            for ch in word.chars() {
                let cw = unicode_width::UnicodeWidthChar::width(ch).unwrap_or(0);
                if w + pw + cw > width {
                    row.push((std::mem::take(&mut part), st));
                    out.push(Row::from(std::mem::take(&mut row)));
                    row = vec![(format!("{pad}{}", " ".repeat(hang)), body())];
                    w = hang;
                    pw = 0;
                }
                part.push(ch);
                pw += cw;
            }
            row.push((part, st));
            w += pw;
            line_has = true;
            continue;
        }
        row.push((word, st));
        w += ww;
        line_has = true;
    }
    let _ = first_w;
    if let Some(last) = row.last() {
        if last.0 == " " {
            row.pop();
        }
    }
    out.push(Row::from(row));
}

fn code_block(info: &str, code: &[&str], width: usize, indent: usize, out: &mut Vec<Row>) {
    let mut parts = info.split_whitespace();
    let lang = parts.next().unwrap_or("");
    let file = parts.next().unwrap_or("");
    let title = if !file.is_empty() { file } else { lang };
    let is_diff = lang == "diff" || lang == "patch";
    let box_w = width.saturating_sub(indent).max(12);
    let inner = box_w - 2;
    let bs = Style::new().fg(BORDER);
    let pad = " ".repeat(indent);
    let mk = |spans: Vec<(String, Style)>, bg: Option<(ratatui::style::Color, u16, u16)>| {
        let mut sp = vec![(pad.clone(), Style::new())];
        sp.extend(spans);
        Row { spans: sp, bg }
    };
    out.push(mk(vec![(format!("╭{}╮", "─".repeat(inner)), bs)], None));
    let head = if title.is_empty() {
        "code".to_string()
    } else {
        truncate(title, inner.saturating_sub(2))
    };
    out.push(mk(
        vec![
            ("│".into(), bs),
            (pad_to(&format!(" {head}"), inner), Style::new().fg(DIM)),
            ("│".into(), bs),
        ],
        None,
    ));

    // line-number bookkeeping
    let mut new_ln: i64 = 1;
    let digits = (code.len() + 1).to_string().len().max(2);
    for (n, raw) in code.iter().enumerate() {
        let (sign, text, bg, ln): (&str, &str, Option<ratatui::style::Color>, Option<i64>) =
            if is_diff {
                if let Some(h) = raw.strip_prefix("@@") {
                    // @@ -a,b +c,d @@
                    if let Some(p) = h.split_whitespace().find(|t| t.starts_with('+')) {
                        new_ln = p[1..]
                            .split(',')
                            .next()
                            .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
                            .unwrap_or(1);
                    }
                    (" ", raw, None, None)
                } else if raw.starts_with("+++")
                    || raw.starts_with("---")
                    || raw.starts_with("diff ")
                    || raw.starts_with("index ")
                {
                    continue;
                } else if let Some(t) = raw.strip_prefix('+') {
                    let l = new_ln;
                    new_ln += 1;
                    ("+", t, Some(DIFF_ADD), Some(l))
                } else if let Some(t) = raw.strip_prefix('-') {
                    ("-", t, Some(DIFF_DEL), Some(new_ln))
                } else {
                    let l = new_ln;
                    new_ln += 1;
                    (" ", raw.strip_prefix(' ').unwrap_or(raw), None, Some(l))
                }
            } else {
                (" ", raw, None, Some(n as i64 + 1))
            };
        let gutter = match ln {
            Some(l) => format!(" {:>w$} ", l, w = digits),
            None => " ".repeat(digits + 2),
        };
        let sign_style = match sign {
            "+" => Style::new().fg(GREEN).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            "-" => Style::new().fg(RED).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            _ => Style::new().fg(DIMMER),
        };
        let avail = inner.saturating_sub(gutter.width() + 3);
        let t = text.replace('\t', "    ");
        let t = truncate(&t, avail);
        let used = gutter.width() + 3 + t.width();
        let mut spans = vec![
            ("│".to_string(), bs),
            (gutter, Style::new().fg(DIMMER)),
            (format!(" {sign} "), sign_style),
        ];
        if ln.is_none() {
            spans.push((t.clone(), Style::new().fg(DIMMER)));
        } else {
            spans.extend(highlight::line(&t));
        }
        spans.push((" ".repeat(inner.saturating_sub(used)), Style::new()));
        spans.push(("│".to_string(), bs));
        out.push(mk(
            spans,
            bg.map(|c| (c, (indent + 1) as u16, (indent + 1 + inner) as u16)),
        ));
    }
    out.push(mk(vec![(format!("╰{}╯", "─".repeat(inner)), bs)], None));
}

pub mod bg;

use crate::app::{App, Screen};
use ratatui::Frame;

pub fn draw(f: &mut Frame, app: &mut App) {
    let area = f.size();
    app.hits.clear();
    let buf = f.buffer_mut();
    if area.width < 40 || area.height < 12 {
        draw::fill(buf, area, theme::BG);
        draw::put(
            buf,
            area.x,
            area.y,
            "Terminal too small",
            theme::dim(),
            area,
        );
        return;
    }
    match app.screen {
        Screen::Home => home::draw(app, buf, area),
        Screen::Chat => chat::draw(app, buf, area),
        Screen::Terminal => terminal::draw(app, buf, area),
    }
    if app.android_full {
        phone::draw(app, buf, area);
    }
    if app.slash.is_some() {
        palette::draw_slash(app, buf, area);
    } else if app.tree.is_some() {
        palette::draw_tree(app, buf, area);
    } else if app.settings.is_some() {
        palette::draw_settings(app, buf, area);
    } else if app.palette.is_some() {
        palette::draw_palette(app, buf, area);
    } else {
        palette::draw_tooltip(app, buf, area);
    }
    // The permission popup is topmost (below only the transient toast): the
    // brain is waiting on the user's y/n, so nothing may hide it.
    if !app.pending_approval.is_empty() {
        palette::draw_permission(app, buf, area);
    }
    palette::draw_toast(app, buf, area);
}
