//! Command palette overlay, tooltip and toast.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use crate::app::{Action, App, Hit, COMMANDS};
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

fn darken(buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    for y in area.y..area.bottom() {
        for x in area.x..area.right() {
            let c = buf.get_mut(x, y);
            let f = match c.fg {
                Color::Rgb(..) => mix(c.fg, Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0), 0.55),
                o => o,
            };
            let b = match c.bg {
                Color::Rgb(..) => mix(c.bg, Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0), 0.55),
                o => o,
            };
            c.set_fg(f);
            c.set_bg(b);
        }
    }
}

pub fn draw_palette(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let Some(p) = &app.palette else { return };
    darken(buf, area);
    let items = p.items();
    let w = 58u16.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));
    let list_h = items.len().clamp(1, 12) as u16;
    let h = list_h + 4;
    let r = Rect::new(
        area.x + (area.width - w) / 2,
        area.y + (area.height.saturating_sub(h)) / 4 + 1,
        w,
        h,
    );
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(30, 21, 17));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(ORANGE));
    let clip = r;
    put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 1, "Commands", bold(), clip);
    put(buf, r.right() - 6, r.y + 1, "esc", dim(), clip);
    let q = format!("› {}", p.query);
    let qx = put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 2, &q, Style::new().fg(TEXT), clip);
    put(buf, qx, r.y + 2, "▌", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
    let sel = p.sel.min(items.len().saturating_sub(1));
    let mut hits = Vec::new();
    for (row, &idx) in items.iter().take(12).enumerate() {
        let (_, label, key) = COMMANDS[idx];
        let y = r.y + 3 + row as u16;
        let line = Rect::new(r.x + 1, y, r.width - 2, 1);
        if row == sel {
            tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
            put(buf, line.x, y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
        }
        put(
            buf,
            r.x + 3,
            y,
            label,
            if row == sel { bold() } else { text() },
            clip,
        );
        put(buf, r.right() - 2 - key.width() as u16, y, key, dim(), clip);
        hits.push(Hit {
            rect: line,
            action: Action::PaletteRun(idx),
            tip: None,
        });
    }
    if items.is_empty() {
        put(
            buf,
            r.x + 3,
            r.y + 3,
            "No matching commands",
            dimmer(),
            clip,
        );
    }
    hits.push(Hit {
        // No-op swallow (NOT Action::Refresh, which fires an Android Home
        // keypress): clicks inside the panel must not trigger anything.
        rect: r,
        action: Action::Swallow,
        tip: None,
    }); // swallow clicks inside
        // palette hits must win over everything beneath
    app.hits.clear();
    app.hits.extend(hits);
}

pub fn draw_tooltip(app: &App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let Some(a) = app.hover else { return };
    let Some(h) = app
        .hits
        .iter()
        .rev()
        .find(|h| h.action == a && h.tip.is_some())
    else {
        return;
    };
    let (label, key) = h.tip.unwrap();
    let inner_w = label.width() + if key.is_empty() { 0 } else { 2 + key.width() };
    let w = inner_w as u16 + 4;
    let mut x = h.rect.x.saturating_sub(1);
    if x + w > area.right() {
        x = area.right().saturating_sub(w);
    }
    let y = h.rect.bottom();
    if y + 3 > area.bottom() {
        return;
    }
    let r = Rect::new(x, y, w, 3);
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(26, 18, 15));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(BORDER));
    let nx = put(
        buf,
        r.x + 2,
        r.y + 1,
        label,
        Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
        r,
    );
    if !key.is_empty() {
        put(buf, nx + 2, r.y + 1, key, dim(), r);
    }
}

pub fn draw_toast(app: &App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let Some((msg, _)) = &app.toast else { return };
    let w = (msg.width() as u16 + 4).min(area.width.saturating_sub(2)).max(8);
    let r = Rect::new(area.right().saturating_sub(w + 2), area.y + 3, w, 3);
    if r.bottom() > area.bottom() {
        return;
    }
    let shown = truncate_to_width(msg, (w - 4) as usize);
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(34, 24, 19));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(ORANGE));
    put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 1, &shown, Style::new().fg(TEXT), r);
}

pub fn draw_settings(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    use crate::settings::Screen;
    let Some(st) = &app.settings else { return };
    // Reset the mouse hit-test rows for this frame; each screen repopulates
    // them as it draws its clickable rows.
    app.settings_hits.clear();
    darken(buf, area);
    let w = 76u16.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));
    let h = area.height.saturating_sub(6).clamp(16, 32).min(area.height);
    let r = Rect::new(
        area.x + area.width.saturating_sub(w) / 2,
        area.y + area.height.saturating_sub(h) / 2,
        w,
        h,
    );
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(30, 21, 17));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(ORANGE));
    put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 1, "Settings", bold(), r);
    put(
        buf,
        r.right().saturating_sub(19),
        r.y + 1,
        "↑↓ navigate",
        dim(),
        r,
    );
    put(buf, r.right().saturating_sub(6), r.y + 1, "esc", dim(), r);
    let inner = Rect::new(
        r.x + 2,
        r.y + 3,
        r.width.saturating_sub(4),
        r.height.saturating_sub(4),
    );
    match st.screen {
        Screen::Root => {
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.y,
                "Commands · Providers · Config — type to filter, Enter to run.",
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
            let qline = format!("› {}", st.query);
            let qx = put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 2, &qline, Style::new().fg(TEXT), inner);
            put(buf, qx, inner.y + 2, "▌", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
            let items = st.root_items();
            let sel = st.sel.min(items.len().saturating_sub(1));
            let max_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(5) as usize;
            // Keep the selection visible when scrolling.
            let start = sel.saturating_sub(max_rows.saturating_sub(1));
            let mut y = inner.y + 4;
            let mut last_cat: Option<&str> = None;
            let mut drawn = 0usize;
            for (visible_row, (orig_idx, e)) in items.iter().enumerate() {
                if visible_row < start {
                    continue;
                }
                if drawn >= max_rows {
                    break;
                }
                if last_cat != Some(e.category) {
                    if drawn > 0 {
                        y = y.saturating_add(1);
                        if y >= inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    put(buf, inner.x, y, e.category, Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                    y = y.saturating_add(1);
                    last_cat = Some(e.category);
                    if y >= inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                let line = Rect::new(inner.x, y, inner.width, 1);
                app.settings_hits.push(crate::settings::HitRow {
                    x: line.x,
                    y: line.y,
                    w: line.width,
                    h: line.height,
                    kind: crate::settings::RowKind::RootItem(visible_row),
                });
                if visible_row == sel {
                    tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
                    put(buf, line.x, line.y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                }
                let _ = orig_idx; // kept for potential hit-testing
                put(
                    buf,
                    line.x + 2,
                    line.y,
                    e.label,
                    if visible_row == sel { bold() } else { text() },
                    inner,
                );
                if !e.key_hint.is_empty() {
                    let hint_w = e.key_hint.width() as u16 + 2;
                    put(
                        buf,
                        inner.right().saturating_sub(hint_w),
                        y,
                        e.key_hint,
                        dim(),
                        inner,
                    );
                }
                y = y.saturating_add(1);
                drawn += 1;
            }
            if items.is_empty() {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 5,
                    "No matching entries",
                    dimmer(),
                    inner,
                );
            }
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1),
                &format!(
                    "{} items · type to filter · enter to run · esc to close",
                    items.len()
                ),
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
        }
        Screen::Providers => {
            put(buf, inner.x, inner.y, "Choose a provider", bold(), inner);
            let items = st.provider_items();
            let total = romacode_shared::catalog::known_len();
            // Search row — typing filters by display name or provider id.
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.y + 1,
                &format!("› {}▌", st.provider_query),
                Style::new().fg(TEXT),
                inner,
            );
            let start = st.sel.saturating_sub(5);
            let visible = inner.height.saturating_sub(5) as usize;
            for (row, (vis, (_, k))) in items
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .skip(start)
                .take(visible)
                .enumerate()
            {
                let line = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + 3 + row as u16, inner.width, 1);
                // Hit rows carry the VISIBLE index, not the original catalog
                // index, so a click selects the same row the cursor is on.
                app.settings_hits.push(crate::settings::HitRow {
                    x: line.x,
                    y: line.y,
                    w: line.width,
                    h: line.height,
                    kind: crate::settings::RowKind::Provider(vis),
                });
                if vis == st.sel {
                    tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
                    put(buf, line.x, line.y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                }
                put(
                    buf,
                    line.x + 2,
                    line.y,
                    &format!("{}  ·  {}", k.name, k.id),
                    if vis == st.sel { bold() } else { text() },
                    inner,
                );
            }
            // The custom-provider row is ALWAYS the last row, after the
            // filtered list — name → base URL → API key → fetch models.
            let custom_vis = items.len();
            let custom_row = custom_vis.saturating_sub(start);
            if custom_row < visible {
                let line = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + 3 + custom_row as u16, inner.width, 1);
                app.settings_hits.push(crate::settings::HitRow {
                    x: line.x,
                    y: line.y,
                    w: line.width,
                    h: line.height,
                    kind: crate::settings::RowKind::Provider(custom_vis),
                });
                if custom_vis == st.sel {
                    tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
                    put(buf, line.x, line.y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                }
                put(
                    buf,
                    line.x + 2,
                    line.y,
                    "＋ Custom provider…",
                    if custom_vis == st.sel { bold() } else { text() },
                    inner,
                );
            }
            if items.is_empty() {
                put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 3, "No matching providers", dim(), inner);
            }
            if let Some(error) = &st.error {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.bottom().saturating_sub(2),
                    &format!("Error: {error}"),
                    Style::new().fg(Color::Rgb(255, 120, 100)),
                    inner,
                );
            }
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1),
                &format!(
                    "{} of {} · type to filter · enter to choose · esc to close",
                    items.len(),
                    total
                ),
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
        }
        Screen::KnownKey | Screen::CustomName | Screen::CustomBase | Screen::CustomKey => {
            let title = match st.screen {
                Screen::KnownKey => format!("Add API Key · {}", st.provider_name),
                Screen::CustomName => "Add Custom Provider · Name (1/3)".into(),
                Screen::CustomBase => "Add Custom Provider · Base URL (2/3)".into(),
                _ => "Add Custom Provider · API Key (3/3)".into(),
            };
            put(buf, inner.x, inner.y, &title, bold(), inner);
            let prompt = match st.screen {
                Screen::KnownKey | Screen::CustomKey => "API key",
                Screen::CustomBase => "Base URL",
                Screen::CustomName => "Provider name",
                _ => "",
            };
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.y + 2,
                &format!("{prompt}:"),
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
            let mask = matches!(st.screen, Screen::KnownKey | Screen::CustomKey);
            let value = st.input_display(mask);
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x + 2,
                inner.y + 3,
                &format!("› {value}"),
                Style::new().fg(TEXT),
                inner,
            );
            // The screen must always say what it is doing: a model fetch
            // freezes the keys on purpose, so show the spinner — and any
            // failure has to be readable here, or the screen looks dead.
            if st.loading {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 5,
                    "Fetching models… (esc to cancel)",
                    Style::new().fg(ORANGE),
                    inner,
                );
            } else if let Some(error) = &st.error {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 5,
                    &format!("Error: {error}"),
                    Style::new().fg(Color::Rgb(255, 120, 100)),
                    inner,
                );
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 7,
                    "Fix the input and press Enter to retry.",
                    dim(),
                    inner,
                );
            }
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.bottom().saturating_sub(2),
                "Enter to fetch models · Esc to go back",
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
        }
        Screen::Models | Screen::SelectModel => {
            let title = if st.screen == Screen::Models {
                format!("Models from {}", st.provider_name)
            } else {
                "Select Model".into()
            };
            put(buf, inner.x, inner.y, &title, bold(), inner);
            if st.loading {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 2,
                    "Fetching models…",
                    Style::new().fg(ORANGE),
                    inner,
                );
            }
            if let Some(error) = &st.error {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 2,
                    &format!("Error: {error}"),
                    Style::new().fg(Color::Rgb(255, 120, 100)),
                    inner,
                );
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 4,
                    "Fix the input and press Enter to retry.",
                    dim(),
                    inner,
                );
            }
            // Search row — typing filters by model id or provider id.
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.y + 1,
                &format!("› {}▌", st.model_query),
                Style::new().fg(TEXT),
                inner,
            );
            let items = st.model_items();
            let start = st.sel.saturating_sub(5);
            let visible = inner.height.saturating_sub(6) as usize;
            for (row, (vis, idx)) in items
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .skip(start)
                .take(visible)
                .enumerate()
            {
                let line = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + 3 + row as u16, inner.width, 1);
                app.settings_hits.push(crate::settings::HitRow {
                    x: line.x,
                    y: line.y,
                    w: line.width,
                    h: line.height,
                    kind: crate::settings::RowKind::Model(vis),
                });
                if vis == st.sel {
                    tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
                    put(buf, line.x, line.y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                }
                let model = st.models.get(*idx).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
                // Every row shows its own provider. On SelectModel the list is
                // cross-provider, so this is the only way to tell which entry
                // a model belongs to; the same model id may appear twice.
                let pid = st.model_providers.get(*idx).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                let provider_label = if pid.is_empty() {
                    st.provider_name.clone()
                } else {
                    romacode_shared::catalog::find(&pid)
                        .map(|k| k.name.clone())
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| pid.clone())
                };
                let budget = inner.width.saturating_sub(6) as usize;
                let label = truncate_to_width(model, budget);
                put(
                    buf,
                    line.x + 2,
                    line.y,
                    &label,
                    if vis == st.sel { bold() } else { text() },
                    inner,
                );
                if !provider_label.is_empty() {
                    let pl = truncate_to_width(&provider_label, (inner.width / 3) as usize);
                    let pw = pl.width() as u16;
                    put(
                        buf,
                        inner.right().saturating_sub(pw + 2),
                        line.y,
                        &pl,
                        dim(),
                        inner,
                    );
                }
            }
            if items.is_empty() {
                put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 3, "No matching models", dim(), inner);
            }
            // The selected model's official running rules (embedded shared
            // modeldata — same source the server clamps requests with). One
            // dim line under the list; the raw id string is never touched, so
            // selection keeps saving exact model ids.
            if !st.loading {
                if let Some(idx) = st.selected_model_index() {
                    let model = st.models.get(idx);
                    let provider = st
                        .model_providers
                        .get(idx)
                        .cloned()
                        .unwrap_or_else(|| st.provider_id.clone());
                    if let (Some(m), false) = (model, provider.is_empty()) {
                        if let Some(p) = romacode_shared::modeldata::find(&provider, m) {
                            let line = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.bottom().saturating_sub(2), inner.width, 1);
                            put(
                                buf,
                                line.x,
                                line.y,
                                &format!(
                                    "{} — {} ({}{})",
                                    p.display_name,
                                    romacode_shared::modeldata::summary(p),
                                    p.status,
                                    if p.unverified_fields.is_empty() {
                                        ""
                                    } else {
                                        ", some fields unverified"
                                    }
                                ),
                                dim(),
                                inner,
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1),
                &format!(
                    "{} of {} models · type to filter · enter to activate · esc to close",
                    items.len(),
                    st.models.len()
                ),
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
        }
        Screen::Tools => {
            let tools = app.tools.list();
            let names: Vec<String> = tools.iter().map(|t| t.name.clone()).collect();
            let filt = st.tools_filter(&names);
            let cats = app.tools.categories().len();
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.y,
                &format!("Tools — integrated builder ({} tools, {} categories)", tools.len(), cats),
                bold(),
                inner,
            );
            let qline = format!("› {}", st.tools_query);
            let qx = put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 2, &qline, Style::new().fg(TEXT), inner);
            put(buf, qx, inner.y + 2, "▌", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
            let sel = st.tools_sel.min(filt.len().saturating_sub(1));
            let max_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(5) as usize;
            let start = sel.saturating_sub(max_rows.saturating_sub(1));
            let mut y = inner.y + 4;
            let mut last_cat: Option<String> = None;
            let mut drawn = 0usize;
            for (vis, &fi) in filt.iter().enumerate() {
                if vis < start {
                    continue;
                }
                if drawn >= max_rows {
                    break;
                }
                let t = &tools[fi];
                if last_cat.as_deref() != Some(t.category.as_str()) {
                    if drawn > 0 {
                        y = y.saturating_add(1);
                        if y >= inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1) {
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    put(buf, inner.x, y, t.category.as_str(), Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                    y = y.saturating_add(1);
                    last_cat = Some(t.category.clone());
                    if y >= inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                let line = Rect::new(inner.x, y, inner.width, 1);
                app.settings_hits.push(crate::settings::HitRow {
                    x: line.x,
                    y: line.y,
                    w: line.width,
                    h: line.height,
                    kind: crate::settings::RowKind::Tool(vis),
                });
                if vis == sel {
                    tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
                    put(buf, line.x, line.y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), inner);
                }
                put(
                    buf,
                    line.x + 2,
                    line.y,
                    t.name.as_str(),
                    if vis == sel { bold() } else { text() },
                    inner,
                );
                let namew = t.name.width() as u16;
                let desc_w = (inner.width as usize).saturating_sub(namew as usize + 4 + 2);
                let desc: String = t.description.chars().take(desc_w).collect();
                if !desc.is_empty() {
                    put(buf, line.x + 2 + namew + 2, line.y, desc.as_str(), dim(), inner);
                }
                y = y.saturating_add(1);
                drawn += 1;
            }
            if filt.is_empty() {
                put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 5, "No matching tools", dimmer(), inner);
            }
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.bottom().saturating_sub(1),
                &format!("{} tools · Enter to run · Esc back · type to filter · click", filt.len()),
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
        }
        Screen::ToolsInput => {
            let name = st.tools_selected.clone().unwrap_or_default();
            put(buf, inner.x, inner.y, &format!("Run tool · {name}"), bold(), inner);
            if let Some(schema) = app.tools.schema_json(&name) {
                let one: String = schema
                    .lines()
                    .next()
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .chars()
                    .take(inner.width.saturating_sub(2) as usize)
                    .collect();
                put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 2, &format!("schema: {one}"), dim(), inner);
            }
            put(buf, inner.x, inner.y + 4, "Input JSON:", dim(), inner);
            let value = st.input_display(false);
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x + 2,
                inner.y + 5,
                &format!("› {value}"),
                Style::new().fg(TEXT),
                inner,
            );
            if let Some((ok, text)) = &st.tools_result {
                let col = if *ok {
                    Color::Rgb(120, 220, 140)
                } else {
                    Color::Rgb(255, 120, 100)
                };
                let label = if *ok { "result" } else { "error" };
                let mut y = inner.y + 7;
                put(buf, inner.x, y, &format!("{label}:"), Style::new().fg(col), inner);
                y = y.saturating_add(1);
                let cap = inner.height.saturating_sub(10) as usize;
                for line in text.lines().take(cap.max(1)) {
                    let trunc: String = line
                        .chars()
                        .take(inner.width.saturating_sub(2) as usize)
                        .collect();
                    put(buf, inner.x + 2, y, &trunc, Style::new().fg(col), inner);
                    y = y.saturating_add(1);
                }
            } else if let Some(err) = &st.error {
                put(
                    buf,
                    inner.x,
                    inner.y + 7,
                    &format!("Error: {err}"),
                    Style::new().fg(Color::Rgb(255, 120, 100)),
                    inner,
                );
            }
            put(
                buf,
                inner.x,
                inner.bottom().saturating_sub(2),
                "Enter to run · Esc back",
                dim(),
                inner,
            );
        }
    }
}

// ── flat Settings page (Ctrl+P) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/// True when a radio-style Preset row is the currently persisted value.
/// Kept pure so the "mark exactly one option" rule is directly testable:
/// Manual (`prompt`) and Auto accept (`autoaccept`) share one path, so only
/// the row whose pinned value equals the live value may show the mark.
fn preset_is_active(tui: &romacode_shared::tui_settings::TuiSettings, path: &str, value: &str) -> bool {
    tui.get(path).and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(|s| s == value)).unwrap_or(false)
}

/// Draw the ONE-page Settings overlay: every section is a main heading with
/// its subsetting options directly below it — no drilling, no breadcrumb, no
/// sub-screens for plain settings. Rows that open a flow (Models, Providers,
/// Tools, Config file) hand off to the same-titled Settings panel.
pub fn draw_tree(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    if app.tree.is_none() {
        return;
    }
    // The panel is sized to its content but never taller than the terminal:
    // the page scrolls inside the viewport with ▲▼ in the header.
    let rows_total = app.tree.as_ref().map(|t| t.rows().len()).unwrap_or(0) as u16;
    let max_h = area.height.saturating_sub(2).min(34).max(8);
    let h = (rows_total + 6).min(max_h);
    let w = 78u16.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));
    let r = Rect::new(
        area.x + (area.width - w) / 2,
        area.y + (area.height.saturating_sub(h)) / 2,
        w,
        h,
    );
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(30, 21, 17));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(ORANGE));
    let clip = r;
    app.tree_hits.clear();
    let Some(t) = app.tree.as_mut() else { return; };

    // Header: one title, always the same — this is the only Settings screen.
    put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 1, "Settings", bold(), clip);
    // Current permission mode, always visible at the top right.
    let auto = app.cfg.tui.session.permissions == "autoaccept";
    let perm = format!("perm: {}", if auto { "auto accept" } else { "manual" });
    put(
        buf,
        r.right().saturating_sub(perm.width() as u16 + 2),
        r.y + 1,
        &perm,
        if auto { Style::new().fg(GREEN) } else { Style::new().fg(ORANGE) },
        clip,
    );

    // Filter row (typing filters leaves by label or section).
    let mut row_y = r.y + 3;
    let q = format!("› {}", t.query);
    let qx = put(buf, r.x + 2, row_y, &q, Style::new().fg(TEXT), clip);
    put(buf, qx, row_y, "▌", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
    row_y += 2;

    // Snapshot the page state (visual rows, visible leaves, cursor, viewport)
    // while the tree borrow is alive, then release it so the draw loop can
    // touch `app.cfg` / `app.tree_hits` freely.
    let avail = r.bottom().saturating_sub(row_y + 2) as usize; // rows that fit
    let (rows, vis, sel, top, vis_len) = {
        t.clamp_viewport(avail);
        let top = t.top;
        (t.rows(), t.visible_leaves(), t.sel, top, t.visible_leaves().len())
    };

    let inner_right = r.right().saturating_sub(1);
    let label_max = (r.width as usize).saturating_sub(4).max(8);

    // The page itself: headings + leaf rows in one scrollable list.
    let shown = rows.len().min(avail);
    for vi in top..(top + shown).min(rows.len()) {
        let y = row_y + (vi - top) as u16;
        match rows[vi] {
            crate::tree::VRow::Heading(sec) => {
                // A main heading with a rule — the section name, then its
                // subsetting options right below.
                let line_txt = format!("  {sec} ");
                let fill = (r.width as usize).saturating_sub(line_txt.width() + 4);
                let heading = format!("{line_txt}{}", "─".repeat(fill));
                put(buf, r.x + 1, y, &truncate_to_width(&heading, (r.width - 2) as usize), Style::new().fg(ORANGE).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD), clip);
            }
            crate::tree::VRow::Leaf(pos) => {
                let Some((_, n, _)) = vis.get(pos) else { continue; };
                let line = Rect::new(r.x + 1, y, r.width.saturating_sub(2), 1);
                let is_sel = pos == sel;
                if is_sel {
                    tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
                    put(buf, line.x, y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
                }
                let crate::tree::NodeKind::Leaf { owner, leaf, .. } = &n.kind else { continue };
                // A Preset row is a radio choice (Manual / Auto accept):
                // exactly the active option gets the filled mark. Every other
                // row keeps the owner badge (● brain / ○ screen).
                let mut preset_active = false;
                let b: &str = match leaf {
                    crate::tree::Leaf::Preset { path, value } => {
                        preset_active = preset_is_active(&app.cfg.tui, path, value);
                        if preset_active { "●" } else { "○" }
                    }
                    _ => if *owner == crate::tree::Owner::Brain { "●" } else { "○" },
                };
                // Settings show their live value; presets show the active
                // mark; flow rows show what they hand off to.
                let value = match leaf {
                    crate::tree::Leaf::Setting { path } => app.cfg.tui.display(path),
                    crate::tree::Leaf::Preset { .. } => {
                        if preset_active { "✓ active".to_string() } else { String::new() }
                    }
                    crate::tree::Leaf::Dest(d) => match d {
                        crate::tree::Dest::SelectModel => {
                            let m = app.cfg.effective_model();
                            if m.is_empty() {
                                "(none — pick one) ›".to_string()
                            } else {
                                format!("{m} ›")
                            }
                        }
                        crate::tree::Dest::OpenProviders => {
                            format!("{} known + custom ›", romacode_shared::catalog::known_len())
                        }
                        crate::tree::Dest::OpenTools => "38 builtin + MCP ›".to_string(),
                        crate::tree::Dest::OpenConfigFile => "~/.config/romacode ›".to_string(),
                        crate::tree::Dest::PrintEffectiveConfig => "view ›".to_string(),
                        crate::tree::Dest::ResetSettings => "restore ›".to_string(),
                    },
                };
                let label_full = format!("{b}  {}", n.label);
                // A long value (model id, path) may take at most half the row;
                // before, it was drawn straight over the label on narrow panes.
                let value = truncate_to_width(&value, (label_max / 2).max(8));
                // Truncate the label so the value always fits on the right.
                let hint_w = value.width();
                let budget = if hint_w + 2 >= label_max {
                    label_max
                } else {
                    label_max.saturating_sub(hint_w + 2)
                };
                let label = truncate_to_width(&label_full, budget);
                put(buf, line.x + 2, y, &label, if is_sel { bold() } else { text() }, clip);
                if !value.is_empty() {
                    put(buf, inner_right.saturating_sub(hint_w as u16), y, &value, dim(), clip);
                }
                app.tree_hits.push(crate::tree::TreeHit {
                    x: line.x,
                    y: line.y,
                    w: line.width,
                    h: line.height,
                    kind: crate::tree::TreeHitKind::TreeRow(pos),
                });
            }
        }
    }
    if vis_len == 0 {
        put(buf, r.x + 3, row_y, "No matching settings", dimmer(), clip);
    }

    // Scroll indicator + footer.
    let more_above = top > 0;
    let more_below = top + shown < rows.len();
    let scroll = match (more_above, more_below) {
        (true, true) => "▲▼",
        (true, false) => "▲",
        (false, true) => "▼",
        (false, false) => "",
    };
    if !scroll.is_empty() {
        put(buf, r.right().saturating_sub(4), r.y + 1, scroll, Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
    }
    put(
        buf,
        r.x + 2,
        r.bottom().saturating_sub(1),
        // The selected row's hint leads the footer: a live one-line
        // description of what the cursor is on ("Theme — color palette").
        &{
            let sel_hint = vis
                .get(sel.min(vis.len().saturating_sub(1)))
                .and_then(|(_, n, _)| match &n.kind {
                    crate::tree::NodeKind::Leaf { hint, .. } => Some(*hint),
                    _ => None,
                })
                .filter(|h| !h.is_empty());
            let base = "↑↓ move · ←→ change · Enter open · type to filter · esc close";
            let footer = match sel_hint {
                Some(h) => format!("{h}  ·  ↑↓ move · ←→ change · Enter open · esc close"),
                None => base.to_string(),
            };
            truncate_to_width(&footer, (r.width.saturating_sub(4)) as usize)
        },
        dim(),
        clip,
    );
    // The panel background swallows stray clicks without activating row 0.
    app.tree_hits.push(crate::tree::TreeHit {
        x: r.x,
        y: r.y,
        w: r.width,
        h: r.height,
        kind: crate::tree::TreeHitKind::Panel,
    });
    app.hits.clear();
}

/// Truncate `s` to fit within `max` display columns, appending `…` if cut.
fn truncate_to_width(s: &str, max: usize) -> String {
    use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;
    if max == 0 {
        return String::new();
    }
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut w = 0usize;
    for ch in s.chars() {
        let cw = unicode_width::UnicodeWidthChar::width(ch).unwrap_or(0);
        if w + cw > max.saturating_sub(1) {
            break;
        }
        out.push(ch);
        w += cw;
    }
    let full_w = UnicodeWidthStr::width(s);
    if full_w > max {
        out.push('…');
    }
    out
}

// ── `/` slash menu (chat) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Draw the `/` slash menu popup over the chat input: a filtered list of
/// every tree leaf. The user types after the slash to filter; Enter runs
/// the selected leaf (toggle, choice, or destination screen).
pub fn draw_slash(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let Some(m) = app.slash.as_mut() else { return; };
    let w = 60u16.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4));
    let max_rows = 10usize;
    let avail = m.items.len().min(max_rows);
    let list_h = avail.max(1) as u16;
    let h = list_h + 5;
    // anchor above the bottom of the screen (where the chat input lives)
    let y = area.bottom().saturating_sub(h + 2).max(area.y + 4);
    let r = Rect::new(area.x + (area.width - w) / 2, y, w, h);
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(30, 21, 17));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(ORANGE));
    let clip = r;
    put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 1, "Command Menu", bold(), clip);
    let q = format!("/{}", m.query);
    let qx = put(buf, r.x + 2, r.y + 2, &q, Style::new().fg(TEXT), clip);
    put(buf, qx, r.y + 2, "▌", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);

    app.tree_hits.clear();
    let sel = m.sel.min(m.items.len().saturating_sub(1));
    m.clamp_viewport(max_rows);
    let top = m.top;
    let label_max = (r.width as usize).saturating_sub(4).max(8);

    let shown = m.items.len().min(max_rows);
    for vi in 0..shown {
        let i = top + vi;
        let Some(f) = m.items.get(i) else { break; };
        let y = r.y + 3 + vi as u16;
        let line = Rect::new(r.x + 1, y, r.width.saturating_sub(2), 1);
        let is_sel = i == sel;
        if is_sel {
            tint(buf, line, PANEL_HI);
            put(buf, line.x, y, "▎", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
        }
        let badge = if f.owner == crate::tree::Owner::Brain { "●" } else { "○" };
        let label_full = format!("{badge} {}", f.label);
        let label = truncate_to_width(&label_full, label_max);
        put(buf, line.x + 2, y, &label, if is_sel { bold() } else { text() }, clip);
        app.tree_hits.push(crate::tree::TreeHit {
            x: line.x,
            y: line.y,
            w: line.width,
            h: line.height,
            kind: crate::tree::TreeHitKind::SlashRow(i),
        });
    }
    if m.items.is_empty() {
        put(buf, r.x + 3, r.y + 3, "No matching commands", dimmer(), clip);
    }
    // scroll indicator
    let more_above = top > 0;
    let more_below = top + shown < m.items.len();
    if more_above || more_below {
        let s = match (more_above, more_below) {
            (true, true) => "▲▼",
            (true, false) => "▲",
            (false, true) => "▼",
            _ => "",
        };
        put(buf, r.right().saturating_sub(4), r.y + 1, s, Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
    }
    put(
        buf,
        r.x + 2,
        r.bottom().saturating_sub(1),
        "↑↓ nav · enter run · esc close",
        dim(),
        clip,
    );
    app.tree_hits.push(crate::tree::TreeHit {
        x: r.x,
        y: r.y,
        w: r.width,
        h: r.height,
        kind: crate::tree::TreeHitKind::Panel,
    });
    app.hits.clear();
}

// ── permission popup (approval requests) ────────────────────────────────────

/// Modal allow/deny popup for a pending tool approval. The brain raises it
/// with an `ApprovalRequest` event (request id + exact pending effect); the
/// user answers with y / n / esc or by clicking the buttons, and the answer
/// goes back over the wire as `ClientRequest::Approval`. Drawn last so it
/// sits above every other overlay.
pub fn draw_permission(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    use crate::app::PermHit;
    let Some(p) = app.pending_approval.first() else {
        app.perm_hits.clear();
        return;
    };
    app.perm_hits.clear();
    darken(buf, area);

    let w = 68u16.min(area.width.saturating_sub(4)).max(26);
    let inner_w = w.saturating_sub(6) as usize;
    let effect_lines = wrap_plain(&p.effect, inner_w);
    // keep the popup on screen: title + tool + effect + buttons + hint + borders
    let max_effect = (area.height.saturating_sub(10)).max(1) as usize;
    let shown = effect_lines.len().min(max_effect);
    let h = (8 + shown as u16).min(area.height.saturating_sub(2));
    let r = Rect::new(
        area.x + (area.width.saturating_sub(w)) / 2,
        area.y + (area.height.saturating_sub(h)) / 2,
        w,
        h,
    );
    fill(buf, r, Color::Rgb(36, 25, 19));
    rounded_box(buf, r, Style::new().fg(ORANGE));
    let clip = r;
    let inner = Rect::new(
        r.x + 2,
        r.y + 1,
        r.width.saturating_sub(4),
        r.height.saturating_sub(2),
    );

    put(
        buf,
        inner.x,
        inner.y,
        "PERMISSION REQUIRED",
        Style::new().fg(YELLOW).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
        clip,
    );
    put(buf, inner.right().saturating_sub(3), inner.y, "esc", dim(), clip);

    let tool_line = format!("{} wants to run (session {}):", p.name, p.session_id);
    put(
        buf,
        inner.x,
        inner.y + 2,
        &truncate_to_width(&tool_line, inner.width as usize),
        accent_bold(),
        clip,
    );

    let mut y = inner.y + 3;
    for line in effect_lines.iter().take(shown) {
        put(buf, inner.x, y, line, text(), clip);
        y += 1;
    }
    if effect_lines.len() > shown {
        let more = format!(
            "… +{} more lines (full effect is in the transcript)",
            effect_lines.len() - shown
        );
        put(
            buf,
            inner.x,
            y,
            &truncate_to_width(&more, inner.width as usize),
            dimmer(),
            clip,
        );
    }

    // Buttons — recorded as hit rows so a click answers the approval.
    let by = r.bottom().saturating_sub(3);
    let allow_label = " [Y] Allow once ";
    let deny_label = " [N] Deny ";
    let aw = allow_label.width() as u16;
    let dw = deny_label.width() as u16;
    let ax = r.x + 3;
    let dx = ax + aw + 3;
    if dx + dw < r.right().saturating_sub(1) {
        let arect = Rect::new(ax, by, aw, 1);
        let drect = Rect::new(dx, by, dw, 1);
        app.perm_hits.push(PermHit {
            x: arect.x,
            y: arect.y,
            w: arect.width,
            h: arect.height,
            allow: true,
        });
        app.perm_hits.push(PermHit {
            x: drect.x,
            y: drect.y,
            w: drect.width,
            h: drect.height,
            allow: false,
        });
        fill(buf, arect, DIFF_ADD);
        put(
            buf,
            ax,
            by,
            allow_label,
            Style::new().fg(GREEN).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            arect,
        );
        fill(buf, drect, DIFF_DEL);
        put(
            buf,
            dx,
            by,
            deny_label,
            Style::new().fg(RED).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            drect,
        );
    }
    put(
        buf,
        inner.x,
        r.bottom().saturating_sub(2),
        "y allow once · n / esc deny · ctrl+c interrupt the turn",
        dim(),
        clip,
    );
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::preset_is_active;
    use romacode_shared::tui_settings::TuiSettings;

    #[test]
    fn permission_mark_follows_the_live_value() {
        let mut tui = TuiSettings::default();
        assert_eq!(tui.session.permissions, "autoaccept");
        assert!(!preset_is_active(&tui, "session.permissions", "prompt"));
        assert!(preset_is_active(&tui, "session.permissions", "autoaccept"));

        tui.set("session.permissions", &serde_json::json!("prompt")).unwrap();
        assert!(preset_is_active(&tui, "session.permissions", "prompt"));
        assert!(!preset_is_active(&tui, "session.permissions", "autoaccept"));
    }
}

//! Android side panel — renders the selected real target's screen and status.
use super::draw::*;
use super::pixels;
use super::theme::*;
use crate::app::{Action, App, Hit};
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

fn center(buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect, y: u16, text: &str, style: Style, clip: Rect) {
    let w = text.width() as u16;
    let x = area.x + area.width.saturating_sub(w) / 2;
    put(buf, x, y, text, style, clip);
}

pub fn draw(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    app.phone_rect = None;
    if area.width < 30 || area.height < 8 {
        return;
    }
    let clip = area;

    // Header values are queried from the selected Android target (streamed
    // from the brain as Device events).
    let (title, status, ok): (String, String, bool) = match &app.android.status {
        Some(st) if st.phase == "online" => {
            let mut status = format!("{} · {} · {}%", st.model, st.serial, st.battery);
            if app.android.streaming {
                // the frame stream is delivering committed frames
                status.push_str(" · live");
            }
            ("Android device".into(), status, true)
        }
        Some(st) if st.phase.starts_with("error:") => (
            "Android target".into(),
            format!(
                "connection error · {}",
                truncate(st.phase.trim_start_matches("error:"), 32)
            ),
            false,
        ),
        _ => (
            "Android device".into(),
            "waiting for ADB target".into(),
            false,
        ),
    };
    put(buf, area.x + 1, area.y, "▣", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
    // leave the last 11 columns for the three header buttons
    let budget = area.width.saturating_sub(6 + 11) as usize;
    let mut x = put(
        buf,
        area.x + 3,
        area.y,
        &truncate(&title, budget.min(20)),
        bold(),
        clip,
    );
    x = put(buf, x, area.y, "  ·  ", dim(), clip);
    let left = (area.right().saturating_sub(12)).saturating_sub(x);
    put_spans(
        buf,
        x,
        area.y,
        &[
            (
                "● ".into(),
                Style::new().fg(if ok { GREEN } else { DIMMER }),
            ),
            (
                truncate(&status, left as usize).into(),
                Style::new().fg(if ok { GREEN } else { DIM }),
            ),
        ],
        clip,
    );
    // header buttons
    let mut bx = area.right().saturating_sub(2);
    for (label, action, tip, key) in [
        ("✕", Action::CloseDevice, "Close panel", "esc"),
        ("⛶", Action::PhoneFullscreen, "Fullscreen phone", ""),
        ("↻", Action::Refresh, "Home screen", ""),
    ] {
        bx -= 3;
        let r = Rect::new(bx, area.y, 3, 1);
        let hov = app.hover == Some(action);
        tint(buf, r, if hov { PANEL_HI } else { PANEL });
        put(
            buf,
            bx + 1,
            area.y,
            label,
            Style::new().fg(if hov { TEXT } else { DIM }),
            clip,
        );
        app.hits.push(Hit {
            rect: r,
            action,
            tip: Some((tip, key)),
        });
        bx -= 1;
    }

    // the phone (chassis + live screen), centered in the panel body. The last
    // row is kept free for the hint line.
    let body = Rect::new(area.x, area.y + 1, area.width, area.height - 1);
    fill(buf, body, Color::Rgb(18, 13, 11));
    let hint_h = if body.height > 12 { 1 } else { 0 };
    let stage = Rect::new(body.x, body.y, body.width, body.height - hint_h);

    let online = matches!(
        &app.android.status,
        Some(st) if st.phase == "online"
    );
    let waiting = if online {
        ("Streaming…", "waiting for the first frame")
    } else {
        (
            "Waiting for Android target…",
            "Connect an emulator or device through ADB",
        )
    };
    let display = app
        .android
        .status
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.display)
        .unwrap_or((0, 0));
    let hit = pixels::paint_phone(buf, stage, app.android.frame.as_ref(), display, waiting);

    // clicking the live screen opens fullscreen
    app.hits.push(Hit {
        rect: hit,
        action: Action::PhoneFullscreen,
        tip: Some(("Open fullscreen", "")),
    });
    app.phone_rect = Some(hit);

    if hint_h == 1 {
        center(
            buf,
            body,
            body.bottom() - 1,
            "click to open · mouse taps · esc closes",
            dimmer(),
            clip,
        );
    }
}

//! Fullscreen view of the selected real Android emulator or device.

use super::draw::*;
use super::pixels;
use super::theme::*;
use crate::app::App;
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

pub const FOOTER_H: u16 = 1;

pub fn draw(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    // The fullscreen phone paints over the ENTIRE screen; without clearing,
    // stale chat-screen hit rects (tab bar, the invisible "×" close button,
    // mode labels) stayed live underneath — clicking where the "×" used to
    // be closed a session, and tooltips for hidden elements still rendered.
    app.hits.clear();
    fill(buf, area, Color::Rgb(6, 8, 12));
    if area.height < 8 || area.width < 20 {
        return;
    }
    // the phone (chassis + live screen) fills the terminal minus a header/footer strip
    let body = Rect::new(area.x, area.y + 1, area.width, area.height - 2 - FOOTER_H);
    let phase = app.android.status.as_ref().map(|st| st.phase.clone());
    let err = app.android.error();
    let waiting = match (&phase, &err) {
        (Some(p), _) if p == "online" => ("Android device", "waiting for display frame"),
        (_, Some(error)) => ("Android target unavailable", error.as_str()),
        _ => (
            "Waiting for Android target…",
            "started the brain? connect with Android Platform-Tools ADB",
        ),
    };
    let display = app
        .android
        .status
        .as_ref()
        .map(|s| s.display)
        .unwrap_or((0, 0));
    let screen = pixels::paint_phone(buf, body, app.android.frame.as_ref(), display, waiting);
    app.phone_rect = Some(screen);

    // Header: selected target and values reported by Android.
    let line = if let Some(st) = &app.android.status {
        match st.phase.as_str() {
            "online" => format!(
                "Android device · {} · {} · battery {}%",
                st.model, st.serial, st.battery
            ),
            p if p.starts_with("error:") => {
                format!("Android target error · {}", &p["error:".len()..])
            }
            _ => "Waiting for Android target".into(),
        }
    } else {
        "Waiting for Android target".into()
    };
    put(
        buf,
        area.x + 2,
        area.y,
        &truncate(&line, area.width.saturating_sub(24) as usize),
        dim(),
        area,
    );
    let hint = "click tap · drag swipe · type text · enter ⏎ · esc close";
    let hx = area.right().saturating_sub(hint.width() as u16 + 2);
    put(buf, hx, area.y, hint, dimmer(), area);

    // footer
    let fy = area.bottom() - 1;
    put(
        buf,
        area.x + 2,
        fy,
        "Android device — fullscreen",
        dim(),
        area,
    );
    put(
        buf,
        area.right() - 12,
        fy,
        "esc  exit",
        Style::new()
            .fg(TEXT)
            .bg(PANEL_HI)
            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
        area,
    );
}

```rust
//! Phone rendering — draws a device chassis (rim, bezel, speaker, camera,
//! side buttons) and the phone's live RGBA framebuffer inside it.
//!
//! Frame → cells: the screen is point-sampled to a 2 × 2 sub-pixel grid per
//! terminal cell, then every cell picks the best two-colour quadrant glyph
//! (`▘ ▝ ▀ ▖ ▌ ▞ ▛ …`). Compared with plain half-blocks this doubles the
//! horizontal resolution, so text and icons stay crisp instead of smearing.
//!
//! Sampling: **one exact device pixel per grid point**, taken at the centre
//! of that point's source footprint with pure integer math. The previous
//! path ran the frame through a box filter first, which averaged ~15×15
//! device pixels per grid point at these sizes and turned the live view into
//! mush; a point sample keeps every edge crisp — a real pixel render, not a
//! smear. When the grid happens to match the frame size the formula
//! degenerates to an exact 1:1 copy.
//!
//! Geometry: a terminal cell is ~1 : 2 (w : h), so a cell is 2 device pixels
//! wide on screen per 1 px tall; the screen rect is sized so the device
//! aspect ratio comes out right (never cropped, never stretched) and the
//! **whole frame** is always visible edge to edge.

use super::draw::*;
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

/// Cell height / cell width of a typical terminal font.
const CELL_ASPECT: f64 = 2.0;
/// Chassis thickness around the screen, in cells (rim + bezel).
pub const INSET_X: u16 = 2;
pub const INSET_Y: u16 = 2;

const BODY: Color = Color::Rgb(12, 13, 16);
const RIM: Color = Color::Rgb(78, 82, 92);
const RIM_HI: Color = Color::Rgb(122, 127, 140);
const SPEAKER: Color = Color::Rgb(38, 40, 46);
const LENS: Color = Color::Rgb(34, 42, 66);
const OFF_SCREEN: Color = Color::Rgb(6, 7, 9);

/// Quadrant glyphs indexed by mask: bit0 = top-left, bit1 = top-right,
/// bit2 = bottom-left, bit3 = bottom-right.
const QUADS: [&str; 16] = [
    " ", "▘", "▝", "▀", "▖", "▌", "▞", "▛", "▗", "▚", "▐", "▜", "▄", "▙", "▟", "█",
];

type Rgb = [u8; 3];

/// Where the chassis and its screen sit inside an area.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Layout {
    pub outer: Rect,
    pub screen: Rect,
}

/// Largest aspect-correct phone that fits `area`, centered.
/// `aspect` is device width / height (e.g. 720 / 1560).
pub fn layout(area: Rect, aspect: f64) -> Option<Layout> {
    let aspect = if aspect.is_finite() && aspect > 0.1 && aspect < 4.0 {
        aspect
    } else {
        720.0 / 1560.0
    };
    if area.width < 2 * INSET_X + 6 || area.height < 2 * INSET_Y + 4 {
        return None;
    }
    let avail_w = area.width - 2 * INSET_X;
    let avail_h = area.height - 2 * INSET_Y;
    // one cell row is CELL_ASPECT cell-widths tall
    let mut sh = avail_h;
    let mut sw = (aspect * CELL_ASPECT * sh as f64).round() as u16;
    if sw > avail_w {
        sw = avail_w;
        sh = ((sw as f64) / (aspect * CELL_ASPECT)).round() as u16;
    }
    let (sw, sh) = (sw.max(4), sh.clamp(2, avail_h));
    let (ow, oh) = (sw + 2 * INSET_X, sh + 2 * INSET_Y);
    let ox = area.x + (area.width - ow) / 2;
    let oy = area.y + (area.height - oh) / 2;
    Some(Layout {
        outer: Rect::new(ox, oy, ow, oh),
        screen: Rect::new(ox + INSET_X, oy + INSET_Y, sw, sh),
    })
}

/// Paint the chassis and the live screen. Returns the screen rect (what
/// mouse taps are mapped against). `frame = None` shows a blank powered-on
/// screen with `waiting` as its caption.
pub fn paint_phone(
    buf: &mut Buffer,
    area: Rect,
    frame: Option<&crate::device::Frame>,
    display: (u32, u32),
    waiting: (&str, &str),
) -> Rect {
    let aspect = match frame {
        Some(f) if f.w > 0 && f.h > 0 => f.w as f64 / f.h as f64,
        _ if display.0 > 0 && display.1 > 0 => display.0 as f64 / display.1 as f64,
        _ => 0.0,
    };
    let Some(lay) = layout(area, aspect) else {
        return area;
    };
    paint_chassis(buf, lay);
    match frame {
        Some(f) if f.w > 0 && f.h > 0 => paint_screen(buf, lay.screen, f),
        _ => paint_waiting(buf, lay.screen, waiting.0, waiting.1),
    }
    lay.screen
}

// ── chassis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn paint_chassis(buf: &mut Buffer, lay: Layout) {
    let o = lay.outer;
    let clip = buf.area;
    fill(buf, o, BODY);

    let rim = Style::new().fg(RIM).bg(BODY);
    let (x0, y0, x1, y1) = (o.x, o.y, o.right() - 1, o.bottom() - 1);
    put(buf, x0, y0, "╭", rim, clip);
    put(buf, x1, y0, "╮", rim, clip);
    put(buf, x0, y1, "╰", rim, clip);
    put(buf, x1, y1, "╯", rim, clip);
    for x in x0 + 1..x1 {
        put(buf, x, y0, "─", rim, clip);
        put(buf, x, y1, "─", rim, clip);
    }
    for y in y0 + 1..y1 {
        put(buf, x0, y, "│", rim, clip);
        put(buf, x1, y, "│", rim, clip);
    }

    // side buttons on the right edge: volume rocker, then power
    let h = o.height as f64;
    let btn = Style::new().fg(RIM_HI).bg(BODY);
    for (from, to) in [(0.17, 0.26), (0.31, 0.38)] {
        let (a, b) = (
            (h * from) as u16,
            ((h * to) as u16).max((h * from) as u16 + 1),
        );
        for y in a.max(2)..b.min(o.height.saturating_sub(2)) {
            put(buf, x1, y0 + y, "┃", btn, clip);
        }
    }

    // earpiece slot + front camera in the top bezel
    let top = y0 + 1;
    let cx = o.x + o.width / 2;
    let slot = Style::new().fg(SPEAKER).bg(BODY);
    put(buf, cx.saturating_sub(3), top, "▬▬▬▬▬▬", slot, clip);
    put(buf, cx + 5, top, "●", Style::new().fg(LENS).bg(BODY), clip);
}

// ── live screen ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn paint_screen(buf: &mut Buffer, screen: Rect, frame: &crate::device::Frame) {
    let (gw, gh) = (screen.width as u32 * 2, screen.height as u32 * 2);
    if gw == 0 || gh == 0 {
        return;
    }
    let body = [12u8, 13, 16];

    // physical size of one grid pixel (cell = 8 × 16 → grid px = 4 × 8)
    let (pw, ph) = (4.0, 4.0 * CELL_ASPECT);
    let (wmax, hmax) = (gw as f64 * pw, gh as f64 * ph);
    let radius = (wmax * 0.085).min(hmax / 2.0);

    let at = |gx: u32, gy: u32| -> Rgb {
        if outside_corner(gx, gy, pw, ph, wmax, hmax, radius) {
            return body;
        }
        // SHARP: one exact device pixel at the footprint centre — never an
        // average. (`scale_rgba`'s box filter smeared 15×15 px into each
        // grid point and made the live view blurry.)
        let (sx, sy) = src_xy(gx, gy, gw, gh, frame.w, frame.h);
        sample_px(frame, sx, sy)
    };

    for row in 0..screen.height as u32 {
        let y = screen.y as u32 + row;
        if y >= buf.area.bottom() as u32 {
            break;
        }
        for col in 0..screen.width as u32 {
            let x = screen.x as u32 + col;
            if x >= buf.area.right() as u32 {
                break;
            }
            let quad = [
                at(col * 2, row * 2),
                at(col * 2 + 1, row * 2),
                at(col * 2, row * 2 + 1),
                at(col * 2 + 1, row * 2 + 1),
            ];
            let (mask, fg, bg) = best_quadrant(quad);
            let cell = buf.get_mut(x as u16, y as u16);
            cell.set_symbol(QUADS[mask]);
            cell.set_fg(Color::Rgb(fg[0], fg[1], fg[2]));
            cell.set_bg(Color::Rgb(bg[0], bg[1], bg[2]));
        }
    }
}

/// Centre-of-footprint point sample of target pixel `(x, y)` on a
/// `dw × dh` target of a `fw × fh` source. With `fw == dw` (and `fh == dh`)
/// this is the identity map. Exact integer math, no rounding drift.
#[inline]
pub fn src_xy(x: u32, y: u32, dw: u32, dh: u32, fw: u32, fh: u32) -> (u32, u32) {
    let sx = (((2 * x as u64 + 1) * fw as u64) / (2 * dw.max(1) as u64)) as u32;
    let sy = (((2 * y as u64 + 1) * fh as u64) / (2 * dh.max(1) as u64)) as u32;
    (sx.min(fw.saturating_sub(1)), sy.min(fh.saturating_sub(1)))
}

/// Bounds-checked RGBA read.
#[inline]
fn sample_px(frame: &crate::device::Frame, x: u32, y: u32) -> Rgb {
    if x >= frame.w || y >= frame.h {
        return [0, 0, 0];
    }
    let i = ((y as u64 * frame.w as u64 + x as u64) * 4) as usize;
    match frame.rgba.get(i..i + 3) {
        Some(p) => [p[0], p[1], p[2]],
        None => [0, 0, 0],
    }
}

/// True when grid pixel (gx, gy) lies in a rounded display corner's cut-off.
fn outside_corner(gx: u32, gy: u32, pw: f64, ph: f64, w: f64, h: f64, r: f64) -> bool {
    let x = (gx as f64 + 0.5) * pw;
    let y = (gy as f64 + 0.5) * ph;
    let cx = if x < r {
        r
    } else if x > w - r {
        w - r
    } else {
        return false;
    };
    let cy = if y < r {
        r
    } else if y > h - r {
        h - r
    } else {
        return false;
    };
    let (dx, dy) = (x - cx, y - cy);
    dx * dx + dy * dy > r * r
}

/// Choose the two-colour split of a 2 × 2 block with the least error.
/// Returns (glyph mask, foreground, background).
fn best_quadrant(p: [Rgb; 4]) -> (usize, Rgb, Rgb) {
    let mean = |idx: &[usize]| -> Rgb {
        let n = idx.len().max(1) as u32;
        let mut s = [0u32; 3];
        for &i in idx {
            for c in 0..3 {
                s[c] += p[i][c] as u32;
            }
        }
        [(s[0] / n) as u8, (s[1] / n) as u8, (s[2] / n) as u8]
    };
    let err = |idx: &[usize], m: Rgb| -> u32 {
        idx.iter()
            .map(|&i| {
                (0..3)
                    .map(|c| (p[i][c] as i32 - m[c] as i32).pow(2) as u32)
                    .sum::<u32>()
            })
            .sum()
    };

    let all = [0usize, 1, 2, 3];
    let flat = mean(&all);
    let mut best = (0usize, flat, flat);
    let mut best_err = err(&all, flat);
    if best_err == 0 {
        return best;
    }
    // masks 1..=7 cover all seven two-group partitions (bit 3 stays in bg)
    for mask in 1usize..8 {
        let fg_i: Vec<usize> = (0..4).filter(|b| mask & (1 << b) != 0).collect();
        let bg_i: Vec<usize> = (0..4).filter(|b| mask & (1 << b) == 0).collect();
        let (fg, bg) = (mean(&fg_i), mean(&bg_i));
        let e = err(&fg_i, fg) + err(&bg_i, bg);
        if e < best_err {
            best_err = e;
            best = (mask, fg, bg);
        }
    }
    best
}

// ── hit-testing ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Map a terminal cell inside `screen` back to device pixel coordinates.
/// The cell's device footprint centre on the same sampling grid
/// [`paint_screen`] used — clicks land exactly where the pixels came from.
pub fn to_device(screen: Rect, frame: &crate::device::Frame, col: u16, row: u16) -> (u32, u32) {
    let gw = (screen.width.max(1) as u32) * 2;
    let gh = (screen.height.max(1) as u32) * 2;
    let gx = ((col.saturating_sub(screen.x)) as u32) * 2 + 1;
    let gy = ((row.saturating_sub(screen.y)) as u32) * 2 + 1;
    let (dx, dy) = src_xy(gx, gy, gw, gh, frame.w, frame.h);
    (
        dx.min(frame.w.saturating_sub(1)),
        dy.min(frame.h.saturating_sub(1)),
    )
}

// ── placeholder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Dark powered-on screen with a two-line caption (before the first frame).
pub fn paint_waiting(buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect, label: &str, sub: &str) {
    fill(buf, area, OFF_SCREEN);
    let cy = area.y + area.height / 2;
    let caption = |buf: &mut Buffer, y: u16, text: &str, style: Style| {
        let text = truncate(text, area.width as usize);
        let w = text.width() as u16;
        put(
            buf,
            area.x + area.width.saturating_sub(w) / 2,
            y,
            &text,
            style,
            area,
        );
    };
    caption(
        buf,
        cy,
        label,
        Style::new()
            .fg(Color::Rgb(154, 160, 166))
            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
    );
    caption(buf, cy + 1, sub, Style::new().fg(Color::Rgb(106, 112, 120)));
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::Arc;

    const FW: u32 = 720;
    const FH: u32 = 1560;

    /// Left half blue, right half red — a horizontal crop is detectable.
    fn frame() -> crate::device::Frame {
        let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (FW * FH * 4) as usize];
        for y in 0..FH {
            for x in 0..FW {
                let i = ((y * FW + x) * 4) as usize;
                let c = if x < FW / 2 { (0, 0, 255) } else { (255, 0, 0) };
                rgba[i] = c.0;
                rgba[i + 1] = c.1;
                rgba[i + 2] = c.2;
                rgba[i + 3] = 255;
            }
        }
        crate::device::Frame {
            gen: 1,
            w: FW,
            h: FH,
            rgba: Arc::new(rgba),
        }
    }

    /// Top half blue, bottom half red — a vertical crop is detectable.
    fn frame_v() -> crate::device::Frame {
        let mut rgba = vec![0u8; (FW * FH * 4) as usize];
        for y in 0..FH {
            for x in 0..FW {
                let i = ((y * FW + x) * 4) as usize;
                let c = if y < FH / 2 { (0, 0, 255) } else { (255, 0, 0) };
                rgba[i] = c.0;
                rgba[i + 1] = c.1;
                rgba[i + 2] = c.2;
                rgba[i + 3] = 255;
            }
        }
        crate::device::Frame {
            gen: 1,
            w: FW,
            h: FH,
            rgba: Arc::new(rgba),
        }
    }

    fn cell_rgb(c: &ratatui::buffer::Cell) -> (Color, Color) {
        (c.fg, c.bg)
    }

    #[test]
    fn layout_keeps_device_aspect_and_fits() {
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, 120, 52);
        let l = layout(area, 720.0 / 1560.0).unwrap();
        assert!(l.outer.right() <= area.right() && l.outer.bottom() <= area.bottom());
        let phys = (l.screen.width as f64 * 8.0) / (l.screen.height as f64 * 16.0);
        assert!((phys - 720.0 / 1560.0).abs() < 0.02, "aspect {phys}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn layout_narrow_area_is_width_limited() {
        let l = layout(Rect::new(0, 0, 30, 80), 0.46).unwrap();
        assert!(l.outer.width <= 30);
    }

    #[test]
    fn layout_rejects_tiny_areas() {
        assert!(layout(Rect::new(0, 0, 8, 5), 0.46).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn quadrant_picks_exact_split() {
        let (w, k) = ([255u8, 255, 255], [0u8, 0, 0]);
        // left column white, right column black → ▌ (mask 5) fg white bg black
        let (m, fg, bg) = best_quadrant([w, k, w, k]);
        assert_eq!((m, fg, bg), (5, w, k));
        // flat block stays a flat block
        assert_eq!(best_quadrant([w, w, w, w]).0, 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn corners_are_cut_but_center_is_not() {
        let (pw, ph, w, h, r) = (4.0, 8.0, 400.0, 800.0, 34.0);
        assert!(outside_corner(0, 0, pw, ph, w, h, r));
        assert!(!outside_corner(50, 100, pw, ph, w, h, r));
    }

    #[test]
    fn sampling_is_exact_1_to_1_when_sizes_match() {
        for (x, y) in [(0u32, 0u32), (5, 9), (99, 199)] {
            let (sx, sy) = src_xy(x, y, 100, 200, 100, 200);
            assert_eq!((sx, sy), (x, y), "identity map must hold");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn sampling_is_monotonic_and_reaches_both_ends() {
        // At 7:1 downscale point sampling cannot hit every source column
        // (that is what averaging would be for) — but the mapping must be
        // monotonic and must reach both edges of the frame.
        let (dw, dh) = (47u32, 51u32);
        let mut last_y = 0u32;
        for y in 0..dh {
            let mut last_x = 0u32;
            for x in 0..dw {
                let (sx, sy) = src_xy(x * 2, y * 2, dw * 2, dh * 2, FW, FH);
                assert!(sx >= last_x, "x mapping must be monotonic");
                assert!(sy >= last_y, "y mapping must be monotonic");
                last_x = sx;
                last_y = sy;
            }
        }
        let (x0, _) = src_xy(0, 0, dw * 2, dh * 2, FW, FH);
        let (xn, _) = src_xy(dw * 2 - 1, dh * 2 - 1, dw * 2, dh * 2, FW, FH);
        assert!(
            x0 < FW / 10,
            "first sample must be at the frame's left, got {x0}"
        );
        assert!(
            xn > FW * 9 / 10,
            "last sample must be at the frame's right, got {xn}"
        );
        let (_, y0) = src_xy(0, 0, dw * 2, dh * 2, FW, FH);
        let (_, yn) = src_xy(dw * 2 - 1, dh * 2 - 1, dw * 2, dh * 2, FW, FH);
        assert!(y0 < FH / 10);
        assert!(yn > FH * 9 / 10);
    }

    /// THE half-screen regression: the painted screen must span the frame's
    /// full width and height — left edge blue, right edge red, top blue,
    /// bottom red. The old sampler read only x < dw/2 and cropped the right
    /// half of the device out of the live view.
    #[test]
    fn paint_spans_the_full_frame() {
        let fh = frame();
        let fv = frame_v();
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, 127, 55);
        let mut buf = Buffer::empty(area);
        let screen = paint_phone(&mut buf, area, Some(&fh), (FW, FH), ("", ""));
        assert!(
            screen.width >= 40,
            "screen must be reasonably wide, got {screen:?}"
        );

        // horizontal: left edge blue, right edge red (inset 1 cell for the
        // rounded display corners; quarter column so we never sit on the
        // frame's centre split)
        let mid = screen.y + screen.height / 2;
        let left = buf.get(screen.x + 1, mid);
        let right = buf.get(screen.x + screen.width - 2, mid);
        assert_eq!(
            cell_rgb(left).1,
            Color::Rgb(0, 0, 255),
            "left edge must show the frame's left"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            cell_rgb(right).1,
            Color::Rgb(255, 0, 0),
            "right edge must show the frame's right"
        );

        // vertical split: top edge blue, bottom edge red
        let mut buf2 = Buffer::empty(area);
        let screen2 = paint_phone(&mut buf2, area, Some(&fv), (FW, FH), ("", ""));
        let cxt = screen2.x + screen2.width / 4;
        let top2 = buf2.get(cxt, screen2.y + 1);
        let bot2 = buf2.get(cxt, screen2.y + screen2.height - 2);
        assert_eq!(
            cell_rgb(top2).1,
            Color::Rgb(0, 0, 255),
            "top edge must show the frame's top"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            cell_rgb(bot2).1,
            Color::Rgb(255, 0, 0),
            "bottom edge must show the frame's bottom"
        );
    }

    /// Blur regression: the source has only two colours (white, black), so
    /// every painted cell must be built from pure white / pure black — the
    /// box filter turned the boundary into grey-on-grey mush; point sampling
    /// cannot invent a grey that is not in the source. The 8-px line spans
    /// several sampling points, so the line itself must also be visible.
    #[test]
    fn sampling_invents_no_grey_and_shows_wide_features() {
        // frame: all white except a black column band x = 400..408
        let mut rgba = vec![255u8; (FW * FH * 4) as usize];
        for y in 0..FH {
            for x in 400..408 {
                let i = ((y * FW + x) * 4) as usize;
                rgba[i] = 0;
                rgba[i + 1] = 0;
                rgba[i + 2] = 0;
            }
        }
        let f = crate::device::Frame {
            gen: 1,
            w: FW,
            h: FH,
            rgba: Arc::new(rgba),
        };
        let area = Rect::new(0, 0, 127, 55);
        let mut buf = Buffer::empty(area);
        let screen = paint_phone(&mut buf, area, Some(&f), (FW, FH), ("", ""));
        let mid = screen.y + screen.height / 2;
        let (white, black) = (Color::Rgb(255, 255, 255), Color::Rgb(0, 0, 0));
        let mut line_visible = false;
        for x in screen.x..screen.x + screen.width {
            let c = buf.get(x, mid);
            let is_w = c.fg == white && c.bg == white;
            let is_b = c.fg == black && c.bg == black;
            let is_split = (c.fg == white && c.bg == black) || (c.fg == black && c.bg == white);
            assert!(
                is_w || is_b || is_split,
                "grey mush cell at x={x}: fg={:?} bg={:?}",
                c.fg,
                c.bg
            );
            if is_b || (is_split && c.fg == black) {
                line_visible = true;
            }
        }
        assert!(
            line_visible,
            "the 8-px line must show up in the painted screen"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn to_device_covers_the_whole_frame() {
        let f = frame();
        let screen = Rect::new(10, 10, 40, 40);
        let (x0, _) = to_device(screen, &f, screen.x, screen.y);
        let (x1, _) = to_device(screen, &f, screen.x + screen.width - 1, screen.y);
        assert!(x0 < FW / 4, "left edge maps near the frame's left");
        assert!(x1 > FW * 3 / 4, "right edge maps near the frame's right");
        let (_, y0) = to_device(screen, &f, screen.x, screen.y);
        let (_, y1) = to_device(screen, &f, screen.x, screen.y + screen.height - 1);
        assert!(y0 < FH / 4, "top edge maps near the frame's top");
        assert!(y1 > FH * 3 / 4, "bottom edge maps near the frame's bottom");
    }
}

````rust
//! Queued queries: what the user typed while the agent was busy.
//!
//! ```text
//! ═════╡ queued · 2 ╞═══════════════  ctrl+s send · alt+e edit · alt+d delete
//! ▌▣ fix the login redirect too                              ➤  ✎  ✕
//!  ▣ then run the tests again                                ➤  ✎  ✕
//! ═════╡══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//! ```
//! `ctrl+s` (or the ➤ icon) hands the selected query to the agent: it appears
//! in the chat at once and the agent reads it before its next step.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use crate::app::{Action, Hit};
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

/// Rows of queued queries shown at once (the rest scroll with the selection).
pub const MAX_VISIBLE: usize = 3;

/// Total height of the box for `n` queued queries (0 when empty).
pub fn height(n: usize) -> u16 {
    if n == 0 {
        0
    } else {
        2 + n.min(MAX_VISIBLE) as u16
    }
}

fn one_line(s: &str) -> String {
    s.replace('\n', " ⏎ ").replace('\t', " ")
}

pub fn draw(
    buf: &mut Buffer,
    r: Rect,
    queue: &[String],
    sel: usize,
    hover: Option<Action>,
    hits: &mut Vec<Hit>,
) {
    if queue.is_empty() || r.width < 24 || r.height < 3 {
        return;
    }
    let clip = r;
    let rule = Style::new().fg(ORANGE);
    let n = queue.len();
    let sel = sel.min(n - 1);
    let vis = ((r.height - 2) as usize).min(MAX_VISIBLE).min(n);
    let start = sel.saturating_sub(vis.saturating_sub(1)).min(n - vis);

    // ── top rule: ═════╡ queued · n ╞═══…  + key hints
    let head = format!("╡ queued · {n} ╞");
    let mut x = hline_str(buf, r.x, r.y, "═════", rule, clip);
    x = put(buf, x, r.y, &head, Style::new().fg(ORANGE).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD), clip);
    let hint = "ctrl+s send · alt+e edit · alt+d delete";
    let hint_w = hint.width() as u16;
    let show_hint = r.width > x - r.x + hint_w + 4;
    let rule_end = if show_hint { r.right() - hint_w - 2 } else { r.right() };
    while x < rule_end {
        x = put(buf, x, r.y, "═", rule, clip);
    }
    if show_hint {
        put(buf, r.right() - hint_w - 1, r.y, hint, dimmer(), clip);
    }

    // ── rows
    for (vi, i) in (start..start + vis).enumerate() {
        let y = r.y + 1 + vi as u16;
        let row = Rect::new(r.x, y, r.width, 1);
        let is_sel = i == sel;
        let bg = if is_sel { PANEL_HI } else { DARKSPACE };
        fill(buf, row, bg);
        hits.push(Hit {
            rect: row,
            action: Action::QueueSelect(i),
            tip: None,
        });
        put(buf, r.x, y, if is_sel { "▌" } else { " " }, Style::new().fg(ORANGE).bg(bg), clip);
        put(buf, r.x + 1, y, "▣", Style::new().fg(if is_sel { ORANGE } else { DIM }).bg(bg), clip);

        // icons, right-aligned: ➤ send   ✎ edit   ✕ delete
        let icons: [(&str, Action, Color, &'static str, &'static str); 3] = [
            ("➤", Action::QueueSend(i), GREEN, "Send now", "ctrl+s"),
            ("✎", Action::QueueEdit(i), AMBER, "Edit", "alt+e"),
            ("✕", Action::QueueDelete(i), RED, "Delete", "alt+d"),
        ];
        let icons_w = 3 * 3;
        let ix0 = r.right().saturating_sub(icons_w + 1);
        for (k, (g, act, col, tip, key)) in icons.iter().enumerate() {
            let gx = ix0 + k as u16 * 3 + 1;
            let hot = hover == Some(*act);
            let mut st = Style::new().fg(*col).bg(if hot { HOVER } else { bg });
            if hot {
                st = st.add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD | Modifier::UNDERLINED);
            }
            put(buf, gx - 1, y, " ", st, clip);
            put(buf, gx, y, g, st, clip);
            put(buf, gx + 1, y, " ", st, clip);
            hits.push(Hit {
                rect: Rect::new(gx - 1, y, 3, 1),
                action: *act,
                tip: Some((tip, key)),
            });
        }

        // query text between the box icon and the action icons
        let tx = r.x + 3;
        let tw = (ix0.saturating_sub(tx + 1)) as usize;
        let text = truncate(&one_line(&queue[i]), tw);
        let st = if is_sel {
            Style::new().fg(TEXT).bg(bg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
        } else {
            Style::new().fg(TEXT).bg(bg)
        };
        put(buf, tx, y, &text, st, clip);
    }

    // ── bottom rule (shows how many more are queued off-screen)
    let by = r.y + 1 + vis as u16;
    let more = n - vis;
    let tag = if more > 0 { format!("╡ +{more} more ╞") } else { "╡".to_string() };
    let mut x = hline_str(buf, r.x, by, "═════", rule, clip);
    x = put(buf, x, by, &tag, rule, clip);
    while x < r.right() {
        x = put(buf, x, by, "═", rule, clip);
    }
}

/// Write a short literal string; returns the x after it.
fn hline_str(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, s: &str, st: Style, clip: Rect) -> u16 {
    put(buf, x, y, s, st, clip)
}

use ratatui::style::Color;
````
