```rust
//! Right-hand session panel: usage and populated integration/task/file state.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use super::transcript::{cost, fmt_tokens};
use crate::app::App;
use crate::session::*;
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

pub const WIDTH: u16 = 34;

fn header(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, w: u16, title: &str, right: &str, clip: Rect) {
    put(buf, x, y, "▾", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
    put(buf, x + 2, y, title, bold(), clip);
    let rw = right.width() as u16;
    put(buf, x + w.saturating_sub(rw), y, right, dim(), clip);
}

fn divider(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, w: u16, clip: Rect) {
    hline(buf, x, y, w, "─", Style::new().fg(BORDER), clip);
}

fn row_kv(
    buf: &mut Buffer,
    x: u16,
    y: u16,
    w: u16,
    left: &[(String, Style)],
    right: &[(String, Style)],
    clip: Rect,
) {
    put_spans(buf, x, y, left, clip);
    let rw: usize = right.iter().map(|(s, _)| s.width()).sum();
    put_spans(buf, x + w.saturating_sub(rw as u16), y, right, clip);
}

pub fn draw(app: &App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let clip = area;
    fill(buf, area, BG);
    for y in area.y..area.bottom() {
        put(buf, area.x, y, "│", Style::new().fg(BORDER), clip);
    }
    let x = area.x + 2;
    let w = area.width.saturating_sub(4);
    let s = app.session();
    let mut y = area.y + 1;

    // The session stores token high-water marks, not a cumulative context or
    // billing total, so label the meter and configured-rate estimate clearly.
    let total = s.tokens_total();
    let win = app.cfg.context_window.max(1);
    let pct = (total * 100 / win).min(100);
    header(
        buf,
        x,
        y,
        w,
        "Reported Usage",
        &format!("{pct}% peak"),
        clip,
    );
    y += 1;
    put_spans(
        buf,
        x,
        y,
        &[
            (fmt_tokens(total), bold()),
            (format!(" peak / {} context tokens", fmt_tokens(win)), dim()),
        ],
        clip,
    );
    y += 1;
    let filled = ((total as f64 / win as f64) * w as f64)
        .ceil()
        .min(w as f64) as u16;
    let filled = if total > 0 { filled.max(1) } else { 0 };
    for i in 0..w {
        let (c, st) = if i < filled {
            ("━", Style::new().fg(ORANGE))
        } else {
            ("━", Style::new().fg(BORDER))
        };
        put(buf, x + i, y, c, st, clip);
    }
    y += 1;
    put(
        buf,
        x,
        y,
        &format!(
            "~${:.2} peak estimate  ·  {} turns",
            cost(s, &app.cfg),
            s.turns
        ),
        dim(),
        clip,
    );
    y += 2;
    divider(buf, x, y, w, clip);
    y += 2;

    // These sections are rendered only when the session contains actual
    // integration/task/file/server state. Empty model fields are not evidence
    // that the corresponding integration exists or is connected.
    if !s.mcp.is_empty() {
        let on = s.mcp.iter().filter(|m| m.on).count();
        header(
            buf,
            x,
            y,
            w,
            "MCP",
            &format!("{on}/{} on", s.mcp.len()),
            clip,
        );
        y += 1;
        for m in &s.mcp {
            let (dot, c, st) = if m.on {
                ("●", GREEN, text())
            } else {
                ("○", DIMMER, dimmer())
            };
            let right = if m.on {
                format!("{} tools", m.tools)
            } else {
                "off".into()
            };
            row_kv(
                buf,
                x,
                y,
                w,
                &[
                    (format!("{dot} "), Style::new().fg(c)),
                    (m.name.clone(), st),
                ],
                &[(right, if m.on { dim() } else { dimmer() })],
                clip,
            );
            y += 1;
        }
        y += 1;
        divider(buf, x, y, w, clip);
        y += 2;
    }

    if !s.todos.is_empty() {
        let done = s
            .todos
            .iter()
            .filter(|t| t.state == TodoState::Done)
            .count();
        header(
            buf,
            x,
            y,
            w,
            "Todo",
            &format!("{done}/{}", s.todos.len()),
            clip,
        );
        y += 1;
        for t in &s.todos {
            let (icon, ist, tst) = match t.state {
                TodoState::Done => ("✓", Style::new().fg(DIM), dim()),
                TodoState::Active => ("◐", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), bold()),
                TodoState::Open => ("○", Style::new().fg(DIMMER), dim()),
            };
            put(buf, x, y, icon, ist, clip);
            put(
                buf,
                x + 2,
                y,
                &truncate(&t.text, w.saturating_sub(2) as usize),
                tst,
                clip,
            );
            y += 1;
        }
        y += 1;
        divider(buf, x, y, w, clip);
        y += 2;
    }

    if !s.files.is_empty() {
        header(
            buf,
            x,
            y,
            w,
            "Modified Files",
            &s.files.len().to_string(),
            clip,
        );
        y += 1;
        for f in &s.files {
            let mut right = Vec::new();
            if f.added > 0 {
                right.push((format!("+{}", f.added), Style::new().fg(GREEN)));
            }
            if f.removed > 0 {
                right.push((format!(" −{}", f.removed), Style::new().fg(RED)));
            }
            row_kv(
                buf,
                x,
                y,
                w,
                &[(truncate(&f.path, w.saturating_sub(10) as usize), text())],
                &right,
                clip,
            );
            y += 1;
        }
        y += 1;
        divider(buf, x, y, w, clip);
        y += 2;
    }

    if !s.lsp.is_empty() {
        header(buf, x, y, w, "LSP", "", clip);
        y += 1;
        for (name, state) in &s.lsp {
            row_kv(
                buf,
                x,
                y,
                w,
                &[
                    ("● ".into(), Style::new().fg(GREEN)),
                    (name.clone(), text()),
                ],
                &[(state.clone(), dim())],
                clip,
            );
            y += 1;
        }
    }

    // footer: branch + version
    let fy = area.bottom().saturating_sub(2);
    divider(buf, x, fy.saturating_sub(1), w, clip);
    if let Some(b) = &app.branch {
        put_spans(
            buf,
            x,
            fy,
            &[
                ("● ".into(), Style::new().fg(AMBER)),
                (
                    truncate(b, 16),
                    Style::new().fg(AMBER).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
                ),
            ],
            clip,
        );
    }
    let v = concat!("v", env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION"));
    put(buf, x + w - v.width() as u16, fy, v, dim(), clip);
}
```

```rust
//! Session tab bar (top, two rows): hover effects, close button, "+" button.
use super::draw::*;
use super::theme::*;
use crate::app::{Action, App, Device, Hit};
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Modifier, Style},
};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

pub const HEIGHT: u16 = 2;

pub fn draw(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    let clip = area;
    fill(buf, area, BG);
    hline(
        buf,
        area.x,
        area.y + 1,
        area.width,
        "─",
        Style::new().fg(BORDER),
        clip,
    );

    // right cluster, laid out right → left
    let mut rx = area.right().saturating_sub(2);
    let icons: [(&str, Action, Device, &str, &str); 1] = [(
        " ▣ ",
        Action::ToggleAndroid,
        Device::Android,
        "Connect to Android emulator/device via ADB",
        "alt+a",
    )];
    for (label, action, dev, tip, key) in icons {
        let w = label.width() as u16;
        if rx < area.x + w {
            break;
        }
        rx -= w;
        let active = app.device == dev;
        let hov = app.hover == Some(action);
        let r = Rect::new(rx, area.y, w, 1);
        if active || hov {
            tint(buf, r, if active { PANEL_HI } else { HOVER });
        }
        let fg = if active {
            ORANGE
        } else if hov {
            TEXT
        } else {
            DIM
        };
        put(
            buf,
            rx,
            area.y,
            label,
            Style::new().fg(fg).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            clip,
        );
        if active {
            hline(buf, rx, area.y + 1, w, "━", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
        }
        app.hits.push(Hit {
            rect: Rect::new(rx, area.y, w, 2),
            action,
            tip: Some((tip, key)),
        });
        rx = rx.saturating_sub(1);
    }
    let panel_lbl = "ctrl+b panel";
    let pw = panel_lbl.width() as u16;
    if rx >= area.x + pw + 2 {
        rx -= pw;
        let hov = app.hover == Some(Action::TogglePanel);
        put(
            buf,
            rx,
            area.y,
            panel_lbl,
            Style::new().fg(if hov { TEXT } else { DIM }),
            clip,
        );
        app.hits.push(Hit {
            rect: Rect::new(rx, area.y, pw, 1),
            action: Action::TogglePanel,
            tip: Some(("Toggle side panel", "ctrl+b")),
        });
    }
    let limit = rx.saturating_sub(2);

    // tabs
    let n = app.sessions.len();
    let plus_w = 3u16;
    let avail = limit.saturating_sub(area.x + 2 + plus_w + 1) as usize;
    let max_title = ((avail / n.max(1)).saturating_sub(7)).clamp(5, 28);
    let t = app.t();
    let mut x = area.x + 2;
    for i in 0..n {
        let (title, running) = {
            let s = &app.sessions[i];
            (truncate(&s.title, max_title), s.is_running())
        };
        let active = i == app.active;
        let w = (title.width() + 7) as u16;
        if x + w > limit {
            break;
        }
        let tab = Rect::new(x, area.y, w, 1);
        let close = Rect::new(x + w - 3, area.y, 3, 1);
        let hov_tab = app.hover == Some(Action::SelectTab(i));
        let hov_close = app.hover == Some(Action::CloseTab(i));
        if active {
            tint(buf, tab, PANEL_HI);
        } else if hov_tab || hov_close {
            tint(buf, tab, HOVER);
        }
        let dot_c = if running && (t * 4.0) as u32 % 2 == 0 {
            AMBER
        } else if active || running {
            ORANGE
        } else {
            DIMMER
        };
        put(buf, x + 1, area.y, "●", Style::new().fg(dot_c), clip);
        let tstyle = if active {
            Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
        } else if hov_tab || hov_close {
            Style::new().fg(TEXT)
        } else {
            Style::new().fg(DIM)
        };
        put(buf, x + 3, area.y, &title, tstyle, clip);
        if hov_tab || hov_close {
            if hov_close {
                tint(buf, close, BORDER);
            }
            put(
                buf,
                close.x + 1,
                area.y,
                "×",
                Style::new().fg(if hov_close { TEXT } else { DIM }),
                clip,
            );
        }
        if active {
            hline(buf, x, area.y + 1, w, "━", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
        } else if hov_tab || hov_close {
            hline(buf, x, area.y + 1, w, "─", Style::new().fg(DIMMER), clip);
        }
        app.hits.push(Hit {
            rect: tab,
            action: Action::SelectTab(i),
            tip: None,
        });
        app.hits.push(Hit {
            rect: close,
            action: Action::CloseTab(i),
            tip: Some(("Close session", "ctrl+w")),
        });
        x += w + 1;
    }

    // "+" button
    if x + plus_w <= limit + 1 {
        let r = Rect::new(x, area.y, plus_w, 1);
        let hov = app.hover == Some(Action::NewTab);
        if hov {
            tint(buf, r, PANEL_HI);
            put(buf, x - 1, area.y, "▕", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
            put(buf, x + plus_w, area.y, "▏", Style::new().fg(ORANGE), clip);
        }
        put(
            buf,
            x + 1,
            area.y,
            "+",
            Style::new()
                .fg(if hov { ORANGE } else { DIM })
                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
            clip,
        );
        app.hits.push(Hit {
            rect: r,
            action: Action::NewTab,
            tip: Some(("New session", "ctrl+n")),
        });
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Ratatui renderer for Roxterm's VT grid.
use super::draw::{fill, put};
use super::theme;
use crate::app::App;
use ratatui::{
    buffer::Buffer,
    layout::Rect,
    style::{Color, Modifier, Style},
};
use rox_protocol::flags;
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthChar;

pub fn draw(app: &mut App, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
    app.hits.clear();
    fill(buf, area, theme::BG);
    if area.width < 12 || area.height < 4 {
        put(
            buf,
            area.x.saturating_add(1),
            area.y,
            "Terminal area too small",
            theme::dim(),
            area,
        );
        return;
    }

    let header_y = area.y;
    let footer_y = area.bottom() - 1;
    let screen_area = Rect::new(area.x, area.y + 1, area.width, area.height - 2);
    let (rows, cursor, cursor_visible, shell_title, status) =
        if let Some(terminal) = app.terminal.as_mut() {
            if terminal.screen.cols() != screen_area.width as usize
                || terminal.screen.rows() != screen_area.height as usize
            {
                let _ = terminal.resize(screen_area.width, screen_area.height);
            }
            let rows = terminal.visible_rows();
            let cursor = terminal.screen.cursor();
            let visible = terminal.screen.mode_bits & 1 != 0;
            let title = if terminal.screen.title.is_empty() {
                "interactive shell".to_string()
            } else {
                terminal.screen.title.clone()
            };
            let status = terminal.exit_code().map(|code| format!("exited {code}"));
            (rows, cursor, visible, title, status)
        } else {
            (
                Vec::new(),
                (0, 0),
                false,
                "terminal unavailable".to_string(),
                None,
            )
        };

    put(
        buf,
        area.x + 1,
        header_y,
        &format!("ROXTERM  ·  {shell_title}"),
        theme::accent_bold(),
        area,
    );
    if let Some(status) = status {
        let text = format!("{status} · alt+t to return");
        let x = area.right().saturating_sub(text.chars().count() as u16 + 1);
        put(buf, x, header_y, &text, theme::dim(), area);
    }

    for (y, row) in rows.iter().take(screen_area.height as usize).enumerate() {
        let py = screen_area.y + y as u16;
        let mut x = screen_area.x;
        for cell in &row.cells {
            if x >= screen_area.right() {
                break;
            }
            let mut ch = cell.ch;
            if cell.flags & flags::HIDDEN != 0 {
                ch = ' ';
            }
            let width = ch.width().unwrap_or(1).max(1) as u16;
            let mut fg = decode_color(cell.fg, theme::TEXT);
            let mut bg = decode_color(cell.bg, theme::BG);
            let reverse = cell.flags & flags::REVERSE != 0
                || (cursor_visible
                    && cursor.0 as u16 == x.saturating_sub(screen_area.x)
                    && cursor.1 as usize == y);
            if reverse {
                std::mem::swap(&mut fg, &mut bg);
            }
            let mut style = Style::default().fg(fg).bg(bg);
            if cell.flags & flags::BOLD != 0 {
                style = style.add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
            }
            if cell.flags & flags::DIM != 0 {
                style = style.add_modifier(Modifier::DIM);
            }
            if cell.flags & flags::ITALIC != 0 {
                style = style.add_modifier(Modifier::ITALIC);
            }
            if cell.flags & flags::UNDERLINE != 0 {
                style = style.add_modifier(Modifier::UNDERLINED);
            }
            if cell.flags & flags::STRIKEOUT != 0 {
                style = style.add_modifier(Modifier::CROSSED_OUT);
            }
            let symbol = ch.to_string();
            buf.get_mut(x, py).set_symbol(&symbol).set_style(style);
            x = x.saturating_add(width);
        }
    }

    fill(
        buf,
        Rect::new(area.x, footer_y, area.width, 1),
        theme::PANEL,
    );
    put(
        buf,
        area.x + 1,
        footer_y,
        "Native PTY · Roxterm VT · shift+PgUp/PgDn or wheel: scrollback · alt+t return · ctrl+c to shell",
        theme::dim(),
        area,
    );
}

fn decode_color(value: u32, default: Color) -> Color {
    match value & 0xc000_0000 {
        0x4000_0000 => Color::Indexed((value & 0xff) as u8),
        0x8000_0000 => Color::Rgb(
            ((value >> 16) & 0xff) as u8,
            ((value >> 8) & 0xff) as u8,
            (value & 0xff) as u8,
        ),
        _ => default,
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn decodes_roxterm_wire_colors() {
        assert_eq!(
            decode_color(0x4000_0000 | 203, theme::BG),
            Color::Indexed(203)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            decode_color(0x8000_0000 | 0x12_34_56, theme::BG),
            Color::Rgb(0x12, 0x34, 0x56)
        );
        assert_eq!(decode_color(0, theme::BG), theme::BG);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Colour palette, sampled from the RomaCode reference screens.
use ratatui::style::{Color, Modifier, Style};

pub const BG: Color = Color::Rgb(22, 16, 13);
pub const PANEL: Color = Color::Rgb(40, 28, 22);
pub const PANEL_HI: Color = Color::Rgb(52, 37, 29);
pub const HOVER: Color = Color::Rgb(46, 33, 27);
pub const BORDER: Color = Color::Rgb(62, 47, 38);
pub const ORANGE: Color = Color::Rgb(232, 120, 48);
pub const AMBER: Color = Color::Rgb(240, 170, 70);
pub const TEXT: Color = Color::Rgb(244, 232, 218);
pub const DIM: Color = Color::Rgb(150, 130, 114);
pub const DIMMER: Color = Color::Rgb(100, 84, 72);
pub const GREEN: Color = Color::Rgb(142, 204, 112);
pub const RED: Color = Color::Rgb(232, 104, 92);
pub const YELLOW: Color = Color::Rgb(232, 192, 104);
pub const DIFF_ADD: Color = Color::Rgb(34, 64, 36);
pub const DIFF_DEL: Color = Color::Rgb(70, 30, 30);
pub const WATER_HI: Color = Color::Rgb(176, 226, 244);
pub const WATER_LO: Color = Color::Rgb(66, 128, 190);
/// The near-black "space" behind the working box and the queued-query rows.
pub const DARKSPACE: Color = Color::Rgb(9, 8, 17);
pub const STAR: Color = Color::Rgb(255, 236, 190);

pub fn text() -> Style {
    Style::new().fg(TEXT)
}
pub fn bold() -> Style {
    Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
}
pub fn dim() -> Style {
    Style::new().fg(DIM)
}
pub fn dimmer() -> Style {
    Style::new().fg(DIMMER)
}
pub fn accent_bold() -> Style {
    Style::new().fg(ORANGE).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
}

pub fn mix(a: Color, b: Color, t: f32) -> Color {
    let (ar, ag, ab) = rgb(a);
    let (br, bg, bb) = rgb(b);
    let t = t.clamp(0.0, 1.0);
    Color::Rgb(
        (ar as f32 + (br as f32 - ar as f32) * t) as u8,
        (ag as f32 + (bg as f32 - ag as f32) * t) as u8,
        (ab as f32 + (bb as f32 - ab as f32) * t) as u8,
    )
}

pub fn rgb(c: Color) -> (u8, u8, u8) {
    match c {
        Color::Rgb(r, g, b) => (r, g, b),
        _ => (22, 16, 13),
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Builds the full list of transcript rows for a session at a given width.
use super::draw::{truncate, Row};
use super::{markdown, theme::*};
use crate::app::ClientState;
use crate::session::*;
use romacode_shared::protocol::Msg;
use ratatui::style::{Modifier, Style};
use unicode_width::UnicodeWidthStr;

pub fn fmt_tokens(n: u64) -> String {
    if n >= 1_000_000 {
        format!("{:.1}M", n as f64 / 1e6)
    } else if n >= 1000 {
        format!("{:.1}K", n as f64 / 1e3)
    } else {
        n.to_string()
    }
}

pub fn cost(s: &UiSession, cfg: &ClientState) -> f64 {
    // Usage state stores high-water marks, not a cumulative billing total.
    (s.tokens_in as f64 * cfg.price_in_per_mtok + s.tokens_out as f64 * cfg.price_out_per_mtok)
        / 1e6
}

pub fn ensure(s: &mut UiSession, cfg: &ClientState, width: u16) {
    if let Some((w, rev, _)) = &s.cache {
        if *w == width && *rev == s.rev {
            return;
        }
    }
    let rows = build(s, cfg, width as usize);
    s.cache = Some((width, s.rev, rows));
}

/// Collapse whitespace/newlines so a tool argument or result stays on one row.
fn flat(s: &str) -> String {
    s.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
}

fn bar_row(spans: Vec<(String, Style)>, width: usize) -> Row {
    let mut sp = vec![("▎".to_string(), Style::new().fg(ORANGE))];
    sp.extend(spans);
    Row {
        spans: sp,
        bg: Some((PANEL, 1, width as u16)),
    }
}

fn build(s: &UiSession, cfg: &ClientState, width: usize) -> Vec<Row> {
    let mut rows: Vec<Row> = Vec::new();
    if s.messages.is_empty() {
        return rows;
    }
    // ── title block ──
    let pct = if cfg.context_window > 0 {
        s.tokens_total() * 100 / cfg.context_window
    } else {
        0
    };
    let right = format!(
        "{} peak ({}%)  ·  ~${:.2} peak estimate ",
        fmt_tokens(s.tokens_total()),
        pct,
        cost(s, cfg)
    );
    let title = format!(
        "  # {}",
        truncate(&s.title, width.saturating_sub(right.width() + 6))
    );
    let gap = width.saturating_sub(1 + title.width() + right.width());
    rows.push(bar_row(
        vec![
            (title, Style::new().fg(TEXT).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)),
            (" ".repeat(gap), Style::new()),
            (right, dim()),
        ],
        width,
    ));
    rows.push(Row::blank());

    for m in &s.messages {
        match m {
            Msg::User { text: t } => {
                let inner = width.saturating_sub(5);
                for l in super::draw::wrap_plain(t, inner) {
                    rows.push(bar_row(
                        vec![(format!("  {l}"), Style::new().fg(TEXT))],
                        width,
                    ));
                }
                rows.push(Row::blank());
            }
            Msg::Assistant {
                blocks,
                model,
                mode,
                secs,
            } => {
                let mut head = vec![
                    ("◆ ".to_string(), Style::new().fg(ORANGE)),
                    (mode.label().to_string(), accent_bold()),
                    (format!("   {model}"), dim()),
                ];
                if let Some(sec) = secs {
                    head.push((format!("  ·  {sec:.1}s"), dim()));
                }
                rows.push(Row::from(head));
                rows.push(Row::blank());
                let mut prev_tool = false;
                for b in blocks {
                    match b {
                        Block::Text { text: t } => {
                            if prev_tool {
                                rows.push(Row::blank());
                            }
                            markdown::render(t.trim_end_matches('\n'), width, 0, &mut rows);
                            rows.push(Row::blank());
                            prev_tool = false;
                        }
                        Block::Tool {
                            name,
                            arg,
                            status,
                            extra,
                            ..
                        } => {
                            let (icon, ic) = match status {
                                ToolStatus::Ok => ("✓", GREEN),
                                ToolStatus::Running => ("◌", ORANGE),
                                ToolStatus::Failed => ("✗", RED),
                            };
                            let arg_line = flat(arg);
                            let arg_txt =
                                truncate(&arg_line, width.saturating_sub(name.width() + 14));
                            let used = 2 + name.width() + 2 + arg_txt.width();
                            let mut sp = vec![
                                (format!("{icon} "), Style::new().fg(ic)),
                                (
                                    name.clone(),
                                    Style::new().fg(DIM).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
                                ),
                                (format!("  {arg_txt}"), dimmer()),
                            ];
                            if let Some(e) = extra {
                                // one line, and only as much as still fits
                                let room = width.saturating_sub(used + 3);
                                if room >= 6 {
                                    sp.push((
                                        format!("  {}", truncate(&flat(e), room)),
                                        Style::new().fg(GREEN),
                                    ));
                                }
                            }
                            rows.push(Row::from(sp));
                            prev_tool = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if prev_tool {
                    rows.push(Row::blank());
                }
            }
            Msg::Notice { text: t } => {
                for l in super::draw::wrap_plain(t, width.saturating_sub(2)) {
                    rows.push(Row::from(vec![(format!("· {l}"), dim())]));
                }
                rows.push(Row::blank());
            }
            Msg::Error { text: t } => {
                for (i, l) in super::draw::wrap_plain(t, width.saturating_sub(4))
                    .into_iter()
                    .enumerate()
                {
                    let lead = if i == 0 { "✗ " } else { "  " };
                    rows.push(Row::from(vec![(
                        format!("{lead}{l}"),
                        Style::new().fg(RED),
                    )]));
                }
                rows.push(Row::blank());
            }
        }
    }
    // trim trailing blank rows
    while rows.last().map_or(false, |r| r.spans.is_empty()) {
        rows.pop();
    }
    rows
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn transcript_does_not_advertise_unsupported_sharing() {
        let cfg = ClientState::default();
        let mut session = UiSession::new(1);
        session.messages.push(Msg::User {
            text: "Keep the existing conversation visible".into(),
        });

        let rows = build(&session, &cfg, 80);
        let rendered = rows
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|row| row.spans.iter().map(|(text, _)| text.as_str()))
            .collect::<String>();

        assert!(rendered.contains("Keep the existing conversation visible"));
        assert!(!rendered.contains("/share"));
        assert!(!rendered.contains("shareable link"));
    }
}
```

## `crates/client-tui/src/ui/waterfall.rs`

[view on disk](crates/client-tui/src/ui/waterfall.rs)

```rust
//! The "working" box: a small dark-space panel with a waterfall (water spills
//! over a dam crest, falls, and the pool at the base flows inward) and, in the
//! sky above it, a star-like dot that behaves like the model's live response —
//! slow pulse while it thinks, fast twinkle while text streams, a spinning
//! star while a tool runs.
use super::draw::{fill, put};
use super::theme::*;
use crate::session::Live;
use ratatui::{buffer::Buffer, layout::Rect, style::{Color, Style}};

/// Box height: sky (star) + dam crest + falling water + pool.
pub const HEIGHT: u16 = 4;
/// Box width — deliberately small; the label sits to its right.
pub const BOX_W: u16 = 14;

fn hash(i: u32) -> f32 {
    let mut h = i.wrapping_mul(2654435761);
    h ^= h >> 15;
    h = h.wrapping_mul(2246822519);
    h ^= h >> 13;
    (h & 0xFFFF) as f32 / 65535.0
}

/// The star dot for a live state: glyph + colour at time `t` (seconds).
pub fn star(live: &Live, t: f32) -> (&'static str, Color) {
    match live {
        Live::Thinking => {
            const F: [&str; 4] = ["·", "✧", "✦", "✧"];
            let i = ((t * 1.6) as usize) % F.len();
            let pulse = (t * 3.2).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5;
            (F[i], mix(DIMMER, WATER_HI, pulse))
        }
        Live::Streaming => {
            const F: [&str; 6] = ["✦", "✶", "✷", "✸", "✷", "✶"];
            let i = ((t * 11.0) as usize) % F.len();
            let flick = (t * 23.0).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5;
            (F[i], mix(AMBER, STAR, flick))
        }
        Live::Tool(_) => {
            const F: [&str; 4] = ["✢", "✣", "✤", "✥"];
            let i = ((t * 7.0) as usize) % F.len();
            (F[i], ORANGE)
        }
        Live::Waiting => {
            let pulse = (t * 2.0).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5;
            ("·", mix(DIMMER, DIM, pulse))
        }
    }
}

/// Short state word for the label next to the box.
pub fn state_word(live: &Live) -> String {
    match live {
        Live::Thinking => "thinking".into(),
        Live::Streaming => "writing".into(),
        Live::Tool(n) => format!("running {n}"),
        Live::Waiting => "working".into(),
    }
}

/// Draw the box with its top-left corner at (x, y). Everything is clipped to
/// `clip`; callers draw it into a scratch buffer so it can scroll partially.
pub fn draw_box(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, t: f32, live: &Live, clip: Rect) {
    let w = BOX_W;
    fill(buf, Rect::new(x, y, w, HEIGHT), DARKSPACE);

    // static star field with a slow twinkle, drawn first so water covers it
    for r in 0..HEIGHT {
        for i in 0..w {
            let h = hash((i as u32 + 1) * 131 + (r as u32 + 1) * 977);
            if h < 0.09 {
                let tw = ((t * 0.9 + h * 60.0).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.6 + 0.15;
                let ch = if h < 0.03 { "∙" } else { "·" };
                put(buf, x + i, y + r, ch, Style::new().fg(mix(DARKSPACE, WATER_HI, tw * 0.55)), clip);
            }
        }
    }

    // the live star dot, centred in the sky row (row 0)
    let (glyph, col) = star(live, t);
    let cx = x + w / 2;
    // a faint halo while text streams
    if matches!(live, Live::Streaming) {
        let halo = Style::new().fg(mix(DARKSPACE, AMBER, 0.45));
        put(buf, cx - 2, y, "·", halo, clip);
        put(buf, cx + 2, y, "·", halo, clip);
    }
    put(buf, cx, y, glyph, Style::new().fg(col), clip);

    // water: inner width leaves a dark margin either side
    let iw = w - 2;
    let wx = x + 1;
    let center = (iw as f32 - 1.0) / 2.0;
    // row 1 — dam crest with an overflowing lip
    for i in 0..iw {
        let wob = ((i as f32 * 0.9 + t * 3.0).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5) * 0.35;
        put(buf, wx + i, y + 1, "▄", Style::new().fg(mix(ORANGE, AMBER, wob)), clip);
    }
    // row 2 — falling water, streaks move downward
    for i in 0..iw {
        let seed = hash(i as u32 * 7 + 3);
        let speed = 5.0 + seed * 4.0;
        let phase = (t * speed + seed * 20.0).rem_euclid(4.0);
        let (ch, k) = match phase {
            p if p < 0.8 => ("█", 1.0),
            p if p < 1.6 => ("▓", 0.8),
            p if p < 2.4 => ("▒", 0.55),
            p if p < 3.2 => ("░", 0.35),
            _ => (" ", 0.0),
        };
        if k > 0.0 {
            put(buf, wx + i, y + 2, ch, Style::new().fg(mix(WATER_HI, WATER_LO, (1.0 - k) * 0.6)), clip);
        }
    }
    // row 3 — pool: ripples travel from both edges toward the centre
    for i in 0..iw {
        let d = (i as f32 - center).abs();
        let wave = (d * 0.8 + t * 4.2).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5;
        let reach = 1.0 - (d / (center + 1.0)) * 0.55;
        let v = wave * reach;
        let ch = match v {
            v if v > 0.75 => "▄",
            v if v > 0.5 => "▃",
            v if v > 0.28 => "▂",
            _ => "▁",
        };
        put(buf, wx + i, y + 3, ch, Style::new().fg(mix(WATER_LO, WATER_HI, v)), clip);
    }
}
```

```rust
// ============================================================================
// dbengine 1.0.0 — a pure-Rust single-file database engine shipped as an MCP server
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ONE source file -> ONE binary. Zero external crates. std only.
//   Build:   rustc -O --edition 2021 dbengine.rs -o dbengine
//   Run:     ./dbengine serve                (MCP stdio, JSON-RPC 2.0)
//   Test:    ./dbengine selftest
//   Home:    DBENGINE_HOME or $HOME/.dbengine   (--home <dir> to override)
//
// Design centerpiece — KEYS. The whole engine is architected around where key
// data lives in databases: primary keys, foreign keys, unique keys and indexes
// are first-class (local catalog.json + remote information_schema/pg_catalog/
// INFORMATION_SCHEMA), and every novel tool (key-graph navigation, key-addressed
// snapshots/branches/diffs/merges, FK-topological extraction, key-based sync)
// is built on that key-graph foundation.
// ============================================================================

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap, HashSet};
use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::io::{BufRead, Read, Write as IoWrite, BufWriter};
use std::net::TcpStream;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::time::{Duration, SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

pub type R<T> = Result<T, String>;

// ============================================================================
// JSON — value model, parser, writer, pretty printer
// ============================================================================

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum J {
    Null,
    Bool(bool),
    Int(i64),
    Num(f64),
    Str(String),
    Arr(Vec<J>),
    Obj(Vec<(String, J)>),
}

impl J {
    pub fn get(&self, k: &str) -> Option<&J> {
        match self {
            J::Obj(m) => m.iter().find(|(kk, _)| kk == k).map(|(_, v)| v),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> Option<&str> {
        match self {
            J::Str(s) => Some(s),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn as_i64(&self) -> Option<i64> {
        match self {
            J::Int(i) => Some(*i),
            J::Num(f) if f.fract() == 0.0 && f.is_finite() => Some(*f as i64),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn as_f64(&self) -> Option<f64> {
        match self {
            J::Int(i) => Some(*i as f64),
            J::Num(f) => Some(*f),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn as_bool(&self) -> Option<bool> {
        match self {
            J::Bool(b) => Some(*b),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn as_arr(&self) -> Option<&Vec<J>> {
        match self {
            J::Arr(a) => Some(a),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn as_obj(&self) -> Option<&Vec<(String, J)>> {
        match self {
            J::Obj(o) => Some(o),
            _ => None,
        }
    }
    pub fn is_null(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self, J::Null)
    }
    pub fn s(v: &str) -> J {
        J::Str(v.to_string())
    }
    pub fn obj(pairs: Vec<(&str, J)>) -> J {
        J::Obj(pairs.into_iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.to_string(), v)).collect())
    }
}

struct P<'a> {
    b: &'a [u8],
    i: usize,
}

pub fn jparse(s: &str) -> R<J> {
    let mut p = P { b: s.as_bytes(), i: 0 };
    p.ws();
    let v = p.val(0)?;
    p.ws();
    if p.i != p.b.len() {
        return Err("trailing data after json".into());
    }
    Ok(v)
}

fn utf8_len(b: u8) -> usize {
    if b < 0x80 {
        1
    } else if b >> 5 == 0b110 {
        2
    } else if b >> 4 == 0b1110 {
        3
    } else {
        4
    }
}

impl<'a> P<'a> {
    fn ws(&mut self) {
        while self.i < self.b.len() && matches!(self.b[self.i], b' ' | b'\t' | b'\r' | b'\n') {
            self.i += 1;
        }
    }
    fn peek(&self) -> Option<u8> {
        self.b.get(self.i).copied()
    }
    fn val(&mut self, d: u32) -> R<J> {
        if d > 256 {
            return Err("json too deep".into());
        }
        match self.peek().ok_or("unexpected end of json")? {
            b'{' => {
                self.i += 1;
                let mut m = Vec::new();
                self.ws();
                if self.peek() == Some(b'}') {
                    self.i += 1;
                    return Ok(J::Obj(m));
                }
                loop {
                    self.ws();
                    let k = match self.val(d + 1)? {
                        J::Str(s) => s,
                        _ => return Err("object key must be string".into()),
                    };
                    self.ws();
                    if self.peek() != Some(b':') {
                        return Err("expected ':' in object".into());
                    }
                    self.i += 1;
                    self.ws();
                    let v = self.val(d + 1)?;
                    m.push((k, v));
                    self.ws();
                    match self.peek() {
                        Some(b',') => {
                            self.i += 1;
                        }
                        Some(b'}') => {
                            self.i += 1;
                            break;
                        }
                        _ => return Err("expected ',' or '}' in object".into()),
                    }
                }
                Ok(J::Obj(m))
            }
            b'[' => {
                self.i += 1;
                let mut a = Vec::new();
                self.ws();
                if self.peek() == Some(b']') {
                    self.i += 1;
                    return Ok(J::Arr(a));
                }
                loop {
                    self.ws();
                    a.push(self.val(d + 1)?);
                    self.ws();
                    match self.peek() {
                        Some(b',') => {
                            self.i += 1;
                        }
                        Some(b']') => {
                            self.i += 1;
                            break;
                        }
                        _ => return Err("expected ',' or ']' in array".into()),
                    }
                }
                Ok(J::Arr(a))
            }
            b'"' => {
                self.i += 1;
                let mut out = String::new();
                loop {
                    let c = self.peek().ok_or("unterminated string")?;
                    self.i += 1;
                    match c {
                        b'"' => break,
                        b'\\' => {
                            let e = self.peek().ok_or("bad escape")?;
                            self.i += 1;
                            match e {
                                b'"' => out.push('"'),
                                b'\\' => out.push('\\'),
                                b'/' => out.push('/'),
                                b'b' => out.push('\u{0008}'),
                                b'f' => out.push('\u{000C}'),
                                b'n' => out.push('\n'),
                                b'r' => out.push('\r'),
                                b't' => out.push('\t'),
                                b'u' => {
                                    let cp = self.hex4()?;
                                    if (0xD800..0xDC00).contains(&cp) {
                                        if self.peek() == Some(b'\\') {
                                            self.i += 1;
                                            if self.peek() == Some(b'u') {
                                                self.i += 1;
                                                let lo = self.hex4()?;
                                                let c =
                                                    0x10000 + ((cp - 0xD800) << 10) + (lo - 0xDC00);
                                                out.push(
                                                    char::from_u32(c).ok_or("bad surrogate")?,
                                                );
                                                continue;
                                            }
                                        }
                                        return Err("bad surrogate pair".into());
                                    }
                                    out.push(char::from_u32(cp).ok_or("bad unicode")?);
                                }
                                _ => return Err("bad escape char".into()),
                            }
                        }
                        _ => {
                            let start = self.i - 1;
                            let len = utf8_len(c);
                            if start + len > self.b.len() {
                                return Err("bad utf8".into());
                            }
                            self.i = start + len;
                            let s = std::str::from_utf8(&self.b[start..self.i])
                                .map_err(|_| "bad utf8")?;
                            out.push_str(s);
                        }
                    }
                }
                Ok(J::Str(out))
            }
            b't' => {
                self.expect_word("true")?;
                Ok(J::Bool(true))
            }
            b'f' => {
                self.expect_word("false")?;
                Ok(J::Bool(false))
            }
            b'n' => {
                self.expect_word("null")?;
                Ok(J::Null)
            }
            b'-' | b'0'..=b'9' => self.number(),
            _ => Err("unexpected character in json".into()),
        }
    }
    fn expect_word(&mut self, w: &str) -> R<()> {
        if self.b[self.i..].starts_with(w.as_bytes()) {
            self.i += w.len();
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(format!("expected '{}'", w))
        }
    }
    fn hex4(&mut self) -> R<u32> {
        if self.i + 4 > self.b.len() {
            return Err("bad \\u escape".into());
        }
        let s = std::str::from_utf8(&self.b[self.i..self.i + 4]).map_err(|_| "bad \\u")?;
        let v = u32::from_str_radix(s, 16).map_err(|_| "bad \\u escape")?;
        self.i += 4;
        Ok(v)
    }
    fn number(&mut self) -> R<J> {
        let start = self.i;
        if self.peek() == Some(b'-') {
            self.i += 1;
        }
        while let Some(c) = self.peek() {
            if c.is_ascii_digit() {
                self.i += 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        let mut float = false;
        if self.peek() == Some(b'.') {
            float = true;
            self.i += 1;
            while let Some(c) = self.peek() {
                if c.is_ascii_digit() {
                    self.i += 1;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if matches!(self.peek(), Some(b'e') | Some(b'E')) {
            float = true;
            self.i += 1;
            if matches!(self.peek(), Some(b'+') | Some(b'-')) {
                self.i += 1;
            }
            while let Some(c) = self.peek() {
                if c.is_ascii_digit() {
                    self.i += 1;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        let s = std::str::from_utf8(&self.b[start..self.i]).map_err(|_| "bad number")?;
        if !float {
            if let Ok(i) = s.parse::<i64>() {
                return Ok(J::Int(i));
            }
        }
        s.parse::<f64>().map(J::Num).map_err(|_| "bad number".into())
    }
}

fn jwrite(v: &J, out: &mut String) {
    match v {
        J::Null => out.push_str("null"),
        J::Bool(b) => out.push_str(if *b { "true" } else { "false" }),
        J::Int(i) => out.push_str(&i.to_string()),
        J::Num(f) => {
            if f.is_finite() {
                out.push_str(&format!("{}", f));
            } else {
                out.push_str("null");
            }
        }
        J::Str(s) => {
            out.push('"');
            for c in s.chars() {
                match c {
                    '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
                    '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
                    '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
                    '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
                    '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
                    c if (c as u32) < 0x20 => {
                        out.push_str(&format!("\\u{:04x}", c as u32));
                    }
                    c => out.push(c),
                }
            }
            out.push('"');
        }
        J::Arr(a) => {
            out.push('[');
            for (i, x) in a.iter().enumerate() {
                if i > 0 {
                    out.push(',');
                }
                jwrite(x, out);
            }
            out.push(']');
        }
        J::Obj(o) => {
            out.push('{');
            for (i, (k, x)) in o.iter().enumerate() {
                if i > 0 {
                    out.push(',');
                }
                jwrite(&J::Str(k.clone()), out);
                out.push(':');
                jwrite(x, out);
            }
            out.push('}');
        }
    }
}

pub fn jstr(v: &J) -> String {
    let mut s = String::new();
    jwrite(v, &mut s);
    s
}

fn pad(out: &mut String, n: usize) {
    for _ in 0..n {
        out.push(' ');
    }
}

fn pw(v: &J, ind: usize, out: &mut String) {
    match v {
        J::Arr(a) if !a.is_empty() => {
            out.push_str("[\n");
            for (i, x) in a.iter().enumerate() {
                pad(out, ind + 2);
                pw(x, ind + 2, out);
                if i + 1 < a.len() {
                    out.push(',');
                }
                out.push('\n');
            }
            pad(out, ind);
            out.push(']');
        }
        J::Obj(o) if !o.is_empty() => {
            out.push_str("{\n");
            for (i, (k, x)) in o.iter().enumerate() {
                pad(out, ind + 2);
                jwrite(&J::Str(k.clone()), out);
                out.push_str(": ");
                pw(x, ind + 2, out);
                if i + 1 < o.len() {
                    out.push(',');
                }
                out.push('\n');
            }
            pad(out, ind);
            out.push('}');
        }
        _ => jwrite(v, out),
    }
}

pub fn jpretty(v: &J) -> String {
    let mut s = String::new();
    pw(v, 0, &mut s);
    s
}

// ---------------- base64 ----------------

const B64T: &[u8] = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";

fn b64e(d: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for ch in d.chunks(3) {
        let b0 = ch[0] as u32;
        let b1 = *ch.get(1).unwrap_or(&0) as u32;
        let b2 = *ch.get(2).unwrap_or(&0) as u32;
        let n = (b0 << 16) | (b1 << 8) | b2;
        out.push(B64T[((n >> 18) & 63) as usize] as char);
        out.push(B64T[((n >> 12) & 63) as usize] as char);
        if ch.len() > 1 {
            out.push(B64T[((n >> 6) & 63) as usize] as char);
        }
        if ch.len() > 2 {
            out.push(B64T[(n & 63) as usize] as char);
        }
    }
    while out.len() % 4 != 0 {
        out.push('=');
    }
    out
}

fn b64d(s: &str) -> R<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut vals = Vec::new();
    for c in s.bytes() {
        match c {
            b'=' => break,
            b'\r' | b'\n' | b' ' => continue,
            b'A'..=b'Z' => vals.push((c - b'A') as u8),
            b'a'..=b'z' => vals.push((c - b'a' + 26) as u8),
            b'0'..=b'9' => vals.push((c - b'0' + 52) as u8),
            b'+' => vals.push(62),
            b'/' => vals.push(63),
            _ => return Err("bad base64".into()),
        }
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for ch in vals.chunks(4) {
        match ch.len() {
            4 => {
                out.push(ch[0] << 2 | ch[1] >> 4);
                out.push((ch[1] & 0x0f) << 4 | ch[2] >> 2);
                out.push((ch[2] & 0x03) << 6 | ch[3]);
            }
            3 => {
                out.push(ch[0] << 2 | ch[1] >> 4);
                out.push((ch[1] & 0x0f) << 4 | ch[2] >> 2);
            }
            2 => {
                out.push(ch[0] << 2 | ch[1] >> 4);
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

// ---------------- small arg helpers ----------------

pub fn arg_s(a: &J, k: &str) -> R<String> {
    a.get(k)
        .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing string param '{}'", k))
}
pub fn arg_opt_s(a: &J, k: &str) -> Option<String> {
    a.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string())
}
pub fn arg_i64(a: &J, k: &str) -> R<i64> {
    a.get(k)
        .and_then(|x| x.as_i64())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing integer param '{}'", k))
}
pub fn arg_u64_d(a: &J, k: &str, dflt: u64) -> u64 {
    a.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_i64()).map(|v| v.max(0) as u64).unwrap_or(dflt)
}
pub fn arg_bool_d(a: &J, k: &str, dflt: bool) -> bool {
    a.get(k).and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(dflt)
}

fn jget(m: &[(String, J)], k: &str) -> Option<J> {
    m.iter().find(|(kk, _)| kk == k).map(|(_, v)| v.clone())
}

// ============================================================================
// Crypto — MD5, SHA1, SHA256, HMAC, PBKDF2 (needed for Postgres md5/SCRAM and
// MySQL mysql_native_password / caching_sha2 fast auth). std only.
// ============================================================================

const MD5_K: [u32; 64] = [
    0xd76aa478, 0xe8c7b756, 0x242070db, 0xc1bdceee, 0xf57c0faf, 0x4787c62a, 0xa8304613, 0xfd469501,
    0x698098d8, 0x8b44f7af, 0xffff5bb1, 0x895cd7be, 0x6b901122, 0xfd987193, 0xa679438e, 0x49b40821,
    0xf61e2562, 0xc040b340, 0x265e5a51, 0xe9b6c7aa, 0xd62f105d, 0x02441453, 0xd8a1e681, 0xe7d3fbc8,
    0x21e1cde6, 0xc33707d6, 0xf4d50d87, 0x455a14ed, 0xa9e3e905, 0xfcefa3f8, 0x676f02d9, 0x8d2a4c8a,
    0xfffa3942, 0x8771f681, 0x6d9d6122, 0xfde5380c, 0xa4beea44, 0x4bdecfa9, 0xf6bb4b60, 0xbebfbc70,
    0x289b7ec6, 0xeaa127fa, 0xd4ef3085, 0x04881d05, 0xd9d4d039, 0xe6db99e5, 0x1fa27cf8, 0xc4ac5665,
    0xf4292244, 0x432aff97, 0xab9423a7, 0xfc93a039, 0x655b59c3, 0x8f0ccc92, 0xffeff47d, 0x85845dd1,
    0x6fa87e4f, 0xfe2ce6e0, 0xa3014314, 0x4e0811a1, 0xf7537e82, 0xbd3af235, 0x2ad7d2bb, 0xeb86d391,
];
const MD5_S: [u32; 64] = [
    7, 12, 17, 22, 7, 12, 17, 22, 7, 12, 17, 22, 7, 12, 17, 22, 5, 9, 14, 20, 5, 9, 14, 20, 5, 9,
    14, 20, 5, 9, 14, 20, 4, 11, 16, 23, 4, 11, 16, 23, 4, 11, 16, 23, 4, 11, 16, 23, 6, 10, 15,
    21, 6, 10, 15, 21, 6, 10, 15, 21, 6, 10, 15, 21,
];

fn md5(msg: &[u8]) -> [u8; 16] {
    let mut data = msg.to_vec();
    let blen = (data.len() as u64) * 8;
    data.push(0x80);
    while data.len() % 64 != 56 {
        data.push(0);
    }
    data.extend_from_slice(&blen.to_le_bytes());
    let (mut a0, mut b0, mut c0, mut d0) =
        (0x67452301u32, 0xefcdab89u32, 0x98badcfeu32, 0x10325476u32);
    for ch in data.chunks(64) {
        let mut m = [0u32; 16];
        for i in 0..16 {
            m[i] = u32::from_le_bytes(ch[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].try_into().unwrap());
        }
        let (mut a, mut b, mut c, mut d) = (a0, b0, c0, d0);
        for i in 0..64 {
            let (f, g) = match i {
                0..=15 => ((b & c) | (!b & d), i),
                16..=31 => ((d & b) | (!d & c), (5 * i + 1) % 16),
                32..=47 => (b ^ c ^ d, (3 * i + 5) % 16),
                _ => (c ^ (b | !d), (7 * i) % 16),
            };
            let tmp = d;
            d = c;
            c = b;
            let x = a
                .wrapping_add(f)
                .wrapping_add(MD5_K[i])
                .wrapping_add(m[g]);
            b = b.wrapping_add(x.rotate_left(MD5_S[i]));
            a = tmp;
        }
        a0 = a0.wrapping_add(a);
        b0 = b0.wrapping_add(b);
        c0 = c0.wrapping_add(c);
        d0 = d0.wrapping_add(d);
    }
    let mut out = [0u8; 16];
    out[0..4].copy_from_slice(&a0.to_le_bytes());
    out[4..8].copy_from_slice(&b0.to_le_bytes());
    out[8..12].copy_from_slice(&c0.to_le_bytes());
    out[12..16].copy_from_slice(&d0.to_le_bytes());
    out
}

fn sha1(msg: &[u8]) -> [u8; 20] {
    let mut data = msg.to_vec();
    let blen = (data.len() as u64) * 8;
    data.push(0x80);
    while data.len() % 64 != 56 {
        data.push(0);
    }
    data.extend_from_slice(&blen.to_be_bytes());
    let mut h: [u32; 5] = [0x67452301, 0xEFCDAB89, 0x98BADCFE, 0x10325476, 0xC3D2E1F0];
    for ch in data.chunks(64) {
        let mut w = [0u32; 80];
        for i in 0..16 {
            w[i] = u32::from_be_bytes(ch[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].try_into().unwrap());
        }
        for i in 16..80 {
            w[i] = (w[i - 3] ^ w[i - 8] ^ w[i - 14] ^ w[i - 16]).rotate_left(1);
        }
        let (mut a, mut b, mut c, mut d, mut e) = (h[0], h[1], h[2], h[3], h[4]);
        for i in 0..80 {
            let (f, k) = match i {
                0..=19 => ((b & c) | (!b & d), 0x5A827999u32),
                20..=39 => (b ^ c ^ d, 0x6ED9EBA1u32),
                40..=59 => ((b & c) | (b & d) | (c & d), 0x8F1BBCDCu32),
                _ => (b ^ c ^ d, 0xCA62C1D6u32),
            };
            let t = a
                .rotate_left(5)
                .wrapping_add(f)
                .wrapping_add(e)
                .wrapping_add(k)
                .wrapping_add(w[i]);
            e = d;
            d = c;
            c = b.rotate_left(30);
            b = a;
            a = t;
        }
        h[0] = h[0].wrapping_add(a);
        h[1] = h[1].wrapping_add(b);
        h[2] = h[2].wrapping_add(c);
        h[3] = h[3].wrapping_add(d);
        h[4] = h[4].wrapping_add(e);
    }
    let mut out = [0u8; 20];
    for i in 0..5 {
        out[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].copy_from_slice(&h[i].to_be_bytes());
    }
    out
}

const SHA256_K: [u32; 64] = [
    0x428a2f98, 0x71374491, 0xb5c0fbcf, 0xe9b5dba5, 0x3956c25b, 0x59f111f1, 0x923f82a4, 0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98, 0x12835b01, 0x243185be, 0x550c7dc3, 0x72be5d74, 0x80deb1fe, 0x9bdc06a7, 0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1, 0xefbe4786, 0x0fc19dc6, 0x240ca1cc, 0x2de92c6f, 0x4a7484aa, 0x5cb0a9dc, 0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152, 0xa831c66d, 0xb00327c8, 0xbf597fc7, 0xc6e00bf3, 0xd5a79147, 0x06ca6351, 0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85, 0x2e1b2138, 0x4d2c6dfc, 0x53380d13, 0x650a7354, 0x766a0abb, 0x81c2c92e, 0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1, 0xa81a664b, 0xc24b8b70, 0xc76c51a3, 0xd192e819, 0xd6990624, 0xf40e3585, 0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116, 0x1e376c08, 0x2748774c, 0x34b0bcb5, 0x391c0cb3, 0x4ed8aa4a, 0x5b9cca4f, 0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee, 0x78a5636f, 0x84c87814, 0x8cc70208, 0x90befffa, 0xa4506ceb, 0xbef9a3f7, 0xc67178f2,
];

fn sha256(msg: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut data = msg.to_vec();
    let blen = (data.len() as u64) * 8;
    data.push(0x80);
    while data.len() % 64 != 56 {
        data.push(0);
    }
    data.extend_from_slice(&blen.to_be_bytes());
    let mut h: [u32; 8] = [
        0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab,
        0x5be0cd19,
    ];
    for ch in data.chunks(64) {
        let mut w = [0u32; 64];
        for i in 0..16 {
            w[i] = u32::from_be_bytes(ch[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].try_into().unwrap());
        }
        for i in 16..64 {
            let s0 = w[i - 15].rotate_right(7) ^ w[i - 15].rotate_right(18) ^ (w[i - 15] >> 3);
            let s1 = w[i - 2].rotate_right(17) ^ w[i - 2].rotate_right(19) ^ (w[i - 2] >> 10);
            w[i] = w[i - 16]
                .wrapping_add(s0)
                .wrapping_add(w[i - 7])
                .wrapping_add(s1);
        }
        let mut v = h;
        for i in 0..64 {
            let s1 = v[4].rotate_right(6) ^ v[4].rotate_right(11) ^ v[4].rotate_right(25);
            let ch = (v[4] & v[5]) ^ (!v[4] & v[6]);
            let t1 = v[7]
                .wrapping_add(s1)
                .wrapping_add(ch)
                .wrapping_add(SHA256_K[i])
                .wrapping_add(w[i]);
            let s0 = v[0].rotate_right(2) ^ v[0].rotate_right(13) ^ v[0].rotate_right(22);
            let mj = (v[0] & v[1]) ^ (v[0] & v[2]) ^ (v[1] & v[2]);
            let t2 = s0.wrapping_add(mj);
            v[7] = v[6];
            v[6] = v[5];
            v[5] = v[4];
            v[4] = v[3].wrapping_add(t1);
            v[3] = v[2];
            v[2] = v[1];
            v[1] = v[0];
            v[0] = t1.wrapping_add(t2);
        }
        for i in 0..8 {
            h[i] = h[i].wrapping_add(v[i]);
        }
    }
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    for i in 0..8 {
        out[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].copy_from_slice(&h[i].to_be_bytes());
    }
    out
}

fn hmac_sha256(key: &[u8], msg: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut k = key.to_vec();
    if k.len() > 64 {
        k = sha256(&k).to_vec();
    }
    k.resize(64, 0);
    let mut ipad = [0x36u8; 64];
    let mut opad = [0x5cu8; 64];
    for i in 0..64 {
        ipad[i] ^= k[i];
        opad[i] ^= k[i];
    }
    let mut m = ipad.to_vec();
    m.extend_from_slice(msg);
    let ih = sha256(&m);
    let mut mo = opad.to_vec();
    mo.extend_from_slice(&ih);
    sha256(&mo).to_vec()
}

fn hmac_sha1(key: &[u8], msg: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut k = key.to_vec();
    if k.len() > 64 {
        k = sha1(&k).to_vec();
    }
    k.resize(64, 0);
    let mut ipad = [0x36u8; 64];
    let mut opad = [0x5cu8; 64];
    for i in 0..64 {
        ipad[i] ^= k[i];
        opad[i] ^= k[i];
    }
    let mut m = ipad.to_vec();
    m.extend_from_slice(msg);
    let ih = sha1(&m);
    let mut mo = opad.to_vec();
    mo.extend_from_slice(&ih);
    sha1(&mo).to_vec()
}

fn pbkdf2_sha256(pass: &[u8], salt: &[u8], iters: u32, dklen: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut block: u32 = 1;
    while out.len() < dklen {
        let mut saltb = salt.to_vec();
        saltb.extend_from_slice(&block.to_be_bytes());
        let mut u = hmac_sha256(pass, &saltb);
        let mut t = u.clone();
        for _ in 1..iters.max(1) {
            u = hmac_sha256(pass, &u);
            for j in 0..t.len() {
                t[j] ^= u[j];
            }
        }
        out.extend_from_slice(&t);
        block += 1;
    }
    out.truncate(dklen);
    out
}

fn hexe(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    b.iter().map(|x| format!("{:02x}", x)).collect()
}

fn xor_vec(a: &[u8], b: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    a.iter().zip(b.iter()).map(|(x, y)| x ^ y).collect()
}

fn rand_bytes(n: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut v = vec![0u8; n];
    if let Ok(mut f) = fs::File::open("/dev/urandom") {
        if f.read_exact(&mut v).is_ok() {
            return v;
        }
    }
    let t = SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64)
        .unwrap_or(12345);
    let mut st = t;
    for i in 0..n {
        st = st.wrapping_mul(0x9E3779B97F4A7C15).wrapping_add(0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9);
        v[i] = (st >> 33) as u8;
    }
    v
}

// ============================================================================
// Small utilities
// ============================================================================

fn now_ms() -> u64 {
    SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_millis() as u64)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

fn sanitize_name(s: &str) -> R<String> {
    if s.is_empty() || s.len() > 64 {
        return Err("name must be 1..64 chars".into());
    }
    for c in s.chars() {
        if !(c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-') {
            return Err(format!("invalid character '{}' in name (allowed: A-Za-z0-9_-)", c));
        }
    }
    Ok(s.to_string())
}

fn sanitize_col(s: &str) -> R<String> {
    if s.is_empty() || s.len() > 64 {
        return Err("column name must be 1..64 chars".into());
    }
    for c in s.chars() {
        if !(c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_') {
            return Err(format!("invalid character '{}' in column name (allowed: A-Za-z0-9_)", c));
        }
    }
    Ok(s.to_string())
}

/// Sanitize a table name for use in WAL file paths (`wal/<table>.jsonl`):
/// keep [A-Za-z0-9_-] and replace every other character with '_' (so path
/// separators and leading dots can never escape the WAL directory), with a
/// fallback for names that would otherwise be empty.
fn wal_table_name(tname: &str) -> String {
    let s: String = tname
        .chars()
        .map(|c| if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_' || c == '-' { c } else { '_' })
        .collect();
    if s.is_empty() {
        "table".to_string()
    } else {
        s
    }
}

fn atomic_write(path: &Path, data: &str) -> R<()> {
    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
        fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("mkdir {}: {}", parent.display(), e))?;
    }
    let tmp = path.with_extension("tmp");
    fs::write(&tmp, data).map_err(|e| format!("write {}: {}", tmp.display(), e))?;
    fs::rename(&tmp, path).map_err(|e| format!("rename {}: {}", path.display(), e))?;
    Ok(())
}

fn like_match(pat: &str, s: &str) -> bool {
    like_rec(pat.as_bytes(), s.as_bytes())
}
fn like_rec(p: &[u8], s: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if p.is_empty() {
        return s.is_empty();
    }
    match p[0] {
        b'%' => {
            for i in 0..=s.len() {
                if like_rec(&p[1..], &s[i..]) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            false
        }
        b'_' => !s.is_empty() && like_rec(&p[1..], &s[1..]),
        c => !s.is_empty() && s[0] == c && like_rec(&p[1..], &s[1..]),
    }
}

use std::cmp::Ordering;

fn cmp_vals(a: &J, b: &J) -> Option<Ordering> {
    match (a, b) {
        (J::Int(x), J::Int(y)) => Some(x.cmp(y)),
        (J::Int(x), J::Num(y)) => (*x as f64).partial_cmp(y),
        (J::Num(x), J::Int(y)) => x.partial_cmp(&(*y as f64)),
        (J::Num(x), J::Num(y)) => x.partial_cmp(y),
        (J::Str(x), J::Str(y)) => Some(x.cmp(y)),
        (J::Bool(x), J::Bool(y)) => Some(x.cmp(y)),
        // cross numeric-string
        (J::Str(x), J::Int(y)) => x.trim().parse::<i64>().ok().map(|p| p.cmp(y)),
        (J::Int(x), J::Str(y)) => y.trim().parse::<i64>().ok().map(|p| x.cmp(&p)),
        (J::Str(x), J::Num(y)) => x
            .trim()
            .parse::<f64>()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|p| p.partial_cmp(y)),
        (J::Num(x), J::Str(y)) => y
            .trim()
            .parse::<f64>()
            .ok()
            .and_then(|p| x.partial_cmp(&p)),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn jeq(a: &J, b: &J) -> bool {
    matches!(cmp_vals(a, b), Some(Ordering::Equal))
}

// ============================================================================
// STORAGE ENGINE — local databases, tables, rows, keys, WAL, indexes
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Where key data lives (local engine):
//   <home>/databases/<db>/catalog.json    -> schema + PK/FK/unique/index definitions
//   <home>/databases/<db>/wal/<table>.jsonl -> rows, each line keyed by PK value
//   in-memory BTreeMap indexes            -> rebuilt from rows on open
//   <home>/snapshots/<db>/<name>.json     -> key-addressed snapshots
//   <home>/extracts/<name>.json           -> portable extract bundles
// ============================================================================

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Col {
    name: String,
    dtype: String, // integer | real | text | boolean | json | any
    nullable: bool,
    auto: bool, // auto-increment (integer)
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Fk {
    cols: Vec<String>,
    ref_table: String,
    ref_cols: Vec<String>,
    on_delete: String, // restrict | cascade
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct IndexDef {
    name: String,
    cols: Vec<String>,
    unique: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct Table {
    name: String,
    cols: Vec<Col>,
    pk: Vec<String>,
    fks: Vec<Fk>,
    uniques: Vec<Vec<String>>,
    indexes: Vec<IndexDef>,
    auto: BTreeMap<String, i64>,
    nocheck: bool, // skip FK enforcement (used for cyclic-key graphs)
    rows: HashMap<String, Vec<(String, J)>>,
    idx: HashMap<String, BTreeMap<String, Vec<String>>>,
    wlines: u64,
}

impl Table {
    fn all_index_defs(&self) -> Vec<(String, Vec<String>, bool)> {
        let mut v = Vec::new();
        if !self.pk.is_empty() {
            v.push(("pk".to_string(), self.pk.clone(), true));
        }
        for (i, u) in self.uniques.iter().enumerate() {
            v.push((format!("u#{}", i), u.clone(), true));
        }
        for (i, f) in self.fks.iter().enumerate() {
            v.push((format!("f#{}", i), f.cols.clone(), false));
        }
        for x in &self.indexes {
            v.push((x.name.clone(), x.cols.clone(), x.unique));
        }
        v
    }
    fn def_for_cols(&self, cols: &[String]) -> Option<String> {
        if !self.pk.is_empty() && self.pk == cols {
            return Some("pk".to_string());
        }
        for (i, u) in self.uniques.iter().enumerate() {
            if u == cols {
                return Some(format!("u#{}", i));
            }
        }
        None
    }
    fn rm_indexes(&mut self, key: &str) {
        for (_, map) in self.idx.iter_mut() {
            map.retain(|_, v| {
                if let Some(p) = v.iter().position(|x| x == key) {
                    v.remove(p);
                }
                !v.is_empty()
            });
        }
    }
    fn add_indexes(&mut self, key: &str, row: &[(String, J)]) {
        for (name, cols, _u) in self.all_index_defs() {
            let vals = colvals(row, &cols);
            let ik = jstr(&J::Arr(vals));
            self.idx
                .entry(name)
                .or_default()
                .entry(ik)
                .or_default()
                .push(key.to_string());
        }
    }
    fn rebuild_indexes(&mut self) {
        self.idx.clear();
        let items: Vec<(String, Vec<(String, J)>)> = self
            .rows
            .iter()
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))
            .collect();
        for (k, row) in items {
            self.add_indexes(&k, &row);
        }
    }
}

fn colvals(row: &[(String, J)], cols: &[String]) -> Vec<J> {
    cols.iter()
        .map(|c| {
            row.iter()
                .find(|(k, _)| k == c)
                .map(|(_, v)| v.clone())
                .unwrap_or(J::Null)
        })
        .collect()
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct Db {
    name: String,
    tables: BTreeMap<String, Table>,
}

// ---------------- coercion ----------------

fn coerce(v: J, dtype: &str, col: &str) -> R<J> {
    Ok(match dtype {
        "integer" => match v {
            J::Null => J::Null,
            J::Int(i) => J::Int(i),
            J::Num(f) => {
                if f.fract() == 0.0 && f.is_finite() {
                    J::Int(f as i64)
                } else {
                    return Err(format!("column '{}': not an integer: {}", col, f));
                }
            }
            J::Bool(b) => J::Int(if b { 1 } else { 0 }),
            J::Str(s) => J::Int(
                s.trim()
                    .parse::<i64>()
                    .map_err(|_| format!("column '{}': invalid integer {:?}", col, s))?,
            ),
            _ => return Err(format!("column '{}': invalid integer value", col)),
        },
        "real" => match v {
            J::Null => J::Null,
            J::Int(i) => J::Num(i as f64),
            J::Num(f) => J::Num(f),
            J::Str(s) => J::Num(
                s.trim()
                    .parse::<f64>()
                    .map_err(|_| format!("column '{}': invalid number {:?}", col, s))?,
            ),
            _ => return Err(format!("column '{}': invalid number value", col)),
        },
        "text" => match v {
            J::Null => J::Null,
            J::Str(s) => J::Str(s),
            J::Bool(b) => J::Str(b.to_string()),
            J::Int(i) => J::Str(i.to_string()),
            J::Num(f) => J::Str(format!("{}", f)),
            _ => return Err(format!("column '{}': invalid text value", col)),
        },
        "boolean" => match v {
            J::Null => J::Null,
            J::Bool(b) => J::Bool(b),
            J::Int(i) => J::Bool(i != 0),
            J::Str(s) => {
                let l = s.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
                match l.as_str() {
                    "true" | "t" | "yes" | "y" | "1" => J::Bool(true),
                    "false" | "f" | "no" | "n" | "0" => J::Bool(false),
                    _ => return Err(format!("column '{}': invalid boolean {:?}", col, s)),
                }
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("column '{}': invalid boolean value", col)),
        },
        "json" | "any" => v,
        other => return Err(format!("column '{}': unknown dtype '{}'", col, other)),
    })
}

// ---------------- engine ----------------

pub struct Engine {
    pub home: PathBuf,
    dbs: HashMap<String, Db>,
}

impl Engine {
    pub fn new(home: PathBuf) -> Engine {
        Engine { home, dbs: HashMap::new() }
    }

    fn db(&mut self, name: &str) -> R<&mut Db> {
        let sname = sanitize_name(name)?;
        if !self.dbs.contains_key(&sname) {
            self.open_db(&sname)?;
        }
        Ok(self.dbs.get_mut(&sname).unwrap())
    }

    fn has_db(&self, name: &str) -> bool {
        self.dbs.contains_key(name)
            || self.home.join("databases").join(name).join("catalog.json").exists()
    }

    fn db_dir(&self, name: &str) -> PathBuf {
        self.home.join("databases").join(name)
    }

    fn open_db(&mut self, sname: &str) -> R<()> {
        let dir = self.db_dir(sname);
        if !dir.exists() {
            fs::create_dir_all(dir.join("wal"))
                .map_err(|e| format!("create db dir: {}", e))?;
            let empty = Db { name: sname.to_string(), tables: BTreeMap::new() };
            atomic_write(&dir.join("catalog.json"), &jstr(&db_to_json(&empty)))?;
        }
        let catp = dir.join("catalog.json");
        let cat = fs::read_to_string(&catp)
            .map_err(|e| format!("read catalog {}: {}", catp.display(), e))?;
        let j = jparse(&cat).map_err(|e| format!("catalog corrupt: {}", e))?;
        let mut db = Db { name: sname.to_string(), tables: BTreeMap::new() };
        if let Some(ts) = j.get("tables").and_then(|x| x.as_arr()) {
            for tv in ts {
                let mut t = table_from_json(tv)?;
                let wal = dir.join("wal").join(format!("{}.jsonl", wal_table_name(&t.name)));
                if let Ok(data) = fs::read_to_string(&wal) {
                    let mut lines = 0u64;
                    for line in data.lines() {
                        if line.trim().is_empty() {
                            continue;
                        }
                        lines += 1;
                        if let Ok(op) = jparse(line) {
                            let kind = op.get("op").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                            match kind {
                                "put" => {
                                    if let (Some(k), Some(r)) = (
                                        op.get("k").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string()),
                                        op.get("r"),
                                    ) {
                                        if let J::Obj(m) = r.clone() {
                                            t.rows.insert(k, m);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                "del" => {
                                    if let Some(k) = op.get("k").and_then(|x| x.as_str()) {
                                        t.rows.remove(k);
                                    }
                                }
                                _ => {}
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    t.wlines = lines;
                }
                t.rebuild_indexes();
                db.tables.insert(t.name.clone(), t);
            }
        }
        self.dbs.insert(sname.to_string(), db);
        // compaction pass
        let tnames: Vec<String> = {
            let d = self.dbs.get(sname).unwrap();
            d.tables.keys().cloned().collect()
        };
        for tn in tnames {
            self.maybe_compact(sname, &tn)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn save_catalog(&mut self, dbname: &str) -> R<()> {
        let sname = sanitize_name(dbname)?;
        let db = self
            .dbs
            .get(&sname)
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("database '{}' not open", sname))?;
        let path = self.db_dir(&sname).join("catalog.json");
        atomic_write(&path, &jstr(&db_to_json(db)))
    }

    fn wal_line(&mut self, dbname: &str, tname: &str, line: &J) -> R<()> {
        let sname = sanitize_name(dbname)?;
        let path = self
            .db_dir(&sname)
            .join("wal")
            .join(format!("{}.jsonl", wal_table_name(tname)));
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("mkdir: {}", e))?;
        }
        let mut f = fs::OpenOptions::new()
            .create(true)
            .append(true)
            .open(&path)
            .map_err(|e| format!("open wal: {}", e))?;
        f.write_all(jstr(line).as_bytes())
            .and_then(|_| f.write_all(b"\n"))
            .map_err(|e| format!("append wal: {}", e))?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn maybe_compact(&mut self, dbname: &str, tname: &str) -> R<()> {
        let sname = sanitize_name(dbname)?;
        let (wlines, nrows) = {
            let d = self.dbs.get(&sname).unwrap();
            let t = match d.tables.get(tname) {
                Some(t) => t,
                None => return Ok(()),
            };
            (t.wlines, t.rows.len())
        };
        if wlines > (nrows * 2).max(256) as u64 {
            let sname2 = sname.clone();
            let tname2 = tname.to_string();
            let mut lines = String::new();
            {
                let d = self.dbs.get(&sname2).unwrap();
                let t = d.tables.get(&tname2).unwrap();
                let mut keys: Vec<&String> = t.rows.keys().collect();
                keys.sort();
                for k in keys {
                    let row = &t.rows[k];
                    let op = J::obj(vec![("op", J::s("put")), ("k", J::s(k)), ("r", J::Obj(row.clone()))]);
                    lines.push_str(&jstr(&op));
                    lines.push('\n');
                }
            }
            let path = self
                .db_dir(&sname2)
                .join("wal")
                .join(format!("{}.jsonl", wal_table_name(&tname2)));
            atomic_write(&path, &lines)?;
            let d = self.dbs.get_mut(&sname2).unwrap();
            let t = d.tables.get_mut(&tname2).unwrap();
            t.wlines = t.rows.len() as u64;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    // -------- row ops --------

    fn put_row(&mut self, dbname: &str, tname: &str, row: &J, upsert: bool) -> R<String> {
        let m = match row {
            J::Obj(m) => m.clone(),
            _ => return Err("row must be an object".into()),
        };
        // phase 1: defs
        let (cols, pk, fks, defs, nocheck) = {
            let db = self.db(dbname)?;
            let t = db
                .tables
                .get(tname)
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("table '{}' not found", tname))?;
            (t.cols.clone(), t.pk.clone(), t.fks.clone(), t.all_index_defs(), t.nocheck)
        };
        for (k, _) in &m {
            if !cols.iter().any(|c| &c.name == k) {
                return Err(format!("unknown column '{}'", k));
            }
        }
        let mut r: Vec<(String, J)> = Vec::new();
        for c in &cols {
            let v = m
                .iter()
                .find(|(k, _)| *k == c.name)
                .map(|(_, v)| v.clone())
                .unwrap_or(J::Null);
            let v = coerce(v, &c.dtype, &c.name)?;
            if v.is_null() && !c.nullable && !c.auto {
                return Err(format!("column '{}' is not nullable", c.name));
            }
            r.push((c.name.clone(), v));
        }
        // auto-increment
        let mut seq_changed = false;
        for c in &cols {
            if c.auto {
                let pos = r.iter().position(|(k, _)| *k == c.name).unwrap();
                if r[pos].1.is_null() {
                    let nv = {
                        let db = self.db(dbname)?;
                        let t = db.tables.get_mut(tname).unwrap();
                        let e = t.auto.entry(c.name.clone()).or_insert(0);
                        *e += 1;
                        *e
                    };
                    r[pos].1 = J::Int(nv);
                    seq_changed = true;
                } else if let Some(iv) = r[pos].1.as_i64() {
                    let db = self.db(dbname)?;
                    let t = db.tables.get_mut(tname).unwrap();
                    let e = t.auto.entry(c.name.clone()).or_insert(0);
                    if iv > *e {
                        *e = iv;
                        seq_changed = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if pk.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!("table '{}' has no primary key", tname));
        }
        let pkv = colvals(&r, &pk);
        if pkv.iter().any(|v| v.is_null()) {
            return Err("primary key columns cannot be null".into());
        }
        let key = jstr(&J::Arr(pkv));
        let existed = {
            let db = self.db(dbname)?;
            db.tables.get(tname).unwrap().rows.contains_key(&key)
        };
        if existed && !upsert {
            return Err(format!("duplicate primary key {} (row already exists)", key));
        }
        // phase 2: checks
        {
            let db = self.db(dbname)?;
            let t = db.tables.get(tname).unwrap();
            for (iname, icols, unique) in &defs {
                if !*unique {
                    continue;
                }
                let vals = colvals(&r, icols);
                if vals.iter().any(|v| v.is_null()) {
                    continue; // SQL semantics: NULLs are distinct in unique keys
                }
                let ik = jstr(&J::Arr(vals));
                if let Some(ks) = t.idx.get(iname).and_then(|m| m.get(&ik)) {
                    if ks.iter().any(|x| x != &key) {
                        return Err(format!(
                            "unique constraint violated on ({})",
                            icols.join(",")
                        ));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if !nocheck {
            let db = self.db(dbname)?;
            for f in &fks {
                let vals = colvals(&r, &f.cols);
                if vals.iter().any(|v| v.is_null()) {
                    continue;
                }
                let ik = jstr(&J::Arr(vals));
                let pt = db
                    .tables
                    .get(&f.ref_table)
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("foreign key references missing table '{}'", f.ref_table))?;
                let dname = pt
                    .def_for_cols(&f.ref_cols)
                    .ok_or_else(|| format!("fk references non-unique columns ({})", f.ref_cols.join(",")))?;
                let ok = pt
                    .idx
                    .get(&dname)
                    .and_then(|m| m.get(&ik))
                    .map(|v| !v.is_empty())
                    .unwrap_or(false);
                if !ok {
                    return Err(format!(
                        "foreign key violation: ({})={} not found in {}.({})",
                        f.cols.join(","),
                        ik,
                        f.ref_table,
```
