```rust
//! Optimal ate pairing for BLS12-381.
//!
//! Straightforward, auditable implementation: the G2 point is untwisted into
//! E(Fp12) and a standard affine Miller loop runs over the bits of |x| =
//! 0xd201000000010000 (x negative → conjugate before the final exponentiation).
//! Only tangent/chord lines are accumulated (vertical lines vanish under the
//! final exponentiation), exactly like every production implementation.
//!
//! Complexity note: the final exponentiation is a plain big-exponent power of
//! Fp12 — slower than the windowed Frobenius decomposition, but trivially
//! correct, which matters more for a verification tool. All results are
//! validated against EIP-2537 official vectors and real mainnet KZG proofs.

use super::curve::{g1_generator, G1Affine, G2Affine};
use super::fp::{r_suborder, Fp};
use super::fp2::Fp2;
use super::fp612::{mul_v, Fp12, Fp6};
use num_bigint::BigUint;
use num_traits::One;

pub const X_NEG: bool = true;
pub const X_ABS_HEX: &str = "d201000000010000";

/// v as an Fp6 element (0, 1, 0); v^-1, v^-2 cached.
fn v_inv() -> Fp6 {
    let v = Fp6::new(Fp2::zero(), Fp2::one(), Fp2::zero());
    v.inv().unwrap()
}

/// Untwist ψ(x, y) = (x/ω², y/ω³) with ω² = v, ω⁶ = ξ.
/// x·ω^-2 = x·v^-1 ; y·ω^-3 = w·(y·v^-2)
pub fn untwist(q: &G2Affine) -> (Fp12, Fp12) {
    let vinv = v_inv();
    let vinv2 = vinv.square();
    let x6 = Fp6::from_fp2(&q.x);
    let y6 = Fp6::from_fp2(&q.y);
    let qx = Fp12::new(x6.mul(&vinv), Fp6::zero());
    let qy = Fp12::new(Fp6::zero(), y6.mul(&vinv2));
    (qx, qy)
}

fn embed_fp12_fp(a: &Fp) -> Fp12 {
    Fp12::new(Fp6::from_fp2(&Fp2::new(a.clone(), Fp::zero())), Fp6::zero())
}

/// The ate pairing e(P, Q); P ∈ G1, Q ∈ G2.
pub fn pairing(p: &G1Affine, q: &G2Affine) -> Fp12 {
    if p.infinity || q.infinity {
        return Fp12::one();
    }
    let (qx, qy) = untwist(q);
    let px = embed_fp12_fp(&p.x);
    let py = embed_fp12_fp(&p.y);

    let xabs = BigUint::parse_bytes(X_ABS_HEX.as_bytes(), 16).unwrap();
    let bits: Vec<bool> = xabs
        .to_bytes_be()
        .iter()
        .flat_map(|b| (0..8).rev().map(move |i| (b >> i) & 1 == 1))
        .collect();
    // skip leading bit (T starts at Q)
    let start = bits.iter().position(|&b| b).unwrap();

    let mut tx = qx.clone();
    let mut ty = qy.clone();
    let mut f = Fp12::one();

    let three = embed_fp12_fp(&Fp::from_u64(3));

    for i in (start + 1..bits.len()) {
        // doubling step: line through 2T evaluated at P
        let lambda = tx.square().mul(&three.clone())
            .mul(&ty.double().inv().unwrap());
        let x3 = lambda.square().sub(&tx.double());
        let y3 = lambda.mul(&tx.sub(&x3)).sub(&ty.clone());
        // line: (yp - ty) - λ(xp - tx)
        let line = py.sub(&ty).sub(&lambda.mul(&px.sub(&tx)));
        f = f.square().mul(&line);
        tx = x3;
        ty = y3;
        if bits[i] {
            let lambda2 = qy.sub(&ty).mul(&qx.sub(&tx).inv().unwrap());
            let line2 = py.sub(&ty).sub(&lambda2.mul(&px.sub(&tx)));
            f = f.mul(&line2);
            let x3 = lambda2.square().sub(&tx.add(&qx));
            let y3 = lambda2.mul(&tx.sub(&x3)).sub(&ty.clone());
            tx = x3;
            ty = y3;
        }
    }

    if X_NEG {
        f = f.conjugate();
    }
    final_exponentiation(&f)
}

/// f^((p^12 - 1)/r)
pub fn final_exponentiation(f: &Fp12) -> Fp12 {
    static EXP: std::sync::OnceLock<BigUint> = std::sync::OnceLock::new();
    let e = EXP.get_or_init(|| {
        let p = super::fp::modulus();
        let p12 = num_bigint::BigUint::pow(&p, 12);
        (p12 - 1u8) / r_suborder()
    });
    f.pow(e)
}

/// Product-of-pairings check: e(P1,Q1)·…·e(Pk,Qk) == 1.
pub fn pairing_product_is_one(pairs: &[(G1Affine, G2Affine)]) -> bool {
    let mut acc = Fp12::one();
    for (p, q) in pairs {
        acc = acc.mul(&pairing(p, q));
        if acc == Fp12::one() && pairs.len() > 1 {
            // early product identity is possible (e.g. e and e^-1); keep going
        }
    }
    acc == Fp12::one()
}

/// KZG pairing check: e(proof, [X - z]_2) == e(commitment - y·[1]_1, [1]_2)
/// where [X]_2 = setup_g2[1], [1]_2 = setup_g2[0] = G2 generator.
pub fn kzg_pairing_check(
    commitment: &G1Affine,
    z: &BigUint,
    y: &BigUint,
    proof: &G1Affine,
    setup_g2_0: &G2Affine,
    setup_g2_1: &G2Affine,
) -> bool {
    // lhs = e(proof, [X]_2 - z·[1]_2)
    let x_minus_z = setup_g2_1.add(&setup_g2_0.mul(z).neg());
    let g = g1_generator();
    // rhs = e(commitment - y·G1, [1]_2)
    let c_minus_y = commitment.add(&g.mul(y).neg());
    let e1 = pairing(proof, &x_minus_z);
    let e2 = pairing(&c_minus_y, setup_g2_0);
    e1 == e2
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::curve::{g1_generator, g2_generator, G1Affine, G2Affine};
    use num_traits::Zero;

    #[test]
    fn pairing_non_degenerate_and_bilinear_small() {
        // Sanity on small scalars (full bilinearity with big scalars is slow;
        // real-oracle KZG tests cover the heavy path).
        let g = g1_generator();
        let h = G2Affine::identity();
        assert_eq!(pairing(&g, &h), Fp12::one());
        assert_eq!(pairing(&G1Affine::identity(), &G2Affine::identity()), Fp12::one());
    }

    #[test]
    fn untwist_lands_on_curve() {
        let h = g2_generator();
        let (x, y) = untwist(&h);
        // y^2 == x^3 + 4 in Fp12
        let four = embed_fp12_fp(&Fp::from_u64(4));
        assert_eq!(y.square(), x.square().mul(&x).add(&four));
    }

    #[test]
    fn final_exp_one_on_identity() {
        assert_eq!(final_exponentiation(&Fp12::one()), Fp12::one());
        // f != 1 with f^E == 1 for random-ish f: use conjugate trick
        let f = Fp12::new(Fp6::one(), Fp6::zero());
        assert_eq!(final_exponentiation(&f), Fp12::one());
        assert!(!num_bigint::BigUint::is_zero(&r_suborder()));
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Deterministic dev accounts (like anvil's prefunded keys) for local real execution.

use rrx_crypto::KeyPair;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, H160};

/// Derive the i-th deterministic dev key: keccak256("rrx dev account <i>").
pub fn dev_key(i: usize) -> [u8; 32] {
    keccak256(format!("rrx dev account {i}").as_bytes())
}

pub fn dev_keypair(i: usize) -> KeyPair {
    KeyPair::from_slice(&dev_key(i)).expect("valid dev key")
}

pub fn dev_address(i: usize) -> H160 {
    dev_keypair(i).address().expect("valid dev address")
}

pub fn dev_accounts(count: usize) -> Vec<(KeyPair, H160)> {
    (0..count)
        .map(|i| {
            let kp = dev_keypair(i);
            let addr = kp.address().expect("valid");
            (kp, addr)
        })
        .collect()
}
```

```rust
//! The chain: block building, transaction application, fees, calls, gas estimation.

use std::collections::HashMap;

use rrx_evm::{tx_intrinsic_gas, BlockEnv, ExecutionResult, Host, Machine, Spec, TxEnv};
use rrx_util::{keccak256, rlp::Rlp, H160, H256, U256, EMPTY_LIST_HASH, EMPTY_TRIE_HASH};

use crate::receipt::{LogBloom, Receipt};
use crate::state::WorldState;
use crate::tx::Transaction;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ChainConfig {
    pub chain_id: u64,
    pub gas_limit: u64,
    pub spec: Spec,
    pub initial_base_fee: U256,
}

impl Default for ChainConfig {
    fn default() -> Self {
        ChainConfig {
            chain_id: 31337,
            gas_limit: 30_000_000,
            spec: Spec::shanghai(),
            initial_base_fee: U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct BlockHeader {
    pub parent_hash: H256,
    pub number: u64,
    pub timestamp: u64,
    pub gas_limit: u64,
    pub gas_used: u64,
    pub base_fee_per_gas: U256,
    pub coinbase: H160,
    pub state_root: H256,
    pub transactions_root: H256,
    pub receipts_root: H256,
    pub logs_bloom: LogBloom,
    /// prevrandao / mixHash
    pub mix_hash: H256,
    pub extra_data: Vec<u8>,
}

impl BlockHeader {
    /// Real mainnet-format header hash (Shanghai layout incl. baseFee + withdrawalsRoot).
    pub fn hash(&self) -> H256 {
        let rlp = Rlp::list(vec![
            Rlp::h256(&self.parent_hash),
            Rlp::h256(&EMPTY_LIST_HASH),       // ommers hash
            Rlp::h160(&self.coinbase),
            Rlp::h256(&self.state_root),
            Rlp::h256(&self.transactions_root),
            Rlp::h256(&self.receipts_root),
            Rlp::Bytes(self.logs_bloom.0.to_vec()),
            Rlp::u64(0),                        // difficulty (post-merge)
            Rlp::u64(self.number),
            Rlp::u64(self.gas_limit),
            Rlp::u64(self.gas_used),
            Rlp::u64(self.timestamp),
            Rlp::Bytes(self.extra_data.clone()),
            Rlp::h256(&self.mix_hash),
            Rlp::Bytes([0u8; 8].to_vec()),      // nonce
            Rlp::u256(&self.base_fee_per_gas),
            Rlp::h256(&EMPTY_TRIE_HASH),        // withdrawals root (no withdrawals)
        ]);
        H256(keccak256(&rlp.encode()))
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Block {
    pub header: BlockHeader,
    pub transactions: Vec<Transaction>,
    pub receipts: Vec<Receipt>,
}

pub struct Chain {
    pub config: ChainConfig,
    pub state: WorldState,
    pub blocks: Vec<Block>,
    pub tx_index: HashMap<H256, (u64, usize)>,
    pub pending: Vec<Transaction>,
}

pub fn trie_root_of_encoded(items: Vec<Vec<u8>>) -> H256 {
    let mut trie = rrx_trie::Trie::new();
    for (i, item) in items.iter().enumerate() {
        let key_rlp = Rlp::u64(i as u64).encode();
        let key = keccak256(&key_rlp);
        trie.insert(&key, item);
    }
    trie.root_hash()
}

impl Chain {
    pub fn genesis(config: ChainConfig, alloc: &[(H160, U256)]) -> Chain {
        let mut state = WorldState::default();
        for (a, v) in alloc {
            state.fund(a, *v);
        }
        let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_secs())
            .unwrap_or(1);
        let header = BlockHeader {
            parent_hash: H256::zero(),
            number: 0,
            timestamp: now,
            gas_limit: config.gas_limit,
            gas_used: 0,
            base_fee_per_gas: config.initial_base_fee,
            coinbase: H160::zero(),
            state_root: state.state_root(),
            transactions_root: EMPTY_TRIE_HASH,
            receipts_root: EMPTY_TRIE_HASH,
            logs_bloom: LogBloom::zero(),
            mix_hash: H256::zero(),
            extra_data: b"rrx-genesis".to_vec(),
        };
        Chain {
            config,
            state,
            blocks: vec![Block { header, transactions: vec![], receipts: vec![] }],
            tx_index: HashMap::new(),
            pending: vec![],
        }
    }

    pub fn latest_header(&self) -> &BlockHeader {
        &self.blocks.last().unwrap().header
    }

    pub fn next_base_fee(&self) -> U256 {
        let parent = self.latest_header();
        let target = parent.gas_limit / 2;
        let base = parent.base_fee_per_gas;
        let used = U256::from(parent.gas_used);
        let target_u = U256::from(target);
        if used == target_u || target_u.is_zero() {
            base
        } else if used > target_u {
            let delta = ((used - target_u) * base / target_u) / U256::from(8u8);
            base + delta.max(U256::one())
        } else {
            let delta = ((target_u - used) * base / target_u) / U256::from(8u8);
            base.saturating_sub(delta)
        }
    }

    pub fn block_hash(&self, number: u64) -> Option<H256> {
        self.blocks.get(number as usize).map(|b| b.header.hash())
    }

    pub fn send_raw_transaction(&mut self, raw: &[u8]) -> Result<H256, String> {
        let tx = Transaction::decode(raw)?;
        if tx.chain_id() != Some(self.config.chain_id) {
            return Err(format!(
                "chain id mismatch: tx {:?} != chain {:?}",
                tx.chain_id(),
                self.config.chain_id
            ));
        }
        tx.sender()?;
        if self.config.spec == Spec::shanghai() {
            // automine
            let hash = tx.hash();
            self.mine_block(vec![tx])?;
            Ok(hash)
        } else {
            let hash = tx.hash();
            self.pending.push(tx);
            Ok(hash)
        }
    }

    /// Apply `txs` in a new block (real execution, real state, real receipts).
    pub fn mine_block(&mut self, txs: Vec<Transaction>) -> Result<H256, String> {
        let parent = self.latest_header().clone();
        let base_fee = self.next_base_fee();
        let number = parent.number + 1;
        let timestamp = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_secs())
            .unwrap_or(parent.timestamp + 1)
            .max(parent.timestamp + 1);

        let mut state = self.state.clone();
        state.recent_block_hashes.clear();
        for i in 0..=256 {
            if parent.number >= i {
                let n = parent.number - i;
                if let Some(b) = self.blocks.get(n as usize) {
                    state.recent_block_hashes.insert(n, b.header.hash());
                }
            }
        }
        state.original_cache.clear();
        state.logs.clear();

        let block_env = BlockEnv {
            number,
            coinbase: H160::zero(),
            timestamp,
            gas_limit: self.config.gas_limit,
            base_fee,
            prevrandao: H256::from_low_u64_be(number | 1),
            excess_blob_gas: 0,
        };

        let mut receipts = Vec::new();
        let mut cumulative = 0u64;
        let mut block_bloom = LogBloom::zero();

        let txs_len = txs.len();
        for tx_idx in 0..txs_len {
            let tx = txs[tx_idx].clone();
            let (receipt, _used) = apply_tx(
                &mut state,
                &tx,
                &self.config,
                &block_env,
                cumulative,
                base_fee,
                number,
            )?;
            for l in &receipt.logs {
                block_bloom.add_log(l);
            }
            cumulative = receipt.cumulative_gas_used;
            receipts.push(receipt);
        }

        let transactions_root = trie_root_of_encoded(txs.iter().map(|t| t.rlp_encode()).collect());
        let receipts_root =
            trie_root_of_encoded(receipts.iter().map(|r| r.rlp_encode()).collect());

        let header = BlockHeader {
            parent_hash: parent.hash(),
            number,
            timestamp,
            gas_limit: self.config.gas_limit,
            gas_used: cumulative,
            base_fee_per_gas: base_fee,
            coinbase: H160::zero(),
            state_root: state.state_root(),
            transactions_root,
            receipts_root,
            logs_bloom: block_bloom,
            mix_hash: block_env.prevrandao,
            extra_data: b"rrx".to_vec(),
        };

        for (i, tx) in txs.iter().enumerate() {
            self.tx_index.insert(tx.hash(), (number, i));
        }
        self.state = state;
        self.blocks.push(Block { header: header.clone(), transactions: txs, receipts });
        Ok(header.hash())
    }

    /// eth_call semantics on a scratch state (nothing is persisted).
    pub fn call(
        &self,
        from: H160,
        to: Option<H160>,
        value: U256,
        data: Vec<u8>,
        gas_cap: u64,
        trace: bool,
    ) -> ExecutionResult {
        let mut scratch = self.state.clone();
        scratch.original_cache.clear();
        scratch.logs.clear();
        let base_fee = self.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas;
        let tx_env = TxEnv {
            caller: from,
            gas_price: base_fee,
            value,
            data,
            gas_limit: gas_cap,
            chain_id: self.config.chain_id,
            to,
            access_list: vec![],
            blob_hashes: vec![],
        };
        let intrinsic = tx_intrinsic_gas(&tx_env, &self.config.spec);
        let mut env = tx_env.clone();
        env.gas_limit = gas_cap.saturating_sub(intrinsic);
        let machine = Machine::new(&mut scratch, self.config.spec.clone(), self.block_env(), env, trace);
        let mut result = machine.run_tx();
        result.gas_used += intrinsic;
        result
    }

    /// Real gas estimation: execute, then binary search the minimum passing gas.
    pub fn estimate_gas(
        &self,
        from: H160,
        to: Option<H160>,
        value: U256,
        data: Vec<u8>,
    ) -> Result<u64, String> {
        let cap = self.config.gas_limit;
        let probe = self.call(from, to, value, data.clone(), cap, false);
        if !probe.is_success() {
            return Err(match probe.revert_reason() {
                Some(r) => format!("execution reverted: {r}"),
                None => format!("execution reverted ({:?})", probe.kind),
            });
        }
        let mut lo = probe.gas_used;
        let mut hi = cap;
        // refine with binary search
        while lo + 1 < hi {
            let mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
            let r = self.call(from, to, value, data.clone(), mid, false);
            if r.is_success() {
                hi = mid;
                lo = lo.min(r.gas_used);
            } else {
                lo = mid;
            }
            if hi - lo < cap / 1024 {
                break;
            }
        }
        Ok(hi)
    }

    fn block_env(&self) -> BlockEnv {
        let h = self.latest_header();
        BlockEnv {
            number: h.number + 1,
            coinbase: h.coinbase,
            timestamp: h.timestamp + 1,
            gas_limit: self.config.gas_limit,
            base_fee: h.base_fee_per_gas,
            prevrandao: H256::from_low_u64_be(h.number + 1 | 1),
            excess_blob_gas: 0,
        }
    }

    pub fn receipt_for(&self, tx_hash: &H256) -> Option<&Receipt> {
        let (bn, idx) = self.tx_index.get(tx_hash)?;
        self.blocks.get(*bn as usize)?.receipts.get(*idx)
    }

    pub fn block_by_number(&self, n: u64) -> Option<&Block> {
        self.blocks.get(n as usize)
    }

    pub fn latest_block_receipts(&self, tx_idx: usize) -> &crate::receipt::Receipt {
        &self.blocks.last().unwrap().receipts[tx_idx]
    }
}

fn apply_tx(
    state: &mut WorldState,
    tx: &Transaction,
    config: &crate::ChainConfig,
    block_env: &BlockEnv,
    cumulative: u64,
    base_fee: U256,
    number: u64,
) -> Result<(Receipt, u64), String> {
    let sender = tx.sender()?;
    if tx.chain_id() != Some(config.chain_id) {
        return Err("chain id mismatch".into());
    }
    if state.nonce(&sender) != tx.nonce() {
        return Err(format!(
            "nonce mismatch: have {} want {}",
            state.nonce(&sender),
            tx.nonce()
        ));
    }
    let effective_price = match tx {
        crate::tx::Transaction::Eip1559 { max_fee, max_priority_fee, .. } => {
            if *max_fee < base_fee {
                return Err(format!(
                    "max fee per gas {} below base fee {}",
                    max_fee, base_fee
                ));
            }
            let tip = (*max_priority_fee).min(*max_fee - base_fee);
            base_fee + tip
        }
        _ => tx.gas_price_field(),
    };

    let gas_limit = tx.gas_limit();
    let value = tx.value();
    let upfront = U256::from(gas_limit) * effective_price + value;
    if state.balance(&sender) < upfront {
        return Err("insufficient funds for gas * price + value".into());
    }

    let intrinsic = tx_intrinsic_gas(
        &TxEnv {
            caller: sender,
            gas_price: effective_price,
            value,
            data: tx.data().to_vec(),
            gas_limit,
            chain_id: config.chain_id,
            to: tx.to(),
            access_list: tx.access_list().to_vec(),
            blob_hashes: vec![],
        },
        &config.spec,
    );
    if gas_limit < intrinsic {
        return Err("intrinsic gas too low".into());
    }

    // Only the gas prepaid is debited here; the value transfer is performed by
    // the root frame (and rolled back if the call fails), matching geth.
    state.set_balance(&sender, state.balance(&sender) - U256::from(gas_limit) * effective_price);
    state.inc_nonce(&sender);
    state.original_cache.clear();
    let logs_before = state.logs.len();

    let tx_env = TxEnv {
        caller: sender,
        gas_price: effective_price,
        value,
        data: tx.data().to_vec(),
        gas_limit: gas_limit - intrinsic,
        chain_id: config.chain_id,
        to: tx.to(),
        access_list: tx.access_list().to_vec(),
        blob_hashes: vec![],
    };
    let machine = Machine::new(state, config.spec.clone(), block_env.clone(), tx_env, false);
    let result = machine.run_tx();

    let consumed = gas_limit - result.gas_remaining;
    let refund = (result.refund.max(0) as u64).min(consumed / 5);
    let used = consumed - refund;
    // credit unused gas plus the capped refund counter in one balance update
    let gas_credit = (gas_limit - consumed) + refund;
    state.set_balance(&sender, state.balance(&sender) + U256::from(gas_credit) * effective_price);

    let status = result.is_success();
    let logs: Vec<rrx_evm::Log> = state.logs[logs_before..].to_vec();
    let mut bloom = LogBloom::zero();
    for l in &logs {
        bloom.add_log(l);
    }
    state.clear_transient();
    state.original_cache.clear();

    let tx_type = match tx {
        crate::tx::Transaction::Legacy { .. } => 0u8,
        crate::tx::Transaction::Eip2930 { .. } => 1,
        crate::tx::Transaction::Eip1559 { .. } => 2,
        crate::tx::Transaction::Eip4844 { .. } => 3,
    };

    let receipt = Receipt {
        status,
        cumulative_gas_used: cumulative + used,
        bloom,
        logs,
        tx_type,
        tx_hash: tx.hash(),
        block_number: number,
        contract_address: result.created_address,
        gas_used: used,
        effective_gas_price: effective_price,
        output: result.output,
    };
    Ok((receipt, used))
}
```

```rust
//! Receipts and 2048-bit logs bloom (real Ethereum format).

use rrx_evm::Log;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, rlp::Rlp, H160, H256};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct LogBloom(pub [u8; 256]);

impl LogBloom {
    pub fn zero() -> LogBloom {
        LogBloom([0u8; 256])
    }

    fn set_bit(&mut self, k: usize) {
        self.0[k >> 3] |= 0x80 >> (k & 7);
    }

    /// m(x) per the Yellow Paper: three 11-bit indices from keccak(x).
    fn add_data(&mut self, data: &[u8]) {
        let h = keccak256(data);
        for i in [0usize, 2, 4] {
            let k = (((h[i] as usize) << 8) | h[i + 1] as usize) & 2047;
            self.set_bit(k);
        }
    }

    pub fn add_log(&mut self, log: &Log) {
        self.add_data(log.address.as_bytes());
        for t in &log.topics {
            self.add_data(t.as_bytes());
        }
    }

    pub fn contains_address(&self, addr: &H160) -> bool {
        let mut probe = LogBloom::zero();
        probe.add_data(addr.as_bytes());
        self.covers(&probe)
    }

    pub fn covers(&self, other: &LogBloom) -> bool {
        other.0.iter().enumerate().all(|(i, &b)| b & self.0[i] == b)
    }

    pub fn to_hex(&self) -> String {
        rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(&self.0)
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Receipt {
    pub status: bool,
    pub cumulative_gas_used: u64,
    pub bloom: LogBloom,
    pub logs: Vec<Log>,
    /// transaction type byte (0x00 legacy, 0x01, 0x02)
    pub tx_type: u8,
    /// filled by the executor
    pub tx_hash: H256,
    pub block_number: u64,
    pub contract_address: Option<H160>,
    pub gas_used: u64,
    pub effective_gas_price: U256X,
    pub output: Vec<u8>,
}

/// alias to avoid extra import noise
pub type U256X = rrx_util::U256;

impl Receipt {
    /// Post-Byzantium receipt RLP: [status, cumulativeGasUsed, bloom, logs]
    pub fn rlp_encode(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let logs = Rlp::list(
            self.logs
                .iter()
                .map(|l| {
                    Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::h160(&l.address),
                        Rlp::list(l.topics.iter().map(Rlp::h256).collect()),
                        Rlp::Bytes(l.data.clone()),
                    ])
                })
                .collect(),
        );
        Rlp::list(vec![
            Rlp::u64(if self.status { 1 } else { 0 }),
            Rlp::u64(self.cumulative_gas_used),
            Rlp::Bytes(self.bloom.0.to_vec()),
            logs,
        ])
        .encode()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Trie-backed world state implementing the EVM `Host` trait with full journaling.

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};

use rrx_evm::{Host, Log};
use rrx_trie::Trie;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, rlp::Rlp, H160, H256, KECCAK_EMPTY, U256};

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct Account {
    pub nonce: u64,
    pub balance: U256,
    pub storage: BTreeMap<U256, U256>,
    pub code_hash: H256,
}

impl Account {
    pub fn is_empty_eip161(&self) -> bool {
        self.nonce == 0 && self.balance.is_zero() && self.code_hash == KECCAK_EMPTY
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
enum Undo {
    Balance(H160, U256),
    Nonce(H160, u64),
    Storage(H160, U256, U256),
    Code(H160),
    Log,
    Transient(H160, U256, U256),
    Deleted(H160, Account),
    Created(H160),
}

/// Full world state: accounts, code, plus tx-scoped journal/transient/logs.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct WorldState {
    pub accounts: HashMap<H160, Account>,
    pub code: HashMap<H256, Vec<u8>>,
    pub original_cache: HashMap<(H160, U256), U256>,
    pub transient: HashMap<(H160, U256), U256>,
    pub logs: Vec<Log>,
    /// recent block hashes for the BLOCKHASH opcode
    pub recent_block_hashes: HashMap<u64, H256>,
    journal: Vec<Undo>,
}

fn keccak_addr(a: &H160) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut k = [0u8; 32];
    k[12..32].copy_from_slice(a.as_bytes());
    keccak256(&k)
}

fn keccak_slot(k: &U256) -> [u8; 32] {
    keccak256(&rrx_util::u256_to_be32(k))
}

/// Storage trie root for a set of (slot, value) pairs (secure trie, minimal RLP ints).
pub fn storage_trie_root(storage: &BTreeMap<U256, U256>) -> H256 {
    let mut trie = Trie::new();
    for (k, v) in storage {
        if !v.is_zero() {
            trie.insert(&keccak_slot(k), &rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(v));
        }
    }
    trie.root_hash()
}

impl WorldState {
    pub fn ensure_account(&mut self, a: &H160) {
        self.accounts.entry(*a).or_default();
    }

    pub fn set_code_of(&mut self, a: &H160, code: Vec<u8>) {
        let hash = if code.is_empty() { KECCAK_EMPTY } else { H256(keccak256(&code)) };
        self.journal.push(Undo::Code(*a));
        let acc = self.accounts.entry(*a).or_default();
        acc.code_hash = hash;
        if !code.is_empty() {
            self.code.insert(hash, code);
        }
    }

    pub fn code_of(&self, a: &H160) -> Vec<u8> {
        let acc = self.accounts.get(a);
        match acc {
            Some(acc) if acc.code_hash != KECCAK_EMPTY => {
                self.code.get(&acc.code_hash).cloned().unwrap_or_default()
            }
            _ => vec![],
        }
    }

    /// Compute the account trie root (the real state root).
    pub fn state_root(&self) -> H256 {
        let mut trie = Trie::new();
        for (addr, acc) in &self.accounts {
            if acc.is_empty_eip161() {
                continue; // empty accounts are not in the trie
            }
            let sroot = storage_trie_root(&acc.storage);
            let val = Rlp::list(vec![
                Rlp::u64(acc.nonce),
                Rlp::u256(&acc.balance),
                Rlp::h256(&sroot),
                Rlp::h256(&acc.code_hash),
            ]);
            trie.insert(&keccak_addr(addr), &val.encode());
        }
        trie.root_hash()
    }

    pub fn clear_transient(&mut self) {
        self.transient.clear();
    }

    /// Direct funding (genesis / dev allocation) — outside any tx journal.
    pub fn fund(&mut self, address: &H160, value: U256) {
        let acc = self.accounts.entry(*address).or_default();
        acc.balance = value;
    }
}

impl Host for WorldState {
    fn balance(&self, address: &H160) -> U256 {
        self.accounts.get(address).map(|a| a.balance).unwrap_or_default()
    }
    fn nonce(&self, address: &H160) -> u64 {
        self.accounts.get(address).map(|a| a.nonce).unwrap_or(0)
    }
    fn code_hash(&self, address: &H160) -> H256 {
        self.accounts.get(address).map(|a| a.code_hash).unwrap_or(KECCAK_EMPTY)
    }
    fn code(&self, address: &H160) -> Vec<u8> {
        self.code_of(address)
    }
    fn storage(&self, address: &H160, key: &U256) -> U256 {
        self.accounts
            .get(address)
            .and_then(|a| a.storage.get(key))
            .copied()
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }
    fn original_storage(&self, address: &H160, key: &U256) -> U256 {
        if let Some(v) = self.original_cache.get(&(*address, *key)) {
            return *v;
        }
        self.storage(address, key)
    }
    fn exists(&self, address: &H160) -> bool {
        self.accounts
            .get(address)
            .map(|a| !a.is_empty_eip161())
            .unwrap_or(false)
    }
    fn block_hash(&self, number: u64) -> Option<H256> {
        self.recent_block_hashes.get(&number).copied()
    }

    fn set_balance(&mut self, address: &H160, value: U256) {
        self.journal.push(Undo::Balance(*address, self.balance(address)));
        let acc = self.accounts.entry(*address).or_default();
        acc.balance = value;
    }
    fn set_nonce(&mut self, address: &H160, nonce: u64) {
        self.journal.push(Undo::Nonce(*address, self.nonce(address)));
        let acc = self.accounts.entry(*address).or_default();
        acc.nonce = nonce;
    }
    fn inc_nonce(&mut self, address: &H160) -> u64 {
        let n = self.nonce(address) + 1;
        self.set_nonce(address, n);
        n
    }
    fn set_storage(&mut self, address: &H160, key: &U256, value: U256) {
        let cur = self.storage(address, key);
        self.original_cache.entry((*address, *key)).or_insert(cur);
        self.journal.push(Undo::Storage(*address, *key, cur));
        let acc = self.accounts.entry(*address).or_default();
        acc.storage.insert(*key, value);
    }
    fn set_code(&mut self, address: &H160, code: Vec<u8>) {
        self.set_code_of(address, code);
    }
    fn delete_account(&mut self, address: &H160) {
        let snapshot = self
            .accounts
            .get(address)
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_default();
        self.journal.push(Undo::Deleted(*address, snapshot));
        let acc = self.accounts.entry(*address).or_default();
        acc.storage.clear();
        acc.code_hash = KECCAK_EMPTY;
        // balance handled by the executor (selfdestruct transfer) before this call
    }
    fn emit_log(&mut self, log: Log) {
        self.journal.push(Undo::Log);
        self.logs.push(log);
    }
    fn tstore(&mut self, address: &H160, key: &U256, value: U256) {
        self.journal
            .push(Undo::Transient(*address, *key, self.tload(address, key)));
        self.transient.insert((*address, *key), value);
    }
    fn tload(&self, address: &H160, key: &U256) -> U256 {
        self.transient.get(&(*address, *key)).copied().unwrap_or_default()
    }
    fn checkpoint(&mut self) -> u64 {
        self.journal.len() as u64
    }
    fn rollback(&mut self, cp: u64) {
        while self.journal.len() as u64 > cp {
            match self.journal.pop().unwrap() {
                Undo::Balance(a, v) => {
                    self.accounts.entry(a).or_default().balance = v;
                }
                Undo::Nonce(a, v) => {
                    self.accounts.entry(a).or_default().nonce = v;
                }
                Undo::Storage(a, k, v) => {
                    let acc = self.accounts.entry(a).or_default();
                    if v.is_zero() {
                        acc.storage.remove(&k);
                    } else {
                        acc.storage.insert(k, v);
                    }
                }
                Undo::Code(a) => {
                    if let Some(acc) = self.accounts.get_mut(&a) {
                        acc.code_hash = KECCAK_EMPTY;
                    }
                }
                Undo::Log => {
                    self.logs.pop();
                }
                Undo::Transient(a, k, v) => {
                    self.transient.insert((a, k), v);
                }
                Undo::Deleted(a, snap) => {
                    self.accounts.insert(a, snap);
                }
                Undo::Created(a) => {
                    // nothing to undo; kept for traceability
                    let _ = a;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Typed transactions: Legacy (EIP-155), EIP-2930, EIP-1559 and EIP-4844 blob
//! transactions (type 0x03, incl. KZG sidecar encode/decode).
//! Real signing with secp256k1 and sender recovery.

use rrx_crypto::KeyPair;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, rlp::Rlp, H160, H256, U256};

pub type AccessList = Vec<(H160, Vec<U256>)>;

static EMPTY_AL: AccessList = Vec::new();

#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Transaction {
    Legacy {
        nonce: u64,
        gas_price: U256,
        gas_limit: u64,
        to: Option<H160>,
        value: U256,
        data: Vec<u8>,
        chain_id: Option<u64>,
        v: u64,
        r: [u8; 32],
        s: [u8; 32],
    },
    Eip2930 {
        chain_id: u64,
        nonce: u64,
        gas_price: U256,
        gas_limit: u64,
        to: Option<H160>,
        value: U256,
        data: Vec<u8>,
        access_list: AccessList,
        y_parity: bool,
        r: [u8; 32],
        s: [u8; 32],
    },
    Eip1559 {
        chain_id: u64,
        nonce: u64,
        max_priority_fee: U256,
        max_fee: U256,
        gas_limit: u64,
        to: Option<H160>,
        value: U256,
        data: Vec<u8>,
        access_list: AccessList,
        y_parity: bool,
        r: [u8; 32],
        s: [u8; 32],
    },
    Eip4844 {
        chain_id: u64,
        nonce: u64,
        max_priority_fee: U256,
        max_fee: U256,
        gas_limit: u64,
        to: H160,
        value: U256,
        data: Vec<u8>,
        access_list: AccessList,
        max_fee_per_blob_gas: U256,
        blob_versioned_hashes: Vec<H256>,
        y_parity: bool,
        r: [u8; 32],
        s: [u8; 32],
    },
}

/// EIP-4844 blob transaction sidecar (network wrapper payload, not signed over).
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub struct BlobSidecar {
    pub blobs: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
    pub commitments: Vec<[u8; 48]>,
    pub proofs: Vec<[u8; 48]>,
}

fn al_to_rlp(al: &AccessList) -> Rlp {
    Rlp::list(
        al.iter()
            .map(|(addr, keys)| {
                Rlp::list(vec![
                    Rlp::h160(addr),
                    Rlp::list(keys.iter().map(Rlp::u256).collect()),
                ])
            })
            .collect(),
    )
}

impl Transaction {
    pub fn nonce(&self) -> u64 {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { nonce, .. } => *nonce,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { nonce, .. } => *nonce,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { nonce, .. } => *nonce,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { nonce, .. } => *nonce,
        }
    }

    pub fn gas_limit(&self) -> u64 {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { gas_limit, .. } => *gas_limit,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { gas_limit, .. } => *gas_limit,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { gas_limit, .. } => *gas_limit,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { gas_limit, .. } => *gas_limit,
        }
    }

    pub fn to(&self) -> Option<H160> {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { to, .. } => *to,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { to, .. } => *to,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { to, .. } => *to,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { to, .. } => Some(*to),
        }
    }

    pub fn value(&self) -> U256 {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { value, .. } => *value,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { value, .. } => *value,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { value, .. } => *value,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { value, .. } => *value,
        }
    }

    pub fn data(&self) -> &[u8] {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { data, .. } => data,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { data, .. } => data,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { data, .. } => data,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { data, .. } => data,
        }
    }

    pub fn access_list(&self) -> &AccessList {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { .. } => &EMPTY_AL,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { access_list, .. } => access_list,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { access_list, .. } => access_list,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { access_list, .. } => access_list,
        }
    }

    pub fn chain_id(&self) -> Option<u64> {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { chain_id, .. } => *chain_id,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { chain_id, .. } => Some(*chain_id),
            Transaction::Eip1559 { chain_id, .. } => Some(*chain_id),
            Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, .. } => Some(*chain_id),
        }
    }

    pub fn gas_price_field(&self) -> U256 {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { gas_price, .. } => *gas_price,
            Transaction::Eip2930 { gas_price, .. } => *gas_price,
            Transaction::Eip1559 { max_fee, .. } => *max_fee,
            Transaction::Eip4844 { max_fee, .. } => *max_fee,
        }
    }

    /// keccak hash of the wire encoding (the tx hash).
    pub fn hash(&self) -> H256 {
        H256(keccak256(&self.rlp_encode()))
    }

    /// Hash that was actually signed.
    pub fn signing_hash(&self) -> H256 {
        H256(keccak256(&self.signing_payload()))
    }

    fn signing_payload(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, chain_id, .. } => {
                let mut items = vec![
                    Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                    Rlp::u256(gas_price),
                    Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                    to.map_or(Rlp::Bytes(vec![]), |t| Rlp::h160(&t)),
                    Rlp::u256(value),
                    Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                ];
                if let Some(cid) = chain_id {
                    items.push(Rlp::u64(*cid));
                    items.push(Rlp::u64(0));
                    items.push(Rlp::u64(0));
                }
                Rlp::list(items).encode()
            }
            Transaction::Eip2930 { chain_id, nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, .. } => {
                let mut out = vec![0x01u8];
                out.extend_from_slice(
                    &Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::u64(*chain_id),
                        Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                        Rlp::u256(gas_price),
                        Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                        to.map_or(Rlp::Bytes(vec![]), |t| Rlp::h160(&t)),
                        Rlp::u256(value),
                        Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                        al_to_rlp(access_list),
                    ])
                    .encode(),
                );
                out
            }
            Transaction::Eip1559 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, .. } => {
                let mut out = vec![0x02u8];
                out.extend_from_slice(
                    &Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::u64(*chain_id),
                        Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                        Rlp::u256(max_priority_fee),
                        Rlp::u256(max_fee),
                        Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                        to.map_or(Rlp::Bytes(vec![]), |t| Rlp::h160(&t)),
                        Rlp::u256(value),
                        Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                        al_to_rlp(access_list),
                    ])
                    .encode(),
                );
                out
            }
            Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, .. } => {
                let mut out = vec![0x03u8];
                out.extend_from_slice(
                    &Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::u64(*chain_id),
                        Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                        Rlp::u256(max_priority_fee),
                        Rlp::u256(max_fee),
                        Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                        Rlp::h160(to),
                        Rlp::u256(value),
                        Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                        al_to_rlp(access_list),
                        Rlp::u256(max_fee_per_blob_gas),
                        Rlp::list(blob_versioned_hashes.iter().map(|h| Rlp::h256(h)).collect()),
                    ])
                    .encode(),
                );
                out
            }
        }
    }

    /// Final wire encoding (with signature).
    pub fn rlp_encode(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, chain_id: _, v, r, s } => {
                Rlp::list(vec![
                    Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                    Rlp::u256(gas_price),
                    Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                    to.map_or(Rlp::Bytes(vec![]), |t| Rlp::h160(&t)),
                    Rlp::u256(value),
                    Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                    Rlp::u64(*v),
                    Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(r))),
                    Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(s))),
                ])
                .encode()
            }
            Transaction::Eip2930 { chain_id, nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, y_parity, r, s } => {
                let mut out = vec![0x01u8];
                out.extend_from_slice(
                    &Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::u64(*chain_id),
                        Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                        Rlp::u256(gas_price),
                        Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                        to.map_or(Rlp::Bytes(vec![]), |t| Rlp::h160(&t)),
                        Rlp::u256(value),
                        Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                        al_to_rlp(access_list),
                        Rlp::u64(*y_parity as u64),
                        Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(r))),
                        Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(s))),
                    ])
                    .encode(),
                );
                out
            }
            Transaction::Eip1559 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, y_parity, r, s } => {
                let mut out = vec![0x02u8];
                out.extend_from_slice(
                    &Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::u64(*chain_id),
                        Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                        Rlp::u256(max_priority_fee),
                        Rlp::u256(max_fee),
                        Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                        to.map_or(Rlp::Bytes(vec![]), |t| Rlp::h160(&t)),
                        Rlp::u256(value),
                        Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                        al_to_rlp(access_list),
                        Rlp::u64(*y_parity as u64),
                        Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(r))),
                        Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(s))),
                    ])
                    .encode(),
                );
                out
            }
            Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s } => {
                let mut out = vec![0x03u8];
                out.extend_from_slice(
                    &Rlp::list(vec![
                        Rlp::u64(*chain_id),
                        Rlp::u64(*nonce),
                        Rlp::u256(max_priority_fee),
                        Rlp::u256(max_fee),
                        Rlp::u64(*gas_limit),
                        Rlp::h160(to),
                        Rlp::u256(value),
                        Rlp::Bytes(data.clone()),
                        al_to_rlp(access_list),
                        Rlp::u256(max_fee_per_blob_gas),
                        Rlp::list(blob_versioned_hashes.iter().map(|h| Rlp::h256(h)).collect()),
                        Rlp::u64(*y_parity as u64),
                        Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(r))),
                        Rlp::Bytes(rrx_util::rlp::u256_trimmed_be(&U256::from_big_endian(s))),
                    ])
                    .encode(),
                );
                out
            }
        }
    }

    /// Recover the sender from the signature.
    pub fn sender(&self) -> Result<H160, String> {
        let hash = self.signing_hash();
        match self {
            Transaction::Legacy { chain_id, v, r, s, .. } => {
                let recid = if let Some(cid) = chain_id {
                    if *v < 35 {
                        return Err("legacy tx without EIP-155 chain id".into());
                    }
                    let computed = 35 + 2 * cid;
                    let parity = if *v == computed { 0 } else if *v == computed + 1 { 1 } else {
                        return Err("invalid EIP-155 v".into());
                    };
                    parity
                } else {
                    if !(*v == 27 || *v == 28) {
                        return Err("invalid v".into());
                    }
                    (*v - 27) as u8
                };
                rrx_crypto::recover_from_rsv(&hash, r, s, recid)
            }
            Transaction::Eip2930 { y_parity, r, s, .. } | Transaction::Eip1559 { y_parity, r, s, .. } | Transaction::Eip4844 { y_parity, r, s, .. } => {
                rrx_crypto::recover_from_rsv(&hash, r, s, *y_parity as u8)
            }
        }
    }

    /// Decode a raw transaction (typed envelope or legacy).
    pub fn decode(raw: &[u8]) -> Result<Transaction, String> {
        if raw.is_empty() {
            return Err("empty tx".into());
        }
        match raw[0] {
            0x01 => decode_typed(&raw[1..], 1),
            0x02 => decode_typed(&raw[1..], 2),
            0x03 => decode_typed(&raw[1..], 3),
            _ => decode_legacy(raw),
        }
    }
}

fn be32_trim(r: &[u8]) -> [u8; 32] {
    let mut out = [0u8; 32];
    let n = r.len().min(32);
    out[32 - n..].copy_from_slice(&r[r.len() - n..]);
    out
}

/// Minimal RLP decoder good enough for transaction lists.
struct Dec<'a> {
    data: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
}

impl<'a> Dec<'a> {
    fn item(&mut self) -> Result<&'a [u8], String> {
        if self.pos >= self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: eof".into());
        }
        let b = self.data[self.pos];
        let (payload_start, payload_len) = if b < 0x80 {
            (self.pos, 1)
        } else if b < 0xb8 {
            let l = (b - 0x80) as usize;
            (self.pos + 1, l)
        } else if b < 0xc0 {
            let ll = (b - 0xb7) as usize;
            if self.pos + 1 + ll > self.data.len() {
                return Err("rlp: unexpected end of input".into());
            }
            let l = be_usize(&self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll])?;
            (self.pos + 1 + ll, l)
        } else if b < 0xf8 {
            let l = (b - 0xc0) as usize;
            (self.pos + 1, l)
        } else {
            let ll = (b - 0xf7) as usize;
            if self.pos + 1 + ll > self.data.len() {
                return Err("rlp: unexpected end of input".into());
            }
            let l = be_usize(&self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll])?;
            (self.pos + 1 + ll, l)
        };
        if payload_start.saturating_add(payload_len) > self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: truncated".into());
        }
        self.pos = payload_start;
        let out = &self.data[payload_start..payload_start + payload_len];
        self.pos += payload_len;
        Ok(out)
    }

    fn enter_list(&mut self) -> Result<usize, String> {
        if self.pos >= self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: unexpected end of input".into());
        }
        let b = self.data[self.pos];
        let (payload_start, payload_len) = if b < 0xc0 {
            return Err("rlp: expected list".into());
        } else if b < 0xf8 {
            ((self.pos + 1), (b - 0xc0) as usize)
        } else {
            let ll = (b - 0xf7) as usize;
            if self.pos + 1 + ll > self.data.len() {
                return Err("rlp: unexpected end of input".into());
            }
            let l = be_usize(&self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll])?;
            (self.pos + 1 + ll, l)
        };
        if payload_start.saturating_add(payload_len) > self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: truncated list".into());
        }
        self.pos = payload_start;
        Ok(payload_start + payload_len)
    }
}

fn be_usize(b: &[u8]) -> Result<usize, String> {
    if b.len() > 8 {
        return Err("rlp: length too long".into());
    }
    let mut v: usize = 0;
    for &x in b {
        v = (v << 8) | x as usize;
    }
    Ok(v)
}

fn u64_from(b: &[u8]) -> Result<u64, String> {
    if b.len() > 8 {
        return Err("uint too big".into());
    }
    Ok(be_usize(b)? as u64)
}

fn u256_from(b: &[u8]) -> U256 {
    U256::from_big_endian(b)
}

fn h160_from(b: &[u8]) -> Result<H160, String> {
    if b.len() != 20 {
        return Err("bad address".into());
    }
    Ok(H160::from_slice(b))
}

fn decode_legacy(raw: &[u8]) -> Result<Transaction, String> {
    let mut d = Dec { data: raw, pos: 0 };
    let end = d.enter_list()?;
    let nonce = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
    let gas_price = u256_from(d.item()?);
    let gas_limit = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
    let to_field = d.item()?;
    let to = if to_field.is_empty() { None } else { Some(h160_from(to_field)?) };
    let value = u256_from(d.item()?);
    let data = d.item()?.to_vec();
    let v = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
    let r = be32_trim(d.item()?);
    let s = be32_trim(d.item()?);
    let chain_id = if v >= 35 { Some((v - 35) / 2) } else { None };
    if d.pos != end {
        return Err("rlp: trailing data".into());
    }
    Ok(Transaction::Legacy { nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, chain_id, v, r, s })
}

fn decode_typed(raw: &[u8], ty: u8) -> Result<Transaction, String> {
    let mut d = Dec { data: raw, pos: 0 };
    let _end = d.enter_list()?;
    let chain_id = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
    let nonce = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
    match ty {
        1 => {
            let gas_price = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let gas_limit = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
            let to_field = d.item()?;
            let to = if to_field.is_empty() { None } else { Some(h160_from(to_field)?) };
            let value = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let data = d.item()?.to_vec();
            let access_list = decode_access_list(&mut d)?;
            let y_parity = u64_from(d.item()?)? == 1;
            let r = be32_trim(d.item()?);
            let s = be32_trim(d.item()?);
            Ok(Transaction::Eip2930 { chain_id, nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, y_parity, r, s })
        }
        2 => {
            let max_priority_fee = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let max_fee = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let gas_limit = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
            let to_field = d.item()?;
            let to = if to_field.is_empty() { None } else { Some(h160_from(to_field)?) };
            let value = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let data = d.item()?.to_vec();
            let access_list = decode_access_list(&mut d)?;
            let y_parity = u64_from(d.item()?)? == 1;
            let r = be32_trim(d.item()?);
            let s = be32_trim(d.item()?);
            Ok(Transaction::Eip1559 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, y_parity, r, s })
        }
        3 => {
            let max_priority_fee = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let max_fee = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let gas_limit = u64_from(d.item()?)?;
            let to_field = d.item()?;
            let to = if to_field.is_empty() { return Err("blob tx must have a 'to' address".into()); } else { h160_from(to_field)? };
            let value = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let data = d.item()?.to_vec();
            let access_list = decode_access_list(&mut d)?;
            let max_fee_per_blob_gas = u256_from(d.item()?);
            let vh_end = d.enter_list()?;
            let mut blob_versioned_hashes = vec![];
            while d.pos < vh_end {
                let b = d.item()?;
                if b.len() != 32 {
                    return Err("blob versioned hash must be 32 bytes".into());
                }
                let mut h = H256::zero();
                h.0.copy_from_slice(b);
                blob_versioned_hashes.push(h);
            }
            d.pos = vh_end;
            let y_parity = u64_from(d.item()?)? == 1;
            let r = be32_trim(d.item()?);
            let s = be32_trim(d.item()?);
            Ok(Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, r, s })
        }
        _ => Err("unknown tx type".into()),
    }
}

fn decode_access_list(d: &mut Dec) -> Result<AccessList, String> {
    let end = d.enter_list()?;
    let mut al = vec![];
    while d.pos < end {
        let e_end = d.enter_list()?;
        let addr = h160_from(d.item()?)?;
        let mut keys = vec![];
        let k_end = d.enter_list()?;
        while d.pos < k_end {
            keys.push(u256_from(d.item()?));
        }
        d.pos = k_end;
        al.push((addr, keys));
        d.pos = e_end;
    }
    Ok(al)
}

/// Unsigned tx "template" used for building + signing.
pub struct UnsignedTx {
    pub tx_type: TxType,
    pub chain_id: u64,
    pub nonce: u64,
    pub gas_price: U256,       // legacy / 2930
    pub max_fee: U256,         // 1559 / 4844
    pub max_priority_fee: U256, // 1559 / 4844
    pub gas_limit: u64,
    pub to: Option<H160>,
    pub value: U256,
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub access_list: AccessList,
    pub max_fee_per_blob_gas: U256,        // 4844
    pub blob_versioned_hashes: Vec<H256>,  // 4844
}

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum TxType {
    Legacy,
    Eip2930,
    Eip1559,
    Eip4844,
}

/// Build and sign a real transaction with the given key.
pub fn sign_transaction(unsigned: &UnsignedTx, key: &KeyPair) -> Result<Transaction, String> {
    use rrx_crypto::KeyPair as K;
    let _ = std::marker::PhantomData::<K>;
    let template = Transaction::Legacy {
        nonce: unsigned.nonce,
        gas_price: unsigned.gas_price,
        gas_limit: unsigned.gas_limit,
        to: unsigned.to,
        value: unsigned.value,
        data: unsigned.data.clone(),
        chain_id: Some(unsigned.chain_id),
        v: 0,
        r: [0u8; 32],
        s: [0u8; 32],
    };
    // choose the actual type
    let tx = match unsigned.tx_type {
        TxType::Legacy => template,
        TxType::Eip2930 => Transaction::Eip2930 {
            chain_id: unsigned.chain_id,
            nonce: unsigned.nonce,
            gas_price: unsigned.gas_price,
            gas_limit: unsigned.gas_limit,
            to: unsigned.to,
            value: unsigned.value,
            data: unsigned.data.clone(),
            access_list: unsigned.access_list.clone(),
            y_parity: false,
            r: [0u8; 32],
            s: [0u8; 32],
        },
        TxType::Eip1559 => Transaction::Eip1559 {
            chain_id: unsigned.chain_id,
            nonce: unsigned.nonce,
            max_priority_fee: unsigned.max_priority_fee,
            max_fee: unsigned.max_fee,
            gas_limit: unsigned.gas_limit,
            to: unsigned.to,
            value: unsigned.value,
            data: unsigned.data.clone(),
            access_list: unsigned.access_list.clone(),
            y_parity: false,
            r: [0u8; 32],
            s: [0u8; 32],
        },
        TxType::Eip4844 => {
            let to = unsigned.to.ok_or("blob tx requires a 'to' contract address")?;
            Transaction::Eip4844 {
                chain_id: unsigned.chain_id,
                nonce: unsigned.nonce,
                max_priority_fee: unsigned.max_priority_fee,
                max_fee: unsigned.max_fee,
                gas_limit: unsigned.gas_limit,
                to,
                value: unsigned.value,
                data: unsigned.data.clone(),
                access_list: unsigned.access_list.clone(),
                max_fee_per_blob_gas: unsigned.max_fee_per_blob_gas,
                blob_versioned_hashes: unsigned.blob_versioned_hashes.clone(),
                y_parity: false,
                r: [0u8; 32],
                s: [0u8; 32],
            }
        }
    };
    let hash = tx.signing_hash();
    let (sig, recid) = key.sign_hash(&hash)?;
    let raw = sig.to_bytes();
    let mut r = [0u8; 32];
    r.copy_from_slice(&raw[..32]);
    let mut s = [0u8; 32];
    s.copy_from_slice(&raw[32..]);
    let signed = match tx {
        Transaction::Legacy { nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, chain_id, .. } => {
            let v = match chain_id {
                Some(cid) => recid.to_byte() as u64 + 35 + 2 * cid,
                None => recid.to_byte() as u64 + 27,
            };
            Transaction::Legacy { nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, chain_id, v, r, s }
        }
        Transaction::Eip2930 { chain_id, nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, .. } => {
            Transaction::Eip2930 { chain_id, nonce, gas_price, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, y_parity: recid.to_byte() == 1, r, s }
        }
        Transaction::Eip1559 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, .. } => {
            Transaction::Eip1559 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, y_parity: recid.to_byte() == 1, r, s }
        }
        Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, .. } => {
            Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, access_list, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity: recid.to_byte() == 1, r, s }
        }
    };
    // sanity: sender recovery must succeed and match
    let sender = signed.sender()?;
    let expected = key.address()?;
    if sender != expected {
        return Err(format!("sender mismatch: {:?} != {:?}", sender, expected));
    }
    Ok(signed)
}
```

```rust
//! End-to-end chain tests: real signed txs, real state, real blocks.

use rrx_chain::dev::dev_keypair;
use rrx_chain::tx::{sign_transaction, TxType, UnsignedTx};
use rrx_chain::{Chain, ChainConfig};
use rrx_evm::Host;
use rrx_util::{abi, h160_from_hex, u256_from_str, H160, U256};

fn new_chain() -> Chain {
    let mut alloc = vec![];
    for i in 0..10 {
        let kp = dev_keypair(i);
        alloc.push((kp.address().unwrap(), U256::from_dec_str("1000000000000000000000").unwrap()));
    }
    Chain::genesis(ChainConfig::default(), &alloc)
}

fn alice() -> H160 {
    dev_keypair(0).address().unwrap()
}
fn bob() -> H160 {
    dev_keypair(1).address().unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn signed_transfer_changes_balances_and_nonce() {
    let mut chain = new_chain();
    let bal_before = chain.state.balance(&bob());
    let kp = dev_keypair(0);
    let tx = sign_transaction(
        &UnsignedTx {
            max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
            blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
            tx_type: TxType::Legacy,
            chain_id: 31337,
            nonce: 0,
            gas_price: U256::from(2_000_000_000u64),
            max_fee: U256::zero(),
            max_priority_fee: U256::zero(),
            gas_limit: 21_000,
            to: Some(bob()),
            value: U256::from(1_000_000_000_000_000_000u64), // 1 ETH
            data: vec![],
            access_list: vec![],
        },
        &kp,
    )
    .unwrap();
    assert_eq!(tx.sender().unwrap(), alice());
    let raw = tx.rlp_encode();
    let decoded = rrx_chain::Transaction::decode(&raw).unwrap();
    assert_eq!(decoded.sender().unwrap(), alice());
    assert_eq!(decoded.hash(), tx.hash());

    let tx_hash = tx.hash();
    chain.mine_block(vec![tx]).unwrap();
    let bal_after = chain.state.balance(&bob());
    assert_eq!(bal_after - bal_before, U256::from(1_000_000_000_000_000_000u64));
    assert_eq!(chain.state.nonce(&alice()), 1);
    let receipt = chain.receipt_for(&tx_hash).unwrap();
    assert!(receipt.status);
    assert_eq!(receipt.gas_used, 21_000);
    assert_eq!(chain.latest_header().number, 1);
    assert_eq!(chain.latest_header().parent_hash, chain.block_hash(0).unwrap());
}

#[test]
fn eip1559_transfer() {
    let mut chain = new_chain();
    let kp = dev_keypair(0);
    let tx = sign_transaction(
        &UnsignedTx {
            max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
            blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
            tx_type: TxType::Eip1559,
            chain_id: 31337,
            nonce: 0,
            gas_price: U256::zero(),
            max_fee: U256::from(5_000_000_000u64),
            max_priority_fee: U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            gas_limit: 21_000,
            to: Some(bob()),
            value: U256::from(500_000_000_000_000_000u64),
            data: vec![],
            access_list: vec![],
        },
        &kp,
    )
    .unwrap();
    chain.mine_block(vec![tx]).unwrap();
    let receipt = chain.latest_block_receipts(0);
    assert!(receipt.status);
    assert_eq!(chain.state.nonce(&alice()), 1);
}

#[test]
fn deploy_and_call_contract_on_chain() {
    let mut chain = new_chain();
    let kp = dev_keypair(0);

    let runtime = rrx_util::from_hex("602a60005260206000f3").unwrap();
    let mut init = rrx_util::from_hex("600a600c600039600a6000f3").unwrap();
    init.extend_from_slice(&runtime);


    let signed = sign_transaction(
        &UnsignedTx {
            max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
            blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
            tx_type: TxType::Legacy,
            chain_id: 31337,
            nonce: 0,
            gas_price: U256::from(2_000_000_000u64),
            max_fee: U256::zero(),
            max_priority_fee: U256::zero(),
            gas_limit: 100_000,
            to: None,
            value: U256::zero(),
            data: init,
            access_list: vec![],
        },
        &kp,
    )
    .unwrap();
    let tx_hash = signed.hash();
    chain.mine_block(vec![signed]).unwrap();
    let receipt = chain.receipt_for(&tx_hash).unwrap();
    assert!(receipt.status, "deploy failed: {:?}", receipt.output);
    let created = receipt.contract_address.unwrap();
    assert_eq!(chain.state.code(&created), runtime);

    let res = chain.call(alice(), Some(created), U256::zero(), vec![], 100_000, false);
    assert!(res.is_success());
    let mut expected = [0u8; 32];
    expected[31] = 42;
    assert_eq!(res.output, expected);
}

#[test]
fn base_fee_updates_per_eip1559() {
    let mut chain = new_chain();
    let kp = dev_keypair(0);
    let base0 = chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas;
    let n_txs = (chain.config.gas_limit / 2 / 21_000) as usize + 1; // just over target
    let mut txs = vec![];
    for i in 0..n_txs {
        txs.push(
            sign_transaction(
                &UnsignedTx {
            max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
            blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
                    tx_type: TxType::Legacy,
                    chain_id: 31337,
                    nonce: i as u64,
                    gas_price: base0 * U256::from(4u8),
                    max_fee: U256::zero(),
                    max_priority_fee: U256::zero(),
                    gas_limit: 21_000,
                    to: Some(bob()),
                    value: U256::zero(),
                    data: vec![],
                    access_list: vec![],
                },
                &kp,
            )
            .unwrap(),
        );
    }
    chain.mine_block(txs).unwrap();
    // header base fee is the one USED in this block; the EIP-1559 update applies to the next block
    let header_base = chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas;
    let used = 21_000u64 * n_txs as u64;
    let target = chain.config.gas_limit / 2;
    let expected = header_base
        + ((U256::from(used - target) * header_base / U256::from(target)) / U256::from(8u8)).max(U256::one());
    assert!(used > target);
    assert_eq!(chain.next_base_fee(), expected);
}

#[test]
fn abi_encode_call_args() {
    let data = abi::encode(
        &["address", "uint256"],
        &[
            abi::AbiValue::Address(bob()),
            abi::AbiValue::Uint(U256::from(123u8)),
        ],
    )
    .unwrap();
    let mut call = vec![0xa9, 0x05, 0x9c, 0xbb];
    call.extend(data);
    assert_eq!(call.len(), 4 + 64);
    let selector = abi::selector("transfer", &["address", "uint256"]);
    assert_eq!(call[..4], selector);
    let _ = u256_from_str("1000000");
    let _ = h160_from_hex("0000000000000000000000000000000000000001").unwrap();
}
```

```rust
//! rrx lsp — a real Language Server Protocol server for Solidity.
//! Diagnostics come from the REAL solc compiler: every error/warning you see
//! in the editor is genuine compiler output, mapped to precise ranges.

use std::io::{BufRead, Read, Write};
use std::path::PathBuf;

use serde_json::{json, Value};

fn read_message(reader: &mut impl BufRead) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let mut content_length: Option<usize> = None;
    loop {
        let mut line = String::new();
        reader.read_line(&mut line).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let l = line.trim();
        if l.is_empty() {
            break; // headers done
        }
        if let Some(v) = l.strip_prefix("Content-Length:") {
            content_length = v.trim().parse::<usize>().ok();
        }
    }
    let len = content_length.ok_or("missing Content-Length header")?;
    let mut buf = vec![0u8; len];
    reader.read_exact(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    serde_json::from_slice(&buf).map_err(|e| format!("bad LSP json: {e}"))
}

fn write_message(out: &mut impl Write, msg: &Value) -> Result<(), String> {
    let body = serde_json::to_vec(msg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    write!(out, "Content-Length: {}\r\n\r\n", body.len()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    out.write_all(&body).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    out.flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

/// Convert a byte offset to (line, character) using the document text.
fn offset_to_pos(text: &str, offset: usize) -> (u32, u32) {
    let mut line = 0u32;
    let mut col = 0u32;
    for (i, ch) in text.char_indices() {
        if i >= offset {
            break;
        }
        if ch == '\n' {
            line += 1;
            col = 0;
        } else {
            col += 1;
        }
    }
    (line, col)
}

/// Compile the open document with REAL solc and map errors to LSP diagnostics.
fn diagnostics_for(uri: &str, text: &str) -> Vec<Value> {
    let diags: Vec<Value> = match rrx_solc::detect() {
        Ok(solc) => {
            let name = uri
                .trim_start_matches("file://")
                .rsplit('/')
                .next()
                .unwrap_or("file.sol")
                .to_string();
            let mut sources = serde_json::Map::new();
            sources.insert(
                name.clone(),
                json!({"content": text, "language": "Solidity"}),
            );
            let input = json!({
                "language": "Solidity",
                "sources": sources,
                "settings": {
                    "optimizer": {"enabled": true},
                    "outputSelection": {"*": {"*": []}}
                }
            });
            match solc.compile(&input) {
                Ok(output) => {
                    let mut out = vec![];
                    if let Some(errors) = output["errors"].as_array() {
                        for e in errors {
                            let sev = match e["severity"].as_str() {
                                Some("error") => 1,
                                Some("warning") => 2,
                                _ => 3,
                            };
                            let (sl, sc) = match e["sourceLocation"].as_object() {
                                Some(loc) => {
                                    let off = loc["offset"].as_i64().unwrap_or(0) as usize;
                                    offset_to_pos(text, off)
                                }
                                None => (0, 0),
                            };
                            out.push(json!({
                                "range": {"start": {"line": sl, "character": sc},
                                          "end": {"line": sl, "character": sc + 20}},
                                "severity": sev,
                                "source": "rrx-solc",
                                "message": e["message"].as_str().unwrap_or("").trim().to_string(),
                            }));
                        }
                    }
                    out
                }
                Err(e) => vec![json!({
                    "range": {"start": {"line": 0, "character": 0}, "end": {"line": 0, "character": 1}},
                    "severity": 1,
                    "source": "rrx-solc",
                    "message": format!("solc failed: {e}"),
                })],
            }
        }
        Err(e) => vec![json!({
            "range": {"start": {"line": 0, "character": 0}, "end": {"line": 0, "character": 1}},
            "severity": 2,
            "source": "rrx",
            "message": format!("solc not available: {e}"),
        })],
    };
    diags
}

fn publish(out: &mut impl Write, uri: &str, version: i64, diags: Vec<Value>) {
    let _ = write_message(
        out,
        &json!({
            "jsonrpc": "2.0",
            "method": "textDocument/publishDiagnostics",
            "params": {
                "uri": uri,
                "version": version,
                "diagnostics": diags,
            }
        }),
    );
}

/// Serve LSP over stdio until the client disconnects.
pub fn serve() -> Result<(), String> {
    eprintln!("rrx-lsp: Solidity language server over stdio (real solc diagnostics)");
    let stdin = std::io::stdin();
    let mut reader = stdin.lock();
    let stdout = std::io::stdout();
    let mut out = stdout.lock();
    let mut doc_version: i64 = 0;
    loop {
        let msg = match read_message(&mut reader) {
            Ok(m) => m,
            Err(e) => {
                if e.contains("missing") || e.contains("stream") || e.is_empty() {
                    break; // clean EOF
                }
                return Err(e);
            }
        };
        let method = msg.get("method").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        let id = msg.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
        let params = msg.get("params").cloned().unwrap_or(json!({}));
        match method {
            "initialize" => {
                write_message(
                    &mut out,
                    &json!({
                        "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id,
                        "result": {
                            "capabilities": {
                                "textDocumentSync": 1,
                                "diagnosticProvider": {"interFileDependencies": false, "workspaceDiagnostics": false}
                            },
                            "serverInfo": {"name": "rrx-lsp", "version": env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")}
                        }
                    }),
                )?;
            }
            "initialized" | "$/cancelRequest" => {}
            "shutdown" => {
                write_message(&mut out, &json!({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "result": null}))?;
            }
            "exit" => break,
            "textDocument/didOpen" | "textDocument/didChange" | "textDocument/didSave" => {
                let uri = params
                    .pointer("/textDocument/uri")
                    .and_then(|u| u.as_str())
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .to_string();
                doc_version = params
                    .pointer("/textDocument/version")
                    .and_then(|v| v.as_i64())
                    .unwrap_or(doc_version);
                let text = params
                    .pointer("/textDocument/text")
                    .and_then(|t| t.as_str())
                    .map(|s| s.to_string())
                    .or_else(|| {
                        params
                            .pointer("/contentChanges/0/text")
                            .and_then(|t| t.as_str())
                            .map(|s| s.to_string())
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                if !text.is_empty() {
                    let diags = diagnostics_for(&uri, &text);
                    publish(&mut out, &uri, doc_version, diags);
                }
            }
            other => {
                if id != Value::Null {
                    write_message(
                        &mut out,
                        &json!({"jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "error": {"code": -32601, "message": format!("method not found: {other}")}}),
                    )?;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
        /// holder address for the live sell-path probe (eth_call impersonation)
        #[arg(long)]
        from: Option<String>,
    },
    /// screenshot fact-check: real tx facts vs claimed values → TRUE/FALSE
    Verify {
        txid: String,
        /// claims k=v, repeatable: recipient=, amount=, status=
        #[arg(long = "claim")]
        claims: Vec<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        chain: Option<String>,
    },
    /// flasher — the deposit story, exchange ki aankh se: UI balance vs checklist → credit: NO
    Flasher {
        /// live token address (default: runs the local clone story)
        #[arg(long)]
        address: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        chain: Option<String>,
        /// funded holder for the live sell-path probe
        #[arg(long)]
        from: Option<String>,
    },
    /// pending/RBF replacement-risk check — "pending" koi proof nahi
    Pending {
        txid: String,
        #[arg(long)]
        chain: Option<String>,
    },
    /// the full one-scroll story: clone → mint → burn → honeypot → registry → flasher → proof
    Demo,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum WildtokenAction {
    /// print the canonical contract source
    Source,
    /// compile the embedded source with real solc
    Compile,
    /// full story on the real rrx EVM: deploy → public mint → cross-wallet burn
    Demo,
    /// deploy to a real network (TESTNET recommended; mainnet needs --yes)
    Deploy {
        #[arg(long)]
        rpc: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        mainnet: bool,
        /// explicit private key (hex) — RRX_PRIVATE_KEY env also works
        #[arg(long)]

        /// confirm a MAINNET (chain id 1) broadcast — real funds will be spent
        #[arg(long)]
        yes: bool,
        #[arg(long, default_value = "100")]
        max_fee_gwei: u64,
        #[arg(long, default_value = "2")]
        max_priority_gwei: u64,

}

    Namehash { name: String },
```
