```rust
//! A real local JSON-RPC node: serves our chain over HTTP with the standard eth_*
//! methods. Tools like wallets, Remix or ethers-js can connect directly.

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use rrx_chain::dev::dev_keypair;
use rrx_chain::tx::{sign_transaction, TxType, UnsignedTx, Transaction};
use rrx_chain::{Chain, ChainConfig};
use rrx_evm::Host;
use rrx_util::{h160_from_hex, u256_from_str, H160, U256};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use tiny_http::{Method, Response, Server};

pub struct NodeOptions {
    pub port: u16,
    pub chain_id: u64,
    pub fund_dev_accounts: bool,
}

pub fn serve(opts: NodeOptions) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut alloc = vec![];
    let mut keys = std::collections::HashMap::new();
    if opts.fund_dev_accounts {
        for i in 0..10 {
            let kp = dev_keypair(i);
            let addr = kp.address().unwrap();
            keys.insert(format!("{addr:?}"), kp);
            alloc.push((addr, U256::from_dec_str("10000000000000000000000").unwrap()));
        }
    }
    let config = ChainConfig {
        chain_id: opts.chain_id,
        ..Default::default()
    };
    let chain = Chain::genesis(config, &alloc);
    let shared = Arc::new(Mutex::new(chain));

    let url = format!("0.0.0.0:{}", opts.port);
    let server = Server::http(&url).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!("rrx node listening on http://127.0.0.1:{} (chain id {})", opts.port, opts.chain_id);
    println!("dev accounts (prefunded):");
    for (a, _) in alloc.iter().take(3) {
        println!("  {a:?}");
    }

    for mut request in server.incoming_requests() {
        if request.method() != &Method::Post {
            let _ = request.respond(Response::from_string("rrx node").with_status_code(200));
            continue;
        }
        let mut body = String::new();
                request.as_reader().read_to_string(&mut body).ok();
        let resp = handle(&shared, &keys, &body);
        let response = Response::from_string(resp).with_header(
            tiny_http::Header::from_bytes(&b"Content-Type"[..], &b"application/json"[..]).unwrap(),
        );
        let _ = request.respond(response);
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn err_obj(code: i64, msg: &str) -> Value {
    json!({ "code": code, "message": msg })
}

fn handle(shared: &Arc<Mutex<Chain>>, keys: &std::collections::HashMap<String, rrx_crypto::KeyPair>, body: &str) -> String {
    let req: Value = match serde_json::from_str(body) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(_) => return json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": null, "error": err_obj(-32700, "parse error") }).to_string(),
    };
    let id = req.get("id").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null);
    let method = req.get("method").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
    let params = req.get("params").cloned().unwrap_or(json!([]));
    let result = dispatch(shared, keys, method, params);
    match result {
        Ok(v) => json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "result": v }).to_string(),
        Err(e) => json!({ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": id, "error": err_obj(-32000, &e) }).to_string(),
    }
}

fn addr_of(v: &Value) -> Result<H160, String> {
    let s = v.as_str().ok_or("expected address string")?;
    h160_from_hex(s)
}

fn dispatch(
    shared: &Arc<Mutex<Chain>>,
    keys: &std::collections::HashMap<String, rrx_crypto::KeyPair>,
    method: &str,
    params: Value,
) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let arr = params.as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    let mut chain = shared.lock().unwrap();
    match method {
        "web3_clientVersion" => Ok(json!("rrx/v0.1.0")),
        "net_version" => Ok(json!(chain.config.chain_id.to_string())),
        "eth_chainId" => Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", chain.config.chain_id))),
        "eth_blockNumber" => Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", chain.latest_header().number))),
        "eth_gasPrice" => Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas))),
        "eth_accounts" => {
            let list: Vec<String> = keys
                .keys()
                .map(|k| format!("0x{}", k.trim_start_matches("0x").to_ascii_lowercase()))
                .collect();
            Ok(json!(list))
        }
        "eth_getBalance" => {
            let a = addr_of(arr.first().ok_or("missing addr")?)?;
            let tag = arr.get(1).and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("latest");
            let bal = if tag == "latest" || tag == "pending" {
                chain.state.balance(&a)
            } else {
                chain.state.balance(&a)
            };
            Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", bal)))
        }
        "eth_getTransactionCount" => {
            let a = addr_of(arr.first().ok_or("missing addr")?)?;
            Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", chain.state.nonce(&a))))
        }
        "eth_getCode" => {
            let a = addr_of(arr.first().ok_or("missing addr")?)?;
            Ok(json!(rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(&chain.state.code(&a))))
        }
        "eth_call" => {
            let obj = arr.first().ok_or("missing tx object")?;
            let to = obj.get("to").map(|v| addr_of(v)).transpose()?.unwrap_or_default();
            let from = match obj.get("from") {
                Some(v) => Some(addr_of(v)?),
                None => None,
            };
            let data = rrx_util::from_hex(obj.get("data").or_else(|| obj.get("input")).and_then(|d| d.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x"))
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let gas = obj
                .get("gas")
                .and_then(|g| g.as_str())
                .and_then(|g| u256_from_str(g).ok())
                .map(|g| g.as_u64())
                .unwrap_or(chain.config.gas_limit);
            let res = chain.call(from.unwrap_or_default(), Some(to), U256::zero(), data, gas, false);
            if res.is_success() {
                Ok(json!(rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(&res.output)))
            } else {
                Err(match res.revert_reason() {
                    Some(r) => format!("execution reverted: {r}"),
                    None => "execution reverted".into(),
                })
            }
        }
        "eth_estimateGas" => {
            let obj = arr.first().ok_or("missing tx object")?;
            let to = match obj.get("to") {
                Some(v) => Some(addr_of(v)?),
                None => None,
            };
            let from = match obj.get("from") {
                Some(v) => Some(addr_of(v)?),
                None => Some(H160::from_low_u64_be(1)),
            };
            let data = rrx_util::from_hex(obj.get("data").or_else(|| obj.get("input")).and_then(|d| d.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x"))
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let est = chain.estimate_gas(from.unwrap_or_else(|| H160::from_low_u64_be(1)), to, U256::zero(), data)?;
            Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", est)))
        }
        "eth_feeHistory" => {
            let n = arr.first().and_then(|v| v.as_str()).and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok()).map(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(1);
            if n == 0 {
                // avoid the `n - 1` underflow; geth returns empty result arrays
                return Ok(json!({ "baseFeePerGas": [], "gasUsedRatio": [], "reward": Value::Null }));
            }
            let mut base = vec![];
            let latest = chain.latest_header().number;
            for i in (latest.saturating_sub(n - 1))..=latest {
                if let Some(b) = chain.block_by_number(i) {
                    base.push(json!(format!("0x{:x}", b.header.base_fee_per_gas)));
                }
            }
            let next = chain.next_base_fee();
            base.push(json!(format!("0x{:x}", next)));
            // allocation bounded by the number of blocks actually collected
            let ratios = base.len().saturating_sub(1);
            Ok(json!({ "baseFeePerGas": base, "gasUsedRatio": vec![0.5f64; ratios], "reward": Value::Null }))
        }
        "eth_sendRawTransaction" => {
            let raw = rrx_util::from_hex(arr.first().and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or("missing raw")?)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let hash = chain.send_raw_transaction(&raw)?;
            Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", hash)))
        }
        "eth_sendTransaction" => {
            // dev-node convenience: sign with the unlocked dev account
            let obj = arr.first().ok_or("missing tx object")?;
            let from = addr_of(obj.get("from").ok_or("missing from")?)?;
            let kp = keys
                .get(&format!("{from:?}"))
                .ok_or("account not unlocked")?;
            let to = match obj.get("to") {
                Some(v) => Some(addr_of(v)?),
                None => None,
            };
            let value = obj
                .get("value")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let data = rrx_util::from_hex(obj.get("data").or_else(|| obj.get("input")).and_then(|d| d.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x"))
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let gas_limit = obj
                .get("gas")
                .and_then(|g| g.as_str())
                .and_then(|g| u256_from_str(g).ok())
                .map(|g| g.as_u64())
                .unwrap_or(600_000);
            let unsigned = UnsignedTx {
                max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
                blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
                tx_type: TxType::Eip1559,
                chain_id: chain.config.chain_id,
                nonce: chain.state.nonce(&from),
                gas_price: U256::zero(),
                max_fee: chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas * U256::from(2u8),
                max_priority_fee: U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
                gas_limit,
                to,
                value,
                data,
                access_list: vec![],
            };
            let signed = sign_transaction(&unsigned, kp)?;
            let hash = signed.hash();
            chain.mine_block(vec![signed])?;
            Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", hash)))
        }
        "eth_getTransactionReceipt" => {
            let h = rrx_util::h256_from_hex(arr.first().and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or("missing hash")?)?;
            match chain.receipt_for(&h) {
                Some(r) => Ok(json!({
                    "transactionHash": format!("0x{:x}", r.tx_hash),
                    "blockNumber": format!("0x{:x}", r.block_number),
                    "status": format!("0x{:x}", r.status as u64),
                    "gasUsed": format!("0x{:x}", r.gas_used),
                    "effectiveGasPrice": format!("0x{:x}", r.effective_gas_price),
                    "contractAddress": r.contract_address.map(|a| json!(format!("0x{:x}", a))),
                    "logs": r.logs.iter().map(|l| json!({
                        "address": format!("0x{:x}", l.address),
                        "topics": l.topics.iter().map(|t| json!(format!("0x{:x}", t))).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                        "data": rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(&l.data),
                    })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                })),
                None => Ok(Value::Null),
            }
        }
        "eth_getBlockByNumber" => {
            let tag = arr.first().and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("latest");
            let n = match tag {
                "latest" => chain.latest_header().number,
                "earliest" => 0,
                s => u256_from_str(s)?.as_u64(),
            };
            match chain.block_by_number(n) {
                Some(b) => Ok(json!({
                    "number": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.number),
                    "hash": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.hash()),
                    "parentHash": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.parent_hash),
                    "stateRoot": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.state_root),
                    "transactionsRoot": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.transactions_root),
                    "gasLimit": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.gas_limit),
                    "gasUsed": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.gas_used),
                    "baseFeePerGas": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.base_fee_per_gas),
                    "timestamp": format!("0x{:x}", b.header.timestamp),
                    "transactions": b.transactions.iter().map(|t: &Transaction| json!(format!("0x{:x}", t.hash()))).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                })),
                None => Ok(Value::Null),
            }
        }
        "evm_mine" => {
            let pending = chain.pending.drain(..).collect();
            let hash = chain.mine_block(pending)?;
            Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", hash)))
        }
        "rrx_stateRoot" => Ok(json!(format!("0x{:x}", chain.state.state_root()))),
        _ => Err(format!("method {method} not supported")),
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Real WebSocket (RFC 6455) client for eth_subscribe — live chain data over wss://.
//!
//! TLS is bridged through the system `openssl s_client` process (no external
//! crates), plain TCP for ws://. Frames: client→server masked, fragmentation,
//! ping/pong handled. All data is REAL live chain data from real endpoints.

use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::TcpStream;
use std::process::{Child, ChildStdin, ChildStdout, Command, Stdio};
use std::sync::mpsc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

// ---------- SHA-1 (handshake only) ----------

fn sha1(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 20] {
    let mut h: [u32; 5] = [0x67452301, 0xEFCDAB89, 0x98BADCFE, 0x10325476, 0xC3D2E1F0];
    let ml = (data.len() as u64) * 8;
    let mut msg = data.to_vec();
    msg.push(0x80);
    while msg.len() % 64 != 56 {
        msg.push(0);
    }
    msg.extend_from_slice(&ml.to_be_bytes());
    for chunk in msg.chunks(64) {
        let mut w = [0u32; 80];
        for i in 0..16 {
            w[i] = u32::from_be_bytes([chunk[i * 4], chunk[i * 4 + 1], chunk[i * 4 + 2], chunk[i * 4 + 3]]);
        }
        for i in 16..80 {
            w[i] = (w[i - 3] ^ w[i - 8] ^ w[i - 14] ^ w[i - 16]).rotate_left(1);
        }
        let (mut a, mut b, mut c, mut d, mut e) = (h[0], h[1], h[2], h[3], h[4]);
        for (i, &wi) in w.iter().enumerate() {
            let (f, k) = match i {
                0..=19 => ((b & c) | ((!b) & d), 0x5A827999u32),
                20..=39 => (b ^ c ^ d, 0x6ED9EBA1),
                40..=59 => ((b & c) | (b & d) | (c & d), 0x8F1BBCDC),
                _ => (b ^ c ^ d, 0xCA62C1D6),
            };
            let tmp = a
                .rotate_left(5)
                .wrapping_add(f)
                .wrapping_add(e)
                .wrapping_add(k)
                .wrapping_add(wi);
            e = d;
            d = c;
            c = b.rotate_left(30);
            b = a;
            a = tmp;
        }
        h[0] = h[0].wrapping_add(a);
        h[1] = h[1].wrapping_add(b);
        h[2] = h[2].wrapping_add(c);
        h[3] = h[3].wrapping_add(d);
        h[4] = h[4].wrapping_add(e);
    }
    let mut out = [0u8; 20];
    for i in 0..5 {
        out[i * 4..i * 4 + 4].copy_from_slice(&h[i].to_be_bytes());
    }
    out
}

const B64: &[u8] = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";

fn base64(data: &[u8]) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for chunk in data.chunks(3) {
        let b = [
            chunk[0],
            chunk.get(1).copied().unwrap_or(0),
            chunk.get(2).copied().unwrap_or(0),
        ];
        let n = ((b[0] as u32) << 16) | ((b[1] as u32) << 8) | b[2] as u32;
        out.push(B64[(n >> 18) as usize & 63] as char);
        out.push(B64[(n >> 12) as usize & 63] as char);
        out.push(if chunk.len() > 1 { B64[(n >> 6) as usize & 63] as char } else { '=' });
        out.push(if chunk.len() > 2 { B64[n as usize & 63] as char } else { '=' });
    }
    out
}

// ---------- transport ----------

/// Write half of the connection.
enum WriteSink {
    Tcp(TcpStream),
    Pipe(ChildStdin),
}

impl WriteSink {
    fn write_all(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        match self {
            WriteSink::Tcp(s) => s.write_all(buf),
            WriteSink::Pipe(p) => p.write_all(buf),
        }
    }
}

/// Read half of the connection.
enum ReadSink {
    Tcp(TcpStream),
    Pipe(ChildStdout),
}

impl ReadSink {
    fn read_exact(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        match self {
            ReadSink::Tcp(s) => s.read_exact(buf),
            ReadSink::Pipe(p) => p.read_exact(buf),
        }
    }
}

/// Parse wss://host[:port]/path or ws://...
fn parse_url(url: &str) -> Result<(bool, String, u16, String), String> {
    let (tls, rest) = if let Some(r) = url.strip_prefix("wss://") {
        (true, r)
    } else if let Some(r) = url.strip_prefix("ws://") {
        (false, r)
    } else {
        return Err("url must start with ws:// or wss://".into());
    };
    let (hostport, path) = match rest.find('/') {
        Some(i) => (&rest[..i], &rest[i..]),
        None => (rest, "/"),
    };
    let (host, port) = match hostport.rsplit_once(':') {
        Some((h, p)) => (h.to_string(), p.parse::<u16>().map_err(|_| "bad port")?),
        None => (hostport.to_string(), if tls { 443 } else { 80 }),
    };
    Ok((tls, host, port, path.to_string()))
}

fn connect_transport(url: &str) -> Result<(WriteSink, ReadSink, Option<Child>), String> {
    let (tls, host, port, _path) = parse_url(url)?;
    if tls {
        let mut child = Command::new("openssl")
            .args(["s_client", "-quiet", "-verify_quiet", "-no_ign_eof"])
            .arg("-connect")
            .arg(format!("{host}:{port}"))
            .arg("-servername")
            .arg(&host)
            .stdin(Stdio::piped())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::null())
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| format!("openssl s_client spawn failed: {e}"))?;
        let stdin = child.stdin.take().ok_or("no stdin")?;
        let stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or("no stdout")?;
        Ok((WriteSink::Pipe(stdin), ReadSink::Pipe(stdout), Some(child)))
    } else {
        let stream = TcpStream::connect((host.as_str(), port)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let read_half = stream.try_clone().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok((WriteSink::Tcp(stream), ReadSink::Tcp(read_half), None))
    }
}

// ---------- frames ----------

fn encode_frame(opcode: u8, payload: &[u8], mask: bool) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = vec![0x80 | opcode]; // FIN + opcode
    let len = payload.len();
    let mask_bit = if mask { 0x80 } else { 0x00 };
    if len < 126 {
        out.push(mask_bit | len as u8);
    } else if len <= 0xffff {
        out.push(mask_bit | 126);
        out.extend_from_slice(&(len as u16).to_be_bytes());
    } else {
        out.push(mask_bit | 127);
        out.extend_from_slice(&(len as u64).to_be_bytes());
    }
    if mask {
        let key: [u8; 4] = rand_bytes();
        out.extend_from_slice(&key);
        for (i, b) in payload.iter().enumerate() {
            out.push(b ^ key[i % 4]);
        }
    } else {
        out.extend_from_slice(payload);
    }
    out
}

fn rand_bytes() -> [u8; 4] {
    // cheap entropy: pid + time (frames only need unpredictability for intermediaries)
    let t = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let mut seed = t.as_nanos() as u64 ^ (std::process::id() as u64) << 32;
    let mut out = [0u8; 4];
    for b in out.iter_mut() {
        seed = seed.wrapping_mul(6364136223846793005).wrapping_add(1442695040888963407);
        *b = (seed >> 33) as u8;
    }
    out
}

pub enum WsMessage {
    Text(String),
    Binary(Vec<u8>),
    Ping(Vec<u8>),
    Pong(Vec<u8>),
    Close(Option<String>),
}

/// Read one COMPLETE message, assembling fragments (FIN + continuation
/// opcodes; some providers emit continuation chunks as binary frames).
fn read_message(t: &mut ReadSink) -> Result<WsMessage, String> {
    let mut acc: Option<(u8, Vec<u8>)> = None;
    loop {
        let mut hdr = [0u8; 2];
        t.read_exact(&mut hdr).map_err(|e| format!("ws read: {e}"))?;
        let fin = hdr[0] & 0x80 != 0;
        let opcode = hdr[0] & 0x0f;
        let masked = hdr[1] & 0x80 != 0;
        let mut len = (hdr[1] & 0x7f) as usize;
        if len == 126 {
            let mut b = [0u8; 2];
            t.read_exact(&mut b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            len = u16::from_be_bytes(b) as usize;
        } else if len == 127 {
            let mut b = [0u8; 8];
            t.read_exact(&mut b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            len = u64::from_be_bytes(b) as usize;
        }
        if len > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {
            return Err("ws frame too large".into());
        }
        let mask_key = if masked {
            let mut k = [0u8; 4];
            t.read_exact(&mut k).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            Some(k)
        } else {
            None
        };
        let mut payload = vec![0u8; len];
        if len > 0 {
            t.read_exact(&mut payload).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        if let Some(k) = mask_key {
            for (i, b) in payload.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                *b ^= k[i % 4];
            }
        }
        match &mut acc {
            None => {
                if opcode == 0x8 {
                    return Ok(WsMessage::Close(if payload.len() >= 2 {
                        Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload[2..]).into_owned())
                    } else {
                        None
                    }));
                }
                if opcode == 0x9 {
                    return Ok(WsMessage::Ping(payload));
                }
                if opcode == 0xA {
                    return Ok(WsMessage::Pong(payload));
                }
                if fin && opcode != 0x0 {
                    return Ok(match opcode {
                        0x1 => WsMessage::Text(String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).into_owned()),
                        _ => WsMessage::Binary(payload),
                    });
                }
                acc = Some((if opcode == 0x0 { 0x1 } else { opcode }, payload));
            }
            Some((op0, buf)) => {
                buf.extend_from_slice(&payload);
                if fin {
                    let op0 = *op0;
                    let buf = std::mem::take(buf);
                    acc = None;
                    return Ok(match op0 {
                        0x1 => WsMessage::Text(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf).into_owned()),
                        _ => WsMessage::Binary(buf),
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

#[allow(dead_code)]
fn read_frame(t: &mut ReadSink) -> Result<WsMessage, String> {
    let mut hdr = [0u8; 2];
    t.read_exact(&mut hdr).map_err(|e| format!("ws read: {e}"))?;
    let fin = hdr[0] & 0x80 != 0;
    let opcode = hdr[0] & 0x0f;
    let masked = hdr[1] & 0x80 != 0;
    let mut len = (hdr[1] & 0x7f) as usize;
    if len == 126 {
        let mut b = [0u8; 2];
        t.read_exact(&mut b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        len = u16::from_be_bytes(b) as usize;
    } else if len == 127 {
        let mut b = [0u8; 8];
        t.read_exact(&mut b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        len = u64::from_be_bytes(b) as usize;
    }
    if len > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {
        return Err("ws frame too large".into());
    }
    let mask_key = if masked {
        let mut k = [0u8; 4];
        t.read_exact(&mut k).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Some(k)
    } else {
        None
    };
    let mut payload = vec![0u8; len];
    if len > 0 {
        t.read_exact(&mut payload).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    if let Some(k) = mask_key {
        for (i, b) in payload.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            *b ^= k[i % 4];
        }
    }
    let _ = fin;
    Ok(match opcode {
        0x1 => WsMessage::Text(String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload).into_owned()),
        0x2 => WsMessage::Binary(payload),
        0x9 => WsMessage::Ping(payload),
        0xA => WsMessage::Pong(payload),
        0x8 => WsMessage::Close(if payload.len() >= 2 {
            Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(&payload[2..]).into_owned())
        } else {
            None
        }),
        _ => WsMessage::Binary(payload), // ignore unknown (incl. continuation for our use)
    })
}

/// A live websocket connection with a background reader thread.
pub struct WsConn {
    writer: std::sync::Arc<std::sync::Mutex<WriteSink>>,
    rx: mpsc::Receiver<WsMessage>,
    _child: Option<Child>,
}

impl WsConn {
    /// Connect + perform the RFC 6455 handshake.
    pub fn connect(url: &str) -> Result<WsConn, String> {
        let (tls, host, port, path) = parse_url(url)?;
        let (mut writer, mut reader, child) = connect_transport(url)?;
        // handshake
        let mut key_raw = [0u8; 16];
        key_raw[..4].copy_from_slice(&rand_bytes());
        let t0 = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default();
        key_raw[4..].copy_from_slice(&t0.as_nanos().to_le_bytes()[..12]);
        let ws_key = base64(&key_raw);
        let req = format!(
            "GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: {host}:{port}\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: {ws_key}\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\nUser-Agent: rrx/0.6\r\n\r\n"
        );
        writer.write_all(req.as_bytes()).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        // read response headers
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        let mut byte = [0u8; 1];
        loop {
            reader.read_exact(&mut byte).map_err(|e| format!("handshake read: {e}"))?;
            buf.push(byte[0]);
            if buf.ends_with(b"\r\n\r\n") {
                break;
            }
            if buf.len() > 16 * 1024 {
                return Err("handshake response too large".into());
            }
        }
        let headers = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf);
        if !headers.contains("101") {
            return Err(format!("handshake failed: {}", headers.lines().next().unwrap_or("")));
        }
        // verify Sec-WebSocket-Accept
        let expect = base64(&sha1(format!("{ws_key}258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11").as_bytes()));
        if !headers.to_lowercase().contains(&expect.to_lowercase()) {
            return Err("Sec-WebSocket-Accept mismatch".into());
        }
        let (tx_msg, rx) = mpsc::channel::<WsMessage>();
        // reader thread owns the read half; pings answered through the writer mutex
        let writer_for_reader = std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(writer));
        {
            let writer_for_reader = writer_for_reader.clone();
            std::thread::spawn(move || {
                loop {
                    match read_message(&mut reader) {
                        Ok(WsMessage::Ping(p)) => {
                            if let Ok(mut w) = writer_for_reader.lock() {
                                let _ = w.write_all(&encode_frame(0xA, &p, true));
                            }
                            let _ = tx_msg.send(WsMessage::Ping(p));
                        }
                        Ok(m) => {
                            if matches!(m, WsMessage::Close(_)) {
                                if let Ok(mut w) = writer_for_reader.lock() {
                                    let _ = w.write_all(&encode_frame(0x8, &[], true));
                                }
                                let _ = tx_msg.send(m);
                                break;
                            }
                            if tx_msg.send(m).is_err() {
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        Err(_) => break,
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        Ok(WsConn { writer: writer_for_reader, rx, _child: child })
    }

    /// Send a text message.
    pub fn send_text(&self, text: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
        let mut w = self.writer.lock().map_err(|_| "writer poisoned")?;
        w.write_all(&encode_frame(0x1, text.as_bytes(), true))
            .map_err(|e| format!("ws write: {e}"))
    }

    /// Receive with timeout; handles pings internally.
    pub fn recv_timeout(&self, timeout: Duration) -> Option<WsMessage> {
        self.rx.recv_timeout(timeout).ok()
    }
}

// ---------- eth_subscribe ----------

/// Default public wss endpoints per chain (publicnode).
pub fn default_wss(chain: &str) -> &'static str {
    match chain {
        "base" => "wss://base-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket",
        "arbitrum" => "wss://arbitrum-one-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket",
        "optimism" => "wss://optimism-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket",
        "polygon" => "wss://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket",
        "bsc" => "wss://bsc-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket",
        _ => "wss://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket",
    }
}

/// Subscribe and collect live notifications.
/// Returns (subscription_id, events) — events are the `params` objects as JSON strings.
pub fn subscribe(
    url: &str,
    method: &str,
    params: serde_json::Value,
    max_events: usize,
    timeout_secs: u64,
) -> Result<(String, Vec<String>), String> {
    let conn = WsConn::connect(url)?;
    let req = serde_json::json!({
        "jsonrpc": "2.0",
        "id": 1,
        "method": "eth_subscribe",
        "params": if params.is_null() { serde_json::json!([method]) } else { serde_json::json!([method, params]) }
    });
    conn.send_text(&req.to_string())?;
    let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(timeout_secs);
    let mut sub_id = String::new();
    let mut events = vec![];
    let mut pending = String::new();
    while Instant::now() < deadline {
        let remain = deadline.saturating_duration_since(Instant::now());
        match conn.recv_timeout(remain.min(Duration::from_millis(500))) {
            Some(WsMessage::Text(t)) => {
                // coalesce fragmented JSON by attempting parse
                pending.push_str(&t);
                let v: serde_json::Result<serde_json::Value> = serde_json::from_str(&pending);
                match v {
                    Ok(v) => {
                        pending.clear();
                        if let Some(id) = v.get("id").and_then(|i| i.as_u64()) {
                            if id == 1 {
                                if let Some(err) = v.get("error") {
                                    return Err(format!("eth_subscribe error: {err}"));
                                }
                                sub_id = v
                                    .get("result")
                                    .and_then(|r| r.as_str())
                                    .unwrap_or("")
                                    .to_string();
                                continue;
                            }
                        }
                        if v.get("method").and_then(|m| m.as_str()) == Some("eth_subscription") {
                            if let Some(params) = v.get("params") {
                                let sid = params.get("subscription").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                if sid == sub_id {
                                    if let Some(result) = params.get("result") {
                                        events.push(result.to_string());
                                        if events.len() >= max_events {
                                            return Ok((sub_id, events));
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Err(_) => {
                        // wait for more fragments; if it can't ever parse, timeout handles it
                        if pending.len() > 1024 * 1024 {
                            return Err("unparseable stream".into());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            Some(WsMessage::Ping(_)) => continue,
            Some(WsMessage::Close(reason)) => {
                return Err(format!("server closed: {:?}", reason));
            }
            None => continue,
            _ => continue,
        }
    }
    if sub_id.is_empty() {
        return Err("no subscription confirmation within timeout".into());
    }
    Ok((sub_id, events))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn sha1_known_vectors() {
        assert_eq!(hex::encode(sha1(b"abc")), "a9993e364706816aba3e25717850c26c9cd0d89d");
        assert_eq!(hex::encode(sha1(b"")), "da39a3ee5e6b4b0d3255bfef95601890afd80709");
        assert_eq!(
            hex::encode(sha1(b"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog")),
            "2fd4e1c67a2d28fced849ee1bb76e7391b93eb12"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn base64_known() {
        assert_eq!(base64(b""), "");
        assert_eq!(base64(b"f"), "Zg==");
        assert_eq!(base64(b"fo"), "Zm8=");
        assert_eq!(base64(b"foo"), "Zm9v");
        assert_eq!(base64(b"foobar"), "Zm9vYmFy");
    }

    #[test]
    fn frame_roundtrip() {
        // encode with mask then decode manually
        let payload = b"hello world";
        let frame = encode_frame(0x1, payload, true);
        assert_eq!(frame[0], 0x81);
        assert_eq!(frame[1] & 0x80, 0x80);
        assert_eq!((frame[1] & 0x7f) as usize, payload.len());
        let key = &frame[2..6];
        let masked = &frame[6..];
        let unmasked: Vec<u8> = masked.iter().enumerate().map(|(i, b)| b ^ key[i % 4]).collect();
        assert_eq!(&unmasked, payload);
        // unmasked encode
        let f2 = encode_frame(0x1, payload, false);
        assert_eq!(&f2[2..], payload);
    }

    #[test]
    fn url_parse() {
        let (tls, host, port, path) = parse_url("wss://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com/websocket").unwrap();
        assert!(tls);
        assert_eq!(host, "ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com");
        assert_eq!(port, 443);
        assert_eq!(path, "/websocket");
        let (tls2, _h, p2, _p) = parse_url("ws://localhost:8546").unwrap();
        assert!(!tls2);
        assert_eq!(p2, 8546);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! rrx-solc: real Solidity compiler integration — detects/installs solc binaries
//! (binaries.soliditylang.org, the same endpoint Remix uses) and compiles via
//! `solc --standard-json` exactly like remix-solidity does.

use std::io::Write;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

use serde_json::{json, Value};

pub struct Solc {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub version: String,
}

fn solc_dir() -> PathBuf {
    if let Ok(d) = std::env::var("RRX_SOLC_DIR") {
        return PathBuf::from(d);
    }
    if let Ok(base) = std::env::var("RRX_HOME") {
        return PathBuf::from(base).join(".solc");
    }
    // fallback: the toolchain-managed dir next to this crate (set at build time)
    PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../.solc")
}

fn fetch_json(url: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
    let resp = ureq::get(url)
        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60))
        .call()
        .map_err(|e| format!("download failed: {e}"))?;
    resp.into_json::<Value>().map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

pub fn list_available() -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
    let list = fetch_json("https://binaries.soliditylang.org/linux-amd64/list.json")?;
    let mut out = vec![];
    if let Value::Object(releases) = list.get("releases").cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
        for k in releases.keys() {
            out.push(k.clone());
        }
    }
    out.sort();
    out.reverse();
    Ok(out)
}

pub fn latest_version() -> Result<String, String> {
    let list = fetch_json("https://binaries.soliditylang.org/linux-amd64/list.json")?;
    Ok(list
        .get("latestRelease")
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("0.8.24")
        .to_string())
}

/// Download and install a solc version; returns the binary path.
pub fn install(version: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    let dir = solc_dir().join(version);
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let bin = dir.join(format!("solc-{version}"));
    if bin.exists() {
        return Ok(bin);
    }
    let list = fetch_json("https://binaries.soliditylang.org/linux-amd64/list.json")?;
    let rel = list["releases"][version]
        .as_str()
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("version {version} not found on binaries.soliditylang.org"))?;
    let url = format!("https://binaries.soliditylang.org/linux-amd64/{rel}");
    let resp = ureq::get(&url)
        .timeout(std::time::Duration::from_secs(300))
        .call()
        .map_err(|e| format!("download failed: {e}"))?;
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    use std::io::Read as _;
    resp.into_reader().take(100_000_000).read_to_end(&mut bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    std::fs::write(&bin, &bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    {
        use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
        std::fs::set_permissions(&bin, std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    Ok(bin)
}

pub fn installed_versions() -> Vec<String> {
    let dir = solc_dir();
    let mut out = vec![];
    if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) {
        for e in entries.flatten() {
            if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(e.path()) {
                for f in rd.flatten() {
                    if let Some(name) = f.file_name().to_str() {
                        if name.starts_with("solc-") {
                            out.push(name.trim_start_matches("solc-").to_string());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out.sort();
    out.reverse();
    out
}

/// Detect a usable solc: PATH first, then the newest installed managed version.
pub fn detect() -> Result<Solc, String> {
    if let Ok(out) = Command::new("solc").arg("--version").output() {
        if out.status.success() {
            let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stdout);
            let version = s
                .split_whitespace()
                .find(|w| w.chars().next().map(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()).unwrap_or(false))
                .unwrap_or("unknown")
                .trim_end_matches('+')
                .to_string();
            return Ok(Solc { path: PathBuf::from("solc"), version });
        }
    }
    if let Some(v) = installed_versions().first().cloned() {
        let path = solc_dir().join(&v).join(format!("solc-{v}"));
        if path.exists() {
            return Ok(Solc { path, version: v });
        }
    }
    Err("no solc found: run `rrx solc install <version>`".into())
}

/// Pin a specific version (installing if needed).
pub fn use_version(version: &str) -> Result<Solc, String> {
    let path = install(version)?;
    Ok(Solc { path, version: version.to_string() })
}

impl Solc {
    /// Run solc --standard-json with the given input (real compiler process).
    pub fn compile(&self, input: &Value) -> Result<Value, String> {
        let mut child = Command::new(&self.path)
            .arg("--standard-json")
            .stdin(Stdio::piped())
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()
            .map_err(|e| format!("failed to start solc: {e}"))?;
        child
            .stdin
            .as_mut()
            .unwrap()
            .write_all(input.to_string().as_bytes())
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let out = child.wait_with_output().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        if !out.status.success() && out.stdout.is_empty() {
            return Err(format!(
                "solc exited with {}: {}",
                out.status,
                String::from_utf8_lossy(&out.stderr)
            ));
        }
        serde_json::from_slice(&out.stdout).map_err(|e| format!("invalid solc output: {e}"))
    }

    pub fn version_output(&self) -> String {
        Command::new(&self.path)
            .arg("--version")
            .output()
            .map(|o| String::from_utf8_lossy(&o.stdout).trim().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }
}

/// Build a standard-json input (like Remix's compiler settings).
pub fn build_input(
    sources: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
    optimizer: bool,
    evm_version: &str,
) -> Value {
    let mut language_sources = serde_json::Map::new();
    for (name, content) in sources {
        language_sources.insert(name.clone(), json!({ "content": content }));
    }
    json!({
        "language": "Solidity",
        "sources": language_sources,
        "settings": {
            "optimizer": { "enabled": optimizer, "runs": 200 },
            "evmVersion": evm_version,
            "outputSelection": {
                "*": {
                    "*": [
                        "abi", "evm.bytecode.object", "evm.bytecode.linkReferences",
                        "evm.deployedBytecode.object", "evm.deployedBytecode.sourceMap",
                        "evm.methodIdentifiers", "metadata"
                    ],
                    "": [ "ast" ]
                }
            }
        }
    })
}

/// Extract contract artifacts { name -> artifact } from standard-json output.
pub fn extract_artifacts(output: &Value) -> Result<Vec<(String, Value)>, String> {
    let mut out = vec![];
    if output.get("contracts").is_none() {
        // surface compiler errors before giving up
        if let Some(errs) = output.get("errors").and_then(|e| e.as_array()) {
            let msgs: Vec<String> = errs
                .iter()
                .map(|e| e.get("formattedMessage").or_else(|| e.get("message")).and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("?").to_string())
                .collect();
            return Err(if msgs.is_empty() { "no contracts in solc output".to_string() } else { msgs.join("\n") });
        }
        return Err("no contracts in solc output".into());
    }
    let contracts = output
        .get("contracts")
        .and_then(|c| c.as_object())
        .ok_or("no contracts in solc output")?;
    for (file, per_file) in contracts {
        if let Some(per_file) = per_file.as_object() {
            for (name, artifact) in per_file {
                let mut a = artifact.clone();
                a["file"] = Value::String(file.clone());
                a["name"] = Value::String(name.clone());
                out.push((format!("{file}:{name}"), a));
            }
        }
    }
    // surface compiler errors
    if let Some(errs) = output.get("errors").and_then(|e| e.as_array()) {
        let hard: Vec<&Value> = errs
            .iter()
            .filter(|e| e.get("severity").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) == Some("error"))
            .collect();
        if !hard.is_empty() && out.is_empty() {
            let msgs: Vec<String> = hard
                .iter()
                .map(|e| e.get("formattedMessage").or_else(|| e.get("message")).and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("?").to_string())
                .collect();
            return Err(msgs.join("\n"));
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}
```

```rust
//! rrx AA — ERC-4337 account abstraction against the REAL EntryPoint contract
//! on Ethereum mainnet. `simulateValidation` runs via eth_call: the genuine
//! on-chain EntryPoint validation logic executes (read-only, no funds move).

use rrx_rpc::Provider;
use rrx_util::{u256_from_str, u256_to_be32, H160, U256};

pub const ENTRYPOINT_V06: &str = "0x5FF137D4b0FDCD49DcA30c7CF57E578a026d2789";
pub const ENTRYPOINT_V07: &str = "0x0000000071727De22E5E9d8BAf0edAc6f37da032";

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct UserOperation {
    pub sender: String,
    pub nonce: String,
    pub init_code: String,
    pub call_data: String,
    pub call_gas_limit: String,
    pub verification_gas_limit: String,
    pub pre_verification_gas: String,
    pub max_fee_per_gas: String,
    pub max_priority_fee_per_gas: String,
    pub paymaster_and_data: String,
    pub signature: String,
}

fn sel(sig: &str) -> [u8; 4] {
    let h = rrx_util::keccak256(sig.as_bytes());
    [h[0], h[1], h[2], h[3]]
}

fn word_u256(v: &U256) -> [u8; 32] {
    u256_to_be32(v)
}

fn parse_u(s: &str) -> Result<U256, String> {
    let s = s.trim();
    if let Some(h) = s.strip_prefix("0x") {
        if h.is_empty() {
            return Ok(U256::zero());
        }
        return u256_from_str(&format!("0x{h}"));
    }
    u256_from_str(s)
}

/// ABI-encode the v0.6 UserOperation tuple (11 members, several dynamic).
fn encode_user_op(op: &UserOperation) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let addr = rrx_util::h160_from_hex(&op.sender)?;
    let nonce = parse_u(&op.nonce)?;
    let call_gas = parse_u(&op.call_gas_limit)?;
    let ver_gas = parse_u(&op.verification_gas_limit)?;
    let pre_gas = parse_u(&op.pre_verification_gas)?;
    let max_fee = parse_u(&op.max_fee_per_gas)?;
    let max_pri = parse_u(&op.max_priority_fee_per_gas)?;
    let init = hex_bytes(&op.init_code)?;
    let call = hex_bytes(&op.call_data)?;
    let pm = hex_bytes(&op.paymaster_and_data)?;
    let sig = hex_bytes(&op.signature)?;

    // head: 11 words (statics + offsets into the tail)
    // 0 addr | 1 nonce | 2 off init | 3 off call | 4 callGas | 5 verGas
    // 6 preGas | 7 maxFee | 8 maxPri | 9 off pm | 10 off sig
    let mut head: Vec<[u8; 32]> = Vec::with_capacity(11);
    let mut a = [0u8; 32];
    a[12..].copy_from_slice(addr.as_bytes());
    head.push(a);
    head.push(word_u256(&nonce));
    head.push([0u8; 32]); // offsets patched below
    head.push([0u8; 32]);
    head.push(word_u256(&call_gas));
    head.push(word_u256(&ver_gas));
    head.push(word_u256(&pre_gas));
    head.push(word_u256(&max_fee));
    head.push(word_u256(&max_pri));
    head.push([0u8; 32]);
    head.push([0u8; 32]);

    let mut tail: Vec<Vec<u8>> = vec![];
    let push_dyn = |tail: &mut Vec<Vec<u8>>, data: &Vec<u8>| -> usize {
        let off = 11 * 32 + tail.iter().map(|t| t.len()).sum::<usize>();
        let mut chunk = Vec::with_capacity(32 + (data.len() + 31) / 32 * 32);
        chunk.extend_from_slice(&word_u256(&U256::from(data.len() as u64)));
        chunk.extend_from_slice(data);
        let pad = (32 - data.len() % 32) % 32;
        chunk.extend(std::iter::repeat(0u8).take(pad));
        tail.push(chunk);
        off
    };
    let off_init = push_dyn(&mut tail, &init);
    let off_call = push_dyn(&mut tail, &call);
    let off_pm = push_dyn(&mut tail, &pm);
    let off_sig = push_dyn(&mut tail, &sig);

    head[2] = word_u256(&U256::from(off_init as u64));
    head[3] = word_u256(&U256::from(off_call as u64));
    head[9] = word_u256(&U256::from(off_pm as u64));
    head[10] = word_u256(&U256::from(off_sig as u64));

    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(11 * 32 + tail.iter().map(|t| t.len()).sum::<usize>());
    for w in head {
        out.extend_from_slice(&w);
    }
    for t in tail {
        out.extend_from_slice(&t);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn hex_bytes(s: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let s = s.trim().trim_start_matches("0x");
    if s.is_empty() {
        return Ok(vec![]);
    }
    rrx_util::from_hex(s).map_err(|e| format!("bad hex: {e}"))
}

fn entrypoint() -> Result<H160, String> {
    rrx_util::h160_from_hex(ENTRYPOINT_V06)
}

/// REAL `simulateValidation(UserOperation)` — executed with the REAL deployed
/// EntryPoint BYTECODE and REAL mainnet state inside the rrx EVM interpreter.
/// Public RPCs strip revert data, and the EntryPoint returns its result BY
/// reverting — so the only honest way to see the true ValidationResult /
/// ExecutionResult is to run the genuine on-chain code locally.
pub fn simulate_validation(p: &Provider, op: &UserOperation) -> Result<String, String> {
    let to = entrypoint()?;
    let calldata = {
        let mut c = sel("simulateValidation((address,uint256,bytes,bytes,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes,bytes))").to_vec();
        c.extend_from_slice(&encode_user_op(op)?);
        c
    };
    let res = execute_on_real_entrypoint(p, &calldata)?;
    Ok(decode_entrypoint_result(&res))
}

/// Download the REAL EntryPoint code + storage from the live network and run
/// arbitrary calldata against it in the rrx EVM (eth_call semantics).
fn execute_on_real_entrypoint(p: &Provider, calldata: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let to = entrypoint()?;
    let forked = crate::fork::download_state(p, "latest", &[to])?;
    let mut chain = rrx_chain::Chain::genesis(
        rrx_chain::ChainConfig {
            chain_id: forked.chain_id,
            ..Default::default()
        },
        &[],
    );
    chain.state = forked.state;
    // eth_call semantics: caller pays nothing, but fund defensively
    chain.state.fund(&H160::zero(), U256::from_dec_str("1000000000000000000").unwrap());
    let debug = std::env::var("RRX_AA_DEBUG").is_ok();
    let res = chain.call(H160::zero(), Some(to), U256::zero(), calldata.to_vec(), 30_000_000, debug);
    if debug {
        if let Some(t) = &res.trace {
            eprintln!("DEBUG executed {} steps, FIRST 12:", t.steps.len());
            for s in t.steps.iter().take(12) {
                eprintln!("  pc={} {} depth={} err={:?}", s.pc, rrx_evm::opcode_name(s.opcode), s.depth, s.error);
            }
            eprintln!("LAST 5:");
            for s in t.steps.iter().rev().take(5).rev() {
                eprintln!("  pc={} {} depth={} err={:?}", s.pc, rrx_evm::opcode_name(s.opcode), s.depth, s.error);
            }
        }
    }
    if res.is_success() {
        Ok(res.output)
    } else if !res.output.is_empty() {
        Ok(res.output) // EntryPoint reverts WITH its result data — that is the answer
    } else if let Some(r) = res.revert_reason() {
        Err(format!("EntryPoint execution reverted: {r}"))
    } else {
        Err("EntryPoint execution reverted with no data — the op is not valid              under the real v0.6 on-chain rules (e.g. sender account missing and              no initCode supplied)".into())
    }
}

/// Decode ValidationResult / ExecutionResult / known failure errors.
fn decode_entrypoint_result(data: &[u8]) -> String {
    if data.is_empty() {
        return "EntryPoint replied with empty data\n".into();
    }
    if let Some(reason) = rrx_util::abi::decode_revert_reason(data) {
        return format!("EntryPoint reverted: {reason}\n");
    }
    let got = sel_bytes(data);
    let s_val = sel("ValidationResult((uint256,uint256,uint256),(uint256,uint256,uint256))");
    let s_exec = sel("ExecutionResult(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,bool)");
    let s_notfound = sel("SenderAccountNotFound(address)");
    if got == s_val {
        // word0 of inner tuple = preOpGas; then validAfter, validUntil; outer tail = returnInfo (paid,...)
        let pre_op_gas = word_at(data, 1);
        let valid_after = word_at(data, 2);
        let valid_until = word_at(data, 3);
        let paid = word_at(data, 4);
        format!(
            "simulateValidation on REAL EntryPoint {ENTRYPOINT_V06} — ValidationResult:\n\
             preOpGas     {pre_op_gas}\n\
             validAfter   {valid_after}\n\
             validUntil   {valid_until}  (0 = infinite)\n\
             paid         {paid} wei\n\
             ✓ real on-chain validation executed (signature/nonce/gas) — read-only eth_call\n"
        )
    } else if got == s_exec {
        let pre_op_gas = word_at(data, 1);
        let paid = word_at(data, 2);
        let valid_after = word_at(data, 3);
        let valid_until = word_at(data, 4);
        format!(
            "simulateValidation on REAL EntryPoint {ENTRYPOINT_V06} — ExecutionResult:\n\
             preOpGas     {pre_op_gas}\n\
             paid         {paid} wei\n\
             validAfter   {valid_after}\n\
             validUntil   {valid_until}\n\
             (validation ran on-chain; op not valid for immediate execution)\n"
        )
    } else if got == sel("FailedOp(uint256,string)") {
        // (uint256 opIndex, string message)
        let op_idx = word_at(data, 1);
        let msg_off = word_at(data, 2);
        let msg = read_string_at(data, &msg_off);
        format!(
            "EntryPoint: FailedOp #{op_idx} — \"{msg}\"\n(REAL on-chain validation failure — e.g. AA20 = account not deployed)\n"
        )
    } else if got == s_notfound {
        format!(
            "EntryPoint: SenderAccountNotFound — the smart-account at the given \
             sender is not deployed yet (needs initCode for the first op). \
             Real on-chain check performed.\n"
        )
    } else {
        let head = if data.len() >= 4 { hexs(&sel_bytes(data)) } else { hexs(data) };
        format!(
            "EntryPoint validation reverted — {} bytes of result data (selector 0x{}):\n  0x{}\n(REAL revert data from the real on-chain validation logic)\n",
            data.len(),
            head,
            hexs(&data[..data.len().min(160)])
        )
    }
}

/// Read an ABI-encoded string at the given byte offset (relative to data start).
fn read_string_at(data: &[u8], off_hex: &str) -> String {
    let off: usize = match off_hex.parse::<u64>() {
        Ok(v) => v as usize,
        Err(_) => return "?".into(),
    };
    if data.len() < off + 32 {
        return "?".into();
    }
    let len = U256::from_big_endian(&data[off..off + 32]).min(U256::from(512u64)).as_u64() as usize;
    let start = off + 32;
    let end = (start + len).min(data.len());
    String::from_utf8_lossy(&data[start..end]).to_string()
}

fn sel_bytes(data: &[u8]) -> [u8; 4] {
    [data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]
}

fn word_at(data: &[u8], idx: usize) -> String {
    let start = idx * 32;
    if data.len() < start + 32 {
        return "0".into();
    }
    let mut b = [0u8; 32];
    b.copy_from_slice(&data[start..start + 32]);
    U256::from_big_endian(&b).to_string()
}

/// REAL nonce read — executed with the REAL EntryPoint code locally.
pub fn nonce_of(p: &Provider, sender: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let addr = rrx_util::h160_from_hex(sender)?;
    let mut calldata = sel("getNonce(address,uint192)").to_vec();
    let mut a = [0u8; 32];
    a[12..].copy_from_slice(addr.as_bytes());
    calldata.extend_from_slice(&a);
    calldata.extend_from_slice(&word_u256(&U256::zero()));
    let raw = execute_on_real_entrypoint(p, &calldata)?;
    if raw.is_empty() {
        return Err("getNonce returned empty".into());
    }
    Ok(word_at(&raw, 0))
}

fn word(data: &[u8], idx: usize) -> String {
    let start = idx * 32;
    if data.len() < start + 32 {
        return "0".into();
    }
    let mut b = [0u8; 32];
    b.copy_from_slice(&data[start..start + 32]);
    U256::from_big_endian(&b).to_string()
}

fn hexs(b: &[u8]) -> String {
    b.iter().map(|x| format!("{x:02x}")).collect()
}
```

```rust
//! Static Analysis (remix-analyzer equivalent): real AST-based security & gas checks.

use serde_json::Value;
use std::path::Path;

#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum Severity {
    High,
    Medium,
    Low,
    Info,
}

impl Severity {
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Severity::High => "HIGH",
            Severity::Medium => "MEDIUM",
            Severity::Low => "LOW",
            Severity::Info => "INFO",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Finding {
    pub rule: &'static str,
    pub severity: Severity,
    pub message: String,
    pub file: String,
    pub line: usize,
    pub col: usize,
}

struct Ctx {
    findings: Vec<Finding>,
    sources: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
}

impl Ctx {
    fn locate(&self, file: &str, src: &str) -> (usize, usize) {
        // src = "start:length:fileIndex"
        let start: usize = src.split(':').next().and_then(|s| s.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(0);
        let text = self.sources.get(file).map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        let mut line = 1usize;
        let mut col = 1usize;
        for (i, ch) in text.char_indices() {
            if i >= start {
                break;
            }
            if ch == '\n' {
                line += 1;
                col = 1;
            } else {
                col += 1;
            }
        }
        (line, col)
    }

    fn add(&mut self, rule: &'static str, sev: Severity, msg: &str, file: &str, src: &str) {
        let (line, col) = self.locate(file, src);
        self.findings.push(Finding {
            rule,
            severity: sev,
            message: msg.to_string(),
            file: file.to_string(),
            line,
            col,
        });
    }
}

/// Run all analyses over standard-json output (needs "ast" in outputSelection).
pub fn analyze(output: &Value, sources: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>) -> Vec<Finding> {
    let mut ctx = Ctx { findings: vec![], sources: sources.clone() };
    if let Some(sources_ast) = output.get("sources").and_then(|s| s.as_object()) {
        for (file, sv) in sources_ast {
            if let Some(ast) = sv.get("ast") {
                let mut stack = vec![ast.clone()];
                while let Some(node) = stack.pop() {
                    visit(&mut ctx, file, &node);
                    if let Some(children) = node.get("nodes").and_then(|n| n.as_array()) {
                        for c in children {
                            stack.push(c.clone());
                        }
                    }
                    if let Some(body) = node.get("body") {
                        if body.is_object() {
                            stack.push(body.clone());
                        }
                    }
                    if let Some(stmts) = node.get("statements").and_then(|n| n.as_array()) {
                        for s in stmts {
                            stack.push(s.clone());
                        }
                    }
                    // expression subtrees we care about
                    for key in ["expression", "leftHandSide", "rightHandSide", "subExpression", "condition", "trueBody", "falseBody", "body", "initializationExpression"] {
                        if let Some(child) = node.get(key) {
                            if child.is_object() {
                                stack.push(child.clone());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ctx.findings.sort_by(|a, b| (a.file.clone(), a.line).cmp(&(b.file.clone(), b.line)));
    ctx.findings
}

fn is_member_call(node: &Value, obj: &str, member: &[&str]) -> bool {
    if node.get("nodeType").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) != Some("FunctionCall") {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(expr) = node.get("expression") {
        if expr.get("nodeType").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) == Some("MemberAccess") {
            let member_name = expr.get("memberName").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            let base_name = expr
                .get("expression")
                .and_then(|e| e.get("name"))
                .and_then(|n| n.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("");
            let base_is = if base_name.is_empty() {
                // e.g. payable(x).call — treat any .call as low level
                false
            } else {
                base_name == obj
            };
            return (base_is || obj.is_empty()) && member.contains(&member_name);
        }
    }
    false
}

fn visit(ctx: &mut Ctx, file: &str, node: &Value) {
    let ty = node.get("nodeType").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
    let src = node.get("src").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");

    match ty {
        "MemberAccess" => {
            let member = node.get("memberName").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            let base = node
                .get("expression")
                .and_then(|e| e.get("name"))
                .and_then(|n| n.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("");
            if base == "tx" && member == "origin" {
                ctx.add(
                    "TXORIGIN",
                    Severity::Medium,
                    "Use of tx.origin for authentication is dangerous (phishing): use msg.sender instead",
                    file,
                    src,
                );
            }
        }
        "FunctionCall" => {
            let kind = node.get("kind").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            let callee = node
                .get("expression")
                .and_then(|e| e.get("name"))
                .and_then(|n| n.as_str())
                .unwrap_or("");
            if callee == "selfdestruct" || callee == "suicide" {
                ctx.add(
                    "SELFDESTRUCT",
                    Severity::Medium,
                    "selfdestruct can send funds to arbitrary addresses and permanently destroys the contract (EIP-6780 restrictions apply)",
                    file,
                    src,
                );
            }
            if is_member_call(node, "", &["delegatecall"]) {
                ctx.add(
                    "DELEGATECALL",
                    Severity::Medium,
                    "delegatecall executes foreign code in the caller's storage context — ensure the target is trusted",
                    file,
                    src,
                );
            }
            if is_member_call(node, "", &["call", "callcode"]) {
                ctx.add(
                    "LOW_LEVEL_CALL",
                    Severity::Low,
                    "Low-level call() bypasses type and return-value checks — check success and consider typed interfaces",
                    file,
                    src,
                );
            }
            if is_member_call(node, "", &["transfer", "send"]) {
                // unchecked if not inside a require/if — heuristic: parent not tracked here,
                // so flag only when the result is obviously ignored (statement expression)
                if kind == "functionCall" {
                    let in_stmt = node
                        .get("expression")
                        .and_then(|e| e.get("memberName"))
                        .is_some();
                    if in_stmt {
                        ctx.add(
                            "UNCHECKED_TRANSFER",
                            Severity::Low,
                            "transfer/send result should be checked (or use call with explicit checks)",
                            file,
                            src,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
            if let Some(expr) = node.get("expression") {
                if expr.get("nodeType").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some("Identifier")
                    && expr.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) == Some("keccak256")
                {
                    // fine; skip
                }
            }
        }
        "InlineAssembly" => {
            ctx.add(
                "INLINE_ASSEMBLY",
                Severity::Info,
                "Inline assembly bypasses Solidity safety checks",
                file,
                src,
            );
        }
        "ForStatement" | "WhileStatement" => {
            ctx.add(
                "GAS_LIMIT_LOOP",
                Severity::Low,
                "Unbounded loop: if iterations depend on user input, the function can exceed the block gas limit",
                file,
                src,
            );
        }
        "ContractDefinition" => {
            let kind = node.get("contractKind").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            if kind == "contract" {
                // could-be-view check: functions without any state mutation marked payable/default
                if let Some(funcs) = node.get("nodes").and_then(|n| n.as_array()) {
                    for f in funcs {
                        if f.get("nodeType").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some("FunctionDefinition") {
                            let name = f.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                            let sm = f.get("stateMutability").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                            let vis = f.get("visibility").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                            if sm == "payable" && !name.is_empty() && vis == "public" {
                                ctx.add(
                                    "PAYABLE_SUSPECT",
                                    Severity::Info,
                                    &format!("function '{name}' is payable — confirm it must accept value (gas: payable adds ~37 gas per call)"),
                                    file,
                                    f.get("src").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(""),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        "PragmaDirective" => {
            let literals: Vec<String> = node
                .get("literals")
                .and_then(|l| l.as_array())
                .map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|x| x.as_str().map(|s| s.to_string())).collect())
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let value = node
                .get("value")
                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
                .map(|s| s.to_string())
                .unwrap_or_else(|| literals.join(" "));
            let has_08 = value.contains("0.8") || value.contains("0.9");
            if !value.is_empty() && !has_08 {
                ctx.add(
                    "OUTDATED_COMPILER",
                    Severity::Medium,
                    "Solidity <0.8 has no built-in overflow checks — consider ^0.8.x",
                    file,
                    src,
                );
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

pub fn format_findings(findings: &[Finding], root: &Path) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    if findings.is_empty() {
        out.push_str("✓ no findings — clean analysis\n");
        return out;
    }
    for f in findings {
        let rel = Path::new(&f.file);
        let shown = root.join(rel);
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "[{:6}] {:22} {}:{}:{} — {}\n",
            f.severity.as_str(),
            f.rule,
            shown.display(),
            f.line,
            f.col,
            f.message
        ));
    }
    let (h, m, l, i) = findings.iter().fold((0, 0, 0, 0), |acc, f| match f.severity {
        Severity::High => (acc.0 + 1, acc.1, acc.2, acc.3),
        Severity::Medium => (acc.0, acc.1 + 1, acc.2, acc.3),
        Severity::Low => (acc.0, acc.1, acc.2 + 1, acc.3),
        Severity::Info => (acc.0, acc.1, acc.2, acc.3 + 1),
    });
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "\n{} finding(s): {h} high, {m} medium, {l} low, {i} info\n",
        findings.len()
    ));
    out
}
```
