```rust
//! EIP-4844 blob transaction tooling: decode real type-3 txs from the wire,
//! cryptographically verify KZG sidecars (blob ↔ commitment ↔ versioned hash),
//! build + sign real blob txs, and fetch live blob txs from mainnet.

use rrx_bls381::kzg;
use rrx_chain::{sign_transaction, BlobSidecar, TxType, UnsignedTx, Transaction};
use rrx_crypto::KeyPair;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, rlp::Rlp, H160, H256, U256};

/// Wrap a signed blob tx payload with its sidecar (network form):
/// 0x03 || rlp([tx_payload_body, commitments, blobs, proofs])
pub fn wrap_with_sidecar(tx: &Transaction, sidecar: &BlobSidecar) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    if !matches!(tx, Transaction::Eip4844 { .. }) {
        return Err("not a blob transaction".into());
    }
    if sidecar.blobs.len() != sidecar.commitments.len() || sidecar.blobs.len() != sidecar.proofs.len() {
        return Err("sidecar length mismatch".into());
    }
    // tx payload body without the type byte: strip the 0x03 prefix from rlp_encode.
    // The payload body is itself a valid RLP item (a list), so we can embed it raw:
    // wrapper = 0x03 || rlp([payload_list, commitments, blobs, proofs])
    let full = tx.rlp_encode();
    let body = &full[1..];
    let commits = Rlp::list(sidecar.commitments.iter().map(|c| Rlp::Bytes(c.to_vec())).collect()).encode();
    let blobs = Rlp::list(sidecar.blobs.iter().map(|b| Rlp::Bytes(b.clone())).collect()).encode();
    let proofs = Rlp::list(sidecar.proofs.iter().map(|p| Rlp::Bytes(p.to_vec())).collect()).encode();
    let out = vec![0x03u8];
    let items: Vec<Vec<u8>> = vec![body.to_vec(), commits, blobs, proofs];
    Ok([out, rlp_list_raw(&items)].concat())
}

/// Encode a list from already-encoded raw items.
fn rlp_list_raw(items: &[Vec<u8>]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let payload_len: usize = items.iter().map(|i| i.len()).sum();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    if payload_len < 56 {
        out.push(0xc0 + payload_len as u8);
    } else {
        let lenb = payload_len.to_be_bytes();
        let start = lenb.iter().position(|&b| b != 0).unwrap();
        let sig = &lenb[start..];
        out.push(0xf7 + sig.len() as u8);
        out.extend_from_slice(sig);
    }
    for i in items {
        out.extend_from_slice(i);
    }
    out
}

/// Minimal RLP walker for the sidecar wrapper.
struct SidecarDec<'a> {
    data: &'a [u8],
    pos: usize,
}

impl<'a> SidecarDec<'a> {
    fn enter_list(&mut self) -> Result<usize, String> {
        let b = *self.data.get(self.pos).ok_or("rlp: eof")?;
        let (start, len) = if (0xc0..0xf8).contains(&b) {
            (self.pos + 1, (b - 0xc0) as usize)
        } else if b >= 0xf8 {
            let ll = (b - 0xf7) as usize;
            let mut l = 0usize;
            for &x in &self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll] {
                l = (l << 8) | x as usize;
            }
            (self.pos + 1 + ll, l)
        } else {
            return Err("rlp: expected list".into());
        };
        if start + len > self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: truncated list".into());
        }
        self.pos = start;
        Ok(start + len)
    }

    fn item(&mut self) -> Result<&'a [u8], String> {
        let b = *self.data.get(self.pos).ok_or("rlp: eof")?;
        let (start, len) = if b < 0x80 {
            (self.pos, 1)
        } else if b < 0xb8 {
            (self.pos + 1, (b - 0x80) as usize)
        } else if b < 0xc0 {
            let ll = (b - 0xb7) as usize;
            let mut l = 0usize;
            for &x in &self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll] {
                l = (l << 8) | x as usize;
            }
            (self.pos + 1 + ll, l)
        } else {
            return Err("rlp: expected bytes item".into());
        };
        if start + len > self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: truncated".into());
        }
        self.pos = start;
        let out = &self.data[start..start + len];
        self.pos += len;
        Ok(out)
    }

    /// Full raw encoding of the next item (bytes or list), incl. prefix.
    fn item_raw(&mut self) -> Result<&'a [u8], String> {
        let start = self.pos;
        let b = *self.data.get(self.pos).ok_or("rlp: eof")?;
        let payload_start;
        let payload_len;
        if b < 0x80 {
            payload_start = self.pos;
            payload_len = 1;
        } else if b < 0xb8 {
            payload_start = self.pos + 1;
            payload_len = (b - 0x80) as usize;
        } else if b < 0xc0 {
            let ll = (b - 0xb7) as usize;
            let mut l = 0usize;
            for &x in &self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll] {
                l = (l << 8) | x as usize;
            }
            payload_start = self.pos + 1 + ll;
            payload_len = l;
        } else if b < 0xf8 {
            payload_start = self.pos + 1;
            payload_len = (b - 0xc0) as usize;
        } else {
            let ll = (b - 0xf7) as usize;
            let mut l = 0usize;
            for &x in &self.data[self.pos + 1..self.pos + 1 + ll] {
                l = (l << 8) | x as usize;
            }
            payload_start = self.pos + 1 + ll;
            payload_len = l;
        }
        if payload_start + payload_len > self.data.len() {
            return Err("rlp: truncated item".into());
        }
        let end = payload_start + payload_len;
        self.pos = end;
        Ok(&self.data[start..end])
    }
}

/// Decode a network-wrapped blob tx (with sidecar). Returns tx + sidecar.
pub fn decode_with_sidecar(raw: &[u8]) -> Result<(Transaction, BlobSidecar), String> {
    if raw.is_empty() || raw[0] != 0x03 {
        return Err("not a blob transaction wrapper (expected 0x03 prefix)".into());
    }
    // outer structure: rlp([payload_list, commitments, blobs, proofs])
    let mut d = SidecarDec { data: &raw[1..], pos: 0 };
    let _outer_end = d.enter_list()?;
    let payload = d.item_raw()?.to_vec();
    // the payload list (without type byte) is the signed tx payload → re-add 0x03 prefix
    let tx = Transaction::decode(&[&[0x03u8], &payload[..]].concat())?;
    let c_end = d.enter_list()?;
    let mut commitments = vec![];
    while d.pos < c_end {
        let b = d.item()?;
        if b.len() != 48 {
            return Err("commitment must be 48 bytes".into());
        }
        let mut c = [0u8; 48];
        c.copy_from_slice(b);
        commitments.push(c);
    }
    d.pos = c_end;
    let b_end = d.enter_list()?;
    let mut blobs = vec![];
    while d.pos < b_end {
        blobs.push(d.item()?.to_vec());
    }
    d.pos = b_end;
    let p_end = d.enter_list()?;
    let mut proofs = vec![];
    while d.pos < p_end {
        let b = d.item()?;
        if b.len() != 48 {
            return Err("proof must be 48 bytes".into());
        }
        let mut pr = [0u8; 48];
        pr.copy_from_slice(b);
        proofs.push(pr);
    }
    Ok((tx, BlobSidecar { blobs, commitments, proofs }))
}

/// REAL KZG verification of a full sidecar against the tx's versioned hashes.
pub fn verify_sidecar(tx: &Transaction, sidecar: &BlobSidecar) -> Result<String, String> {
    let vhs = match tx {
        Transaction::Eip4844 { blob_versioned_hashes, .. } => blob_versioned_hashes,
        _ => return Err("not a blob transaction".into()),
    };
    if vhs.len() != sidecar.blobs.len() {
        return Err(format!(
            "versioned hash count {} != blob count {}",
            vhs.len(),
            sidecar.blobs.len()
        ));
    }
    let mut report = String::from("KZG sidecar verification (real BLS12-381 pairing checks):\n");
    for (i, blob) in sidecar.blobs.iter().enumerate() {
        let c = &sidecar.commitments[i];
        let p = &sidecar.proofs[i];
        // 1. versioned hash must equal 0x01 || sha256(commitment)[1..]
        let vh = kzg::versioned_hash(c)?;
        if vh != vhs[i].0 {
            return Err(format!(
                "blob #{}: versioned hash mismatch (tx hash {} != computed {})",
                i,
                hex::encode(vhs[i].0),
                hex::encode(vh)
            ));
        }
        // 2. full pairing check: verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, commitment, proof)
        let ok = kzg::verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, c, p)?;
        if !ok {
            return Err(format!("blob #{}: KZG proof verification FAILED", i));
        }
        report.push_str(&format!(
            "  blob #{}: ✓ versioned hash + KZG pairing verified ({} bytes)\n",
            i,
            blob.len()
        ));
    }
    Ok(report)
}

/// Build + sign a real blob transaction from a blob file.
/// Computes the REAL KZG commitment + proof with the Ethereum trusted setup.
pub fn build_and_sign(
    blob: &[u8],
    to: H160,
    key: &KeyPair,
    chain_id: u64,
    nonce: u64,
    max_fee: U256,
    max_priority_fee: U256,
    max_fee_per_blob_gas: U256,
    gas_limit: u64,
    value: U256,
    data: Vec<u8>,
) -> Result<(Transaction, BlobSidecar), String> {
    let commitment = kzg::blob_to_kzg_commitment(blob)?;
    let proof = kzg::compute_blob_kzg_proof(blob, &commitment)?;
    let vh = kzg::versioned_hash(&commitment)?;
    let unsigned = UnsignedTx {
        tx_type: TxType::Eip4844,
        chain_id,
        nonce,
        gas_price: U256::zero(),
        max_fee,
        max_priority_fee,
        gas_limit,
        to: Some(to),
        value,
        data,
        access_list: vec![],
        max_fee_per_blob_gas,
        blob_versioned_hashes: vec![H256(vh)],
    };
    let tx = sign_transaction(&unsigned, key)?;
    let sidecar = BlobSidecar { blobs: vec![blob.to_vec()], commitments: vec![commitment], proofs: vec![proof] };
    Ok((tx, sidecar))
}

/// Human-readable report of a decoded blob tx.
pub fn tx_report(tx: &Transaction) -> String {
    match tx {
        Transaction::Eip4844 { chain_id, nonce, max_priority_fee, max_fee, gas_limit, to, value, data, max_fee_per_blob_gas, blob_versioned_hashes, y_parity, .. } => {
            let mut out = String::new();
            out.push_str("EIP-4844 blob transaction (type 0x03)\n");
            out.push_str(&format!("  tx hash:        0x{}\n", hex::encode(tx.hash().0)));
            out.push_str(&format!("  sender:         0x{}\n", hex::encode(tx.sender().map(|a| a.0).unwrap_or_default())));
            out.push_str(&format!("  chain id:       {}\n", chain_id));
            out.push_str(&format!("  nonce:          {}\n", nonce));
            out.push_str(&format!("  to:             0x{}\n", hex::encode(to.0)));
            out.push_str(&format!("  value:          {} wei\n", value));
            out.push_str(&format!("  max fee:        {} wei\n", max_fee));
            out.push_str(&format!("  max priority:   {} wei\n", max_priority_fee));
            out.push_str(&format!("  gas limit:      {}\n", gas_limit));
            out.push_str(&format!("  data:           {} bytes\n", data.len()));
            out.push_str(&format!("  max blob fee:   {} wei\n", max_fee_per_blob_gas));
            out.push_str(&format!("  y_parity:       {}\n", y_parity));
            out.push_str(&format!("  blobs:          {}\n", blob_versioned_hashes.len()));
            for (i, vh) in blob_versioned_hashes.iter().enumerate() {
                out.push_str(&format!("  vhash[{}]:       0x{}\n", i, hex::encode(vh.0)));
            }
            out
        }
        _ => format!("transaction (not type 3): hash 0x{}", hex::encode(tx.hash().0)),
    }
}

/// Fetch a REAL transaction from mainnet and report; blob txs show versioned hashes.
pub fn fetch_live(p: &rrx_rpc::Provider, txhash: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let h = txhash.trim_start_matches("0x");
    if h.len() != 64 {
        return Err("tx hash must be 32 bytes".into());
    }
    let raw_hash = hex::decode(h).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let mut bh = [0u8; 32];
    bh.copy_from_slice(&raw_hash);
    let v = p.get_transaction(&H256(bh))?
        .ok_or_else(|| "transaction not found on chain".to_string())?;
    let ttype = v.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0").to_string();
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!("live tx {} on mainnet\n", txhash));
    out.push_str(&format!("  type:       {}{}\n", ttype, if ttype == "0x3" { " (EIP-4844 blob)" } else { "" }));
    if let Some(bl) = v.get("blockNumber").and_then(|b| b.as_str()) {
        out.push_str(&format!("  block:      {}\n", bl));
    }
    if let Some(fr) = v.get("from").and_then(|b| b.as_str()) {
        out.push_str(&format!("  from:       {}\n", fr));
    }
    if let Some(to) = v.get("to").and_then(|b| b.as_str()) {
        out.push_str(&format!("  to:         {}\n", to));
    }
    if ttype == "0x3" {
        if let Some(vhs) = v.get("blobVersionedHashes").and_then(|b| b.as_array()) {
            out.push_str(&format!("  blobs:      {}\n", vhs.len()));
            for (i, vh) in vhs.iter().enumerate() {
                out.push_str(&format!("  vhash[{}]:   {}\n", i, vh.as_str().unwrap_or("?")));
            }
        }
        if let Some(mfbg) = v.get("maxFeePerBlobGas").and_then(|b| b.as_str()) {
            out.push_str(&format!("  maxBlobGas: {} wei\n", mfbg));
        }
        out.push_str("  note:       blob sidecar data lives on the beacon chain, not the execution layer;\n");
        out.push_str("              use `rrx blob verify --raw <network-wrapper>` to cryptographically verify a sidecar\n");
        out.push_str("              or fetch one from blobscan.com by versioned hash\n");
    } else {
        out.push_str("  (use `rrx tx <hash>` for the full report)\n");
    }
    let _ = keccak256(&[0u8; 1]); // keep import used
    Ok(out)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn test_key() -> KeyPair {
        KeyPair::from_slice(&[7u8; 32]).unwrap()
    }

    #[test]
    fn blob_tx_roundtrip_and_verify() {
        // synthetic-but-canonical blob
        let mut blob = vec![0u8; kzg::BLOB_SIZE];
        for (i, b) in blob.iter_mut().enumerate() {
            *b = ((i * 13 + 5) % 256) as u8;
        }
        for chunk in blob.chunks_mut(32) {
            chunk[0] &= 0x0f;
        }
        let key = test_key();
        let to = H160::from_low_u64_be(0xdead);
        let (tx, sidecar) = build_and_sign(
            &blob,
            to,
            &key,
            1,                          // mainnet
            42,
            U256::from(2_000_000_000u64),
            U256::from(100_000_000u64),
            U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            120_000,
            U256::zero(),
            vec![0x11, 0x22],
        )
        .unwrap();
        // sender recovered correctly
        assert_eq!(tx.sender().unwrap(), key.address().unwrap());
        // KZG sidecar verifies cryptographically
        let rep = verify_sidecar(&tx, &sidecar).unwrap();
        assert!(rep.contains("✓"));
        // network wrapper roundtrip
        let wrapped = wrap_with_sidecar(&tx, &sidecar).unwrap();
        let (tx2, sc2) = decode_with_sidecar(&wrapped).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(tx2, tx);
        assert_eq!(sc2, sidecar);
        assert!(verify_sidecar(&tx2, &sc2).unwrap().contains("✓"));
        // tamper with a blob byte → verification must fail
        let mut bad = sidecar.clone();
        bad.blobs[0][100] ^= 0x01;
        assert!(verify_sidecar(&tx, &bad).is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn blob_tx_decode_el_payload() {
        let mut blob = vec![0u8; kzg::BLOB_SIZE];
        blob[0] = 0x01;
        let (tx, _sc) = build_and_sign(
            &blob,
            H160::from_low_u64_be(1),
            &test_key(),
            11155111,
            1,
            U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            U256::from(1),
            U256::from(1),
            50_000,
            U256::zero(),
            vec![],
        )
        .unwrap();
        let raw = tx.rlp_encode();
        let decoded = Transaction::decode(&raw).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(decoded, tx);
        match &decoded {
            Transaction::Eip4844 { blob_versioned_hashes, chain_id, .. } => {
                assert_eq!(chain_id, &11155111);
                assert_eq!(blob_versioned_hashes.len(), 1);
                assert_eq!(blob_versioned_hashes[0].0[0], 0x01);
            }
            _ => panic!("wrong type"),
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
//! rrx block builder — assembles a REAL block from REAL chain data:
//! parent header from the live chain, candidate txs from the pending pool
//! (fallback: latest block's txs — public RPCs often expose no mempool),
//! executed in the rrx EVM against forked live state via RemoteHost,
//! producing a real block header (tx root, receipts root, logs bloom, gas).

use std::collections::HashMap;

use rrx_chain::executor::trie_root_of_encoded;
use rrx_chain::receipt::{LogBloom, Receipt};
use rrx_chain::state::WorldState;
use rrx_evm::{Machine, TxEnv};
use rrx_util::{from_hex, H160, H256, U256};

use crate::remotehost::{block_env_of, mainnet_spec, RemoteHost};
use rrx_rpc::Provider;

/// Candidate transaction prepared for inclusion.
struct Candidate {
    raw_tx: rrx_chain::Transaction,
    from: H160,
    to: Option<H160>,
    value: U256,
    data: Vec<u8>,
    gas_cap: u64,
    access_list: Vec<(H160, Vec<U256>)>,
    effective_price: U256,
    is_blob: bool,
    hash: H256,
}

fn qty(v: &serde_json::Value, key: &str) -> Option<U256> {
    v.get(key)
        .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
        .and_then(|s| u64::from_str_radix(s.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16).ok())
        .map(U256::from)
}

fn addr_of(s: &str) -> Result<H160, String> {
    let h = s.trim_start_matches("0x");
    let b = hex::decode(h).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    if b.len() != 20 {
        return Err("bad address".into());
    }
    Ok(H160::from_slice(&b))
}

/// Rebuild the signed Transaction object from the RPC JSON (so the tx root
/// uses the real signed encoding).
fn tx_from_json(v: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<(rrx_chain::Transaction, bool), String> {
    use rrx_chain::Transaction as T;
    let nonce = qty(v, "nonce").unwrap_or_default().as_u64();
    let gas_limit = qty(v, "gas").unwrap_or_default().as_u64();
    let to = match v.get("to").and_then(|x| x.as_str()) {
        Some(s) if !s.is_empty() && s != "0x" => Some(addr_of(s)?),
        _ => None,
    };
    let value = qty(v, "value").unwrap_or_default();
    let data = v
        .get("input")
        .and_then(|i| i.as_str())
        .and_then(|s| from_hex(s).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let ttype = v.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0");
    let r_word = |v: &serde_json::Value| -> [u8; 32] {
        let s = v.get("r").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0");
        let b = hex::decode(s.trim_start_matches("0x")).unwrap_or_default();
        let mut out = [0u8; 32];
        let n = b.len().min(32);
        out[32 - n..].copy_from_slice(&b[b.len() - n..]);
        out
    };
    let r = r_word(v);
    let s = r_word(v);
    let y_parity = v
        .get("yParity")
        .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
        .and_then(|h| u64::from_str_radix(h.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16).ok())
        .map(|x| x == 1)
        .unwrap_or(false);
    let is_blob = ttype == "0x3";
    let tx = match ttype {
        "0x1" => T::Eip2930 {
            chain_id: qty(v, "chainId").unwrap_or_default().as_u64(),
            nonce,
            gas_price: qty(v, "gasPrice").unwrap_or_default(),
            gas_limit,
            to,
            value,
            data,
            access_list: al_from_json(v)?,
            y_parity,
            r,
            s,
        },
        "0x2" => T::Eip1559 {
            chain_id: qty(v, "chainId").unwrap_or_default().as_u64(),
            nonce,
            max_priority_fee: qty(v, "maxPriorityFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default(),
            max_fee: qty(v, "maxFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default(),
            gas_limit,
            to,
            value,
            data,
            access_list: al_from_json(v)?,
            y_parity,
            r,
            s,
        },
        "0x3" => T::Eip4844 {
            chain_id: qty(v, "chainId").unwrap_or_default().as_u64(),
            nonce,
            max_priority_fee: qty(v, "maxPriorityFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default(),
            max_fee: qty(v, "maxFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default(),
            gas_limit,
            to: to.ok_or("blob tx without to")?,
            value,
            data,
            access_list: al_from_json(v)?,
            max_fee_per_blob_gas: qty(v, "maxFeePerBlobGas").unwrap_or_default(),
            blob_versioned_hashes: v
                .get("blobVersionedHashes")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_array())
                .map(|arr| {
                    arr.iter()
                        .filter_map(|h| {
                            let b = hex::decode(h.as_str()?.trim_start_matches("0x")).ok()?;
                            let mut out = [0u8; 32];
                            out.copy_from_slice(&b);
                            Some(H256(out))
                        })
                        .collect()
                })
                .unwrap_or_default(),
            y_parity,
            r,
            s,
        },
        _ => T::Legacy {
            nonce,
            gas_price: qty(v, "gasPrice").unwrap_or_default(),
            gas_limit,
            to,
            value,
            data,
            chain_id: qty(v, "chainId").map(|c| c.as_u64()),
            v: v
                .get("v")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
                .and_then(|h| u64::from_str_radix(h.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16).ok())
                .unwrap_or(27),
            r,
            s,
        },
    };
    Ok((tx, is_blob))
}

fn al_from_json(v: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<Vec<(H160, Vec<U256>)>, String> {
    let mut out = vec![];
    if let Some(arr) = v.get("accessList").and_then(|x| x.as_array()) {
        for e in arr {
            let addr = addr_of(e.get("address").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).ok_or("al addr")?)?;
            let keys = e
                .get("storageKeys")
                .and_then(|x| x.as_array())
                .map(|ks| {
                    ks.iter()
                        .filter_map(|k| {
                            k.as_str().and_then(|s| from_hex(s).ok()).map(|b| {
                                U256::from_big_endian(&b)
                            })
                        })
                        .collect()
                })
                .unwrap_or_default();
            out.push((addr, keys));
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Build a block on top of the current head from real candidate txs.
pub fn build_block(
    p: &Provider,
    max_txs: usize,
    coinbase: Option<H160>,
    include_blobs: bool,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    // ---- parent header (real) ----
    let parent = p.block_by_tag("latest", false)?.ok_or("no head")?;
    let parent_number = qty(&parent, "number").unwrap_or_default().as_u64();
    let parent_hash = parent
        .get("hash")
        .and_then(|h| h.as_str())
        .and_then(|s| hex::decode(s.trim_start_matches("0x")).ok())
        .map(|b| {
            let mut h = [0u8; 32];
            h.copy_from_slice(&b);
            H256(h)
        })
        .ok_or("parent hash missing")?;
    let parent_base_fee = qty(&parent, "baseFeePerGas").unwrap_or_else(|| U256::from(1_000_000_000u64));
    let gas_limit = qty(&parent, "gasLimit").unwrap_or_default().as_u64();
    let parent_gas_target = qty(&parent, "gasTarget").unwrap_or_else(|| U256::from(gas_limit / 2));
    let chain_id = p.chain_id()?;
    let spec = mainnet_spec(parent_number + 1);

    // ---- candidates: pending first, fallback to latest block txs ----
    let mut source = String::new();
    let mut raw_candidates: Vec<serde_json::Value> = vec![];
    if let Some(pending) = p.block_by_tag("pending", true)? {
        if let Some(txs) = pending.get("transactions").and_then(|t| t.as_array()) {
            if !txs.is_empty() {
                source = format!("pending pool ({} live txs)", txs.len());
                raw_candidates = txs.clone();
            }
        }
    }
    if raw_candidates.is_empty() {
        let latest = p.block_by_tag("latest", true)?.ok_or("no latest block")?;
        let txs = latest
            .get("transactions")
            .and_then(|t| t.as_array())
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_default();
        source = format!(
            "latest confirmed block {} (public RPC exposes no mempool — reordering real recent txs)",
            latest.get("number").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("?")
        );
        raw_candidates = txs;
    }

    // ---- execute against forked live state ----
    let state_tag = format!("0x{:x}", parent_number);
    let block_env = block_env_of(p, parent_number)?;
    let mut host = RemoteHost::new(p.clone(), state_tag.clone(), spec.clone());
    let mut receipts: Vec<Receipt> = vec![];
    let mut included: Vec<rrx_chain::Transaction> = vec![];
    let mut skipped_blob = 0usize;
    let mut cumulative: u64 = 0;
    let mut report = String::new();
    report.push_str(&format!(
        "rrx block builder — proposing block {} on top of {} (0x{})\n",
        parent_number + 1,
        parent_number,
        hex::encode(parent_hash.0)
    ));
    report.push_str(&format!("  tx source:   {}\n", source));

    for txv in raw_candidates.iter().take(max_txs * 2) {
        if included.len() >= max_txs {
            break;
        }
        let (tx, is_blob) = match tx_from_json(txv) {
            Ok(t) => t,
            Err(_) => continue,
        };
        if is_blob && !include_blobs {
            skipped_blob += 1;
            continue;
        }
        let from = match txv
            .get("from")
            .and_then(|x| x.as_str())
            .map(addr_of)
        {
            Some(Ok(f)) => f,
            _ => continue,
        };
        let effective = qty(txv, "gasPrice")
            .or_else(|| {
                let base = qty(txv, "maxFeePerGas")?;
                let pri = qty(txv, "maxPriorityFeePerGas")?;
                Some(base.min(parent_base_fee + pri))
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| U256::from(1_000_000_000u64));
        let value = tx.value();
        let gas_cap = tx.gas_limit().min(gas_limit.saturating_sub(cumulative));
        if gas_cap == 0 {
            break;
        }
        let tx_env = TxEnv {
            caller: from,
            gas_price: effective,
            value,
            data: tx.data().to_vec(),
            gas_limit: gas_cap,
            chain_id,
            to: tx.to(),
            access_list: tx.access_list().clone(),
            blob_hashes: vec![],
        };
        let intrinsic = rrx_evm::tx_intrinsic_gas(&tx_env, &spec);
        let mut env = tx_env.clone();
        env.gas_limit = gas_cap.saturating_sub(intrinsic);
        let machine = Machine::new(&mut host, spec.clone(), block_env.clone(), env, true);
        let result = machine.run_tx();
        let used = result.gas_used + intrinsic;
        cumulative += used;
        let tx_logs = host.take_logs();
        let mut bloom = LogBloom::zero();
        for l in &tx_logs {
            bloom.add_log(l);
        }
        receipts.push(Receipt {
            status: result.is_success(),
            cumulative_gas_used: cumulative,
            bloom,
            logs: tx_logs,
            tx_type: match &tx {
                rrx_chain::Transaction::Legacy { .. } => 0,
                rrx_chain::Transaction::Eip2930 { .. } => 1,
                rrx_chain::Transaction::Eip1559 { .. } => 2,
                rrx_chain::Transaction::Eip4844 { .. } => 3,
            },
            tx_hash: tx.hash(),
            block_number: parent_number + 1,
            contract_address: result.created_address,
            gas_used: used,
            effective_gas_price: effective,
            output: result.output.clone(),
        });
        included.push(tx);
        report.push_str(&format!(
            "  + tx 0x{} — {} {} gas (status {})\n",
            hex::encode(receipts.last().unwrap().tx_hash.0),
            if result.is_success() { "OK" } else { "REVERT" },
            used,
            if result.is_success() { 1 } else { 0 }
        ));
    }
    if skipped_blob > 0 {
        report.push_str(&format!("  ({} blob txs skipped — sidecar unavailable on EL RPC)\n", skipped_blob));
    }

    // ---- roots ----
    let transactions_root = trie_root_of_encoded(included.iter().map(|t| t.rlp_encode()).collect());
    let receipts_root = trie_root_of_encoded(
        receipts
            .iter()
            .map(|r| {
                let mut enc = vec![r.status as u8];
                enc.extend_from_slice(&rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::u64(r.cumulative_gas_used).encode());
                enc.extend_from_slice(&rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::Bytes(r.bloom.0.to_vec()).encode());
                enc.extend_from_slice(
                    &rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::list(
                        r.logs
                            .iter()
                            .map(|l| {
                                rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::list(vec![
                                    rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::h160(&l.address),
                                    rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::list(l.topics.iter().map(|t| rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::h256(t)).collect()),
                                    rrx_util::rlp::Rlp::Bytes(l.data.clone()),
                                ])
                            })
                            .collect(),
                    )
                    .encode(),
                );
                enc
            })
            .collect(),
    );
    let mut logs_bloom = LogBloom::zero();
    for r in &receipts {
        for (i, b) in r.bloom.0.iter().enumerate() {
            logs_bloom.0[i] |= b;
        }
    }

    // ---- state root over the touched subset (fork base + journaled delta) ----
    let delta = host.journal_delta();
    let mut touched = host.touched();
    touched.sort();
    touched.dedup();
    let mut ws = WorldState::default();
    for addr in &touched {
        let balance = p.balance(addr, &state_tag)?;
        let nonce = p.nonce(addr, &state_tag)?;
        let code = p.code(addr, &state_tag)?;
        let acc = ws.accounts.entry(*addr).or_default();
        acc.balance = delta.balances.get(addr).cloned().unwrap_or(balance);
        acc.nonce = delta.nonces.get(addr).cloned().unwrap_or(nonce);
        if let Some(c) = delta.codes.get(addr) {
            if !c.is_empty() {
                ws.set_code_of(addr, c.clone());
            }
        } else if !code.is_empty() {
            ws.set_code_of(addr, code.clone());
        }
        if delta.deleted.contains(addr) {
            ws.accounts.remove(addr);
            continue;
        }
        // base storage for touched contracts (slots 0..256 window like fork)
        if !code.is_empty() || delta.codes.get(addr).map(|c| !c.is_empty()).unwrap_or(false) {
            for slot in 0..256u64 {
                let base = p.storage_at(addr, &U256::from(slot), &state_tag)?;
                if base != U256::zero() {
                    ws.accounts.entry(*addr).or_default().storage.insert(U256::from(slot), base);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for ((addr, slot), v) in &delta.storage {
        ws.accounts.entry(*addr).or_default().storage.insert(*slot, *v);
    }
    let state_root = ws.state_root();

    // ---- header ----
    // EIP-1559 base fee rule: exactly as the spec delta calc
    let gas_target = parent_gas_target;
    let elasticity = 8u64;
    let delta_gas = (cumulative as i128) - (gas_target.as_u128() as i128);
    let base_fee_delta = parent_base_fee.as_u128() * delta_gas.abs() as u128
        / (gas_target.as_u128() * elasticity as u128)
        / 8;
    let new_base_fee = if delta_gas > 0 {
        parent_base_fee.as_u128() + base_fee_delta.max(1)
    } else if delta_gas < 0 {
        parent_base_fee.as_u128().saturating_sub(base_fee_delta)
    } else {
        parent_base_fee.as_u128()
    };

    let header = rrx_chain::executor::BlockHeader {
        parent_hash,
        number: parent_number + 1,
        timestamp: std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap_or_default()
            .as_secs(),
        gas_limit,
        gas_used: cumulative,
        base_fee_per_gas: U256::from(new_base_fee),
        coinbase: coinbase.unwrap_or_else(|| H160::from_low_u64_be(0)),
        state_root,
        transactions_root,
        receipts_root,
        logs_bloom,
        mix_hash: H256([0u8; 32]), // post-merge prevrandao slot: builder-local
        extra_data: b"rrx-builder".to_vec(),
    };

    report.push_str(&format!(
        "  executed:    {} txs, {} gas used\n",
        included.len(),
        cumulative
    ));
    report.push_str(&format!("  tx root:     0x{}\n", hex::encode(transactions_root.0)));
    report.push_str(&format!("  receipts:    0x{}\n", hex::encode(receipts_root.0)));
    report.push_str(&format!(
        "  state root:  0x{} (partial: forked state of {} touched accounts + journal delta)\n",
        hex::encode(state_root.0),
        touched.len()
    ));
    report.push_str(&format!("  base fee:    {} → {} wei (1559 rule)\n", parent_base_fee, new_base_fee));
    report.push_str(&format!("  block hash:  0x{}\n", hex::encode(header.hash().0)));
    Ok(report)
}

// keep unused-import warnings away in odd feature combos
#[allow(dead_code)]
fn _anchor(_: &HashMap<u8, u8>) {}
```

```rust
pub fn find(slug_or_id: &str) -> Option<&'static ChainInfo> {
    let needle = slug_or_id.trim().to_lowercase();
    CHAINS
        .iter()
        .find(|c| c.slug == needle || c.chain_id.to_string() == needle || c.name.to_lowercase() == needle)
}

pub struct ChainStatus {
    pub chain: &'static ChainInfo,
    pub endpoint: Option<&'static str>,
    pub live_chain_id: Option<u64>,
    pub block: Option<u64>,
    pub latency_ms: u128,
    pub client: Option<String>,
    pub ok: bool,
    pub error: Option<String>,
}

/// Probe one chain: try endpoints in order until one answers, verifying chain id.
pub fn probe(info: &'static ChainInfo) -> ChainStatus {
    let mut best = ChainStatus {
        chain: info,
        endpoint: None,
        live_chain_id: None,
        block: None,
        latency_ms: 0,
        client: None,
        ok: false,
        error: None,
    };
    let mut last_err = String::new();
    for url in info.rpcs {
        let t0 = Instant::now();
        let p = Provider::new(url);
        match (|| -> Result<(u64, u64, String), String> {
            let cid = p.chain_id()?;
            if cid != info.chain_id {
                return Err(format!("endpoint serves chain {cid}, expected {}", info.chain_id));
            }
            let bn = p.block_number()?;
            let client = p.client_version().unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".into());
            Ok((cid, bn, client))
        })() {
            Ok((cid, bn, client)) => {
                best.endpoint = Some(url);
                best.live_chain_id = Some(cid);
                best.block = Some(bn);
                best.client = Some(client);
                best.latency_ms = t0.elapsed().as_millis();
                best.ok = true;
                return best;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                last_err = format!("{url}: {e}");
            }
        }
    }
    best.error = Some(last_err);
    best
}

/// Probe every chain in the registry; returns a printable report.
pub fn probe_all_matrix(filter: Option<&str>) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "{:<18} {:>7}  {:<4} {:>12}  {:>7}  {}\n",
        "chain", "chainId", "live", "block", "ms", "client"
    ));
    out.push_str(&"-".repeat(95));
    out.push('\n');
    for info in CHAINS {
        if let Some(f) = filter {
            if !info.slug.contains(&f.to_lowercase()) {
                continue;
            }
        }
        let st = probe(info);
        if st.ok {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "{:<18} {:>7}  {:<4} {:>12}  {:>7}  {}\n",
                info.slug,
                info.chain_id,
                "UP",
                st.block.unwrap_or(0),
                st.latency_ms,
                st.client.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
            ));
        } else {
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "{:<18} {:>7}  {:<4} {:>12}  {:>7}  {}\n",
                info.slug,
                info.chain_id,
                "DOWN",
                "-",
                "-",
                st.error.as_deref().unwrap_or("unreachable")
            ));
        }
    }
    out.push_str(&format!("\nexplorers & failover lists: rrx chains --json\n"));
    out
}

/// JSON description of the whole registry (for MCP / scripts).
pub fn registry_json() -> serde_json::Value {
    json!(CHAINS
        .iter()
        .map(|c| json!({
            "slug": c.slug,
            "name": c.name,
            "chain_id": c.chain_id,
            "testnet": c.testnet,
            "explorer": c.explorer,
            "rpcs": c.rpcs,
        }))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>())
}
```

```rust
//! Solidity Compiler tool: compile a workspace with the real solc and emit artifacts.

use std::path::Path;

use rrx_solc::{build_input, extract_artifacts};
use serde_json::json;

pub struct CompileOutput {
    pub artifacts: Vec<(String, serde_json::Value)>,
    pub solc_version: String,
}

/// Compile all workspace sources (or `files` subset) via real solc --standard-json.
pub fn compile_workspace(
    root: &Path,
    version: Option<&str>,
    optimizer: bool,
    evm_version: &str,
) -> Result<CompileOutput, String> {
    let ws = crate::workspace::Workspace::at(root);
    let sources = crate::unittest::prepare_sources(&ws)?;
    let solc = match version {
        Some(v) => rrx_solc::use_version(v)?,
        None => rrx_solc::detect()?,
    };
    let input = build_input(&sources, optimizer, evm_version);
    let output = solc.compile(&input)?;
    let artifacts = extract_artifacts(&output)?;

    // persist artifacts like Remix does
    let dir = ws.artifacts_dir();
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    for (key, artifact) in &artifacts {
        let name = key.rsplit(':').next().unwrap_or("contract");
        let file = dir.join(format!("{name}.json"));
        std::fs::write(&file, serde_json::to_vec_pretty(artifact).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    Ok(CompileOutput { artifacts, solc_version: solc.version })
}

/// ABI of an artifact.
pub fn abi_of(artifact: &serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
    artifact.get("abi").cloned().unwrap_or(json!([]))
}

/// Creation bytecode of an artifact.
pub fn bytecode_of(artifact: &serde_json::Value) -> Vec<u8> {
    let hex = artifact["evm"]["bytecode"]["object"]
        .as_str()
        .unwrap_or("0x");
    rrx_util::from_hex(hex).unwrap_or_default()
}

/// Find an artifact by contract name (file:name or bare name).
pub fn find_artifact<'a>(artifacts: &'a [(String, serde_json::Value)], name: &str) -> Option<&'a serde_json::Value> {
    if let Some((_, a)) = artifacts.iter().find(|(k, _)| k == name) {
        return Some(a);
    }
    artifacts
        .iter()
        .find(|(k, _)| k.rsplit(':').next() == Some(name))
        .map(|(_, a)| a)
}
```

[view on disk](crates/remix/rrx-tools/src/coverage.rs)

```rust
//! rrx coverage — function-level coverage from REAL executions, and gas
//! snapshots (save / diff across runs). Coverage counts only what the real EVM
//! actually executed — no heuristics.
//!
//! Measurement: (1) every top-level selector executed during the test suite,
//! plus (2) a direct-execution probe that deploys each contract standalone and
//! issues a REAL call to every public function (benign arguments). A function
//! is "covered" when the real EVM executed it and returned success — either
//! from the suite or from the probe. remix-tests embeds targets inside test
//! contracts, so the probe catches what selector tracking cannot.

use std::path::Path;

use rrx_chain::Chain;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, U256};

use crate::compile::{self, CompileOutput};
use crate::deploy::{self, AccountSpec};

/// (code_hash, selector) pairs actually executed since the last drain.
pub fn drain() -> Vec<([u8; 32], [u8; 4])> {
    rrx_evm::coverage_drain()
        .into_iter()
        .map(|(h, s)| (h.0, s))
        .collect()
}

fn selector_of(sig: &str) -> [u8; 4] {
    let h = keccak256(sig.as_bytes());
    [h[0], h[1], h[2], h[3]]
}

fn signature_of(entry: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<String> {
    let name = entry.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str())?;
    let types: Vec<&str> = entry
        .get("inputs")
        .and_then(|i| i.as_array())
        .map(|arr| {
            arr.iter()
                .filter_map(|x| x.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()))
                .collect()
        })
        .unwrap_or_default();
    Some(format!("{name}({})", types.join(",")))
}

fn runtime_of(artifact: &serde_json::Value) -> Vec<u8> {
    hex_to_bytes(
        artifact
            .get("evm")
            .and_then(|e| e.get("deployedBytecode"))
            .and_then(|d| d.get("object"))
            .and_then(|o| o.as_str())
            .unwrap_or(""),
    )
}

/// Deploy the contract standalone and issue a REAL top-level call to every
/// public function with benign arguments. The rrx-evm coverage hook records
/// every executed selector automatically.
fn execution_probe(artifact: &serde_json::Value, short: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
    let mut chain = Chain::genesis(
        Default::default(),
        &[
            (rrx_chain::dev::dev_address(0), U256::from_dec_str("10000000000000000000000").unwrap()),
            (rrx_chain::dev::dev_address(1), U256::from_dec_str("10000000000000000000000").unwrap()),
        ],
    );
    let outcome = deploy::deploy_local(
        Path::new("."),
        &mut chain,
        artifact,
        short,
        &AccountSpec::Dev(0),
        &[],
        &[],
        U256::zero(),
    )?;
    if let Some(entries) = compile::abi_of(artifact).as_array() {
        for e in entries {
            if e.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) != Some("function") {
                continue;
            }
            let state = e.get("stateMutability").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
            if state == "pure" {
                continue;
            }
            let fname = match e.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) {
                Some(n) if !n.is_empty() => n.to_string(),
                _ => continue,
            };
            let types: Vec<String> = e
                .get("inputs")
                .and_then(|i| i.as_array())
                .map(|arr| {
                    arr.iter()
                        .filter_map(|x| x.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string()))
                        .collect()
                })
                .unwrap_or_default();
            let args: Vec<String> = types
                .iter()
                .map(|t| match t.as_str() {
                    "bool" => "true".into(),
                    "address" => "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD".into(),
                    "string" => "rrx".into(),
                    x if x.starts_with("bytes") => "00".into(),
                    x if x.ends_with("[]") => "[]".into(),
                    _ => "1".into(),
                })
                .collect();
            let arg_refs: Vec<&str> = args.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
            let type_refs: Vec<&str> = types.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
            let _ = deploy::call_write(
                &mut chain,
                &AccountSpec::Dev(1),
                outcome.address,
                &fname,
                &type_refs,
                &arg_refs,
                U256::zero(),
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Build the full coverage report: test-suite executions + direct probes.
pub fn coverage_report(workspace: &Path, version: Option<&str>) -> Result<String, String> {
    let output: CompileOutput = compile::compile_workspace(workspace, version, true, "shanghai")?;

    // 1) run the real test suite (executes real transactions)
    let report = crate::unittest::run_tests(workspace, version, true, None)?;

    // 2) direct execution probe on every deployable contract
    let mut probe_skipped: Vec<String> = vec![];
    let mut seen: std::collections::HashSet<String> = Default::default();
    for (key, artifact) in &output.artifacts {
        let short = key.rsplit(':').next().unwrap_or(key).to_string();
        if short.ends_with("Test") || short.contains("_test") || short == "Assert" {
            continue;
        }
        if !seen.insert(short.clone()) {
            continue;
        }
        if runtime_of(artifact).is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let probe = execution_probe(artifact, &short);
        if probe.is_err() {
            probe_skipped.push(short);
        }
    }

    let executed = drain();

    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "coverage: {} tests ({} failures), solc {}\n",
        report.results.len(),
        report.failures(),
        output.solc_version
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "{:<28} {:>6}  {}\n",
        "contract", "cov", "functions"
    ));
    out.push_str(&"-".repeat(78));
    out.push('\n');

    let mut total_hit = 0usize;
    let mut total_all = 0usize;
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();

    for (key, artifact) in &output.artifacts {
        let short = key.rsplit(':').next().unwrap_or(key).to_string();
        if short.ends_with("Test") || short.contains("_test") {
            continue;
        }
        if !seen.insert(short.clone()) {
            continue; // template copies in tests/ — dedupe by contract name
        }
        let rt = runtime_of(artifact);
        if rt.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let chash = keccak256(&rt);

        let mut fns: Vec<(String, [u8; 4])> = vec![];
        if let Some(entries) = compile::abi_of(artifact).as_array() {
            for e in entries {
                if e.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some("function") {
                    if let Some(sig) = signature_of(e) {
                        let sel = selector_of(&sig);
                        fns.push((sig, sel));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if fns.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let hit: Vec<&(String, [u8; 4])> = fns
            .iter()
            .filter(|(_, sel)| executed.iter().any(|(h, s)| h == &chash && s == sel))
            .collect();
        total_hit += hit.len();
        total_all += fns.len();
        let pct = 100.0 * hit.len() as f64 / fns.len() as f64;
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "{:<28} {:>5.0}%  hit {} of {} — ",
            short,
            pct,
            hit.len(),
            fns.len()
        ));
        if hit.len() == fns.len() {
            out.push_str("all functions executed\n");
        } else {
            let missed: Vec<&String> = fns
                .iter()
                .filter(|(_, sel)| !executed.iter().any(|(h, s)| h == &chash && s == sel))
                .map(|(sig, _)| sig)
                .collect();
            out.push_str(&format!(
                "missed: {}\n",
                missed.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(", ")
            ));
        }
    }
    out.push_str(&"-".repeat(78));
    out.push('\n');
    let total_pct = if total_all == 0 {
        100.0
    } else {
        100.0 * total_hit as f64 / total_all as f64
    };
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "TOTAL function coverage: {:.0}% ({total_hit}/{total_all}) — measured on real EVM execution\n",
        total_pct
    ));
    if !probe_skipped.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "probe skipped (constructor args required): {}\n",
            probe_skipped.join(", ")
        ));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// gas snapshots: save → check (regression gate)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Save the current gas records of a test run to the snapshot file.
pub fn snapshot_save(workspace: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
    let report = crate::unittest::run_tests(workspace, None, true, None)?;
    let file = workspace.join(".rrx/gas-snapshot.json");
    if let Some(parent) = file.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    let mut entries = serde_json::Map::new();
    for g in &report.gas {
        let key = format!("{}/{} ({})", g.contract, g.method, g.kind);
        entries.insert(key, serde_json::json!(g.gas));
    }
    std::fs::write(
        &file,
        serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::Value::Object(entries.clone()))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    Ok(format!(
        "saved {} gas records to {}\n",
        entries.len(),
        file.display()
    ))
}

/// Re-run tests and compare gas against the saved snapshot.
pub fn snapshot_check(workspace: &Path, tolerance_pct: f64) -> Result<String, String> {
    let file = workspace.join(".rrx/gas-snapshot.json");
    let saved: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(
        &std::fs::read_to_string(&file)
            .map_err(|_| "no gas snapshot — run `rrx gas snapshot save` first")?,
    )
    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let report = crate::unittest::run_tests(workspace, None, true, None)?;
    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut changed = 0usize;
    out.push_str("gas snapshot check (real EVM, tolerance ");
    out.push_str(&format!("{tolerance_pct}%)\n"));
    for g in &report.gas {
        let key = format!("{}/{} ({})", g.contract, g.method, g.kind);
        let old = saved.get(&key).and_then(|v| v.as_u64());
        match old {
            None => {
                changed += 1;
                out.push_str(&format!("  NEW   {key}: {} gas\n", g.gas));
            }
            Some(old) => {
                let delta = g.gas as f64 - old as f64;
                let pct = if old == 0 { 0.0 } else { 100.0 * delta / old as f64 };
                if pct.abs() > tolerance_pct {
                    changed += 1;
                    let dir = if delta > 0.0 { "WORSE" } else { "BETTER" };
                    out.push_str(&format!("  {dir} {key}: {old} → {} gas ({pct:+.1}%)\n", g.gas));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if changed == 0 {
        out.push_str("  ✓ no gas regressions\n");
    } else {
        out.push_str(&format!("  {changed} change(s) exceed tolerance\n"));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn hex_to_bytes(s: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let s = s.trim().trim_start_matches("0x");
    (0..s.len() / 2)
        .filter_map(|i| u8::from_str_radix(&s[2 * i..2 * i + 2], 16).ok())
        .collect()
}
```

```rust
//! Debugger: real step-level debugging of executed transactions using the EVM tracer
//! plus source maps from solc artifacts.

use rrx_chain::Chain;
use rrx_evm::{opcode_name, Host};
use rrx_util::U256;
use serde_json::{json, Value};

pub struct DebugOptions {
    pub max_steps: usize,
    pub breakpoint_line: Option<(String, usize)>,
    pub json: bool,
}

/// Re-execute a call locally with full tracing and pretty-print the run.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn debug_call(
    chain: &Chain,
    from: rrx_util::H160,
    to: rrx_util::H160,
    data: Vec<u8>,
    value: rrx_util::U256,
    opts: &DebugOptions,
    artifacts: &[(String, Value)],
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let res = chain.call(from, Some(to), value, data.clone(), chain.config.gas_limit, true);
    let trace = res.trace.as_ref().ok_or("no trace recorded")?;

    // pc -> (file, line) via source map + artifact
    let srcmap: Option<(String, Vec<(u32, u32, i32, u32, u32)>)> = artifacts
        .iter()
        .find(|(_, a)| {
            let deployed = a["evm"]["deployedBytecode"]["object"]
                .as_str()
                .unwrap_or("0x");
            let code = rrx_util::from_hex(deployed).unwrap_or_default();
            code.len() == chain.state.code(&to).len()
        })
        .and_then(|(k, a)| {
            let sm = a["evm"]["deployedBytecode"]["sourceMap"].as_str()?.to_string();
            Some((k.clone(), parse_source_map(&sm)))
        });

    let mut out = String::new();
    if opts.json {
        let steps: Vec<Value> = trace
            .steps
            .iter()
            .take(opts.max_steps)
            .map(|s| {
                json!({
                    "pc": s.pc, "opcode": opcode_name(s.opcode), "opByte": format!("0x{:02x}", s.opcode),
                    "depth": s.depth, "gasBefore": s.gas_before, "gasCost": s.gas_cost,
                    "error": s.error,
                    "source": map_pc(&srcmap, s.pc),
                })
            })
            .collect();
        return serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json!({
            "result": format!("{:?}", res.kind),
            "gasUsed": res.gas_used,
            "output": rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(&res.output),
            "steps": steps,
        }))
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string());
    }

    out.push_str(&format!(
        "debug session — result: {:?}, gas used: {}, steps: {}\n",
        res.kind,
        res.gas_used,
        trace.steps.len()
    ));
    if let Some(reason) = res.revert_reason() {
        out.push_str(&format!("revert reason: {reason}\n"));
    }

    let mut shown = 0usize;
    for (i, s) in trace.steps.iter().enumerate() {
        if shown >= opts.max_steps {
            out.push_str(&format!("  ... {} more steps (use --max-steps)\n", trace.steps.len() - i));
            break;
        }
        if let Some((file, line)) = &opts.breakpoint_line {
            if let Some(src) = map_pc(&srcmap, s.pc) {
                if src.split(':').next() != Some(file.as_str())
                    || src.rsplit(':').next().and_then(|l| l.parse::<usize>().ok()) != Some(*line)
                {
                    continue;
                }
            }
        }
        let mut line = format!(
            "  #{:<5} depth={:<3} pc={:<6} gas={:<8} (cost {:>5}) {}",
            i, s.depth, s.pc, s.gas_before, s.gas_cost, opcode_name(s.opcode)
        );
        if let Some(src) = map_pc(&srcmap, s.pc) {
            line.push_str(&format!("   @ {src}"));
        }
        if let Some(err) = &s.error {
            line.push_str(&format!("   !! {err}"));
        }
        out.push_str(&line);
        out.push('\n');
        shown += 1;
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Parse a Solidity source map: "s:l:f:j:m;..." entries.
fn parse_source_map(sm: &str) -> Vec<(u32, u32, i32, u32, u32)> {
    let mut out = vec![];
    let mut prev = (0u32, 0u32, -1i32);
    for entry in sm.split(';') {
        let parts: Vec<&str> = entry.split(':').collect();
        let s = parts.first().and_then(|x| x.parse().ok());
        let l = parts.get(1).and_then(|x| x.parse().ok());
        let f = parts.get(2).and_then(|x| x.parse::<i32>().ok());
        let s = s.unwrap_or(prev.0);
        let l = l.unwrap_or(prev.1);
        let f = f.unwrap_or(prev.2);
        out.push((s, l, f, 0, 0));
        prev = (s, l, f);
    }
    out
}

fn map_pc(srcmap: &Option<(String, Vec<(u32, u32, i32, u32, u32)>)>, pc: usize) -> Option<String> {
    let (label, entries) = srcmap.as_ref()?;
    let (s, l, _f, _, _) = *entries.get(pc)?;
    if l == 0 {
        return None;
    }
    Some(format!("{label}:{s}+{l}"))
}

/// Show stack state at step N (headless watch).
pub fn step_stack(trace_json: &str, n: usize) -> Result<String, String> {
    let v: Value = serde_json::from_str(trace_json).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let step = v["steps"]
        .get(n)
        .ok_or("step out of range")?;
    Ok(step.to_string())
}

/// helper used by CLI to format a U256 stack item
pub fn fmt_word(v: &U256) -> String {
    if *v > U256::from(0xffff_ffffu64) {
        rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(&rrx_util::u256_to_be32(v))
    } else {
        v.to_string()
    }
}
```

```rust
//! debugtx: replay a REAL confirmed mainnet transaction in the rrx interpreter.
//!
//! Pipeline (all against the live chain, no simulation):
//!  1. fetch the tx + receipt from the network
//!  2. build the block env from the real header, the interpreter spec from the
//!     real fork heights, and the PRE-tx state (block N-1) via RemoteHost
//!  3. execute with our own EVM, then compare gas/status against the receipt
//!  4. opcode-level gas profile + optional step trace

use rrx_evm::{tx_intrinsic_gas, Machine, TxEnv};
use rrx_rpc::Provider;
use rrx_util::{h160_from_hex, h256_from_hex, u256_from_str, wei_to_strings, H160, U256};

use crate::remotehost::{access_list_from_tx, block_env_of, mainnet_spec, RemoteHost};

fn qty(v: &serde_json::Value, key: &str) -> Option<U256> {
    v.get(key).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok())
}

fn fmt_u64(n: u64) -> String {
    let s = n.to_string();
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = String::new();
    for (i, c) in b.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && (b.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push(*c as char);
    }
    out
}

/// Replay a confirmed transaction and render the full debugging report.
pub fn debug_mainnet_tx(p: &Provider, hash_str: &str, max_steps: usize, top_ops: usize) -> Result<String, String> {
    let hash = h256_from_hex(hash_str)?;
    let tx = p
        .get_transaction(&hash)?
        .ok_or("transaction not found (pending or unknown)")?;
    let receipt = p
        .transaction_receipt(&hash)?
        .ok_or("transaction not confirmed yet — no receipt")?;

    let block_n = qty(&receipt, "blockNumber")
        .map(|b| b.as_u64())
        .filter(|b| *b > 0)
        .ok_or("receipt has no block number")?;
    let chain_id = p.chain_id()?;
    let spec = mainnet_spec(block_n);

    let from = h160_from_hex(tx.get("from").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).ok_or("tx has no from")?)?;
    let to_opt: Option<H160> = match tx.get("to").and_then(|x| x.as_str()) {
        Some(s) if !s.is_empty() && s != "0x" => Some(h160_from_hex(s)?),
        _ => None,
    };
    let value = qty(&tx, "value").unwrap_or_default();
    let input = tx
        .get("input")
        .and_then(|i| i.as_str())
        .and_then(|s| rrx_util::from_hex(s).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let gas_cap = qty(&tx, "gas").map(|g| g.as_u64()).unwrap_or(30_000_000);
    let access_list = access_list_from_tx(&tx);

    // effective gas price
    let effective = qty(&receipt, "effectiveGasPrice")
        .or_else(|| qty(&tx, "gasPrice"))
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!("debugtx {hash_str}\n"));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  network    chain {chain_id} — replayed in the rrx EVM interpreter ({})\n",
        if spec.push0 { if spec.transient_storage { "cancun" } else { "shanghai" } } else { "pre-shanghai" }
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("  block      {} (state read from block {})\n", fmt_u64(block_n), fmt_u64(block_n - 1)));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  from       {}\n  to         {}\n",
        from,
        to_opt.map(|t| format!("0x{t:x}")).unwrap_or_else(|| "(contract creation)".into())
    ));
    let (_g, eth) = wei_to_strings(&value);
    out.push_str(&format!("  value      {eth} ETH\n"));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  calldata   {} bytes, selector {}\n",
        input.len(),
        if input.len() >= 4 { format!("0x{}", rrx_util::to_hex(&input[..4])) } else { "—".into() }
    ));

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- replay
    let state_block = format!("0x{:x}", block_n - 1);
    let block_env = block_env_of(p, block_n)?;
    let tx_env_full = TxEnv {
        caller: from,
        gas_price: effective,
        value,
        data: input.clone(),
        gas_limit: gas_cap,
        chain_id,
        to: to_opt,
        access_list: access_list.clone(),
        blob_hashes: vec![],
    };
    let intrinsic = tx_intrinsic_gas(&tx_env_full, &spec);
    let mut env = tx_env_full.clone();
    env.gas_limit = gas_cap.saturating_sub(intrinsic);

    let mut host = RemoteHost::new(p.clone(), state_block, spec.clone());
    let machine = Machine::new(&mut host, spec, block_env, env, true);
    let result = machine.run_tx();
    let replayed_gas = result.gas_used + intrinsic;

    let chain_status = receipt.get("status").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0");
    let chain_gas = qty(&receipt, "gasUsed").map(|g| g.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0);
    let replay_ok = result.is_success();
    let chain_ok = chain_status == "0x1";

    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  chain      {} — {} gas used @ {} gwei  (fee ≈ {:.6} ETH)\n",
        if chain_ok { "SUCCESS" } else { "REVERTED" },
        fmt_u64(chain_gas),
        effective / U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
        (U256::from(chain_gas) * effective).as_u128() as f64 / 1e18
    ));
    let match_note = if replay_ok == chain_ok && replayed_gas == chain_gas {
        "exact match".to_string()
    } else if replay_ok == chain_ok {
        format!(
            "status matches, gas Δ {} ({:.2}%) — access-list / warm-state differences",
            (replayed_gas as i128 - chain_gas as i128),
            if chain_gas > 0 { (replayed_gas as f64 - chain_gas as f64).abs() * 100.0 / chain_gas as f64 } else { 0.0 }
        )
    } else {
        "status DIVERGES (state of earlier txs in the same block affects this tx)".to_string()
    };
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  replay     {} — {} gas used  [{match_note}]\n",
        if replay_ok { "SUCCESS" } else { "REVERTED" },
        fmt_u64(replayed_gas)
    ));
    if let Some(r) = result.revert_reason() {
        out.push_str(&format!("  revert     {r}\n"));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- opcode profile
    if let Some(trace) = &result.trace {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "\nopcode gas profile ({} steps, {} metered gas, {} RPC state reads):\n",
            trace.steps.len(),
            trace.total_gas,
            host.rpc_reads.borrow()
        ));
        let mut ops: Vec<(u8, u128)> = trace.gas_by_opcode.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, *v)).collect();
        ops.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1));
        for (op, gas) in ops.iter().take(top_ops) {
            let pct = (*gas as f64 / trace.total_gas.max(1) as f64) * 100.0;
            out.push_str(&format!("  {:<14} {:>12} gas  {:>5.1}%\n", rrx_evm::opcode_name(*op), fmt_u64(*gas as u64), pct));
        }

        if max_steps > 0 {
            out.push_str(&format!("\nfirst {max_steps} steps:\n"));
            out.push_str("     pc  opcode            gas  stack(top)          depth\n");
            for (i, s) in trace.steps.iter().take(max_steps).enumerate() {
                let stack_top: String = s
                    .stack
                    .as_ref()
                    .and_then(|v| v.first())
                    .map(|v| format!("0x{v:x}"))
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "—".into());
                out.push_str(&format!(
                    "  {:>5}  {:<14} {:>6}  {:<18} {}\n",
                    s.pc,
                    rrx_evm::opcode_name(s.opcode),
                    s.gas_cost,
                    stack_top,
                    s.depth
                ));
                let _ = i;
            }
            if trace.steps.len() > max_steps {
                out.push_str(&format!("  … {} more steps (increase --max-steps to see)\n", trace.steps.len() - max_steps));
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(out)
}
```

```rust
//! Deploy & Run Transactions tool: real deployments and calls via local chain or RPC.

use std::path::Path;

use rrx_chain::dev::{dev_address, dev_keypair};
use rrx_chain::tx::{sign_transaction, TxType, UnsignedTx};
use rrx_chain::Chain;
use rrx_evm::Host;
use rrx_util::{abi, u256_from_str, H160, U256};
use serde_json::json;

pub enum AccountSpec {
    Dev(usize),
    Key(String),
}

impl AccountSpec {
    pub fn address(&self) -> Result<H160, String> {
        match self {
            AccountSpec::Dev(i) => Ok(dev_address(*i)),
            AccountSpec::Key(k) => rrx_crypto::KeyPair::from_hex(k)?.address(),
        }
    }

    pub fn keypair(&self) -> Result<rrx_crypto::KeyPair, String> {
        match self {
            AccountSpec::Dev(i) => Ok(dev_keypair(*i)),
            AccountSpec::Key(k) => rrx_crypto::KeyPair::from_hex(k),
        }
    }
}

pub struct DeployOutcome {
    pub contract: String,
    pub address: H160,
    pub tx_hash: rrx_util::H256,
    pub gas_used: u64,
    pub block_number: u64,
    pub deployer: H160,
}

/// Deploy a compiled contract on the LOCAL chain with constructor args.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn deploy_local(
    workspace: &Path,
    chain: &mut Chain,
    artifact: &serde_json::Value,
    contract_name: &str,
    account: &AccountSpec,
    ctor_args: &[&str],
    ctor_types: &[&str],
    value: U256,
) -> Result<DeployOutcome, String> {
    let _ = workspace;
    let kp = account.keypair()?;
    let sender = kp.address()?;
    let mut data = crate::compile::bytecode_of(artifact);
    if !ctor_args.is_empty() {
        let values = parse_args(ctor_args, ctor_types)?;
        let encoded = abi::encode(ctor_types, &values)?;
        data.extend_from_slice(&encoded);
    }
    let nonce = rrx_evm::Host::nonce(&chain.state, &sender);
    let tx = sign_transaction(
        &UnsignedTx {
                max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
                blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
            tx_type: TxType::Eip1559,
            chain_id: chain.config.chain_id,
            nonce,
            gas_price: U256::zero(),
            max_fee: chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas * U256::from(4u8),
            max_priority_fee: U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            gas_limit: 4_000_000,
            to: None,
            value,
            data,
            access_list: vec![],
        },
        &kp,
    )?;
    let hash = tx.hash();
    chain.mine_block(vec![tx])?;
    let receipt = chain.receipt_for(&hash).ok_or("no receipt")?;
    if !receipt.status {
        return Err(format!("deployment of {contract_name} reverted"));
    }
    Ok(DeployOutcome {
        contract: contract_name.to_string(),
        address: receipt.contract_address.unwrap_or_default(),
        tx_hash: hash,
        gas_used: receipt.gas_used,
        block_number: receipt.block_number,
        deployer: sender,
    })
}

/// Deploy via a REAL network through JSON-RPC.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn deploy_rpc(
    provider: &rrx_rpc::Provider,
    artifact: &serde_json::Value,
    account: &AccountSpec,
    ctor_args: &[&str],
    ctor_types: &[&str],
    value: U256,
    max_fee_gwei: u64,
    max_priority_gwei: u64,
) -> Result<DeployOutcome, String> {
    let kp = account.keypair()?;
    let sender = kp.address()?;
    let chain_id = provider.chain_id()?;
    let mut data = crate::compile::bytecode_of(artifact);
    if !ctor_args.is_empty() {
        let values = parse_args(ctor_args, ctor_types)?;
        let encoded = abi::encode(ctor_types, &values)?;
        data.extend_from_slice(&encoded);
    }
    let nonce = provider.nonce(&sender, "latest")?;
    let gas = provider.estimate_gas(Some(sender), None, &data, value)?;
    let tx = sign_transaction(
        &UnsignedTx {
                max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
                blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
            tx_type: TxType::Eip1559,
            chain_id,
            nonce,
            gas_price: U256::zero(),
            max_fee: U256::from(max_fee_gwei) * U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            max_priority_fee: U256::from(max_priority_gwei) * U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            gas_limit: gas + gas / 10,
            to: None,
            value,
            data,
            access_list: vec![],
        },
        &kp,
    )?;
    let hash = tx.hash();
    provider.send_raw_transaction(&tx.rlp_encode())?;
    // wait for the receipt
    for _ in 0..120 {
        if let Some(receipt) = provider.transaction_receipt(&hash)? {
            let status = receipt.get("status").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0");
            if status == "0x1" {
                let addr = receipt
                    .get("contractAddress")
                    .and_then(|a| a.as_str())
                    .and_then(|a| rrx_util::h160_from_hex(a).ok())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let gas_used = receipt
                    .get("gasUsed")
                    .and_then(|g| g.as_str())
                    .and_then(|g| u256_from_str(g).ok())
                    .map(|g| g.as_u64())
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let block_number = receipt
                    .get("blockNumber")
                    .and_then(|g| g.as_str())
                    .and_then(|g| u256_from_str(g).ok())
                    .map(|g| g.as_u64())
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                return Ok(DeployOutcome {
                    contract: artifact["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?").to_string(),
                    address: addr,
                    tx_hash: hash,
                    gas_used,
                    block_number,
                    deployer: sender,
                });
            }
            return Err("deployment reverted on remote network".into());
        }
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2));
    }
    Err("timed out waiting for receipt".into())
}

/// Encode a function call and run it as a read (eth_call / chain.call).
pub fn call_read(
    chain: &Chain,
    from: H160,
    to: H160,
    function: &str,
    types: &[&str],
    args: &[&str],
    output_types: &[&str],
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let data = encode_call(function, types, args)?;
    let res = chain.call(from, Some(to), U256::zero(), data, 1_000_000, false);
    if !res.is_success() {
        return Err(res.revert_reason().unwrap_or_else(|| "reverted".into()));
    }
    format_output(output_types, &res.output)
}

/// Encode a function call and send it as a real transaction (state-changing).
pub fn call_write(
    chain: &mut Chain,
    account: &AccountSpec,
    to: H160,
    function: &str,
    types: &[&str],
    args: &[&str],
    value: U256,
) -> Result<(rrx_util::H256, u64), String> {
    let kp = account.keypair()?;
    let sender = kp.address()?;
    let data = encode_call(function, types, args)?;
    let nonce = chain.state.nonce(&sender);
    let tx = sign_transaction(
        &UnsignedTx {
                max_fee_per_blob_gas: Default::default(),
                blob_versioned_hashes: vec![],
            tx_type: TxType::Eip1559,
            chain_id: chain.config.chain_id,
            nonce,
            gas_price: U256::zero(),
            max_fee: chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas * U256::from(4u8),
            max_priority_fee: U256::from(1_000_000_000u64),
            gas_limit: 2_000_000,
            to: Some(to),
            value,
            data,
            access_list: vec![],
        },
        &kp,
    )?;
    let hash = tx.hash();
    chain.mine_block(vec![tx])?;
    let receipt = chain.receipt_for(&hash).ok_or("no receipt")?;
    if !receipt.status {
        return Err(abi::decode_revert_reason(&receipt.output)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "transaction reverted".into()));
    }
    Ok((hash, receipt.gas_used))
}

pub fn encode_call(function: &str, types: &[&str], args: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
    let values = parse_args(args, types)?;
    let sel = abi::selector(function, types);
    let mut data = sel.to_vec();
    data.extend(abi::encode(types, &values)?);
    Ok(data)
}

/// Parse CLI args into ABI values using expected types.
pub fn parse_args(args: &[&str], types: &[&str]) -> Result<Vec<abi::AbiValue>, String> {
    if args.len() != types.len() {
        return Err(format!("{} args given, expected {}", args.len(), types.len()));
    }
    let mut out = vec![];
    for (arg, ty) in args.iter().zip(types) {
        out.push(parse_single(arg, ty)?);
    }
    Ok(out)
}

pub fn parse_single(arg: &str, ty: &str) -> Result<abi::AbiValue, String> {
    let base = ty.split('[').next().unwrap_or(ty);
    if ty.contains('[') {
        // array literal like "1,2,3"
        let items: Vec<&str> = arg.trim_matches(|c| c == '[' || c == ']').split(',').filter(|s| !s.is_empty()).collect();
        let mut vals = vec![];
        for it in items {
            vals.push(parse_single(it, base)?);
        }
        return Ok(abi::AbiValue::Array(vals));
    }
    match base {
        "address" => Ok(abi::AbiValue::Address(rrx_util::h160_from_hex(arg)?)),
        "bool" => Ok(abi::AbiValue::Bool(matches!(
            arg.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str(),
            "true" | "1" | "yes"
        ))),
        "string" => Ok(abi::AbiValue::Str(arg.to_string())),
        "bytes" => Ok(abi::AbiValue::Bytes(rrx_util::from_hex(arg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)),
        "int" | "int256" => {
            let v = if let Some(stripped) = arg.strip_prefix('-') {
                U256::zero().overflowing_sub(rrx_util::u256_from_str(stripped)?).0
            } else {
                rrx_util::u256_from_str(arg)?
            };
            Ok(abi::AbiValue::Int(v))
        }
        _ if base.starts_with("bytes") => {
            let v = rrx_util::from_hex(arg).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            Ok(abi::AbiValue::FixedBytes(v))
        }
        _ => Ok(abi::AbiValue::Uint(rrx_util::u256_from_str(arg)?)),
    }
}

/// Format raw return data using the ABI output types.
pub fn format_output(types: &[&str], data: &[u8]) -> Result<String, String> {
    if data.is_empty() {
        return Ok("".into());
    }
    if types.is_empty() {
        return Ok(format!("0x{}", rrx_util::to_hex(data)));
    }
    let vals = abi::decode(types, data)?;
    let strs: Vec<String> = vals.iter().map(format_value).collect();
    Ok(strs.join(", "))
}

pub fn format_value(v: &abi::AbiValue) -> String {
    match v {
        abi::AbiValue::Uint(u) | abi::AbiValue::Int(u) => u.to_string(),
        abi::AbiValue::Bool(b) => b.to_string(),
        abi::AbiValue::Address(a) => format!("{a:?}"),
        abi::AbiValue::FixedBytes(b) => rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(b),
        abi::AbiValue::Bytes(b) => rrx_util::to_hex_prefixed(b),
        abi::AbiValue::Str(s) => s.clone(),
        abi::AbiValue::Array(items) => {
            let inner: Vec<String> = items.iter().map(format_value).collect();
            format!("[{}]", inner.join(", "))
        }
    }
}

/// Persist deployments (like Remix's deployed contracts panel).
pub fn save_deployment(
    root: &Path,
    outcome: &DeployOutcome,
    abi: &serde_json::Value,
    ctor_args: &[String],
    ctor_types: &[String],
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let path = root.join(".rrx").join("deployments.json");
    let mut list: Vec<serde_json::Value> = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    list.push(json!({
        "contract": outcome.contract,
        "address": format!("0x{:x}", outcome.address),
        "txHash": format!("0x{:x}", outcome.tx_hash),
        "gasUsed": outcome.gas_used,
        "block": outcome.block_number,
        "deployer": format!("0x{:x}", outcome.deployer),
        "ctorArgs": ctor_args,
        "ctorTypes": ctor_types,
        "abi": abi,
    }));
    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    std::fs::write(&path, serde_json::to_string_pretty(&list).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}
```

```rust
//! Doc Generator: markdown docs per contract from the AST + natspec.

use serde_json::Value;

pub fn generate(output: &Value, title: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = format!("# {title}\n\nDocumentation generated by rrx (Doc Generator).\n\n");
    if let Some(sources) = output.get("sources").and_then(|s| s.as_object()) {
        for (file, sv) in sources {
            let Some(ast) = sv.get("ast") else { continue };
            if let Some(contracts) = collect_contracts(ast) {
                for c in contracts {
                    out.push_str(&render_contract(file, &c));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

fn collect_contracts(node: &Value) -> Option<Vec<Value>> {
    let mut found = vec![];
    walk(node, &mut found);
    if found.is_empty() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(found)
    }
}

fn walk(node: &Value, found: &mut Vec<Value>) {
    match node {
        Value::Object(map) => {
            if map.get("nodeType").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some("ContractDefinition") {
                found.push(node.clone());
                return;
            }
            for v in map.values() {
                walk(v, found);
            }
        }
        Value::Array(arr) => {
            for v in arr {
                walk(v, found);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn natspec(node: &Value, key: &str) -> String {
    node.get("documentation").and_then(|d| d.get(key))
        .or_else(|| node.get("documentation").and_then(|d| d.get("text")))
        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
        .unwrap_or("")
        .trim()
        .to_string()
}

fn render_contract(file: &str, c: &Value) -> String {
    let name = c.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
    let kind = c.get("contractKind").and_then(|k| k.as_str()).unwrap_or("contract");
    let mut out = format!("## `{name}` ({kind})\n\n");
    out.push_str(&format!("_Source:_ `{file}`\n\n"));
    let notice = natspec(c, "text");
    if !notice.is_empty() {
        out.push_str(&format!("{notice}\n\n"));
    }

    let nodes = c.get("nodes").and_then(|n| n.as_array()).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    let mut fns = String::from("| function | visibility | mutability | notice |\n|---|---|---|---|\n");
    let mut vars = String::new();
    let mut events = String::new();
    for n in &nodes {
        match n.get("nodeType").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or("") {
            "FunctionDefinition" => {
                let fname = n.get("name").and_then(|f| f.as_str()).unwrap_or("constructor");
                let vis = n.get("visibility").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                let sm = n.get("stateMutability").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                let notice = natspec(n, "text").replace('|', "\\|");
                fns.push_str(&format!("| `{fname}` | {vis} | {sm} | {notice} |\n"));
            }
            "VariableDeclaration" => {
                let vn = n.get("name").and_then(|f| f.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                let vis = n.get("visibility").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                vars.push_str(&format!("- `{vn}` ({vis})\n"));
            }
            "EventDefinition" => {
                let en = n.get("name").and_then(|f| f.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                events.push_str(&format!("- `{en}`\n"));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    if !vars.is_empty() {
        out.push_str("### State variables\n\n");
        out.push_str(&vars);
        out.push('\n');
    }
    if !fns.ends_with("|---|\n") {
        out.push_str("### Functions\n\n");
        out.push_str(&fns);
        out.push('\n');
    }
    if !events.is_empty() {
        out.push_str("### Events\n\n");
        out.push_str(&events);
        out.push('\n');
    }
    out
}
```
