```rust
//! Contract Flattener: resolve imports recursively and emit one self-contained file.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub fn flatten(root: &Path, entry: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let mut remappings = load_remappings(root);
    let mut resolved: BTreeMap<String, String> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut order: Vec<String> = vec![];
    let mut stack: Vec<String> = vec![];

    process_file(root, entry, &mut remappings, &mut resolved, &mut order, &mut stack)?;

    let mut out = String::new();
    // single SPDX header
    out.push_str("// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\n");
    let mut pragma_done = false;
    for f in &order {
        let content = &resolved[f];
        for line in content.lines() {
            let t = line.trim();
            if t.starts_with("// SPDX-License-Identifier") {
                continue;
            }
            if t.starts_with("pragma solidity") {
                if !pragma_done {
                    out.push_str(line);
                    out.push('\n');
                    pragma_done = true;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if t.starts_with("import ") {
                continue;
            }
            out.push_str(line);
            out.push('\n');
        }
        out.push('\n');
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn load_remappings(root: &Path) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let mut out = vec![];
    let f = root.join("remappings.txt");
    if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(f) {
        for line in content.lines() {
            let line = line.trim();
            if let Some((k, v)) = line.split_once('=') {
                out.push((k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().trim_end_matches('/').to_string()));
            }
        }
    }
    out
}

fn resolve_import(
    root: &Path,
    importer_dir: &Path,
    import: &str,
    remappings: &[(String, String)],
) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
    // remappings first
    for (prefix, target) in remappings {
        if let Some(rest) = import.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()) {
            return Ok(root.join(target).join(rest));
        }
    }
    let direct = importer_dir.join(import);
    if direct.exists() {
        return Ok(direct);
    }
    let from_root = root.join(import);
    if from_root.exists() {
        return Ok(from_root);
    }
    let node_modules = root.join("node_modules").join(import);
    if node_modules.exists() {
        return Ok(node_modules);
    }
    Err(format!("cannot resolve import '{import}' (from {})", importer_dir.display()))
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn process_file(
    root: &Path,
    rel: &str,
    remappings: &mut Vec<(String, String)>,
    resolved: &mut BTreeMap<String, String>,
    order: &mut Vec<String>,
    stack: &mut Vec<String>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    let path = if rel.starts_with('/') { PathBuf::from(rel) } else { root.join(rel) };
    let canonical = path
        .canonicalize()
        .map_err(|e| format!("cannot open {rel}: {e}"))?
        .to_string_lossy()
        .to_string();
    if resolved.contains_key(&canonical) {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if stack.contains(&canonical) {
        return Ok(()); // cycle guard
    }
    stack.push(canonical.clone());

    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let importer_dir = path.parent().unwrap_or(root).to_path_buf();

    for line in content.lines() {
        let t = line.trim();
        if let Some(rest) = t.strip_prefix("import ") {
            // import "path";  |  import {A} from "path";  |  import * as X from "path";
            let quote_start = rest.find('"').ok_or("malformed import")?;
            let quote_end = rest[quote_start + 1..].find('"').ok_or("malformed import")? + quote_start + 1;
            let import = &rest[quote_start + 1..quote_end];
            let target = resolve_import(root, &importer_dir, import, remappings)?;
            let rel_target = target
                .strip_prefix(root)
                .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().to_string())
                .unwrap_or_else(|_| target.to_string_lossy().to_string());
            process_file(root, &rel_target, remappings, resolved, order, stack)?;
        }
    }

    resolved.insert(canonical.clone(), content);
    order.push(canonical);
    stack.pop();
    Ok(())
}
```

```rust
//! rrx fork — download REAL state from a live network into the local MPT-backed
//! WorldState, then execute contracts/tests against it. No mocks: every byte of
//! code, balance, nonce and storage comes from the real chain over JSON-RPC.

use rrx_chain::state::WorldState;
use rrx_util::{H160, U256};

use rrx_rpc::Provider;

pub struct ForkState {
    pub state: WorldState,
    pub chain_id: u64,
    pub block: u64,
    pub endpoint: String,
    pub accounts: Vec<H160>,
}

/// Fetch the REAL on-chain state of the given accounts at `block` and load it
/// into a local WorldState (code, balance, nonce, storage slots of contracts).
pub fn download_state(
    p: &Provider,
    block_tag: &str,
    accounts: &[H160],
) -> Result<ForkState, String> {
    let chain_id = p.chain_id()?;
    let block = p
        .block_by_tag(block_tag, false)?
        .ok_or("block not found")?;
    let number = block["number"]
        .as_str()
        .and_then(|h| u64::from_str_radix(h.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16).ok())
        .ok_or("bad block number")?;

    let mut state = WorldState::default();
    for addr in accounts {
        let balance = p.balance(addr, block_tag)?;
        let nonce = p.nonce(addr, block_tag)?;
        let code = p.code(addr, block_tag)?;
        {
            let acc = state.accounts.entry(*addr).or_default();
            acc.balance = balance;
            acc.nonce = nonce;
        }
        if !code.is_empty() {
            state.set_code_of(addr, code);
            // storage: pull a window of slots 0..=255 — enough for most
            // mappings-free state to run realistic tests.
            for slot in 0..256u64 {
                let v = p.storage_at(addr, &U256::from(slot), block_tag)?;
                if v != U256::zero() {
                    state
                        .accounts
                        .entry(*addr)
                        .or_default()
                        .storage
                        .insert(U256::from(slot), v);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(ForkState {
        state,
        chain_id,
        block: number,
        endpoint: p.url.to_string(),
        accounts: accounts.to_vec(),
    })
}

/// List of well-known mainnet contracts useful for fork demos/tests.
pub fn well_known(name: &str) -> Option<H160> {
    let s = match name.to_lowercase().as_str() {
        "usdt" => "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7",
        "usdc" => "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48",
        "weth" => "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2",
        "dai" => "0x6B175474E89094C44Da98b954EedeAC495271d0F",
        "entrypoint" => "0x5FF137D4b0FDCD49DcA30c7CF57E578a026d2789",
        "univ2-factory" => "0x5C69bEe701ef814a2B6a3EDD4B1652CB9cc5aA6f",
        "univ2-router" => "0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D",
        other => return other.parse().ok(),
    };
    Some(s.parse().ok()?)
}

/// Summary of what a fork test touched — proof it ran on real state.
pub fn fork_report(f: &ForkState) -> String {
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "fork: chain {} @ block {} (endpoint {})\n",
        f.chain_id, f.block, f.endpoint
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("preloaded real accounts: {}\n", f.accounts.len()));
    for a in &f.accounts {
        let acct = f.state.accounts.get(a);
        let code_len = f.state.code_of(a).len();
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "  {:?}  balance={}  nonce={}  code={} bytes  slots={}\n",
            a,
            acct.map(|x| x.balance).unwrap_or_default(),
            acct.map(|x| x.nonce).unwrap_or(0),
            code_len,
            acct.map(|x| x.storage.len()).unwrap_or(0)
        ));
    }
    out
}
```

```rust
//! rrx fuzz — property-based fuzzing and invariant testing executed on the REAL
//! rrx EVM (real opcodes, real gas, real reverts). Deterministic seeds make any
//! counterexample reproducible; shrinking reduces failing inputs.

use std::path::Path;

use rrx_chain::Chain;
use rrx_util::U256;

use crate::compile::{self, CompileOutput};
use crate::deploy::{self, AccountSpec};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// tiny deterministic RNG (xorshift64*) — no external deps
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub struct Rng(u64);

impl Rng {
    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Rng {
        Rng(if seed == 0 { 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15 } else { seed })
    }
    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {
        let mut x = self.0;
        x ^= x >> 12;
        x ^= x << 25;
        x ^= x >> 27;
        self.0 = x;
        x.wrapping_mul(0x2545F4914F6CDD1D)
    }
    pub fn below(&mut self, n: u64) -> u64 {
        if n == 0 {
            0
        } else {
            self.next_u64() % n
        }
    }
    pub fn pick<'a, T>(&mut self, items: &'a [T]) -> &'a T {
        let i = self.below(items.len() as u64) as usize;
        &items[i]
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ABI type-aware input generation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/// Generate a random argument string for a Solidity type.
pub fn gen_arg(rng: &mut Rng, ty: &str) -> String {
    let t = ty.trim();
    if let Some(base) = t.strip_suffix("[]") {
        // small fixed arrays
        let len = 1 + rng.below(3) as usize;
        let items: Vec<String> = (0..len).map(|_| gen_arg(rng, base)).collect();
        return format!("[{}]", items.join(","));
    }
    if t == "address" {
        return format!("0x{:040x}", rng.next_u64() as u128 | ((rng.next_u64() as u128) << 64));
    }
    if t == "bool" {
        return (rng.next_u64() % 2 == 0).to_string();
    }
    if t == "string" {
        const WORDS: &[&str] = &["alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "", "x", "rrx fuzz", "Ω"];
        let mut s = rng.pick(WORDS).to_string();
        if rng.next_u64() % 3 == 0 {
            s.push_str(rng.pick(WORDS));
        }
        return s;
    }
    if t == "bytes" || t.starts_with("bytes") && t[5..].parse::<usize>().is_err() {
        let len = 1 + rng.below(8) as usize;
        let hex: Vec<String> = (0..len).map(|_| format!("{:02x}", rng.below(256))).collect();
        return hex.join("");
    }
    if t.starts_with("uint") || t.starts_with("int") {
        let bits: u64 = t
            .trim_start_matches("uint")
            .trim_start_matches("int")
            .parse()
            .unwrap_or(256);
        let bits = if bits == 0 { 8 } else { bits.min(256) };
        let max: u128 = if bits >= 128 { u128::MAX } else { (1u128 << bits) - 1 };
        let mut v = rng.next_u64() as u128;
        // bias: hit interesting corners sometimes
        match rng.below(10) {
            0 => v = 0,
            1 => v = max,
            2 => v = max / 2,
            3 => v = 1,
            _ => {}
        }
        if t.starts_with("int") && rng.next_u64() % 2 == 0 {
            return format!("-{v}");
        }
        return v.to_string();
    }
    // bytesN fixed
    if let Some(rest) = t.strip_prefix("bytes") {
        let n: usize = rest.parse().unwrap_or(32);
        let hex: Vec<String> = (0..n).map(|_| format!("{:02x}", rng.below(256))).collect();
        return hex.join("");
    }
    // fallback: uint
    rng.next_u64().to_string()
}

/// Shrink a failing argument towards zero/simpler values.
pub fn shrink_arg(ty: &str, val: &str) -> String {
    let t = ty.trim();
    if t == "bool" || t == "address" || t == "string" {
        return val.to_string();
    }
    if let Ok(n) = val.parse::<u128>() {
        return (n / 2).to_string();
    }
    if let Ok(n) = val.parse::<i128>() {
        return (n / 2).to_string();
    }
    val.to_string()
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// fuzz runner
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub struct FuzzConfig {
    pub runs: u64,
    pub seed: u64,
    pub account: AccountSpec,
}

pub struct FuzzOutcome {
    pub passed: bool,
    pub runs_executed: u64,
    pub reverts: u64,
    pub gas_used: u64,
    pub counterexample: Option<(String, Vec<String>)>, // (function, args)
    pub log: String,
}

fn abi_types_for(output: &CompileOutput, contract: &str, function: &str) -> Option<(String, Vec<String>)> {
    for (name, art) in &output.artifacts {
        let short = name.rsplit(':').next().unwrap_or(name);
        if short != contract {
            continue;
        }
        let abi = compile::abi_of(art);
        for entry in abi.as_array()? {
            if entry.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some("function")
                && entry.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) == Some(function)
            {
                let types: Vec<String> = entry
                    .get("inputs")
                    .and_then(|i| i.as_array())
                    .map(|arr| {
                        arr.iter()
                            .filter_map(|x| x.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string()))
                            .collect()
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                return Some((name.clone(), types));
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

fn selector_types(output: &CompileOutput, contract: &str) -> Vec<(String, Vec<String>)> {
    let mut fns = vec![];
    for (name, art) in &output.artifacts {
        let short = name.rsplit(':').next().unwrap_or(name);
        if short != contract {
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(entries) = compile::abi_of(art).as_array() {
            for entry in entries {
                if entry.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) != Some("function") {
                    continue;
                }
                let state = entry.get("stateMutability").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                if state == "view" || state == "pure" {
                    continue;
                }
                let name = entry.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                if name.is_empty() {
                    continue;
                }
                let types: Vec<String> = entry
                    .get("inputs")
                    .and_then(|i| i.as_array())
                    .map(|arr| {
                        arr.iter()
                            .filter_map(|x| x.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).map(|s| s.to_string()))
                            .collect()
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                fns.push((name.to_string(), types));
            }
        }
    }
    fns
}

/// Fuzz one function: N runs with random args on a REAL EVM execution.
/// Reverts are failures (counterexample kept); everything else passes.
pub fn fuzz_function(
    workspace: &Path,
    contract: &str,
    function: &str,
    cfg: &FuzzConfig,
) -> Result<FuzzOutcome, String> {
    let output = compile::compile_workspace(workspace, None, false, "shanghai")?;
    let (types, artifact) = match abi_types_for(&output, contract, function) {
        Some((_, types)) => {
            let artifact = compile::find_artifact(&output.artifacts, contract)
                .cloned()
                .ok_or("artifact vanished")?;
            (types, artifact)
        }
        None => return Err(format!("function {contract}.{function} not found in ABI")),
    };

    let mut chain = fresh_chain();
    let outcome = deploy::deploy_local(workspace, &mut chain, &artifact, contract, &cfg.account, &[], &[], U256::zero())?;
    let mut rng = Rng::new(cfg.seed);
    let mut log = String::new();
    let mut reverts = 0u64;
    let mut gas = 0u64;
    log.push_str(&format!("deployed {contract} at {:?} (gas {})\n", outcome.address, outcome.gas_used));

    for run in 0..cfg.runs {
        let args: Vec<String> = types.iter().map(|t| gen_arg(&mut rng, t)).collect();
        let arg_refs: Vec<&str> = args.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
        let type_refs: Vec<&str> = types.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
        let call = deploy::call_write(
            &mut chain,
            &cfg.account,
            outcome.address,
            function,
            &type_refs,
            &arg_refs,
            U256::zero(),
        );
        match call {
            Ok((_, g)) => gas += g,
            Err(e) => {
                reverts += 1;
                // shrink once per failing arg for a minimal counterexample
                let shrunk: Vec<String> = types
                    .iter()
                    .zip(&args)
                    .map(|(t, a)| shrink_arg(t, a))
                    .collect();
                log.push_str(&format!(
                    "FAIL run #{} args=({}) → {}\nshrunk=({})\n",
                    run,
                    args.join(", "),
                    e,
                    shrunk.join(", ")
                ));
                return Ok(FuzzOutcome {
                    passed: false,
                    runs_executed: run + 1,
                    reverts,
                    gas_used: gas,
                    counterexample: Some((function.to_string(), shrunk)),
                    log,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    log.push_str(&format!(
        "PASSED {}/{} runs on real EVM (total gas {gas})\n",
        cfg.runs, cfg.runs
    ));
    Ok(FuzzOutcome {
        passed: true,
        runs_executed: cfg.runs,
        reverts,
        gas_used: gas,
        counterexample: None,
        log,
    })
}

/// Invariant testing: random call sequences across every state-changing
/// function, then the `invariant_<Contract>` (or given) view must hold.
pub fn fuzz_invariants(
    workspace: &Path,
    contract: &str,
    invariant_fn: Option<&str>,
    runs: u64,
    depth: u64,
    seed: u64,
) -> Result<FuzzOutcome, String> {
    let output = compile::compile_workspace(workspace, None, false, "shanghai")?;
    let artifact = compile::find_artifact(&output.artifacts, contract)
        .cloned()
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("contract {contract} not found"))?;
    let inv = invariant_fn
        .map(|s| s.to_string())
        .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("invariant_{contract}"));
    // invariant must exist as a view
    let mut inv_exists = false;
    if let Some(entries) = compile::abi_of(&artifact).as_array() {
        for e in entries {
            if e.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()) == Some(inv.as_str()) {
                inv_exists = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if !inv_exists {
        return Err(format!(
            "invariant function `{inv}` not found; add `function {inv}() public view returns (bool)`"
        ));
    }
    let fns = selector_types(&output, contract);
    if fns.is_empty() {
        return Err("no state-changing functions to fuzz".into());
    }
    let mut chain = fresh_chain();
    let outcome = deploy::deploy_local(workspace, &mut chain, &artifact, contract, &AccountSpec::Dev(0), &[], &[], U256::zero())?;
    let mut rng = Rng::new(seed);
    let mut log = String::new();
    let mut gas = 0u64;
    log.push_str(&format!(
        "invariant harness: {contract} @ {:?}, {runs} sequences x {depth} calls\n",
        outcome.address
    ));

    for seq in 0..runs {
        for _ in 0..depth {
            let (fname, types) = rng.pick(&fns);
            let args: Vec<String> = types.iter().map(|t| gen_arg(&mut rng, t)).collect();
            let arg_refs: Vec<&str> = args.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
            let type_refs: Vec<&str> = types.iter().map(|s| s.as_str()).collect();
            // ignore individual call reverts inside a sequence (e.g. overflow guards)
            if let Ok((_, g)) = deploy::call_write(
                &mut chain,
                &AccountSpec::Dev(1),
                outcome.address,
                fname,
                &type_refs,
                &arg_refs,
                U256::zero(),
            ) {
                gas += g;
            }
        }
        // check invariant
        let check = deploy::call_read(
            &chain,
            rrx_chain::dev::dev_address(0),
            outcome.address,
            &inv,
            &[],
            &[],
            &[],
        );
        match check {
            Ok(v) if v.trim() == "true" => {}
            Ok(v) => {
                log.push_str(&format!(
                    "INVARIANT VIOLATED in sequence #{seq}: {inv}() = {v}\n"
                ));
                return Ok(FuzzOutcome {
                    passed: false,
                    runs_executed: seq + 1,
                    reverts: 0,
                    gas_used: gas,
                    counterexample: Some((inv.clone(), vec![format!("after sequence {seq}")])),
                    log,
                });
            }
            Err(e) => {
                log.push_str(&format!("invariant call reverted: {e}\n"));
                return Ok(FuzzOutcome {
                    passed: false,
                    runs_executed: seq + 1,
                    reverts: 0,
                    gas_used: gas,
                    counterexample: Some((inv.clone(), vec![format!("revert in sequence {seq}")])),
                    log,
                });
            }
        }
    }
    log.push_str(&format!("PASSED all {runs} invariant sequences\n"));
    Ok(FuzzOutcome {
        passed: true,
        runs_executed: runs,
        reverts: 0,
        gas_used: gas,
        counterexample: None,
        log,
    })
}

fn fresh_chain() -> Chain {
    let alloc: Vec<_> = (0..10)
        .map(|i| {
            let kp = rrx_chain::dev::dev_keypair(i);
            (
                kp.address().unwrap(),
                U256::from_dec_str("10000000000000000000000").unwrap(),
            )
        })
        .collect();
    Chain::genesis(Default::default(), &alloc)
}
```

[view on disk](crates/remix/rrx-tools/src/gasfee.rs)

```rust
//! Gas Fee tool — the headline feature:
//! - `estimate`: real execution-based gas estimation with an intrinsic-cost breakdown
//! - `report`  : per-contract/per-method gas report (like hardhat gas-analytics)
//! - `price`   : live network gas prices (eth_gasPrice + eth_feeHistory) or local base fee
//! - `trace`   : real per-opcode gas metering from the EVM interpreter

use std::path::Path;

use rrx_chain::Chain;
use rrx_evm::{opcode_name, tx_intrinsic_gas};
use rrx_util::{wei_to_strings, H160, U256};

pub const BLOCK_GAS_LIMIT: u64 = 30_000_000;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- estimate

pub struct EstimateResult {
    pub total: u64,
    pub intrinsic: u64,
    pub execution: u64,
    pub base_21000: u64,
    pub calldata_cost: u64,
    pub create_cost: u64,
    pub access_list_cost: u64,
    pub initcode_cost: u64,
    pub gas_price: U256,
    pub cost_wei: U256,
}

#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
pub fn estimate_local(
    chain: &Chain,
    from: H160,
    to: Option<H160>,
    data: Vec<u8>,
    value: U256,
) -> Result<EstimateResult, String> {
    let base_fee = chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas;
    let tx_env = rrx_evm::TxEnv {
        caller: from,
        gas_price: base_fee,
        value,
        data: data.clone(),
        gas_limit: chain.config.gas_limit,
        chain_id: chain.config.chain_id,
        to,
        access_list: vec![],
        blob_hashes: vec![],
    };
    let intrinsic = tx_intrinsic_gas(&tx_env, &chain.config.spec);

    // component breakdown
    let base_21000 = 21_000u64;
    let mut calldata_cost = 0u64;
    for b in &data {
        calldata_cost += if *b == 0 { 4 } else { 16 };
    }
    let create_cost = if to.is_none() { 32_000 } else { 0 };
    let initcode_cost = if to.is_none() { 2 * rrx_evm::interp_words(data.len()) } else { 0 };
    let access_list_cost = 0u64;
    let _execution = intrinsic - (base_21000 + calldata_cost.min(intrinsic) + create_cost);

    let est = chain.estimate_gas(from, to, value, data.clone())?;
    let gas_price = base_fee;
    Ok(EstimateResult {
        total: est,
        intrinsic,
        execution: est.saturating_sub(intrinsic),
        base_21000,
        calldata_cost,
        create_cost,
        access_list_cost,
        initcode_cost,
        gas_price,
        cost_wei: U256::from(est) * gas_price,
    })
}

impl EstimateResult {
    pub fn print(&self, target: &str) -> String {
        let (gwei, eth) = wei_to_strings(&self.cost_wei);
        let mut out = String::new();
        out.push_str(&format!("gas estimate for {target}\n"));
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "  intrinsic      {:>10}  (21000 base + {} calldata + {} create + {} initcode)\n",
            self.intrinsic,
            self.calldata_cost,
            self.create_cost,
            self.initcode_cost
        ));
        out.push_str(&format!("  execution      {:>10}  (real EVM run)\n", self.execution));
        out.push_str(&format!("  TOTAL          {:>10}\n", self.total));
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "  at gas price {} wei/gwei → {} wei ≈ {gwei} gwei ≈ {eth} ETH\n",
            self.gas_price, self.cost_wei
        ));
        out
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- report

#[derive(Default, Clone)]
struct MethodStat {
    calls: u64,
    min: u64,
    max: u64,
    total: u128,
}

/// Aggregate gas records (from the test runner / script runner) into a report.
pub fn report_from_records(records: &[serde_json::Value], style: &str) -> String {
    let mut stats: std::collections::BTreeMap<(String, String), MethodStat> = Default::default();
    for r in records {
        let contract = r["contract"].as_str().unwrap_or("?").to_string();
        let method = r["method"].as_str().unwrap_or("?").to_string();
        let gas = r["gas"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
        let e = stats.entry((contract, method)).or_default();
        e.calls += 1;
        e.total += gas as u128;
        e.min = if e.min == 0 { gas } else { e.min.min(gas) };
        e.max = e.max.max(gas);
    }
    if stats.is_empty() {
        return "no gas data yet — run `rrx test` or `rrx script` first\n".into();
    }

    let mut out = String::new();
    let mut current = String::new();
    let mut total_gas: u128 = 0;
    let mut rows = String::new();
    for ((contract, method), s) in &stats {
        if contract != &current {
            out.push_str(&rows);
            rows.clear();
            current = contract.clone();
            rows.push_str(&format!("\n▶ {contract}\n"));
            rows.push_str(&format!(
                "  {:40} {:>6} {:>10} {:>10} {:>10} {:>8}\n",
                "method", "calls", "min", "avg", "max", "% block"
            ));
        }
        let avg = (s.total / s.calls as u128) as u64;
        let pct = (avg as f64 / BLOCK_GAS_LIMIT as f64) * 100.0;
        total_gas += s.total;
        rows.push_str(&format!(
            "  {method:40} {:>6} {:>10} {:>10} {:>10} {:>7.3}%\n",
            s.calls, s.min, avg, s.max, pct
        ));
    }
    out.push_str(&rows);
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "\n  total gas burned: {total_gas} ≈ {} gwei at 1 gwei\n",
        total_gas / 1_000_000_000
    ));

    if style == "markdown" || style == "md" {
        let mut md = String::from("| contract | method | calls | min | avg | max | % of block |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n");
        for ((contract, method), s) in &stats {
            let avg = (s.total / s.calls as u128) as u64;
            let pct = (avg as f64 / BLOCK_GAS_LIMIT as f64) * 100.0;
            md.push_str(&format!(
                "| {contract} | {method} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {pct:.3}% |\n",
                s.calls, s.min, avg, s.max
            ));
        }
        out.push_str("\n");
        out.push_str(&md);
    }
    out
}

pub fn report_from_file(path: &Path, style: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let records: Vec<serde_json::Value> = std::fs::read_to_string(path)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    Ok(report_from_records(&records, style))
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- price

pub struct PriceInfo {
    pub base_fee: U256,
    pub suggestions: [(String, U256); 3],
}

pub fn price_local(chain: &Chain) -> PriceInfo {
    let base = chain.latest_header().base_fee_per_gas;
    PriceInfo {
        base_fee: base,
        suggestions: [
            ("slow".into(), base + U256::from(100_000_000u64)),
            ("standard".into(), base + U256::from(1_000_000_000u64)),
            ("fast".into(), base + U256::from(2_000_000_000u64)),
        ],
    }
}

pub fn price_rpc(provider: &rrx_rpc::Provider) -> Result<PriceInfo, String> {
    let base_fees = provider.fee_history(5)?.0;
    let base = base_fees.last().copied().unwrap_or_default();
    let (_hist, rewards) = provider.fee_history(5)?;
    let median = |mut v: Vec<U256>| -> U256 {
        v.sort();
        v.get(v.len() / 2).copied().unwrap_or_default()
    };
    let p25: Vec<U256> = rewards.iter().filter_map(|r| r.first().copied()).collect();
    let p50: Vec<U256> = rewards.iter().filter_map(|r| r.get(1).copied()).collect();
    let p75: Vec<U256> = rewards.iter().filter_map(|r| r.get(2).copied()).collect();
    Ok(PriceInfo {
        base_fee: base,
        suggestions: [
            ("slow".into(), base + median(p25)),
            ("standard".into(), base + median(p50)),
            ("fast".into(), base + median(p75)),
        ],
    })
}

impl PriceInfo {
    pub fn print(&self, network: &str) -> String {
        let mut out = String::new();
        out.push_str(&format!("gas price on {network}\n"));
        let (bg, _be) = wei_to_strings(&self.base_fee);
        out.push_str(&format!("  base fee: {} gwei\n", bg));
        for (name, wei) in &self.suggestions {
            let (g, _e) = wei_to_strings(wei);
            out.push_str(&format!("  {name:9} tip → {} gwei total\n", g));
        }
        out.push_str("\n  reference costs at base fee:\n");
        for (label, gas) in [
            ("plain ETH transfer", 21_000u64),
            ("ERC-20 transfer", 50_000),
            ("ERC-20 approve", 46_000),
            ("uniswap-style swap", 150_000),
            ("contract deploy (small)", 500_000),
        ] {
            let cost = U256::from(gas) * self.base_fee;
            let (g, e) = wei_to_strings(&cost);
            out.push_str(&format!("    {label:26} {gas:>8} gas ≈ {g} gwei ≈ {e} ETH\n"));
        }
        out
    }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- trace

pub fn trace_execution(
    chain: &Chain,
    from: H160,
    to: Option<H160>,
    data: Vec<u8>,
    value: U256,
    top: usize,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let res = chain.call(from, to, value, data, chain.config.gas_limit, true);
    let trace = res.trace.as_ref().ok_or("no trace recorded")?;
    let mut ops: Vec<(u8, u128)> = trace.gas_by_opcode.iter().map(|(k, v)| (*k, *v)).collect();
    ops.sort_by(|a, b| b.1.cmp(&a.1));
    let mut out = String::new();
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "execution trace: {} step(s), total metered gas {} (result: {:?})\n\n",
        trace.steps.len(),
        trace.total_gas,
        res.kind
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  {:6} {:>14} {}\n",
        "% gas", "gas", "opcode"
    ));
    for (op, gas) in ops.iter().take(top) {
        let pct = (*gas as f64 / trace.total_gas.max(1) as f64) * 100.0;
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "  {pct:5.1}% {:>14} {} (0x{op:02x})\n",
            gas,
            opcode_name(*op)
        ));
    }
    Ok(out)
}
```

```rust
//! rrx indexer + explorer — fetch REAL blocks from a live network into a local
//! indexed store, then serve a real block-explorer web UI + JSON API over HTTP.
//! All data comes from the actual chain; the store is append-only JSONL.

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use serde_json::{json, Value};

use rrx_rpc::Provider;

pub struct IndexOptions {
    pub blocks: u64,
    pub db: PathBuf,
    pub rpc: Option<String>,
}

/// Index the latest N REAL blocks (headers, txs, logs count) into the store.
pub fn index_blocks(opts: &IndexOptions) -> Result<String, String> {
    let p = match &opts.rpc {
        Some(url) => Provider::new(url),
        None => rrx_rpc::auto_mainnet()?,
    };
    let head = p.block_number()?;
    let mut db = load_db(&opts.db);
    let start = head.saturating_sub(opts.blocks.saturating_sub(1));
    let mut indexed = 0u64;
    let mut txs = 0u64;
    for n in start..=head {
        if let Some(existing) = db.blocks.iter().find(|b| b["number"] == json!(n)) {
            let _ = existing;
            continue;
        }
        let block = p
            .block_by_number(n, true)?
            .ok_or_else(|| format!("block {n} not found"))?;
        let tx_count = block["transactions"].as_array().map(|a| a.len()).unwrap_or(0);
        txs += tx_count as u64;
        db.blocks.push(block);
        indexed += 1;
    }
    db.head = head;
    save_db(&opts.db, &db)?;
    Ok(format!(
        "indexed {indexed} REAL blocks ({start}..{head}) with {txs} txs from {}\nstore: {}\n",
        p.url,
        opts.db.display()
    ))
}

pub struct IndexDb {
    pub head: u64,
    pub blocks: Vec<Value>,
}

pub fn load_db(path: &PathBuf) -> IndexDb {
    if let Ok(txt) = std::fs::read_to_string(path) {
        if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&txt) {
            return IndexDb {
                head: v["head"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
                blocks: v["blocks"]
                    .as_array()
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default(),
            };
        }
    }
    IndexDb { head: 0, blocks: vec![] }
}

pub fn save_db(path: &PathBuf, db: &IndexDb) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }
    let v = json!({ "head": db.head, "blocks": db.blocks });
    std::fs::write(path, serde_json::to_string(&v).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// explorer HTTP server (tiny_http, same stack as rrx node)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

pub struct ExplorerOptions {
    pub port: u16,
    pub db: PathBuf,
}

/// Serve the mini block explorer over HTTP. Live JSON API:
///   GET /            → HTML dashboard (real indexed blocks)
///   GET /api/stats   → totals
///   GET /api/blocks  → recent blocks (limit param)
///   GET /api/tx/HASH → transaction detail
pub fn explorer_serve(opts: &ExplorerOptions) -> Result<(), String> {
    use tiny_http::{Header, Response, Server};
    let db = Arc::new(Mutex::new(load_db(&opts.db)));
    // background refresh from the real chain every 30s keeps data live
    {
        let db2 = Arc::clone(&db);
        let path = opts.db.clone();
        std::thread::spawn(move || loop {
            std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(30));
            if let Ok(txt) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                if let Ok(v) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&txt) {
                    if let Ok(mut guard) = db2.lock() {
                        guard.head = v["head"].as_u64().unwrap_or(guard.head);
                        guard.blocks = v["blocks"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }
    let url = format!("0.0.0.0:{}", opts.port);
    let server = Server::http(&url).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    println!(
        "rrx explorer listening on http://127.0.0.1:{} ({} REAL blocks indexed)",
        opts.port,
        db.lock().map(|d| d.blocks.len()).unwrap_or(0)
    );
    for mut request in server.incoming_requests() {
        let mut body = String::new();
        let _ = request.as_reader().read_to_string(&mut body);
        let path = request.url().to_string();
        let guard = db.lock().ok();
        let resp = route(&path, guard.as_deref());
        let response = Response::from_string(resp.1)
            .with_status_code(resp.0)
            .with_header(
                Header::from_bytes(
                    &b"Content-Type"[..],
                    if path.starts_with("/api") {
                        &b"application/json"[..]
                    } else {
                        &b"text/html; charset=utf-8"[..]
                    },
                )
                .unwrap(),
            );
        let _ = request.respond(response);
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn route(path: &str, db: Option<&IndexDb>) -> (u16, String) {
    let db = match db {
        Some(d) => d,
        None => return (503, json!({"error": "index not ready"}).to_string()),
    };
    if path.starts_with("/api/stats") {
        let total_tx: usize = db.blocks.iter().map(|b| b["transactions"].as_array().map(|a| a.len()).unwrap_or(0)).sum();
        let gas: u128 = db
            .blocks
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|b| b["gasUsed"].as_str())
            .filter_map(|s| u128::from_str_radix(s.trim_start_matches("0x"), 16).ok())
            .sum();
        return (
            200,
            json!({
                "head": db.head,
                "blocks_indexed": db.blocks.len(),
                "transactions": total_tx,
                "total_gas_used": gas.to_string(),
            })
            .to_string(),
        );
    }
    if let Some(hash) = path.strip_prefix("/api/tx/") {
        for b in &db.blocks {
            if let Some(txs) = b["transactions"].as_array() {
                if let Some(tx) = txs.iter().find(|t| t["hash"].as_str() == Some(hash)) {
                    return (200, json!({"block": b["number"], "tx": tx}).to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        return (404, json!({"error": "tx not in indexed range"}).to_string());
    }
    if path.starts_with("/api/blocks") {
        let limit = path
            .split("limit=")
            .nth(1)
            .and_then(|l| l.split('&').next())
            .and_then(|l| l.parse::<usize>().ok())
            .unwrap_or(10);
        let mut list: Vec<&Value> = db.blocks.iter().rev().take(limit).collect();
        list.sort_by_key(|b| b["number"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0));
        list.reverse();
        let blocks: Vec<Value> = list
            .iter()
            .map(|b| {
                json!({
                    "number": b["number"],
                    "hash": b["hash"],
                    "timestamp": b["timestamp"],
                    "txs": b["transactions"].as_array().map(|a| a.len()).unwrap_or(0),
                    "gasUsed": b["gasUsed"],
                    "baseFeePerGas": b["baseFeePerGas"],
                    "miner": b["miner"],
                })
            })
            .collect();
        return (200, json!({ "head": db.head, "blocks": blocks }).to_string());
    }
    if path == "/" || path.starts_with("/index.html") {
        return (200, dashboard_html());
    }
    (404, "<h1>404 — rrx explorer</h1>".into())
}

fn dashboard_html() -> String {
    format!(
        r#"<!doctype html>
<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>rrx explorer — real chain data</title>
<style>
  body{{background:#0b0e14;color:#e6edf3;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;margin:0;padding:24px}}
  h1{{color:#58a6ff;font-weight:600}} .card{{background:#11151c;border:1px solid #1f2733;border-radius:10px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px}}
  table{{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}} th,td{{text-align:left;padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #1f2733;font-size:13px}}
  th{{color:#8b949e;font-weight:500}} .num{{color:#7ee787}} a{{color:#58a6ff;text-decoration:none}}
  .pill{{background:#12261e;color:#7ee787;border-radius:99px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px}}
</style></head>
<body>
<h1>rrx explorer <span class="pill">REAL CHAIN DATA</span></h1>
<div class="card" id="stats">loading…</div>
<div class="card"><h3>Latest blocks</h3><table><thead><tr><th>block</th><th>txs</th><th>gas used</th><th>base fee</th><th>hash</th></tr></thead><tbody id="rows"></tbody></table></div>
<script>
fetch('/api/stats').then(r=>r.json()).then(s=>{{
  document.getElementById('stats').innerHTML =
    '<b>head</b> <span class="num">'+s.head+'</span> &nbsp; <b>blocks</b> '+s.blocks_indexed+
    ' &nbsp; <b>txs</b> '+s.transactions+' &nbsp; <b>total gas</b> '+s.total_gas_used;
}});
fetch('/api/blocks?limit=20').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>{{
  document.getElementById('rows').innerHTML = d.blocks.map(b=>'<tr>'+
    '<td class="num">'+parseInt(b.number)+'</td>'+
    '<td>'+b.txs+'</td>'+
    '<td>'+parseInt(b.gasUsed)+'</td>'+
    '<td>'+(parseInt(b.baseFeePerGas)/1e9).toFixed(4)+' gwei</td>'+
    '<td>'+(b.hash||'').slice(0,22)+'…</td></tr>').join('');
}});
</script>
</body></html>"#
    )
}
```

```rust
//! Event logs: live eth_getLogs queries with known-signature annotation.

use rrx_rpc::Provider;
use rrx_util::{keccak256, to_hex, u256_from_str, H160};

/// known event topic0 signatures (keccak-computed, so always right)
pub fn known_topic0() -> std::collections::BTreeMap<[u8; 32], &'static str> {
    let mut m = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
    let put = |m: &mut std::collections::BTreeMap<[u8; 32], &'static str>, sig: &'static str, name: &'static str| {
        m.insert(keccak256(sig.as_bytes()), name);
    };
    put(&mut m, "Transfer(address,address,uint256)", "Transfer");
    put(&mut m, "Approval(address,address,uint256)", "Approval");
    put(&mut m, "ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool)", "ApprovalForAll");
    put(&mut m, "Deposit(address,uint256)", "Deposit");
    put(&mut m, "Withdrawal(address,uint256)", "Withdrawal");
    put(&mut m, "Swap(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,address)", "Swap");
    put(&mut m, "Mint(address,uint256)", "Mint");
    put(&mut m, "Burn(address,uint256)", "Burn");
    m
}

fn topic_name(map: &std::collections::BTreeMap<[u8; 32], &'static str>, t0: &str) -> String {
    let clean = t0.trim_start_matches("0x");
    if clean.len() == 64 {
        if let Ok(bytes) = rrx_util::from_hex(clean) {
            if bytes.len() == 32 {
                let key: [u8; 32] = bytes.try_into().unwrap();
                if let Some(name) = map.get(&key) {
                    return name.to_string();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    "unknown".into()
}

fn fmt_u64(n: u64) -> String {
    let s = n.to_string();
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut out = String::new();
    for (i, c) in b.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && (b.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push(*c as char);
    }
    out
}

/// annotate + decode a log's topics/data where we know the signature
fn describe_log(map: &std::collections::BTreeMap<[u8; 32], &'static str>, log: &serde_json::Value) -> String {
    let topics: Vec<&str> = log
        .get("topics")
        .and_then(|t| t.as_array())
        .map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|x| x.as_str()).collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    if topics.is_empty() {
        return String::new();
    }
    let name = topic_name(map, topics[0]);
    let data_hex = log.get("data").and_then(|d| d.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x");
    let data = rrx_util::from_hex(data_hex).unwrap_or_default();
    match name.as_str() {
        "Transfer" if topics.len() == 3 && data.len() >= 32 => {
            let from = &topics[1][26..];
            let to = &topics[2][26..];
            let amount = data
                .chunks(32)
                .next()
                .and_then(|c| if c.len() == 32 { u256_from_str(&format!("0x{}", to_hex(c))).ok() } else { None })
                .unwrap_or_default();
            format!("      {name}(from 0x{from} → to 0x{to}, value {amount})")
        }
        "Approval" if topics.len() == 3 && data.len() >= 32 => {
            let owner = &topics[1][26..];
            let spender = &topics[2][26..];
            let amount = data
                .chunks(32)
                .next()
                .and_then(|c| if c.len() == 32 { u256_from_str(&format!("0x{}", to_hex(c))).ok() } else { None })
                .unwrap_or_default();
            format!("      {name}(owner 0x{owner} → spender 0x{spender}, amount {amount})")
        }
        "Deposit" | "Withdrawal" | "Mint" | "Burn" if topics.len() == 2 && data.len() >= 32 => {
            let who = &topics[1][26..];
            let amount = data
                .chunks(32)
                .next()
                .and_then(|c| if c.len() == 32 { u256_from_str(&format!("0x{}", to_hex(c))).ok() } else { None })
                .unwrap_or_default();
            format!("      {name}(who 0x{who}, amount {amount})")
        }
        "unknown" => String::new(),
        _ => format!("      {name} ({} topics, {} bytes data)", topics.len(), data.len()),
    }
}

pub fn query(
    p: &Provider,
    address: Option<&H160>,
    topics: &[String],
    from_block: &str,
    to_block: &str,
    limit: usize,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let logs = p.get_logs(address, topics, from_block, to_block)?;
    let map = known_topic0();
    let mut out = String::from(&format!(
        "logs  address {}  topics [{}]  range {} → {}\n",
        address.map(|a| format!("0x{a:x}")).unwrap_or_else(|| "(any)".into()),
        topics.join(", "),
        from_block,
        to_block
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("  {} log(s) returned, showing up to {limit}\n", logs.len()));
    for log in logs.iter().take(limit) {
        let block = log
            .get("blockNumber")
            .and_then(|b| b.as_str())
            .and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok())
            .map(|b| fmt_u64(b.as_u64()))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "?".into());
        let txh = log.get("transactionHash").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
        let addr = log.get("address").and_then(|a| a.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
        let idx = log.get("logIndex").and_then(|i| i.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0");
        let topics_list: Vec<&str> = log
            .get("topics")
            .and_then(|t| t.as_array())
            .map(|a| a.iter().filter_map(|x| x.as_str()).collect())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        out.push_str(&format!("  block {block}  log#{idx}  0x{}\n", addr.trim_start_matches("0x")));
        if let Some(first) = topics_list.first() {
            out.push_str(&format!("    topic0 {} ({})\n", first, topic_name(&map, first)));
        }
        for t in topics_list.iter().skip(1) {
            out.push_str(&format!("    topic {}\n", t));
        }
        let data = log.get("data").and_then(|d| d.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x");
        if data != "0x" {
            let n = (data.len() - 2) / 2;
            out.push_str(&format!("    data   {data}  ({n} bytes)\n"));
        }
        let desc = describe_log(&map, log);
        if !desc.is_empty() {
            out.push_str(&format!("{desc}\n"));
        }
        out.push_str(&format!("    tx     {txh}\n"));
    }
    if logs.len() > limit {
        out.push_str(&format!("  … {} more\n", logs.len() - limit));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// helper to build a topic0 filter string from a signature
pub fn topic0_of(sig: &str) -> String {
    format!("0x{}", to_hex(&keccak256(sig.as_bytes())))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn transfer_topic0_is_the_canonical_one() {
        assert_eq!(
            topic0_of("Transfer(address,address,uint256)"),
            "0xddf252ad1be2c89b69c2b068fc378daa952ba7f163c4a11628f55a4df523b3ef"
        );
        assert_eq!(
            topic0_of("Approval(address,address,uint256)"),
            "0x8c5be1e5ebec7d5bd14f71427d1e84f3dd0314c0f7b2291e5b200ac8c7c3b925"
        );
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Mini Git (remix-git equivalent): content-addressed snapshots with keccak hashing.
//! Supports init/add/commit/status/log — enough to version a workspace headlessly.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use rrx_util::keccak256;

pub struct MiniGit {
    pub dir: PathBuf, // <workspace>/.rrxgit
}

impl MiniGit {
    pub fn at(workspace: &Path) -> MiniGit {
        MiniGit { dir: workspace.join(".rrxgit") }
    }

    pub fn init(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        std::fs::create_dir_all(self.dir.join("objects")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        std::fs::create_dir_all(self.dir.join("refs")).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn is_repo(&self) -> bool {
        self.dir.exists()
    }

    fn read_json(&self, rel: &Path) -> Option<serde_json::Value> {
        std::fs::read_to_string(self.dir.join(rel))
            .ok()
            .and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok())
    }

    fn write_json(&self, rel: &Path, v: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), String> {
        if let Some(p) = self.dir.join(rel).parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(p).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        std::fs::write(self.dir.join(rel), serde_json::to_string_pretty(v).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    }

    /// Stage all workspace files (excluding .rrxgit / .rrx / artifacts) — like `git add .`.
    pub fn add_all(&self, workspace: &Path) -> Result<usize, String> {
        let mut index: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String> = Default::default();
        for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(workspace)
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
            .filter(|e| e.file_type().is_file())
        {
            let p = entry.path();
            let rel = p.strip_prefix(workspace).unwrap_or(p).to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
            if rel.starts_with(".rrxgit/") || rel.starts_with(".rrx/") || rel.starts_with("artifacts/") {
                continue;
            }
            let content = std::fs::read(p).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let hash = rrx_util::to_hex(&keccak256(&content));
            std::fs::write(self.dir.join("objects").join(&hash), &content).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            index.insert(rel, hash);
        }
        let n = index.len();
        self.write_json(Path::new("index"), &serde_json::to_value(&index).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?)?;
        Ok(n)
    }

    /// Commit the staged index. Returns the commit hash.
    pub fn commit(&self, message: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
        let idx_val = self.read_json(Path::new("index")).ok_or("nothing staged — run add first")?;
        let index: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String> =
            serde_json::from_value(idx_val).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let parent = self.head().unwrap_or_default();
        let time = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .map(|d| d.as_secs())
            .unwrap_or(0);
        let commit = serde_json::json!({
            "message": message,
            "time": time,
            "parent": parent,
            "tree": index,
        });
        let body = serde_json::to_string(&commit).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let hash = rrx_util::to_hex(&keccak256(body.as_bytes()));
        std::fs::write(self.dir.join("objects").join(&hash), body).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        self.write_json(Path::new("refs/head"), &serde_json::Value::String(hash.clone()))?;
        Ok(hash)
    }

    pub fn head(&self) -> Option<String> {
        self.read_json(Path::new("refs/head")).and_then(|v| v.as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()))
    }

    /// Changed / new / deleted files vs HEAD.
    pub fn status(&self, workspace: &Path) -> Result<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>, Vec<String>), String> {
        let head_tree: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String> = self
            .head()
            .and_then(|h| {
                let body: serde_json::Value =
                    serde_json::from_str(&std::fs::read_to_string(self.dir.join("objects").join(&h)).ok()?).ok()?;
                let tree = body.get("tree")?;
                serde_json::from_value(tree.clone()).ok()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default();


        let mut modified = vec![];
        let mut added = vec![];
        let mut deleted: Vec<String> = head_tree.keys().cloned().collect();
        for entry in walkdir::WalkDir::new(workspace)
            .into_iter()
            .filter_map(|e| e.ok())
            .filter(|e| e.file_type().is_file())
        {
            let p = entry.path();
            let rel = p.strip_prefix(workspace).unwrap_or(p).to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/");
            if rel.starts_with(".rrxgit/") || rel.starts_with(".rrx/") || rel.starts_with("artifacts/") {
                continue;
            }
            deleted.retain(|d| d != &rel);
            let content = std::fs::read(p).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let hash = rrx_util::to_hex(&keccak256(&content));
            match head_tree.get(&rel) {
                Some(h) if h == &hash => {}
                Some(_) => modified.push(rel),
                None => added.push(rel),
            }
        }
        Ok((modified, added, deleted))
    }

    /// One line per commit (newest first).
    pub fn log(&self) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
        let mut out = vec![];
        let mut cur = self.head();
        let mut guard = 0;
        while let Some(h) = cur {
            guard += 1;
            if guard > 1000 {
                break;
            }
            let body: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(
                &std::fs::read_to_string(self.dir.join("objects").join(&h)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let msg = body["message"].as_str().unwrap_or("?");
            let time = body["time"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0);
            out.push(format!("{h} {} — {}", time, msg));
            cur = body["parent"].as_str().map(|s| s.to_string()).filter(|s| !s.is_empty());
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Live mainnet status tools: connectivity matrix, chain dashboard,
//! transaction / block / account lookups and call-tree traces.
//!
//! These are the "har link main chain se connected" reports — everything
//! is fetched live from real Ethereum mainnet JSON-RPC endpoints.

use crate::deploy;
use rrx_rpc::endpoints::{probe_all, MAINNET_ENDPOINTS, MAINNET_CHAIN_ID};
use rrx_rpc::Provider;
use rrx_util::{h256_from_hex, h160_from_hex, u256_from_str, wei_to_strings, H256, U256};
use serde_json::Value;

fn gwei(v: &U256) -> String {
    let whole = *v / U256::from(1_000_000_000u64);
    let rem = *v % U256::from(1_000_000_000u64);
    let frac = format!("{:09}", rem.as_u64().max(0)).trim_end_matches('0').to_string();
    if frac.is_empty() { format!("{} gwei", whole) } else { format!("{}.{} gwei", whole, frac) }
}

fn gwei_u(v: &U256) -> String {
    gwei(v)
}

fn qty(v: &Value, key: &str) -> Option<U256> {
    v.get(key).and_then(|x| x.as_str()).and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok())
}

fn qty_u64(v: &Value, key: &str) -> Option<u64> {
    qty(v, key).map(|x| x.as_u64())
}

fn fmt_u64(n: u64) -> String {
    let s = n.to_string();
    let mut out = String::new();
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    for (i, c) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
        if i > 0 && (bytes.len() - i) % 3 == 0 {
            out.push(',');
        }
        out.push(*c as char);
    }
    out
}

/// Days-from-civil algorithm (Hinnant): unix seconds → "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS UTC".
pub fn utc_string(epoch: u64) -> String {
    let days = epoch / 86_400;
    let secs = epoch % 86_400;
    let z = days as i64 + 719_468;
    let era = z / 146_097;
    let doe = z - era * 146_097;
    let yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36_524 - doe / 146_096) / 365;
    let y = yoe + era * 400;
    let doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    let mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    let d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1;
    let m = if mp < 10 { mp + 3 } else { mp - 9 };
    let y = if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y };
    format!(
        "{y:04}-{m:02}-{d:02} {:02}:{:02}:{:02} UTC",
        secs / 3600,
        (secs % 3600) / 60,
        secs % 60
    )
}

/// Connectivity matrix over every built-in mainnet endpoint.
pub fn net_table() -> String {
    let statuses = probe_all();
    let mut out = String::from("mainnet endpoints (probed live):\n");
    let mut first_ok = None;
    for st in &statuses {
        let mark = if st.ok { "up  " } else { "DOWN" };
        let info = if st.ok {
            first_ok = first_ok.or(Some(st.url.clone()));
            format!(
                "chain {}  block {}  {} ms  {}",
                st.chain_id.map(|c| c.to_string()).unwrap_or("?".into()),
                st.block.map(fmt_u64).unwrap_or_else(|| "?".into()),
                st.latency_ms,
                st.client.clone().unwrap_or_default()
            )
        } else {
            st.error.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| "unreachable".into())
        };
        out.push_str(&format!("  [{mark}] {:<40} {}\n", st.url, info));
    }
    match first_ok {
        Some(u) => out.push_str(&format!("\nselected endpoint: {u}\nfailover order: {}\n", MAINNET_ENDPOINTS.join(" → "))),
        None => out.push_str("\nno endpoint healthy — check internet connection\n"),
    }
    out
}

/// One-screen live chain dashboard.
pub fn chain_dashboard(p: &Provider) -> Result<String, String> {
    let chain_id = p.chain_id()?;
    let client = p.client_version().unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".into());
    let latest = p.block_number()?;
    let block = p.block_by_tag("latest", false)?.ok_or("latest block not found")?;
    let ts = qty_u64(&block, "timestamp").unwrap_or(0);
    let age = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_secs().saturating_sub(ts))
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let base_fee = qty(&block, "baseFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default();
    let gas_price = p.gas_price()?;
    let (base_hist, rewards) = p.fee_history(20)?;
    let base_next = base_hist.last().cloned().unwrap_or(base_fee);
    let pick = |i: usize| -> U256 {
        rewards
            .get(rewards.len() / 2)
            .and_then(|row| row.get(i).copied())
            .unwrap_or_default()
    };
    let mut out = String::new();
    let name = match chain_id {
        1 => "Ethereum Mainnet",
        11155111 => "Sepolia",
        84532 => "Base Sepolia",
        8453 => "Base",
        137 => "Polygon",
        42161 => "Arbitrum One",
        10 => "Optimism",
        _ => "unknown network",
    };
    out.push_str(&format!("network        chain {chain_id} — {name}\n"));
    out.push_str(&format!("endpoint       {}\n", p.url));
    out.push_str(&format!("client         {client}\n"));
    out.push_str(&format!("latest block   {}  (age {age}s)\n", fmt_u64(latest)));
    out.push_str(&format!("base fee       {}   next block ~{}\n", gwei(&base_fee), gwei_u(&base_next)));
    out.push_str(&format!("gas price      {}\n", gwei(&gas_price)));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "priority fees  slow {} | standard {} | fast {}\n",
        gwei_u(&pick(0)),
        gwei_u(&pick(1)),
        gwei_u(&pick(2))
    ));
    let (_g, eth) = wei_to_strings(&(U256::from(21_000u64) * gas_price));
    out.push_str(&format!("transfer cost  21000 gas ≈ {eth} ETH\n"));
    let _ = MAINNET_CHAIN_ID;
    Ok(out)
}

fn tx_type_name(v: &Value) -> String {
    match v.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) {
        Some("0x0") => "legacy".into(),
        Some("0x1") => "EIP-2930".into(),
        Some("0x2") => "EIP-1559".into(),
        Some("0x3") => "EIP-4844 blob".into(),
        Some(t) => format!("type {t}"),
        None => "legacy".into(),
    }
}

/// Live transaction + receipt report.
pub fn tx_report(p: &Provider, hash_str: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let hash: H256 = h256_from_hex(hash_str)?;
    let tx = p.get_transaction(&hash)?.ok_or("transaction not found (pending or unknown)")?;
    let receipt = p.transaction_receipt(&hash)?;
    let mut out = String::from(&format!("tx {}\n", tx.get("hash").and_then(|h| h.as_str()).unwrap_or(hash_str)));
    out.push_str(&format!("  type      {}\n", tx_type_name(&tx)));
    out.push_str(&format!("  from      {}\n", tx.get("from").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("?")));
    let to = tx.get("to").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  to        {}\n",
        if to.is_empty() { "(contract creation)".to_string() } else { to.to_string() }
    ));
    if let Some(val) = qty(&tx, "value") {
        let (_g, eth) = wei_to_strings(&val);
        out.push_str(&format!("  value     {eth} ETH\n"));
    }
    if let Some(r) = &receipt {
        let status = r.get("status").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0x0");
        let block = qty_u64(r, "blockNumber").unwrap_or(0);
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "  status    {} (block {})\n",
            if status == "0x1" { "SUCCESS" } else { "REVERTED" },
            fmt_u64(block)
        ));
        let used = qty(r, "gasUsed").unwrap_or_default();
        let effective = qty(r, "effectiveGasPrice").unwrap_or_default();
        let fee = used * effective;
        let (_g, fee_eth) = wei_to_strings(&fee);
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "  gas       {} used @ {}  → fee {fee_eth} ETH\n",
            fmt_u64(used.as_u64()),
            gwei(&effective)
        ));
        let logs = r.get("logs").and_then(|l| l.as_array()).map(|a| a.len()).unwrap_or(0);
        out.push_str(&format!("  logs      {logs}\n"));
    } else {
        out.push_str("  status    pending (no receipt yet)\n");
        if let Some(gp) = qty(&tx, "gasPrice") {
            out.push_str(&format!("  gasPrice  {}\n", gwei(&gp)));
        }
        if let Some(mf) = qty(&tx, "maxFeePerGas") {
            out.push_str(&format!("  maxFee    {}  tip {}\n", gwei(&mf), gwei(&qty(&tx, "maxPriorityFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default())));
        }
    }
    if let Some(input) = tx.get("input").and_then(|i| i.as_str()) {
        let len = (input.len().saturating_sub(2)) / 2;
        if len >= 4 {
            out.push_str(&format!("  input     {len} bytes, selector {}\n", &input[..10]));
        } else if len > 0 {
            out.push_str(&format!("  input     {len} bytes\n"));
        }
    }
    if let Some(n) = qty_u64(&tx, "nonce") {
        out.push_str(&format!("  nonce     {n}\n"));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Live block summary ("latest", "finalized", or a decimal number).
pub fn block_report(p: &Provider, tag: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let b = p.block_by_tag(tag, false)?.ok_or_else(|| format!("block '{tag}' not found"))?;
    let number = qty_u64(&b, "number").unwrap_or(0);
    let ts = qty_u64(&b, "timestamp").unwrap_or(0);
    let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .map(|d| d.as_secs())
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let gas_used = qty_u64(&b, "gasUsed").unwrap_or(0);
    let gas_limit = qty_u64(&b, "gasLimit").unwrap_or(1);
    let base = qty(&b, "baseFeePerGas").unwrap_or_default();
    let txs = b.get("transactions").and_then(|t| t.as_array()).map(|a| a.len()).unwrap_or(0);
    let mut out = String::from(&format!(
        "block {} ({})\n",
        fmt_u64(number),
        if tag.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) { "by number" } else { tag }
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("  hash        {}\n", b.get("hash").and_then(|h| h.as_str()).unwrap_or("?")));
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  time        {}  (age {}s)\n",
        utc_string(ts),
        now.saturating_sub(ts)
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("  transactions {}\n", txs));
    let pct = if gas_limit > 0 { gas_used * 100 / gas_limit } else { 0 };
    out.push_str(&format!(
        "  gas         {} / {} ({}%)\n",
        fmt_u64(gas_used),
        fmt_u64(gas_limit),
        pct
    ));
    out.push_str(&format!("  base fee    {}\n", gwei(&base)));
    out.push_str(&format!("  proposed by {}\n", b.get("miner").and_then(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("?")));
    Ok(out)
}

/// Live account report: balance, nonce, code.
pub fn account_report(p: &Provider, addr_str: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let addr = h160_from_hex(addr_str)?;
    let block = "latest";
    let balance = p.balance(&addr, block)?;
    let nonce = p.nonce(&addr, block)?;
    let code = p.code(&addr, block)?;
    let (_g, eth) = wei_to_strings(&balance);
    let mut out = String::from(&format!("account 0x{:x}\n", addr));
    out.push_str(&format!("  balance     {eth} ETH\n"));
    out.push_str(&format!("  nonce       {nonce}\n"));
    if code.is_empty() {
        out.push_str("  code        — (EOA wallet)\n");
    } else {
        out.push_str(&format!("  code        {} bytes (smart contract)\n", code.len()));
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Live call-tree trace of a confirmed transaction (callTracer).
pub fn trace_report(p: &Provider, hash_str: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
    let hash: H256 = h256_from_hex(hash_str)?;
    let tree = match p.trace_call_tree(&hash) {
        Ok(t) => t,
        Err(e) => {
            return Err(format!(
                "this endpoint does not support debug_traceTransaction ({e}) — try another endpoint with --rpc (archive/trace nodes required)"
            ))
        }
    };
    let mut out = String::from(&format!("trace {}\n", hash_str));
    format_call(&tree, 0, &mut out, true);
    Ok(out)
}

fn format_call(node: &Value, depth: usize, out: &mut String, root: bool) {
    if depth > 6 {
        return;
    }
    let typ = node.get("type").and_then(|t| t.as_str()).unwrap_or("CALL").to_uppercase();
    let from = node.get("from").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
    let to = node.get("to").and_then(|x| x.as_str()).unwrap_or("(create)");
    let gas_used = node.get("gasUsed").and_then(|g| g.as_str()).and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok()).unwrap_or_default();
    let value = node.get("value").and_then(|g| g.as_str()).and_then(|s| u256_from_str(s).ok()).unwrap_or_default();
    let err = node.get("error").and_then(|e| e.as_str());
    let (_g, eth) = wei_to_strings(&value);
    let pad = "  ".repeat(depth);
    if root {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "{pad}{}  {} → {}\n{pad}  gasUsed {}  value {eth} ETH  {}\n",
            typ, from, to, fmt_u64(gas_used.as_u64()), err.unwrap_or("status success")
        ));
    } else {
        out.push_str(&format!(
            "{pad}├─ {} {}  gas {}  value {eth}{}\n",
            typ,
            to,
            fmt_u64(gas_used.as_u64()),
            if let Some(e) = err { format!("  ERROR: {e}") } else { String::new() }
        ));
    }
    if let Some(calls) = node.get("calls").and_then(|c| c.as_array()) {
        for (i, c) in calls.iter().take(10).enumerate() {
            let _ = i;
            format_call(c, depth + 1, out, false);
        }
        if calls.len() > 10 {
            out.push_str(&format!("{}   … {} more calls\n", "  ".repeat(depth + 1), calls.len() - 10));
        }
    }
}

/// Read-only eth_call against a real network with ABI decode.
pub fn remote_call(
    p: &Provider,
    to_str: &str,
    function: &str,
    types: &[&str],
    args: &[&str],
    out_types: &[&str],
    block: &str,
) -> Result<String, String> {
    let to = h160_from_hex(to_str)?;
    let data = deploy::encode_call(function, types, args)?;
    let raw = p.call(None, &to, &data, block)?;
    if raw.is_empty() {
        return Ok("(empty return)".into());
    }
    deploy::format_output(out_types, &raw)
}
```
