```rust
//! `mandroid` — native Android engine CLI.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use serde_json::{json, Value};

use mandroid::{api, apk::Apk, axml, key, smali, tools};

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(
    name = "mandroid",
    version,
    about = "Native Android engine: APK analysis + ADB wire protocol"
)]
struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    cmd: Cmd,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
enum Cmd {
    /// Decode the binary AndroidManifest.xml (no aapt/apktool).
    Manifest {
        apk: String,
        /// Emit the structured model as JSON instead of the raw tree.
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Summarise the APK container.
    Info {
        apk: String,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Static security analysis of an APK.
    Scan {
        apk: String,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
        /// Only report this severity or worse.
        #[arg(long, default_value = "info")]
        min_severity: String,
    },
    /// Search the DEX string pool.
    Strings {
        apk: String,
        /// Case-insensitive substring (empty lists all).
        #[arg(default_value = "")]
        needle: String,
        #[arg(long, default_value = "100")]
        limit: usize,
    },
    /// List the static-analysis rule pack.
    Rules {
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Download an APK over http(s) natively (no curl/wget).
    Download {
        url: String,
        /// Destination file or directory (default: the URL's basename).
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Disassemble an APK's DEX to smali (no apktool).
    Decompile {
        apk: String,
        /// Only classes whose smali name contains this substring.
        #[arg(long)]
        class: Option<String>,
        /// Max classes to print (default 3, or 10 when --class is given).
        #[arg(long)]
        limit: Option<usize>,
        /// Write one .smali file per class into this directory instead of printing.
        #[arg(long)]
        out: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Decode resources.arsc: app label, packages, and resolved strings.
    Resources {
        apk: String,
        /// Resolve one resource id, e.g. 0x7f110045 or decimal.
        #[arg(long)]
        query: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// List the named manifest-edit presets.
    Presets {
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Apply manifest edits to an APK, writing a new unsigned APK.
    Modify {
        apk: String,
        /// Path to write the modified, unsigned APK.
        #[arg(long)]
        out: String,
        /// Preset bundle name (see `mandroid presets`).
        #[arg(long)]
        preset: Option<String>,
        /// Compact edit spec, e.g. debuggable=true (repeatable).
        #[arg(long = "edit")]
        edit: Vec<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Sign an APK with a stable local identity.
    Sign {
        apk: String,
        /// Path to write the signed APK.
        #[arg(long)]
        out: String,
        /// Certificate common name.
        #[arg(long, default_value = "mandroid")]
        cn: String,
        /// Directory holding the signing key/cert.
        #[arg(long)]
        keystore: Option<String>,
        /// Disable the v1 (JAR) signature scheme.
        #[arg(long)]
        no_v1: bool,
        /// Disable the v2 signature scheme.
        #[arg(long)]
        no_v2: bool,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Verify an APK's v1/v2 signatures.
    Verify {
        apk: String,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Modify then sign in one step (the common case).
    Build {
        apk: String,
        /// Path to write the modified, signed APK.
        #[arg(long)]
        out: String,
        /// Preset bundle name (see `mandroid presets`).
        #[arg(long)]
        preset: Option<String>,
        /// Compact edit spec (repeatable).
        #[arg(long = "edit")]
        edit: Vec<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Run the full acquire -> analyze -> modify -> sign -> verify pipeline.
    Workflow {
        /// https URL or local path to the APK.
        source: String,
        /// Directory for intermediates and the signed APK.
        #[arg(long)]
        work_dir: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        preset: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long = "edit")]
        edit: Vec<String>,
        /// Device host[:port]; omit to stop after signing.
        #[arg(long)]
        device: Option<String>,
        /// Install the result on the device.
        #[arg(long)]
        install: bool,
        /// Launch the package after install.
        #[arg(long)]
        launch: bool,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Talk to a device's adbd over TCP (no adb binary).
    Device {
        /// Device host, host:port, [v6]:port or tcp: URL.
        target: String,
        /// Run a shell command.
        #[arg(long)]
        shell: Option<String>,
        /// Push a local file: LOCAL:REMOTE.
        #[arg(long)]
        push: Option<String>,
        /// Pull a remote file: REMOTE:LOCAL.
        #[arg(long)]
        pull: Option<String>,
        /// Install this APK on the device.
        #[arg(long)]
        install: Option<String>,
        /// Launch this package or component (com.pkg or com.pkg/.Activity).
        #[arg(long)]
        launch: Option<String>,
        /// Root policy for this invocation: auto (default, rooted when
        /// possible) | on (require root) | off (plain shell).
        #[arg(long, default_value = "auto")]
        root: String,
        /// Report (status) / re-escalate (enable) or drop (disable) root, then exit.
        #[arg(long)]
        root_action: Option<String>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Show or adjust the virtual device hardware profile (16 GB RAM / 1 TB
    /// ROM, CPU matched to the host, dual eSIM, out-of-the-box apps, account).
    Profile {
        /// Provision the account e-mail (identifier only; never a secret).
        #[arg(long)]
        set_account: Option<String>,
        /// Store an alternate/recovery e-mail alongside the account.
        #[arg(long)]
        set_alt_account: Option<String>,
        /// Remove the provisioned account identifiers.
        #[arg(long)]
        clear_account: bool,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Manage the SIM roster: many ready eSIM profiles across 12+ countries.
    Sim {
        /// list (default) | scan | configure | activate | deactivate.
        #[arg(default_value = "list")]
        action: String,
        /// Country filter for configure ('US', 'Pakistan', ...) or profile id
        /// for activate.
        #[arg(long)]
        country: Option<String>,
        /// Carrier filter for configure (e.g. 'jazz').
        #[arg(long)]
        carrier: Option<String>,
        /// Slot for configure/activate/deactivate (1 or 2).
        #[arg(long)]
        slot: Option<u32>,
        /// Profile id for activate (e.g. pk-jazz).
        #[arg(long)]
        id: Option<String>,
        /// Per-probe budget in ms for scan/configure.
        #[arg(long, default_value = "2500")]
        timeout_ms: u64,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Show or adjust a device's screen: resolution + density, and capture it.
    Screen {
        /// Device host, host:port, [v6]:port or tcp: URL.
        #[arg(long)]
        target: String,
        /// get (default) | set | reset.
        #[arg(long, default_value = "get")]
        action: String,
        /// Width in px (action=set).
        #[arg(long)]
        width: Option<u32>,
        /// Height in px (action=set).
        #[arg(long)]
        height: Option<u32>,
        /// Density in dpi (action=set).
        #[arg(long)]
        density: Option<u32>,
        /// Capture a screenshot to this .png path.
        #[arg(long)]
        screenshot: Option<String>,
        /// Screenshot scale in (0,1].
        #[arg(long)]
        scale: Option<f32>,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Show or generate the ADB public key (the private key is never printed).
    AdbKey {
        /// Key directory (default ~/.android).
        #[arg(long)]
        dir: Option<String>,
        /// Generate a fresh key, overwriting any existing one.
        #[arg(long)]
        generate: bool,
        #[arg(long)]
        json: bool,
    },
    /// Engine status: version, tool roster, rule pack.
    Status,
    /// Invoke one tool by id, JSON args on stdin. Same contract as burp-rs and
    /// roma-327, so the agent bridge is uniform across engines.
    Call {
        /// Tool id, e.g. android_scan.
        tool: String,
    },
}

fn main() -> Result<()> {
    // Unix pipelines close early (`mandroid --help | head`); restore the
    // default SIGPIPE disposition so that is a clean exit, not a panic.
    #[cfg(unix)]
    unsafe {
        libc::signal(libc::SIGPIPE, libc::SIG_DFL);
    }
    let cli = Cli::parse();
    match cli.cmd {
        Cmd::Manifest { apk, json } => {
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&api::manifest(&apk)?)?);
            } else {
                let mut a = Apk::open(&apk)?;
                print_tree(&a.manifest()?, 0);
            }
        }
        Cmd::Info { apk, json } => {
            let v = api::info(&apk)?;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            } else {
                println!("apk:        {apk}");
                println!("entries:    {}", v["entries"]);
                println!("package:    {}", v["package"]);
                println!(
                    "minSdk:     {}  targetSdk: {}",
                    v["min_sdk"], v["target_sdk"]
                );
                println!("components: {}", v["components"]);
                println!("abis:       {}", v["abis"]);
                let dex: Vec<String> = v["dex"]
                    .as_array()
                    .map(|a| {
                        a.iter()
                            .map(|d| d["file"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string())
                            .collect()
                    })
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                println!("dex:        {}", dex.join(", "));
            }
        }
        Cmd::Scan {
            apk,
            json,
            min_severity,
        } => {
            let v = api::scan(&apk, &min_severity)?;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            } else {
                println!("{}  ({apk})", v["package"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"));
                println!(
                    "  minSdk={} targetSdk={}  components={}",
                    v["min_sdk"],
                    v["target_sdk"],
                    v["components"].as_array().map(|a| a.len()).unwrap_or(0)
                );
                let c = &v["counts"];
                println!(
                    "  {} finding(s): {} critical, {} high, {} medium, {} low\n",
                    c["total"], c["critical"], c["high"], c["medium"], c["low"]
                );
                for f in v["findings"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    println!(
                        "  [{}] {} ({})",
                        f["severity"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_uppercase(),
                        f["title"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        f["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                    );
                    println!("      subject:  {}", f["subject"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                    if let Some(cwe) = f["cwe"].as_str() {
                        println!("      cwe:      {cwe}");
                    }
                    println!("      evidence: {}", f["evidence"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Strings { apk, needle, limit } => {
            let v = api::strings(&apk, &needle, limit)?;
            println!(
                "{} strings total, {} matched, showing {}",
                v["total_strings"], v["matched"], v["returned"]
            );
            for s in v["strings"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                println!("  {}", s.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            }
            for p in v["secret_patterns_hit"]
                .as_array()
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_default()
            {
                println!(
                    "  ! secret pattern matched: {} ({})",
                    p["title"], p["severity"]
                );
            }
        }
        Cmd::Rules { json } => {
            let v = api::rules()?;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            } else {
                println!(
                    "rules v{} — {} rules, {} secret patterns",
                    v["version"], v["rule_count"], v["secret_pattern_count"]
                );
                for r in v["rules"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    println!(
                        "  [{:>8}] {} ({})",
                        r["severity"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        r["title"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        r["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Download { url, out, json } => {
            let mut args = json!({ "url": url });
            if let Some(out) = out {
                args["dest"] = json!(out);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_download", args)?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                println!("downloaded {}", v["path"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"));
                println!("  final url: {}", v["final_url"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("  bytes:     {}", v["bytes"]);
                println!("  sha256:    {}", v["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("  content:   {}", v["content_type"].as_str().unwrap_or("-"));
                println!("  apk/zip:   {}", v["looks_like_apk"]);
            }
        }
        Cmd::Decompile {
            apk,
            class,
            limit,
            out,
            json,
        } => {
            if let Some(dir) = out {
                let classes =
                    smali::disassemble_apk(&apk).with_context(|| format!("disassembling {apk}"))?;
                let needle = class.as_deref().map(str::to_ascii_lowercase);
                let selected: Vec<&smali::SmaliClass> = classes
                    .iter()
                    .filter(|c| match &needle {
                        Some(n) => c.name.to_ascii_lowercase().contains(n),
                        None => true,
                    })
                    .collect();
                std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).with_context(|| format!("creating {dir}"))?;
                for c in &selected {
                    let file = Path::new(&dir).join(format!("{}.smali", c.name.replace('/', ".")));
                    std::fs::write(&file, &c.source)
                        .with_context(|| format!("writing {}", file.display()))?;
                }
                println!(
                    "{} classes total, wrote {} smali file(s) to {dir}",
                    classes.len(),
                    selected.len()
                );
            } else {
                let mut args = json!({ "apk": apk });
                if let Some(class) = class {
                    args["class"] = json!(class);
                }
                if let Some(limit) = limit {
                    args["limit"] = json!(limit);
                }
                let v = invoke("android_decompile", args)?;
                if json {
                    print_json(&v)?;
                } else {
                    println!(
                        "{} classes, {} lines total; {} match; showing {}",
                        v["total_classes"],
                        v["total_lines"],
                        v["matched_classes"],
                        v["returned_classes"]
                    );
                    for c in v["classes"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                        println!(
                            "\n// ---- {} ({} lines) ----",
                            c["class"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                            c["lines"]
                        );
                        println!("{}", c["smali"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                    }
                    if let Some(note) = v["note"].as_str() {
                        println!("\n{note}");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Resources { apk, query, json } => {
            let mut args = json!({ "apk": apk });
            if let Some(query) = query {
                args["query"] = json!(query);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_resources", args)?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else if v["query"].is_string() {
                println!(
                    "app label: {}",
                    v["app_label"].as_str().unwrap_or("(unresolved)")
                );
                println!(
                    "{} -> {}",
                    v["resource_id"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    if v["found"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false) {
                        v["value"].as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string()
                    } else {
                        "(not found)".to_string()
                    }
                );
            } else {
                println!(
                    "app label:    {}",
                    v["app_label"].as_str().unwrap_or("(unresolved)")
                );
                println!("packages:     {}", v["package_count"]);
                println!("entries:      {}", v["entry_count"]);
                for p in v["packages"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    println!(
                        "  package {} ({})",
                        p["name"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        p["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                    );
                    for t in p["types"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                        println!(
                            "    {:<14} #{:<3} {} entries in {} config(s)",
                            t["type"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                            t["id"],
                            t["entries"],
                            t["configs"]
                        );
                    }
                }
                let samples = v["sample_values"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
                println!(
                    "\n{} of {} resolvable value(s):",
                    v["sample_values_returned"], v["sample_values_total"]
                );
                for sv in samples {
                    println!(
                        "  {} {} {} = {}",
                        sv["id"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        sv["type"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        sv["key"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        sv["value"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Presets { json } => {
            let v = invoke("android_presets", json!({}))?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                for p in v["presets"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    println!(
                        "{}  ({} edit{})",
                        p["name"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        p["edit_count"],
                        if p["edit_count"] == 1 { "" } else { "s" }
                    );
                    println!("    {}", p["description"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                    for e in p["edits"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                        println!("      - {}", e.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Modify {
            apk,
            out,
            preset,
            edit,
            json,
        } => {
            let v = invoke("android_modify", edit_args(apk, out, preset, edit))?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                print_changes(&v);
                println!("unsigned APK: {}", v["out"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("bytes:        {}", v["bytes"]);
            }
        }
        Cmd::Sign {
            apk,
            out,
            cn,
            keystore,
            no_v1,
            no_v2,
            json,
        } => {
            let mut args = json!({
                "apk": apk,
                "out": out,
                "cn": cn,
                "v1": !no_v1,
                "v2": !no_v2,
            });
            if let Some(keystore) = keystore {
                args["keystore_dir"] = json!(keystore);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_sign", args)?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                println!("signed {}", v["out"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("  signer:    {}", v["signer"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("  v1: {}  v2: {}", v["v1"], v["v2"]);
                println!("  keystore:  {}", v["keystore_dir"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!(
                    "  entries:   {}  (removed {} old signature files)",
                    v["entries"], v["removed_signatures"]
                );
                println!("  bytes:     {}", v["bytes"]);
                println!("  sha256:    {}", v["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            }
        }
        Cmd::Verify { apk, json } => {
            let v = invoke("android_verify", json!({ "apk": apk }))?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                println!(
                    "{}: {}",
                    v["apk"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                    v["verdict"].as_str().unwrap_or("?")
                );
                println!(
                    "  v1: present={} signed_entries={}",
                    v["v1"]["present"], v["v1"]["signed_entries"]
                );
                println!(
                    "  v2: present={} signers={} algorithm={}",
                    v["v2"]["present"], v["v2"]["signers"], v["v2"]["algorithm"]
                );
                println!(
                    "      digest_ok={} signature_ok={}",
                    v["v2"]["digest_ok"], v["v2"]["signature_ok"]
                );
                if let Some(sha) = v["v2"]["certificate_sha256"].as_str() {
                    println!("      cert sha256: {sha}");
                }
                for e in v["v2"]["errors"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    println!("      error: {}", e.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Build {
            apk,
            out,
            preset,
            edit,
            json,
        } => {
            let v = invoke("android_build", edit_args(apk, out, preset, edit))?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                print_changes(&v);
                println!(
                    "built {}  (valid={})",
                    v["out"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                    v["valid"]
                );
                println!("  signer: {}", v["signer"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("  bytes:  {}", v["bytes"]);
                println!("  sha256: {}", v["sha256"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            }
        }
        Cmd::Workflow {
            source,
            work_dir,
            preset,
            edit,
            device,
            install,
            launch,
            json,
        } => {
            let mut args = json!({ "source": source });
            if let Some(dir) = work_dir {
                args["work_dir"] = json!(dir);
            }
            if let Some(preset) = preset {
                args["preset"] = json!(preset);
            }
            if !edit.is_empty() {
                args["edits"] = json!(edit);
            }
            if let Some(device) = device {
                args["device"] = json!(device);
            }
            if install {
                args["install"] = json!(true);
            }
            if launch {
                args["launch"] = json!(true);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_workflow", args)?;
            if json {
                print_json(&v)?;
            } else {
                print!("{}", v["rendered"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                println!("signed APK: {}", v["apk"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
                if !v["succeeded"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false) {
                    anyhow::bail!("workflow did not complete successfully");
                }
            }
        }
        Cmd::Device {
            target,
            shell,
            push,
            pull,
            install,
            launch,
            root,
            root_action,
            json,
        } => {
            if let Some(action) = root_action {
                let v = invoke(
                    "android_adb_root",
                    json!({ "device": target, "action": action, "root": root }),
                )?;
                if json {
                    print_json(&v)?;
                } else {
                    let r = &v["root"];
                    println!(
                        "root: {} (uid {}) — {}",
                        r["status"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                        r["uid"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                        r["note"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                    );
                }
                return Ok(());
            }
            device_command(&target, shell, push, pull, install, launch, &root, json)?;
        }
        Cmd::Profile {
            set_account,
            set_alt_account,
            clear_account,
            json,
        } => {
            let mut args = json!({});
            if let Some(a) = &set_account {
                args["set_account"] = json!(a);
            }
            if let Some(a) = &set_alt_account {
                args["set_alt_account"] = json!(a);
            }
            if clear_account {
                args["clear_account"] = json!(true);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_device_profile", args)?;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            } else {
                let acct = &v["account"];
                println!("device profile: {}", v["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"));
                println!(
                    "  ram:     {} ({})",
                    v["ram"]["spec"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["ram"]["gb"],
                );
                println!(
                    "  rom:     {} ({} GiB usable)",
                    v["rom"]["spec"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["rom"]["gib"],
                );
                println!(
                    "  cpu:     {} core(s), {} ({})",
                    v["cpu"]["cores"],
                    v["cpu"]["arch"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["cpu"]["soc"].as_str().unwrap_or("?")
                );
                println!(
                    "  serial:  {}  IMEI {} / {}",
                    v["identifiers"]["serial"], v["identifiers"]["imei"], v["identifiers"]["imei2"]
                );
                println!(
                    "  eid:     {}  baseband {}",
                    v["identifiers"]["eid"], v["identifiers"]["baseband"]
                );
                println!(
                    "  screen:  {} @ {}dpi (resizable)",
                    v["screen"]["geometry"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    v["screen"]["density"]
                );
                println!(
                    "  esim:    dual eSIM, {} slots, {} profile(s) registered, {} catalog profiles",
                    v["esim"]["slot_count"],
                    v["esim"]["profiles_registered"],
                    v["esim"]["profile_catalog"]
                );
                let s1 = &v["esim"]["slots"][0];
                let s2 = &v["esim"]["slots"][1];
                let slot_line = |s: &Value| {
                    if s["state"] == "enabled" {
                        let p = &s["profile"];
                        format!(
                            "{} ({}, ICCID {}, line {})",
                            p["carrier"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                            p["state"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                            p["iccid"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                            p["msisdn"].as_str().unwrap_or("?")
                        )
                    } else {
                        "(empty)".to_string()
                    }
                };
                println!("  sim 1:   {}", slot_line(s1));
                println!("  sim 2:   {}", slot_line(s2));
                println!(
                    "  apps:    {} preinstalled (like new phone, incl. Play Store)",
                    v["apps"]["count"]
                );
                let email = acct["email"].as_str().unwrap_or("(none)");
                let alt = acct["alternate_email"].as_str().unwrap_or("(none)");
                println!("  account: {email} (alt: {alt}) — identifiers only, password via MANDROID_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD");
            }
        }
        Cmd::Sim {
            action,
            country,
            carrier,
            slot,
            id,
            timeout_ms,
            json,
        } => {
            let mut args = json!({ "action": action, "timeout_ms": timeout_ms });
            if let Some(c) = &country {
                args["country"] = json!(c);
            }
            if let Some(c) = &carrier {
                args["carrier"] = json!(c);
            }
            if let Some(s) = slot {
                args["slot"] = json!(s);
            }
            if let Some(i) = &id {
                args["id"] = json!(i);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_sim", args)?;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            } else if v["sims"].is_array() {
                // list view
                let s1 = &v["slots"]["slot1"];
                let s2 = &v["slots"]["slot2"];
                let name = |s: &Value| {
                    if s["state"] == "enabled" {
                        format!(
                            "{} ({})",
                            s["profile"]["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                            s["profile"]["carrier"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                        )
                    } else {
                        "(empty)".into()
                    }
                };
                println!(
                    "SIM roster: {} profiles, {} countries (dual eSIM)",
                    v["catalog_size"], v["countries"]
                );
                println!("  slot 1: {}", name(s1));
                println!("  slot 2: {}", name(s2));
                for s in v["sims"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    let slot_mark = if s["slot"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) > 0 {
                        format!(" [slot {}]", s["slot"])
                    } else {
                        String::new()
                    };
                    println!(
                        "  {:<18} {:<18} {:<3} {}{}",
                        s["id"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        s["carrier"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        s["country"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        s["plmn"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        slot_mark
                    );
                }
            } else if v["scan"]["results"].is_array() {
                // configure view
                let c = &v["configured"];
                println!(
                    "configured slot {} -> {} ({}) @ {}ms",
                    c["slot"],
                    c["profile"]["id"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    c["profile"]["carrier"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                    c["latency_ms"]
                );
                if v["second_slot"]["profile"]["id"].is_string() {
                    println!(
                        "configured slot 2 -> {} ({})",
                        v["second_slot"]["profile"]["id"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                        v["second_slot"]["profile"]["carrier"]
                            .as_str()
                            .unwrap_or("")
                    );
                }
                println!(
                    "scan: {} online / {} probed",
                    v["scan"]["online"], v["scan"]["probed"]
                );
            } else if v["results"].is_array() {
                // scan view
                println!(
                    "scan: {} online / {} probed (fastest: {})\n",
                    v["online"],
                    v["probed"],
                    v["fastest_online"].as_str().unwrap_or("-")
                );
                for r in v["results"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default() {
                    if r["online"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false) {
                        println!(
                            "  [online  {:>4}ms] {:<18} {:<18} {}",
                            r["latency_ms"],
                            r["id"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                            r["carrier"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                            r["country"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                        );
                    } else {
                        println!(
                            "  [offline      ] {:<18} {:<18} {}",
                            r["id"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                            r["carrier"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                            r["country"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                        );
                    }
                }
            } else {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            }
        }
        Cmd::Screen {
            target,
            action,
            width,
            height,
            density,
            screenshot,
            scale,
            json,
        } => {
            if let Some(out) = screenshot {
                let mut args = json!({ "device": target, "out": out });
                if let Some(s) = scale {
                    args["scale"] = json!(s);
                }
                let v = invoke("android_screenshot", args)?;
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
                return Ok(());
            }
            let mut args = json!({ "device": target, "action": action });
            if let Some(w) = width {
                args["width"] = json!(w);
            }
            if let Some(h) = height {
                args["height"] = json!(h);
            }
            if let Some(d) = density {
                args["density"] = json!(d);
            }
            let v = invoke("android_screen", args)?;
            if json {
                println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v)?);
            } else {
                println!("screen: {:?} @ {}dpi", v["geometry"], v["density"]);
                let r = &v["root"];
                println!(
                    "root: {} ({})",
                    r["status"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                    r["note"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                );
            }
        }
        Cmd::AdbKey {
            dir,
            generate,
            json,
        } => {
            let dir = dir.map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or_else(key::default_dir);
            let adb = if generate {
                key::generate_at(&dir)?
            } else {
                key::load_or_generate(&dir)?
            };
            // Public material only — the private key is never rendered.
            let public_text = adb.public_text()?;
            if json {
                print_json(&json!({
                    "private_key": adb.private_path.display().to_string(),
                    "public_key": adb.public_path.display().to_string(),
                    "public_key_text": public_text,
                }))?;
            } else {
                println!("private key: {}", adb.private_path.display());
                println!("public key:  {}", adb.public_path.display());
                println!("public key text (add to the device's adb_keys):");
                println!("{public_text}");
            }
        }
        Cmd::Status => {
            println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(&tools::status())?);
        }
        Cmd::Call { tool } => {
            let mut input = String::new();
            std::io::Read::read_to_string(&mut std::io::stdin(), &mut input)?;
            let args: Value = if input.trim().is_empty() {
                json!({})
            } else {
                serde_json::from_str(&input)?
            };
            match tools::call(&tool, &args) {
                Ok(v) => println!(
                    "{}",
                    serde_json::to_string(&json!({"ok": true, "result": v}))?
                ),
                Err(e) => {
                    println!(
                        "{}",
                        serde_json::to_string(&json!({"ok": false, "error": e}))?
                    );
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Call one native tool and surface its error as an `anyhow` error.
fn invoke(tool: &str, args: Value) -> Result<Value> {
    tools::call(tool, &args).map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!(e))
}

fn print_json(v: &Value) -> Result<()> {
    println!("{}", serde_json::to_string_pretty(v)?);
    Ok(())
}

/// Build the shared `{apk, out, preset, edits}` argument object.
fn edit_args(apk: String, out: String, preset: Option<String>, edit: Vec<String>) -> Value {
    let mut args = json!({ "apk": apk, "out": out });
    if let Some(preset) = preset {
        args["preset"] = json!(preset);
    }
    if !edit.is_empty() {
        args["edits"] = json!(edit);
    }
    args
}

fn print_changes(v: &Value) {
    let changes = v["changes"].as_array().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
    println!("{} change(s):", changes.len());
    for c in changes {
        println!("  - {}", c.as_str().unwrap_or(""));
    }
}

/// `mandroid device` — info by default, or the requested actions in order.
#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
fn device_command(
    target: &str,
    shell: Option<String>,
    push: Option<String>,
    pull: Option<String>,
    install: Option<String>,
    launch: Option<String>,
    root: &str,
    json: bool,
) -> Result<()> {
    let mut acted = false;

    if let Some(command) = shell {
        acted = true;
        let v = invoke(
            "android_adb_shell",
            json!({ "device": target, "command": command, "root": root }),
        )?;
        if json {
            print_json(&v)?;
        } else {
            print!("{}", v["output"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            if !v["output"].as_str().unwrap_or("").ends_with('\n') {
                println!();
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(spec) = push {
        acted = true;
        let (local, remote) = split_pair(&spec, "LOCAL:REMOTE")?;
        let v = invoke(
            "android_adb_push",
            json!({ "device": target, "local": local, "remote": remote, "root": root }),
        )?;
        if json {
            print_json(&v)?;
        } else {
            println!("pushed {local} -> {remote} ({} bytes)", v["bytes"]);
        }
    }
    if let Some(spec) = pull {
        acted = true;
        let (remote, local) = split_pair(&spec, "REMOTE:LOCAL")?;
        let v = invoke(
            "android_adb_pull",
            json!({ "device": target, "remote": remote, "local": local, "root": root }),
        )?;
        if json {
            print_json(&v)?;
        } else {
            println!("pulled {remote} -> {local} ({} bytes)", v["bytes"]);
        }
    }
    if let Some(apk) = install {
        acted = true;
        let v = invoke(
            "android_install",
            json!({ "device": target, "apk": apk, "root": root }),
        )?;
        if json {
            print_json(&v)?;
        } else {
            println!(
                "install {}: {} on {} (sdk {})",
                if v["success"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false) {
                    "ok"
                } else {
                    "FAILED"
                },
                v["apk"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                v["model"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
                v["sdk"]
            );
            let out = v["output"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
            if !out.is_empty() {
                println!("{out}");
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(component) = launch {
        acted = true;
        let v = invoke(
            "android_launch",
            json!({ "device": target, "component": component, "root": root }),
        )?;
        if json {
            print_json(&v)?;
        } else {
            println!("launched {}", v["component"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            let out = v["output"].as_str().unwrap_or("");
            if !out.is_empty() {
                println!("{out}");
            }
        }
    }

    if !acted {
        let v = invoke("android_device_info", json!({ "device": target }))?;
        if json {
            print_json(&v)?;
        } else {
            println!("device:   {}", v["device"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            println!("model:    {}", v["model"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            println!("sdk:      {}", v["sdk"]);
            println!("banner:   {}", v["banner"].as_str().unwrap_or(""));
            let features: Vec<String> = v["features"]
                .as_array()
                .map(|a| {
                    a.iter()
                        .map(|f| f.as_str().unwrap_or("").to_string())
                        .collect()
                })
                .unwrap_or_default();
            println!("features: {}", features.join(", "));
            println!("getprop ({} properties):", v["getprop_count"]);
            for p in v["getprop_highlights"]
                .as_array()
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_default()
            {
                println!(
                    "  {:<34} {}",
                    p["key"].as_str().unwrap_or(""),
                    p["value"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
                );
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

/// Split `LEFT:RIGHT`, rejecting a missing half.
fn split_pair(spec: &str, what: &str) -> Result<(String, String)> {
    let (a, b) = spec
        .split_once(':')
        .filter(|(a, b)| !a.is_empty() && !b.is_empty())
        .with_context(|| format!("expected {what}, got {spec:?}"))?;
    Ok((a.to_string(), b.to_string()))
}

fn print_tree(n: &axml::Node, depth: usize) {
    let pad = "  ".repeat(depth);
    let attrs: Vec<String> = n
        .attrs
        .iter()
        .map(|a| format!("{}={:?}", a.name, a.value.display()))
        .collect();
    if attrs.is_empty() {
        println!("{pad}<{}>", n.name);
    } else {
        println!("{pad}<{} {}>", n.name, attrs.join(" "));
    }
    for c in &n.children {
        print_tree(c, depth + 1);
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Typed AndroidManifest model.
//!
//! Turns the decoded AXML tree into the things a security review actually asks
//! about: which components exist, which are reachable by other apps, and what
//! the application-level flags allow.

use serde::Serialize;

use crate::axml::Node;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Default)]
pub struct Application {
    pub label: Option<String>,
    /// `android:debuggable="true"` — ships a debuggable production build.
    pub debuggable: bool,
    /// `android:allowBackup` (default true unless explicitly false).
    pub allow_backup: Option<bool>,
    /// `android:usesCleartextTraffic`.
    pub uses_cleartext_traffic: Option<bool>,
    /// `android:networkSecurityConfig` — the modern way to scope cleartext.
    pub network_security_config: Option<String>,
    pub request_legacy_external_storage: Option<bool>,
    pub extract_native_libs: Option<bool>,
    pub name: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize)]
pub struct Component {
    /// activity | activity-alias | service | receiver | provider
    pub kind: String,
    pub name: String,
    /// The literal `android:exported` value, if declared.
    pub exported: Option<bool>,
    /// What the platform will actually do. Before API 31 an intent filter made a
    /// component implicitly exported; API 31+ requires the attribute. We report
    /// both so the finding can distinguish "declared" from "implicit".
    pub effectively_exported: bool,
    pub implicitly_exported: bool,
    pub permission: Option<String>,
    pub read_permission: Option<String>,
    pub write_permission: Option<String>,
    pub intent_filter_count: usize,
    pub authorities: Option<String>,
    pub grant_uri_permissions: Option<bool>,
}

impl Component {
    pub fn is_provider(&self) -> bool {
        self.kind == "provider"
    }
    /// A component is "guarded" when some permission gates access to it.
    pub fn has_permission_guard(&self) -> bool {
        self.permission.is_some()
            || self.read_permission.is_some()
            || self.write_permission.is_some()
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Default)]
pub struct Manifest {
    pub package: String,
    pub version_code: Option<i32>,
    pub version_name: Option<String>,
    pub min_sdk: Option<i32>,
    pub target_sdk: Option<i32>,
    pub compile_sdk: Option<i32>,
    pub permissions: Vec<String>,
    pub declared_permissions: Vec<String>,
    pub application: Application,
    pub components: Vec<Component>,
    pub has_network_security_config: bool,
}

impl Manifest {
    pub fn from_node(root: &Node) -> Manifest {
        let mut m = Manifest {
            package: root.attr_str("package").unwrap_or_default(),
            version_code: root.attr_int("versionCode"),
            version_name: root.attr_str("versionName"),
            compile_sdk: root.attr_int("compileSdkVersion"),
            ..Default::default()
        };

        let mut nodes = Vec::new();
        root.walk(&mut nodes);

        for n in &nodes {
            match n.name.as_str() {
                "uses-sdk" => {
                    m.min_sdk = n.attr_int("minSdkVersion");
                    m.target_sdk = n.attr_int("targetSdkVersion");
                }
                "uses-permission" | "uses-permission-sdk-23" => {
                    if let Some(p) = n.attr_str("name") {
                        m.permissions.push(p);
                    }
                }
                "permission" => {
                    if let Some(p) = n.attr_str("name") {
                        m.declared_permissions.push(p);
                    }
                }
                "application" => {
                    m.application = Application {
                        label: n.attr_str("label"),
                        debuggable: n.attr_bool("debuggable").unwrap_or(false),
                        allow_backup: n.attr_bool("allowBackup"),
                        uses_cleartext_traffic: n.attr_bool("usesCleartextTraffic"),
                        network_security_config: n.attr_str("networkSecurityConfig"),
                        request_legacy_external_storage: n
                            .attr_bool("requestLegacyExternalStorage"),
                        extract_native_libs: n.attr_bool("extractNativeLibs"),
                        name: n.attr_str("name"),
                    };
                    m.has_network_security_config = m.application.network_security_config.is_some();
                }
                k @ ("activity" | "activity-alias" | "service" | "receiver" | "provider") => {
                    let intent_filters = n
                        .children
                        .iter()
                        .filter(|c| c.name == "intent-filter")
                        .count();
                    let exported = n.attr_bool("exported");
                    // Pre-API-31 rule: an intent filter implies exported.
                    let implicit = intent_filters > 0 && exported.is_none();
                    m.components.push(Component {
                        kind: k.to_string(),
                        name: n.attr_str("name").unwrap_or_default(),
                        exported,
                        effectively_exported: exported.unwrap_or(implicit),
                        implicitly_exported: implicit,
                        permission: n.attr_str("permission"),
                        read_permission: n.attr_str("readPermission"),
                        write_permission: n.attr_str("writePermission"),
                        intent_filter_count: intent_filters,
                        authorities: n.attr_str("authorities"),
                        grant_uri_permissions: n.attr_bool("grantUriPermissions"),
                    });
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }

        // targetSdk may only live in uses-sdk; keep min/target sane if absent.
        if m.min_sdk.is_none() {
            m.min_sdk = Some(1);
        }
        if m.target_sdk.is_none() {
            m.target_sdk = m.min_sdk;
        }
        m
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::axml::{Attr, AttrValue};

    fn node(name: &str, attrs: &[(&str, AttrValue)]) -> Node {
        Node {
            name: name.into(),
            namespace: None,
            attrs: attrs
                .iter()
                .map(|(n, v)| Attr {
                    namespace: Some("android".into()),
                    name: (*n).into(),
                    value: v.clone(),
                })
                .collect(),
            children: vec![],
            line: 0,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn implicit_export_from_intent_filter_is_detected() {
        let mut act = node("activity", &[("name", AttrValue::Str(".Main".into()))]);
        act.children.push(node("intent-filter", &[]));
        let app = node("application", &[]);
        let root = Node {
            name: "manifest".into(),
            namespace: None,
            attrs: vec![Attr {
                namespace: None,
                name: "package".into(),
                value: AttrValue::Str("com.example".into()),
            }],
            children: vec![app, act],
            line: 0,
        };
        let m = Manifest::from_node(&root);
        assert_eq!(m.package, "com.example");
        assert_eq!(m.components.len(), 1);
        let c = &m.components[0];
        assert_eq!(c.exported, None, "attribute was not declared");
        assert!(c.implicitly_exported);
        assert!(c.effectively_exported);
        assert!(!c.has_permission_guard());
    }

    #[test]
    fn explicit_exported_false_wins_over_intent_filter() {
        let mut act = node(
            "activity",
            &[
                ("name", AttrValue::Str(".Main".into())),
                ("exported", AttrValue::Bool(false)),
            ],
        );
        act.children.push(node("intent-filter", &[]));
        let root = Node {
            name: "manifest".into(),
            namespace: None,
            attrs: vec![],
            children: vec![act],
            line: 0,
        };
        let m = Manifest::from_node(&root);
        let c = &m.components[0];
        assert_eq!(c.exported, Some(false));
        assert!(!c.effectively_exported);
        assert!(
            !c.implicitly_exported,
            "declaring exported=false is not implicit export"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn application_flags_and_permissions_are_collected() {
        let app = node(
            "application",
            &[
                ("debuggable", AttrValue::Bool(true)),
                ("allowBackup", AttrValue::Bool(true)),
                ("usesCleartextTraffic", AttrValue::Bool(true)),
                (
                    "networkSecurityConfig",
                    AttrValue::Str("@0x7f100000".into()),
                ),
            ],
        );
        let perm = node(
            "uses-permission",
            &[("name", AttrValue::Str("android.permission.INTERNET".into()))],
        );
        let sdk = node(
            "uses-sdk",
            &[
                ("minSdkVersion", AttrValue::Int(21)),
                ("targetSdkVersion", AttrValue::Int(30)),
            ],
        );
        let root = Node {
            name: "manifest".into(),
            namespace: None,
            attrs: vec![],
            children: vec![sdk, perm, app],
            line: 0,
        };
        let m = Manifest::from_node(&root);
        assert!(m.application.debuggable);
        assert_eq!(m.application.allow_backup, Some(true));
        assert_eq!(m.application.uses_cleartext_traffic, Some(true));
        assert!(m.has_network_security_config);
        assert_eq!(m.min_sdk, Some(21));
        assert_eq!(m.target_sdk, Some(30));
        assert_eq!(m.permissions, vec!["android.permission.INTERNET"]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn provider_permissions_guard_correctly() {
        let p = node(
            "provider",
            &[
                ("name", AttrValue::Str(".P".into())),
                ("readPermission", AttrValue::Str("com.example.READ".into())),
                ("grantUriPermissions", AttrValue::Bool(true)),
            ],
        );
        let root = Node {
            name: "manifest".into(),
            namespace: None,
            attrs: vec![],
            children: vec![p],
            line: 0,
        };
        let m = Manifest::from_node(&root);
        let c = &m.components[0];
        assert!(c.is_provider());
        assert!(c.has_permission_guard(), "readPermission is a guard");
        assert_eq!(c.grant_uri_permissions, Some(true));
    }
}
```

```rust
//! Manifest modification — the "change how the app behaves" half.
//!
//! Edits are a closed set of named operations rather than free-form XML
//! surgery, so an agent picks from a menu and the result is predictable. The
//! decoded tree is altered and re-encoded with [`crate::axmlenc`]; nothing here
//! shells out to `apktool`.

use anyhow::{anyhow, bail, Context, Result};

use crate::axml::{self, Attr, AttrValue, Node};
use crate::axmlenc;

pub const ANDROID_NS: &str = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";

/// One legal change to a manifest.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum ManifestEdit {
    SetDebuggable(bool),
    SetAllowBackup(bool),
    SetCleartextTraffic(bool),
    /// Mark one component explicitly exported (or not).
    SetExported {
        component: String,
        exported: bool,
    },
    SetMinSdk(u32),
    SetTargetSdk(u32),
    AddPermission(String),
    RemovePermission(String),
    RenamePackage(String),
    /// Point the app at a network security config resource.
    SetNetworkSecurityConfig(String),
    /// Disable certificate pinning checks by removing the attribute.
    RemoveCleartextGuard,
}

impl ManifestEdit {
    /// Parse the compact `key=value` form used by the CLI and MCP tools.
    pub fn parse(spec: &str) -> Result<ManifestEdit> {
        let (key, value) = spec
            .split_once('=')
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("expected key=value, got {spec:?}"))?;
        let flag = |v: &str| -> Result<bool> {
            match v.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
                "true" | "1" | "yes" => Ok(true),
                "false" | "0" | "no" => Ok(false),
                other => bail!("expected true/false, got {other:?}"),
            }
        };
        match key {
            "debuggable" => Ok(ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(flag(value)?)),
            "allowBackup" | "allow-backup" => Ok(ManifestEdit::SetAllowBackup(flag(value)?)),
            "cleartext" | "usesCleartextTraffic" => {
                Ok(ManifestEdit::SetCleartextTraffic(flag(value)?))
            }
            "exported" => {
                let (component, flag_text) = value
                    .rsplit_once(':')
                    .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("exported expects <component>:<true|false>"))?;
                Ok(ManifestEdit::SetExported {
                    component: component.to_string(),
                    exported: flag(flag_text)?,
                })
            }
            "minSdk" | "min-sdk" => Ok(ManifestEdit::SetMinSdk(
                value.parse().context("minSdk must be a number")?,
            )),
            "targetSdk" | "target-sdk" => Ok(ManifestEdit::SetTargetSdk(
                value.parse().context("targetSdk must be a number")?,
            )),
            "permission+" | "addPermission" => Ok(ManifestEdit::AddPermission(value.to_string())),
            "permission-" | "removePermission" => {
                Ok(ManifestEdit::RemovePermission(value.to_string()))
            }
            "package" => Ok(ManifestEdit::RenamePackage(value.to_string())),
            "networkSecurityConfig" => {
                Ok(ManifestEdit::SetNetworkSecurityConfig(value.to_string()))
            }
            "cleartextGuard" => {
                if value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("off") || value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("none") {
                    Ok(ManifestEdit::RemoveCleartextGuard)
                } else {
                    bail!("cleartextGuard only supports =off")
                }
            }
            other => bail!("unknown manifest edit {other:?}"),
        }
    }

    pub fn describe(&self) -> String {
        match self {
            ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(v) => format!("android:debuggable={v}"),
            ManifestEdit::SetAllowBackup(v) => format!("android:allowBackup={v}"),
            ManifestEdit::SetCleartextTraffic(v) => format!("android:usesCleartextTraffic={v}"),
            ManifestEdit::SetExported {
                component,
                exported,
            } => {
                format!("android:exported={exported} on {component}")
            }
            ManifestEdit::SetMinSdk(v) => format!("uses-sdk android:minSdkVersion={v}"),
            ManifestEdit::SetTargetSdk(v) => format!("uses-sdk android:targetSdkVersion={v}"),
            ManifestEdit::AddPermission(p) => format!("add uses-permission {p}"),
            ManifestEdit::RemovePermission(p) => format!("remove uses-permission {p}"),
            ManifestEdit::RenamePackage(p) => format!("package={p}"),
            ManifestEdit::SetNetworkSecurityConfig(v) => {
                format!("android:networkSecurityConfig={v}")
            }
            ManifestEdit::RemoveCleartextGuard => "remove android:usesCleartextTraffic".into(),
        }
    }
}

/// Named bundles so an agent can ask for an outcome instead of composing edits.
pub fn presets() -> Vec<(&'static str, &'static str, Vec<ManifestEdit>)> {
    vec![
        (
            "debug",
            "Make the app debuggable and allow backup, for instrumentation and data extraction.",
            vec![
                ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(true),
                ManifestEdit::SetAllowBackup(true),
            ],
        ),
        (
            "cleartext",
            "Permit cleartext HTTP and drop any network security config, so traffic can be intercepted.",
            vec![
                ManifestEdit::SetCleartextTraffic(true),
                ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(true),
            ],
        ),
        (
            "expose-all",
            "Export every activity, service and receiver so components can be invoked directly.",
            vec![ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(true)],
        ),
        (
            "backup",
            "Allow adb backup of application data.",
            vec![ManifestEdit::SetAllowBackup(true)],
        ),
    ]
}

/// Look up a preset by name.
pub fn preset(name: &str) -> Option<Vec<ManifestEdit>> {
    presets()
        .into_iter()
        .find(|(n, _, _)| *n == name)
        .map(|(_, _, edits)| edits)
}

fn matches_name(attr_name: &str, wanted: &str) -> bool {
    attr_name == wanted || attr_name.ends_with(&format!(":{wanted}"))
}

/// Set an attribute, adding it if absent. Returns true when it already existed.
fn set_android_attr(node: &mut Node, name: &str, value: AttrValue) -> bool {
    if let Some(existing) = node.attrs.iter_mut().find(|a| matches_name(&a.name, name)) {
        existing.value = value;
        return true;
    }
    node.attrs.push(Attr {
        namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.to_string()),
        name: name.to_string(),
        value,
    });
    false
}

/// Set `android:exported` on the first matching component in `nodes`.
fn export_in(nodes: &mut [Node], package: &str, component: &str, exported: bool) -> Option<String> {
    for node in nodes.iter_mut() {
        if !matches!(
            node.name.as_str(),
            "activity" | "service" | "receiver" | "provider"
        ) {
            continue;
        }
        let declared = match node.attr_str("name") {
            Some(s) => s,
            None => continue,
        };
        if component_matches(&declared, package, component) {
            set_android_attr(node, "exported", AttrValue::Bool(exported));
            return Some(format!(
                "{}/{} android:exported={exported}",
                node.name, declared
            ));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn find_application<'a>(root: &'a mut Node) -> Option<&'a mut Node> {
    if root.name == "application" {
        return Some(root);
    }
    root.children.iter_mut().find(|c| c.name == "application")
}

/// Resolve a component name the way the platform does. A manifest may write it
/// fully qualified (`com.example.Thing`) or relative to the package, either as
/// `.Thing` or as a bare `Thing`.
fn resolve_component(declared: &str, package: &str) -> String {
    if let Some(rest) = declared.strip_prefix('.') {
        format!("{package}.{rest}")
    } else if declared.contains('.') {
        declared.to_string()
    } else {
        format!("{package}.{declared}")
    }
}

/// Do a declared name and a requested name refer to the same component?
/// Accepts the fully-qualified form and the short form on either side, so the
/// caller can say `com.example.Thing` or just `Thing`.
fn component_matches(declared: &str, package: &str, wanted: &str) -> bool {
    let resolved = resolve_component(declared, package);
    let wanted_resolved = resolve_component(wanted, package);
    resolved == wanted_resolved
        || resolved.ends_with(&format!(".{wanted}"))
        || wanted_resolved.ends_with(&format!(".{resolved}"))
}

/// Apply one edit, returning a description of what actually changed.
pub fn apply(root: &mut Node, edit: &ManifestEdit) -> Result<String> {
    match edit {
        ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(v) => {
            let app = find_application(root)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("manifest has no <application> element"))?;
            set_android_attr(app, "debuggable", AttrValue::Bool(*v));
            Ok(edit.describe())
        }
        ManifestEdit::SetAllowBackup(v) => {
            let app = find_application(root)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("manifest has no <application> element"))?;
            set_android_attr(app, "allowBackup", AttrValue::Bool(*v));
            Ok(edit.describe())
        }
        ManifestEdit::SetCleartextTraffic(v) => {
            let app = find_application(root)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("manifest has no <application> element"))?;
            set_android_attr(app, "usesCleartextTraffic", AttrValue::Bool(*v));
            Ok(edit.describe())
        }
        ManifestEdit::RemoveCleartextGuard => {
            let app = find_application(root)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("manifest has no <application> element"))?;
            let before = app.attrs.len();
            app.attrs
                .retain(|a| !matches_name(&a.name, "usesCleartextTraffic"));
            if app.attrs.len() == before {
                return Ok("no android:usesCleartextTraffic to remove".into());
            }
            Ok(edit.describe())
        }
        ManifestEdit::SetNetworkSecurityConfig(v) => {
            let app = find_application(root)
                .ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("manifest has no <application> element"))?;
            set_android_attr(app, "networkSecurityConfig", AttrValue::Str(v.clone()));
            Ok(edit.describe())
        }
        ManifestEdit::SetExported {
            component,
            exported,
        } => {
            let package = root.attr_str("package").unwrap_or_default();
            // Components live under <application>, not directly under
            // <manifest>. Search there first, then fall back to the root for the
            // unusual manifests that declare them at top level.
            let mut changed = None;
            if let Some(app) = root.children.iter_mut().find(|c| c.name == "application") {
                changed = export_in(&mut app.children, &package, component, *exported);
            }
            if changed.is_none() {
                changed = export_in(&mut root.children, &package, component, *exported);
            }
            changed.ok_or_else(|| anyhow!("no component matching {component:?}"))
        }
        ManifestEdit::SetMinSdk(v) => set_sdk(root, "minSdkVersion", *v),
        ManifestEdit::SetTargetSdk(v) => set_sdk(root, "targetSdkVersion", *v),
        ManifestEdit::AddPermission(p) => {
            let already = root.children.iter().any(|c| {
                c.name == "uses-permission" && c.attr_str("name").map(|n| n == *p).unwrap_or(false)
            });
            if already {
                return Ok(format!("permission {p} already present"));
            }
            root.children.push(Node {
                name: "uses-permission".into(),
                namespace: None,
                attrs: vec![Attr {
                    namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.to_string()),
                    name: "name".into(),
                    value: AttrValue::Str(p.clone()),
                }],
                children: Vec::new(),
                line: 0,
            });
            Ok(format!("added uses-permission {p}"))
        }
        ManifestEdit::RemovePermission(p) => {
            let before = root.children.len();
            root.children.retain(|c| {
                !(c.name == "uses-permission"
                    && c.attr_str("name").map(|n| n == *p).unwrap_or(false))
            });
            if root.children.len() == before {
                bail!("permission {p} is not declared");
            }
            Ok(format!("removed uses-permission {p}"))
        }
        ManifestEdit::RenamePackage(p) => {
            let existing = root.attrs.iter_mut().find(|a| a.name == "package");
            match existing {
                Some(a) => {
                    let was = a.value.display();
                    a.value = AttrValue::Str(p.clone());
                    Ok(format!("package {was} -> {p}"))
                }
                None => bail!("manifest has no package attribute"),
            }
        }
    }
}

fn set_sdk(root: &mut Node, attribute: &str, value: u32) -> Result<String> {
    if let Some(node) = root.children.iter_mut().find(|c| c.name == "uses-sdk") {
        set_android_attr(node, attribute, AttrValue::Int(value as i32));
        return Ok(format!("uses-sdk android:{attribute}={value}"));
    }
    // Insert a fresh <uses-sdk> ahead of <application>, which is where it
    // conventionally sits.
    let mut node = Node {
        name: "uses-sdk".into(),
        namespace: None,
        attrs: Vec::new(),
        children: Vec::new(),
        line: 0,
    };
    set_android_attr(&mut node, attribute, AttrValue::Int(value as i32));
    let position = root
        .children
        .iter()
        .position(|c| c.name == "application")
        .unwrap_or(root.children.len());
    root.children.insert(position, node);
    Ok(format!("added uses-sdk android:{attribute}={value}"))
}

/// Apply a list of edits in order.
pub fn apply_all(root: &mut Node, edits: &[ManifestEdit]) -> Result<Vec<String>> {
    edits.iter().map(|e| apply(root, e)).collect()
}

/// Decode a binary manifest, apply edits, and re-encode it.
pub fn modify_manifest(bytes: &[u8], edits: &[ManifestEdit]) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Vec<String>)> {
    let mut root = axml::decode(bytes).context("decoding AndroidManifest.xml")?;
    let changes = apply_all(&mut root, edits)?;
    let encoded = axmlenc::encode(&root).context("re-encoding AndroidManifest.xml")?;
    Ok((encoded, changes))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::io::Read;

    fn real_manifest() -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        let path =
            std::path::PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("testdata/test-app.apk");
        if !path.exists() {
            return None;
        }
        let file = std::fs::File::open(path).ok()?;
        let mut archive = zip::ZipArchive::new(file).ok()?;
        let mut member = archive.by_name("AndroidManifest.xml").ok()?;
        let mut data = Vec::new();
        member.read_to_end(&mut data).ok()?;
        Some(data)
    }

    #[test]
    fn parses_the_compact_edit_syntax() {
        assert_eq!(
            ManifestEdit::parse("debuggable=true").unwrap(),
            ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(true)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ManifestEdit::parse("minSdk=24").unwrap(),
            ManifestEdit::SetMinSdk(24)
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ManifestEdit::parse("exported=com.example.Thing:true").unwrap(),
            ManifestEdit::SetExported {
                component: "com.example.Thing".into(),
                exported: true
            }
        );
        assert_eq!(
            ManifestEdit::parse("permission+=android.permission.INTERNET").unwrap(),
            ManifestEdit::AddPermission("android.permission.INTERNET".into())
        );
        assert!(ManifestEdit::parse("nonsense=1").is_err());
        assert!(ManifestEdit::parse("debuggable=maybe").is_err());
        assert!(ManifestEdit::parse("debuggable").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn every_preset_parses_and_describes() {
        for (name, desc, edits) in presets() {
            assert!(!name.is_empty());
            assert!(desc.len() > 20, "preset {name} needs a real description");
            assert!(!edits.is_empty(), "preset {name} is empty");
            for e in &edits {
                assert!(!e.describe().is_empty());
            }
            assert!(preset(name).is_some());
        }
        assert!(preset("nope").is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn setting_debuggable_on_a_synthetic_manifest_round_trips() {
        let mut root = axml::decode(&synthetic_manifest()).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(root.attr_bool("debuggable"), None);
        let changes = apply_all(
            &mut root,
            &[
                ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(true),
                ManifestEdit::SetMinSdk(24),
                ManifestEdit::AddPermission("android.permission.INTERNET".into()),
            ],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(changes.len(), 3);

        let bytes = axmlenc::encode(&root).unwrap();
        let decoded = axml::decode(&bytes).unwrap();
        let application = decoded
            .children
            .iter()
            .find(|c| c.name == "application")
            .expect("application survives");
        assert_eq!(application.attr_bool("debuggable"), Some(true));
        let sdk = decoded
            .children
            .iter()
            .find(|c| c.name == "uses-sdk")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(sdk.attr_int("minSdkVersion"), Some(24));
        assert!(decoded.children.iter().any(|c| c.name == "uses-permission"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn removing_a_permission_that_is_absent_is_an_error_not_a_silent_noop() {
        let mut root = axml::decode(&synthetic_manifest()).unwrap();
        let err = apply(
            &mut root,
            &ManifestEdit::RemovePermission("android.permission.NOPE".into()),
        )
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
        assert!(err.contains("not declared"), "{err}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn export_edit_matches_short_and_qualified_component_names() {
        let mut root = axml::decode(&synthetic_manifest()).unwrap();
        // The synthetic manifest declares ".Lazy" relative to the package.
        let changed = apply(
            &mut root,
            &ManifestEdit::SetExported {
                component: "com.example.Lazy".into(),
                exported: true,
            },
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert!(changed.contains("exported=true"), "{changed}");
        let bytes = axmlenc::encode(&root).unwrap();
        let decoded = axml::decode(&bytes).unwrap();
        let application = decoded
            .children
            .iter()
            .find(|c| c.name == "application")
            .unwrap();
        let activity = application
            .children
            .iter()
            .find(|c| c.name == "activity")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(activity.attr_bool("exported"), Some(true));
    }

    #[test]
    fn real_manifest_can_be_made_debuggable_and_re_decoded() {
        let Some(original) = real_manifest() else {
            eprintln!("skipping: testdata/test-app.apk not present");
            return;
        };
        let before = axml::decode(&original).unwrap();
        assert_ne!(before.attr_bool("debuggable"), Some(true));

        let (modified, changes) = modify_manifest(
            &original,
            &[
                ManifestEdit::SetDebuggable(true),
                ManifestEdit::SetAllowBackup(true),
            ],
        )
        .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(changes.len(), 2);
        assert!(!modified.is_empty());

        let after = axml::decode(&modified).unwrap();
        let app = after
            .children
            .iter()
            .find(|c| c.name == "application")
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(app.attr_bool("debuggable"), Some(true));
        assert_eq!(app.attr_bool("allowBackup"), Some(true));

        // The package name and the component count must be untouched.
        assert_eq!(before.attr_str("package"), after.attr_str("package"));
        assert_eq!(before.children.len(), after.children.len());
    }

    #[test]
    fn an_edit_that_matches_nothing_reports_which_component() {
        let mut root = axml::decode(&synthetic_manifest()).unwrap();
        let err = apply(
            &mut root,
            &ManifestEdit::SetExported {
                component: "com.example.Missing".into(),
                exported: true,
            },
        )
        .unwrap_err()
        .to_string();
        assert!(err.contains("com.example.Missing"), "{err}");
    }

    /// A tiny but structurally valid manifest, so the modify layer is testable
    /// without an APK.
    fn synthetic_manifest() -> Vec<u8> {
        use axml::Node;
        let root = Node {
            name: "manifest".into(),
            namespace: None,
            attrs: vec![
                Attr {
                    namespace: None,
                    name: "package".into(),
                    value: AttrValue::Str("com.example".into()),
                },
                Attr {
                    namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.into()),
                    name: "versionCode".into(),
                    value: AttrValue::Int(3),
                },
            ],
            children: vec![
                Node {
                    name: "application".into(),
                    namespace: None,
                    attrs: vec![Attr {
                        namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.into()),
                        name: "label".into(),
                        value: AttrValue::Str("Example".into()),
                    }],
                    children: vec![Node {
                        name: "activity".into(),
                        namespace: None,
                        attrs: vec![
                            Attr {
                                namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.into()),
                                name: "name".into(),
                                value: AttrValue::Str(".Lazy".into()),
                            },
                            Attr {
                                namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.into()),
                                name: "exported".into(),
                                value: AttrValue::Bool(false),
                            },
                        ],
                        children: Vec::new(),
                        line: 0,
                    }],
                    line: 0,
                },
                Node {
                    name: "uses-permission".into(),
                    namespace: None,
                    attrs: vec![Attr {
                        namespace: Some(ANDROID_NS.into()),
                        name: "name".into(),
                        value: AttrValue::Str("android.permission.CAMERA".into()),
                    }],
                    children: Vec::new(),
                    line: 0,
                },
            ],
            line: 0,
        };
        axmlenc::encode(&root).unwrap()
    }
}
```
