## `crates/server/phone/src/adbd.rs`

[view on disk](crates/server/phone/src/adbd.rs)

```rust
//! `adbd` — the phone's ADB daemon. Listens on TCP (the port `adb connect`
//! uses), speaks the transport protocol server-side: `CNXN` handshake with
//! RSA token authentication against an authorised-key store, then
//! `OPEN`/`WRTE`/`OKAY`/`CLSE` channels for `exec:`, `shell:`, `sync:`,
//! `root:` and `unroot:`.
//!
//! Any real ADB client can connect to it — mandroid's native client, Google's
//! `adb`, or anything else that speaks the wire protocol.

use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use anyhow::{anyhow, bail, Context, Result};
use rsa::pkcs1v15::Pkcs1v15Sign;
use rsa::RsaPublicKey;
use sha1::{Digest, Sha1};

use crate::persist;
use crate::shell;
use crate::state::OsState;

pub const A_SYNC: u32 = 0x434e5953;
pub const A_CNXN: u32 = 0x4e584e43;
pub const A_OPEN: u32 = 0x4e45504f;
pub const A_OKAY: u32 = 0x59414b4f;
pub const A_CLSE: u32 = 0x45534c43;
pub const A_WRTE: u32 = 0x45545257;
pub const A_AUTH: u32 = 0x48545541;

pub const A_VERSION: u32 = 0x0100_0001;
pub const MAX_DATA: u32 = 256 * 1024;
const ADB_AUTH_TOKEN: u32 = 1;
const ADB_AUTH_SIGNATURE: u32 = 2;
const ADB_AUTH_RSAPUBLICKEY: u32 = 3;
const SYNC_DATA_MAX: usize = 64 * 1024;

const ID_STAT: u32 = u32::from_le_bytes(*b"STAT");
const ID_DATA: u32 = u32::from_le_bytes(*b"DATA");
const ID_DONE: u32 = u32::from_le_bytes(*b"DONE");
const ID_OKAY: u32 = u32::from_le_bytes(*b"OKAY");
const ID_FAIL: u32 = u32::from_le_bytes(*b"FAIL");
const ID_QUIT: u32 = u32::from_le_bytes(*b"QUIT");

fn adb_log(msg: &str) {
    if std::env::var("ROMACODE_ADBD_LOG")
        .map(|v| v == "1")
        .unwrap_or(false)
    {
        eprintln!("[adbd] {msg}");
    }
}

pub struct Adbd {
    pub state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>,
    pub stop: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    pub bound_port: Arc<Mutex<Option<u16>>>,
}

impl Adbd {
    /// Bind and serve until `stop` is set. Returns the bound port when the
    /// listener exits.
    pub fn serve(self) -> Result<u16> {
        let state = self.state.clone();
        let stop = self.stop.clone();
        let bound = self.bound_port.clone();

        // port selection: default 5555, step by 2 (the ADB convention).
        // Keep the last bind error: "no free port" used to hide the real
        // cause (permission denied, a stale listener, …).
        let mut listener = None;
        let mut last_bind_err = None::<std::io::Error>;
        for port in (5555..=5615).step_by(2) {
            match TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", port)) {
                Ok(l) => {
                    listener = Some((l, port));
                    break;
                }
                Err(e) => last_bind_err = Some(e),
            }
        }
        let (listener, port) = listener.ok_or_else(|| {
            anyhow!(
                "no free ADB port in 5555..=5615 (last bind error: {})",
                last_bind_err
                    .map(|e| e.to_string())
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".into())
            )
        })?;
        *bound.lock().unwrap() = Some(port);
        if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
            // the transport is TCP, but the device reports its physical serial
            // (what `ro.serialno` and the CNXN banner carry)
            st.serial = st.identity.serial.clone();
            st.adb_port = port;
            st.notify("Android", &format!("adbd online on 127.0.0.1:{port}"), None);
        }

        listener.set_nonblocking(true).ok();
        while !stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
            match listener.accept() {
                Ok((stream, _addr)) => {
                    let state = state.clone();
                    let stop = stop.clone();
                    std::thread::spawn(move || {
                        stream.set_nonblocking(false).ok();
                        let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(120)));
                        let _ = stream.set_write_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(60)));
                        let _ = stream.set_nodelay(true);
                        let _ = Connection::run(stream, state, stop);
                    });
                }
                Err(ref e) if e.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock => {
                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(80));
                }
                Err(_) => std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(200)),
            }
        }
        Ok(port)
    }
}

fn command_name(code: u32) -> &'static str {
    match code {
        A_SYNC => "SYNC",
        A_CNXN => "CNXN",
        A_OPEN => "OPEN",
        A_OKAY => "OKAY",
        A_CLSE => "CLSE",
        A_WRTE => "WRTE",
        A_AUTH => "AUTH",
        _ => "????",
    }
}

/// One client connection: handshake, then a channel loop.
struct Connection {
    stream: TcpStream,
    max_data: u32,
    local_next: u32,
    client_local: u32,
    server_remote: u32,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct Message {
    command: u32,
    arg0: u32,
    arg1: u32,
    data: Vec<u8>,
}

impl Connection {
    fn run(stream: TcpStream, state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>, stop: Arc<AtomicBool>) -> Result<()> {
        let mut conn = Self {
            stream,
            max_data: MAX_DATA,
            local_next: 1,
            client_local: 0,
            server_remote: 0,
        };
        conn.handshake(&state)?;
        conn.channel_loop(state, stop)
    }

    fn send(&mut self, command: u32, arg0: u32, arg1: u32, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
        let mut header = [0u8; 24];
        header[0..4].copy_from_slice(&command.to_le_bytes());
        header[4..8].copy_from_slice(&arg0.to_le_bytes());
        header[8..12].copy_from_slice(&arg1.to_le_bytes());
        header[12..16].copy_from_slice(&(data.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        header[16..20].copy_from_slice(&checksum(data).to_le_bytes());
        header[20..24].copy_from_slice(&(command ^ 0xffff_ffff).to_le_bytes());
        self.stream.write_all(&header)?;
        if !data.is_empty() {
            self.stream.write_all(data)?;
        }
        self.stream.flush()?;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn recv(&mut self) -> Result<Message> {
        let mut header = [0u8; 24];
        self.stream
            .read_exact(&mut header)
            .context("reading header")?;
        let command = u32::from_le_bytes(header[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
        let arg0 = u32::from_le_bytes(header[4..8].try_into().unwrap());
        let arg1 = u32::from_le_bytes(header[8..12].try_into().unwrap());
        let length = u32::from_le_bytes(header[12..16].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
        let wire_sum = u32::from_le_bytes(header[16..20].try_into().unwrap());
        let magic = u32::from_le_bytes(header[20..24].try_into().unwrap());
        if magic != command ^ 0xffff_ffff {
            bail!("header magic mismatch on {command:#010x}");
        }
        if length > 4 * 1024 * 1024 {
            bail!("implausible payload length {length}");
        }
        let mut data = vec![0u8; length];
        if length > 0 {
            self.stream.read_exact(&mut data)?;
            if wire_sum != 0 && checksum(&data) != wire_sum {
                bail!("checksum mismatch on {length}-byte payload");
            }
        }
        Ok(Message {
            command,
            arg0,
            arg1,
            data,
        })
    }

    /// CNXN + AUTH: the client opens with its CNXN; we either accept (key
    /// known) or challenge with a 20-byte token and verify the signature
    /// against the owner-managed authorised keys. Network clients can never
    /// add their own keys; use the local pairing/bootstrap path instead.
    fn handshake(&mut self, state: &Arc<Mutex<OsState>>) -> Result<()> {
        // 1. client CNXN
        let first = self.recv()?;
        adb_log(&format!("first message: {}", command_name(first.command)));
        if first.command != A_CNXN {
            bail!("expected CNXN, got {}", command_name(first.command));
        }
        let data_dir = state.lock().unwrap().data_dir.clone();

        // 2. token challenge unless this key is already authorised
        let authorized = persist::authorized_keys(&data_dir);
        if !authorized.is_empty() {
            // optimistic path: challenge once, verify signature against store
            let token = random_token();
            adb_log(&format!(
                "known keys: {} — challenge sent",
                authorized.len()
            ));
            self.send(A_AUTH, ADB_AUTH_TOKEN, 0, &token)?;
            for _ in 0..4 {
                let msg = self.recv()?;
                adb_log(&format!(
                    "auth msg: {} arg0={}",
                    command_name(msg.command),
                    msg.arg0
                ));
                match msg.command {
                    A_AUTH if msg.arg0 == ADB_AUTH_SIGNATURE => {
                        if verify_signature(&authorized, &token, &msg.data) {
                            return self.send_cnxn(state);
                        }
                        self.send(A_AUTH, ADB_AUTH_TOKEN, 0, &random_token())?;
                    }
                    A_AUTH if msg.arg0 == ADB_AUTH_RSAPUBLICKEY => {
                        bail!("ADB key is not authorised; explicit local owner pairing is required")
                    }
                    other => bail!("unexpected {} during auth", command_name(other)),
                }
            }
            bail!("authentication failed: key not authorised")
        }
        // An empty store is not permission to trust whichever remote client
        // happens to connect first. Challenge, then refuse all client keys.
        let token = random_token();
        adb_log("fresh device — challenge sent");
        self.send(A_AUTH, ADB_AUTH_TOKEN, 0, &token)?;
        for _ in 0..4 {
            let msg = self.recv()?;
            adb_log(&format!(
                "first-auth msg: {} arg0={}",
                command_name(msg.command),
                msg.arg0
            ));
            match msg.command {
                A_AUTH if msg.arg0 == ADB_AUTH_SIGNATURE => {
                    bail!("no ADB keys are authorised; explicit local owner pairing is required")
                }
                A_AUTH if msg.arg0 == ADB_AUTH_RSAPUBLICKEY => {
                    bail!("ADB key is not authorised; explicit local owner pairing is required")
                }
                other => bail!("unexpected {} during first auth", command_name(other)),
            }
        }
        bail!("first authentication failed")
    }

    fn send_cnxn(&mut self, state: &Arc<Mutex<OsState>>) -> Result<()> {
        let banner = {
            let st = state.lock().unwrap();
            // the same banner a physical handset sends: serialno, product
            // identity, SDK level and the negotiated features
            format!(
                "device::ro.product.model={model};ro.product.device={device};\
                 ro.build.version.release={rel};ro.build.version.sdk={sdk};\
                 ro.serialno={serial};features=cmd,shell_v2,stat_v2",
                model = st.identity.model,
                device = st.identity.device,
                rel = st.identity.android_release,
                sdk = st.identity.sdk_level,
                serial = st.identity.serial,
            )
        };
        self.send(A_CNXN, A_VERSION, MAX_DATA, banner.as_bytes())
    }

    /// Post-handshake channel loop.
    fn channel_loop(&mut self, state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>, stop: Arc<AtomicBool>) -> Result<()> {
        loop {
            if stop.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
                return Ok(());
            }
            let msg = self.recv()?;
            match msg.command {
                A_OPEN => {
                    let service = String::from_utf8_lossy(&msg.data)
                        .trim_end_matches('\0')
                        .to_string();
                    adb_log(&format!("OPEN service: {service}"));
                    self.client_local = msg.arg0;
                    self.server_remote = self.local_next;
                    self.local_next += 1;
                    if service.starts_with("exec:") || service.starts_with("shell:") {
                        let cmd = service
                            .trim_start_matches("exec:")
                            .trim_start_matches("shell:")
                            .to_string();
                        self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        // stream the output, close the CHANNEL — the transport
                        // stays up for the client's next OPEN (real adbd)
                        self.run_exec(state.clone(), &cmd).ok();
                    } else if service == "sync:" {
                        self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        self.sync_loop(state.clone()).ok();
                    } else if service == "root:" {
                        self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
                            st.rooted = true;
                        }
                        self.send(A_CLSE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        // the "restart" drops the transport, like a real userdebug device
                        return Ok(());
                    } else if service == "unroot:" {
                        self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        if let Ok(mut st) = state.lock() {
                            st.rooted = false;
                        }
                        self.send(A_CLSE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        return Ok(());
                    } else if service == "features:" {
                        self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                        self.write_channel(b"cmd").ok();
                        self.send(A_CLSE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                    } else {
                        // unknown service: refuse with CLSE (like real adbd)
                        self.send(A_CLSE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                    }
                }
                A_CLSE | A_OKAY | A_WRTE => {
                    // stray traffic for closed channels: acknowledge politely
                    if msg.command == A_WRTE {
                        self.send(A_OKAY, msg.arg1, msg.arg0, &[])?;
                    }
                }
                A_CNXN => {
                    // re-handshake (client reconnecting on the same socket)
                    let _ = msg;
                }
                other => bail!("unexpected {} in channel loop", command_name(other)),
            }
        }
    }

    /// Run one shell command and stream its output.
    fn run_exec(&mut self, state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>, cmd: &str) -> Result<()> {
        if cmd.is_empty() {
            return Ok(());
        }
        // scrcpy-style live screen stream: one channel, every committed frame
        // pushed raw until the client hangs up
        if cmd.trim() == "screenrecord --raw" || cmd.trim().starts_with("screenrecord ") {
            return self.run_screenrecord(state);
        }
        // screencap clones the committed frame and encodes outside the lock
        let out = if cmd.trim() == "screencap -p"
            || cmd.trim() == "screencap"
            || cmd.trim().starts_with("screencap ")
        {
            let (fb, (w, h), path) = {
                let st = state.lock().unwrap();
                let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
                let fb = st.fb.clone();
                let path = cmd
                    .split_whitespace()
                    .skip(1)
                    .find(|a| !a.starts_with('-'))
                    .and_then(|p| shell::resolve_path(&st, p));
                (fb, (w, h), path)
            };
            let png = mandroid::screen::encode_png(&fb, w, h).unwrap_or_default();
            if let Some(path) = path {
                std::fs::write(path, &png).ok();
                Vec::new()
            } else {
                png
            }
        } else {
            let mut st = state.lock().unwrap();
            shell::exec(&mut st, cmd)
        };
        self.write_channel(&out)?;
        self.send(A_CLSE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
        Ok(())
    }

    /// `screenrecord --raw` — the live display stream (what scrcpy does over
    /// `adb exec-out` on a physical device). Frames are pushed the moment the
    /// compositor commits them: a 20-byte header (magic `RCF1`, commit
    /// generation u64, width u32, height u32, all little-endian) followed by
    /// `w*h*4` bytes of RGBA8. The channel stays open until the client
    /// disconnects.
    ///
    /// The state lock is taken only to clone the frame — never while waiting
    /// on the client — so the compositor keeps rendering at full rate while
    /// the stream is being watched. On an idle screen a heartbeat re-send
    /// every 2 s keeps the channel demonstrably alive (and the client's read
    /// timeout from ever firing on a healthy device).
    fn run_screenrecord(&mut self, state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>) -> Result<()> {
        const MAGIC: &[u8; 4] = b"RCF1";
        let mut last_gen = 0u64;
        let mut last_sent = Instant::now() - Duration::from_secs(10);
        loop {
            let mut frame = None;
            {
                let st = state.lock().unwrap();
                let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
                let gen = st.fb_gen;
                if gen != last_gen || last_sent.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(2) {
                    frame = Some((gen, w, h, st.fb.clone()));
                }
            }
            if let Some((gen, w, h, rgba)) = frame {
                last_gen = gen;
                last_sent = Instant::now();
                let mut pkt = Vec::with_capacity(20 + rgba.len());
                pkt.extend_from_slice(MAGIC);
                pkt.extend_from_slice(&gen.to_le_bytes());
                pkt.extend_from_slice(&w.to_le_bytes());
                pkt.extend_from_slice(&h.to_le_bytes());
                pkt.extend_from_slice(&rgba);
                // errors here mean the client went away — end the stream
                self.write_channel(&pkt)?;
            } else {
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(8));
            }
        }
    }

    /// Stream `data` as WRTE chunks, waiting for the client's OKAY each time.
    fn write_channel(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {
        for chunk in data.chunks(self.max_data.max(4096) as usize) {
            self.send(A_WRTE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, chunk)?;
            loop {
                let msg = self.recv()?;
                match msg.command {
                    A_OKAY if msg.arg1 == self.server_remote => break,
                    A_CLSE if msg.arg1 == self.server_remote => bail!("client closed channel"),
                    A_WRTE if msg.arg1 == self.server_remote => {
                        self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, msg.arg0, &[])?;
                    }
                    other => bail!("unexpected {} waiting for OKAY", command_name(other)),
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    /// The `sync:` byte-stream service: SEND/RECV/STAT/QUIT over WRTE
    /// payloads, byte-oriented exactly like AOSP's file_sync_service. The
    /// client writes requests back-to-back without waiting, so every read
    /// goes through one buffered stream that drains leftover payload bytes
    /// before pulling the next WRTE.
    fn sync_loop(&mut self, state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>) -> Result<()> {
        let mut buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let hdr = self.sync_read_exact(&mut buf, state.clone(), 8)?;
            let id = u32::from_le_bytes(hdr[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
            let len = u32::from_le_bytes(hdr[4..8].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
            if len > 16 * 1024 * 1024 {
                // a hostile local client can declare a ~4 GB body — refuse
                // it instead of ballooning the buffer
                self.sync_fail("sync request too large")?;
                continue;
            }
            let body = self.sync_read_exact(&mut buf, state.clone(), len)?;
            match id {
                x if x == u32::from_le_bytes(*b"SEND") => {
                    let spec = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).to_string();
                    let (path, _mode) = spec.rsplit_once(',').unwrap_or((&spec, "0644"));
                    match self.sync_recv_file(&mut buf, state.clone()) {
                        Ok(bytes) => {
                            let full = {
                                let guard = state.lock().unwrap();
                                shell::resolve_path(&guard, path.trim_end_matches('\0'))
                            };
                            let Some(full) = full else {
                                self.sync_fail("unsafe destination path")?;
                                continue;
                            };
                            if let Some(parent) = full.parent() {
                                let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(parent);
                            }
                            let res = std::fs::write(&full, &bytes)
                                .map_err(|e| format!("write {}: {e}", full.display()));
                            // exactly one OKAY/FAIL status at the end (AOSP contract)
                            match res {
                                Ok(()) => self.send(
                                    A_WRTE,
                                    self.server_remote,
                                    self.client_local,
                                    &ID_OKAY.to_le_bytes(),
                                )?,
                                Err(e) => self.sync_fail(&e)?,
                            }
                        }
                        Err(e) => self.sync_fail(&e)?,
                    }
                }
                x if x == u32::from_le_bytes(*b"RECV") => {
                    let path = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body)
                        .trim_end_matches('\0')
                        .to_string();
                    let full = {
                        let guard = state.lock().unwrap();
                        shell::resolve_path(&guard, &path)
                    };
                    let Some(full) = full else {
                        self.sync_fail("unsafe source path")?;
                        continue;
                    };
                    match std::fs::read(&full) {
                        Ok(bytes) => {
                            for chunk in bytes.chunks(SYNC_DATA_MAX) {
                                let mut pkt = b"DATA".to_vec();
                                pkt.extend((chunk.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
                                pkt.extend_from_slice(chunk);
                                self.send(A_WRTE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &pkt)?;
                            }
                            let mut done = b"DONE".to_vec();
                            done.extend(crate::state::now_secs().to_le_bytes());
                            self.send(A_WRTE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &done)?;
                        }
                        Err(_) => {
                            let msg = format!("pull {}: No such file or directory", path);
                            self.sync_fail(&msg)?;
                        }
                    }
                }
                x if x == ID_STAT
                    || x == u32::from_le_bytes(*b"LST2")
                    || x == u32::from_le_bytes(*b"STA2") =>
                {
                    let path = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body)
                        .trim_end_matches('\0')
                        .to_string();
                    let full = {
                        let guard = state.lock().unwrap();
                        shell::resolve_path(&guard, &path)
                    };
                    let mut reply = b"STAT".to_vec();
                    let metadata = full.and_then(|p| {
                        std::fs::symlink_metadata(p)
                            .ok()
                            .filter(|m| !m.file_type().is_symlink())
                    });
                    match metadata {
                        Some(m) => {
                            let mode: u32 = if m.is_dir() { 0o040755 } else { 0o0100644 };
                            reply.extend(mode.to_le_bytes());
                            reply.extend((m.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
                            reply.extend(mtime_u32(&m).to_le_bytes());
                        }
                        None => reply.extend([0u8; 12]),
                    }
                    self.send(A_WRTE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &reply)?;
                }
                x if x == ID_QUIT => {
                    self.send(A_CLSE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &[])?;
                    return Ok(());
                }
                other => {
                    // unknown request: fail the channel, keep the transport
                    let msg = format!("unexpected sync id {other:#010x}");
                    self.sync_fail(&msg)?;
                    return Ok(());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn sync_fail(&mut self, msg: &str) -> Result<()> {
        let mut fail = ID_FAIL.to_le_bytes().to_vec();
        fail.extend((msg.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        fail.extend(msg.as_bytes().to_vec());
        self.send(A_WRTE, self.server_remote, self.client_local, &fail)
    }

    /// Pull one WRTE payload (acknowledging it), for the byte-oriented sync
    /// stream.
    fn read_wrte(&mut self, _state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
        loop {
            let msg = self.recv()?;
            match msg.command {
                A_WRTE if msg.arg1 == self.server_remote => {
                    self.send(A_OKAY, self.server_remote, msg.arg0, &[])?;
                    return Ok(msg.data);
                }
                A_OKAY if msg.arg1 == self.server_remote => {}
                A_CLSE if msg.arg1 == self.server_remote => bail!("sync channel closed"),
                other => bail!("unexpected {} during sync read", command_name(other)),
            }
        }
    }

    /// Read exactly `n` bytes of the sync byte stream: leftovers first, then
    /// fresh WRTE payloads.
    fn sync_read_exact(
        &mut self,
        buf: &mut Vec<u8>,
        state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>,
        n: usize,
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
        while buf.len() < n {
            buf.extend(self.read_wrte(state.clone())?);
        }
        Ok(buf.drain(..n).collect())
    }

    /// Read the file body after a SEND header: DATA chunks then DONE.
    fn sync_recv_file(
        &mut self,
        buf: &mut Vec<u8>,
        state: Arc<Mutex<OsState>>,
    ) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        loop {
            let head = self
                .sync_read_exact(buf, state.clone(), 8)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            let id = u32::from_le_bytes(head[0..4].try_into().unwrap());
            let len = u32::from_le_bytes(head[4..8].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
            let body = self
                .sync_read_exact(buf, state.clone(), len)
                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            match id {
                x if x == ID_DATA => {
                    out.extend_from_slice(&body);
                    if out.len() > 512 * 1024 * 1024 {
                        return Err("pushed file exceeds the 512 MiB limit".to_string());
                    }
                }
                x if x == ID_DONE => return Ok(out),
                other => return Err(format!("unexpected sync id {other:#010x} in SEND")),
            }
        }
    }
}

fn checksum(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {
    data.iter().fold(0u32, |acc, &b| acc.wrapping_add(b as u32))
}

fn random_token() -> [u8; 20] {
    let mut t = [0u8; 20];
    rand_bytes(&mut t);
    t
}

fn rand_bytes(buf: &mut [u8]) {
    // The ADB auth token must be unpredictable — it proves the host holds a
    // previously authorized key. SipHash via `RandomState` is keyed by a
    // random seed but is NOT a CSPRNG: its diffusion and predictability
    // properties are wrong for secret material. Use `OsRng` directly so the
    // bytes come from the host's CSPRNG (getrandom / RtlGenRandom).
    use rand::RngCore;
    rand::rngs::OsRng.fill_bytes(buf);
}

fn mtime_u32(m: &std::fs::Metadata) -> u32 {
    m.modified()
        .ok()
        .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
        .map(|d| d.as_secs() as u32)
        .unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Parse a 524-byte ADB public-key blob and verify an AUTH signature.
/// Blob layout (little-endian): len(4) n0inv(4) n(256) rr(256) e(4, BE).
fn verify_signature(keys_b64: &[String], token: &[u8], sig: &[u8]) -> bool {
    for b64 in keys_b64 {
        let Ok(blob) = mandroid::crypto::base64_decode(b64) else {
            continue;
        };
        if blob.len() < 524 {
            continue;
        }
        let n_le = &blob[8..264];
        let exp = u32::from_le_bytes([blob[520], blob[521], blob[522], blob[523]]);
        let mut n_be = n_le.to_vec();
        n_be.reverse();
        let n = rsa::BigUint::from_bytes_be(&n_be);
        let e = rsa::BigUint::from(exp);
        let Ok(pub_key) = RsaPublicKey::new(n, e) else {
            continue;
        };
        let digest = sha1::Sha1::digest(token);
        if pub_key
            .verify(Pkcs1v15Sign::new::<Sha1>(), &digest, sig)
            .is_ok()
        {
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod auth_security_tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::net::TcpListener;
    use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};

    fn send_msg(stream: &mut TcpStream, command: u32, arg0: u32, arg1: u32, data: &[u8]) {
        let mut h = [0u8; 24];
        h[0..4].copy_from_slice(&command.to_le_bytes());
        h[4..8].copy_from_slice(&arg0.to_le_bytes());
        h[8..12].copy_from_slice(&arg1.to_le_bytes());
        h[12..16].copy_from_slice(&(data.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        h[16..20].copy_from_slice(&checksum(data).to_le_bytes());
        h[20..24].copy_from_slice(&(command ^ 0xffff_ffff).to_le_bytes());
        stream.write_all(&h).unwrap();
        stream.write_all(data).unwrap();
        stream.flush().unwrap();
    }

    #[test]
    fn empty_store_does_not_self_enroll_network_supplied_key() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
            "phone-adb-auth-{}-{}",
            std::process::id(),
            SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
                .unwrap()
                .as_nanos()
        ));
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
        let state = Arc::new(Mutex::new(persist::fresh(&dir)));
        let listener = TcpListener::bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)).unwrap();
        let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap();
        let server_state = state.clone();
        let server = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let (stream, _) = listener.accept().unwrap();
            let mut conn = Connection {
                stream,
                max_data: MAX_DATA,
                local_next: 1,
                client_local: 0,
                server_remote: 0,
            };
            conn.handshake(&server_state)
        });
        let mut client = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();
        send_msg(&mut client, A_CNXN, A_VERSION, MAX_DATA, b"host::");
        let mut auth = [0u8; 24];
        client.read_exact(&mut auth).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(u32::from_le_bytes(auth[0..4].try_into().unwrap()), A_AUTH);
        let token_len = u32::from_le_bytes(auth[12..16].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
        let mut token = vec![0; token_len];
        client.read_exact(&mut token).unwrap();
        let key_dir = dir.join("generated-client-key");
        let key = mandroid::key::generate_at(&key_dir).unwrap();
        let mut payload = (key.public_text().unwrap().len() as u32)
            .to_le_bytes()
            .to_vec();
        payload.extend_from_slice(key.public_text().unwrap().as_bytes());
        payload.push(0);
        send_msg(&mut client, A_AUTH, ADB_AUTH_RSAPUBLICKEY, 0, &payload);
        assert!(server.join().unwrap().is_err());
        assert!(!persist::key_is_authorized(
            &dir,
            &key.public_text().unwrap()
        ));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(dir);
    }
}
```

## `crates/server/phone/src/apps.rs`

[view on disk](crates/server/phone/src/apps.rs)

```rust
//! The apps. Each one is a real screen with its own state, rendering and
//! touch handling — no mock content anywhere: lists show what the device
//! actually has, the browser makes real network requests, the files app
//! browses the real sdcard directory.

use crate::compose::{civil_from_days, KB_H, NAV_H, STATUS_H};
use crate::gfx::{in_rect, mix, Canvas, Rgb};
use crate::state::*;
use crate::theme::*;
use crate::theme::{ACCENT, BG, DIM, DIMMER, GREEN, RED, SURFACE, SURFACE_HI, TEXT};

// ── dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn render_app(c: &mut Canvas, st: &mut OsState, app: &AppId) {
    match app {
        AppId::Settings => render_settings(c, st),
        AppId::Calculator => render_calculator(c, st),
        AppId::Clock => render_clock(c, st),
        AppId::Messages => render_messages(c, st),
        AppId::Dialer => render_dialer(c, st),
        AppId::Browser => render_browser(c, st),
        AppId::Photos => render_photos(c, st),
        AppId::Files => render_files(c, st),
        AppId::Termux => render_termux(c, st),
        AppId::Magisk => render_magisk(c, st),
        AppId::RootExplorer => render_root_explorer(c, st),
        AppId::TitaniumBackup => render_titanium(c, st),
        AppId::User(_) => render_user_app(c, st, app),
    }
}

/// `true` if the app consumed Back internally (keeps it open); `false` = close.
pub fn go_back(st: &mut OsState, app: &AppId) -> bool {
    match app {
        AppId::Settings => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.settings;
            if ui.sel_app.is_some() {
                ui.sel_app = None;
            } else if ui.section != 0 {
                ui.section = 0;
            } else {
                return false;
            }
            true
        }
        AppId::Messages => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.messages;
            if ui.kb.visible {
                ui.kb.visible = false;
                ui.field = 0;
                return true;
            }
            if ui.open_thread.is_some() {
                ui.open_thread = None;
                ui.compose_to.clear();
                ui.compose_text.clear();
            } else {
                return false;
            }
            true
        }
        AppId::Dialer => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.dialer;
            if ui.call.is_some() {
                end_call(st);
                true
            } else if !ui.number.is_empty() {
                ui.number.pop();
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        AppId::Browser => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.browser;
            if ui.kb.visible {
                ui.kb.visible = false;
                ui.url_bar_focus = false;
                return true;
            }
            if ui.error.is_some() {
                ui.error = None;
                ui.lines.clear();
                return true;
            }
            if ui.history_idx.map_or(false, |i| i > 0) {
                browser_nav(st, -1);
                return true;
            }
            false
        }
        AppId::Photos => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.photos;
            if ui.viewer.is_some() {
                ui.viewer = None;
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        AppId::Files => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.files;
            if ui.detail.is_some() {
                ui.detail = None;
                return true;
            }
            if ui.cwd.parent().is_some() {
                ui.cwd = ui.cwd.parent().unwrap().to_path_buf();
                refresh_files(st);
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        AppId::Termux => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.termux;
            if ui.kb.visible {
                ui.kb.visible = false;
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        AppId::Magisk => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.magisk;
            if ui.sel_grant.is_some() {
                ui.sel_grant = None;
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        AppId::RootExplorer => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.rootexplorer;
            if ui.detail.is_some() {
                ui.detail = None;
                return true;
            }
            match &ui.cwd {
                None => false,
                Some(cwd) => {
                    if cwd == "/" {
                        ui.cwd = None;
                    } else {
                        ui.cwd = Some(
                            std::path::Path::new(cwd)
                                .parent()
                                .map(|p| p.display().to_string())
                                .unwrap_or_else(|| "/".to_string()),
                        );
                    }
                    refresh_root_explorer(st);
                    true
                }
            }
        }
        AppId::TitaniumBackup => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.titanium;
            if ui.log.len() > 12 {
                ui.log.clear();
                true
            } else {
                false
            }
        }
        AppId::Clock => false,
        AppId::Calculator => false,
        AppId::User(_) => false,
    }
}

pub fn key_enter(st: &mut OsState, app: &AppId) {
    match app {
        AppId::Termux => {
            let cmd = st.app.termux.input.trim().to_string();
            if !cmd.is_empty() {
                termux_run_command(st, &cmd, true);
            }
        }
        AppId::Messages => {
            let ui = &st.app.messages;
            if ui.open_thread.is_some() && !ui.compose_text.is_empty() {
                send_composed_sms(st);
            }
        }
        AppId::Browser => {
            navigate_browser(st);
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

pub fn key_del(st: &mut OsState, app: &AppId) {
    match app {
        AppId::Termux => {
            st.app.termux.input.pop();
        }
        AppId::Messages => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.messages;
            if ui.field == 0 {
                ui.compose_to.pop();
            } else {
                ui.compose_text.pop();
            }
        }
        AppId::Dialer => {
            st.app.dialer.number.pop();
        }
        AppId::Browser => {
            st.app.browser.url_bar.pop();
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

pub fn text_input(st: &mut OsState, app: &AppId, text: &str) {
    match app {
        AppId::Termux => {
            st.app.termux.input.push_str(text);
        }
        AppId::Messages => {
            let ui = &mut st.app.messages;
            if ui.field == 0 {
                ui.compose_to.push_str(text);
            } else {
                ui.compose_text.push_str(text);
            }
        }
        AppId::Dialer => {
            let digits: String = text
                .chars()
                .filter(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit() || *ch == '+' || *ch == '#')
                .collect();
            st.app.dialer.number.push_str(&digits);
        }
        AppId::Browser => {
            st.app.browser.url_bar.push_str(text);
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

// ── chrome shared by apps ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// App bar: title + accent underline.
fn app_bar(c: &mut Canvas, title: &str) {
    c.fill_rect(0, STATUS_H, c.w as i32, 96, SURFACE);
    c.text(36, STATUS_H + 26, title, 5, TEXT);
    c.fill_rect(0, STATUS_H + 94, c.w as i32, 2, mix(APP_BAR_LINE, BG, 0.0));
}

const APP_BAR_LINE: Rgb = [56, 66, 82];

fn row(c: &mut Canvas, y: i32, h: i32, title: &str, sub: &str, accent: Rgb) {
    let w = c.w as i32;
    c.fill_rect(0, y, w, h, SURFACE);
    c.fill_rect(0, y, 10, h, accent);
    c.text(40, y + h / 2 - 12, title, 4, TEXT);
    if !sub.is_empty() {
        let tw = Canvas::text_w(title, 4);
        c.text(40 + tw + 24, y + h / 2 - 6, sub, 2, DIM);
    }
    c.fill_rect(0, y + h - 1, w, 1, [16, 20, 26]);
}

fn toggle(c: &mut Canvas, x: i32, y: i32, on: bool) {
    let w = 72;
    c.round_rect(x, y, w, 36, 18, if on { GREEN } else { DIMMER });
    let kx = if on { x + w - 34 } else { x + 2 };
    c.circle(kx + 16, y + 18, 16, TEXT);
}

// ── Settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn render_settings(c: &mut Canvas, st: &OsState) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    let content_h = h as i32 - STATUS_H - NAV_H;
    let ui = &st.app.settings;
    if let Some(pkg) = ui.sel_app.clone() {
        app_bar(c, "App info");
        let y = STATUS_H + 120;
        let label = st
            .package(&pkg)
            .map(|p| p.label.clone())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let version = st
            .package(&pkg)
            .map(|p| p.version.clone())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let system = st.package(&pkg).map(|p| p.system).unwrap_or(true);
        c.round_rect(36, y, wi - 72, 200, 24, SURFACE);
        draw_app_icon(c, &AppId::User(pkg.clone()), wi / 2 - 44, y + 24, 88);
        c.text_center(wi / 2, y + 130, &label, 4, TEXT);
        c.text_center(wi / 2, y + 165, &pkg, 2, DIM);
        c.text_center(wi / 2, y + 240, &format!("version {version}"), 3, TEXT);
        c.text_center(
            wi / 2,
            y + 275,
            if system {
                "system package"
            } else {
                "user install"
            },
            2,
            DIM,
        );
        if !system {
            let by = y + 330;
            c.round_rect(wi / 2 - 120, by, 240, 64, 16, RED);
            c.text_center(wi / 2, by + 20, "Uninstall", 4, TEXT);
        }
        return;
    }
    match ui.section {
        0 => {
            app_bar(c, "Settings");
            let entries = [
                ("Network & internet", net_sub(st), ACCENT),
                ("Battery", format!("{}%", st.battery), GREEN),
                ("Display", display_sub(st), PURPLE),
                ("Apps", format!("{} installed", st.packages.len()), TEAL),
                ("System update", os_sub(st), ORANGE),
                ("About phone", st.identity.model.to_string(), ACCENT),
            ];
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let rh = 110;
            for (i, (title, sub, col)) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
                row(c, y0 + i as i32 * rh, rh, title, sub, *col);

        }
        1 => {
            app_bar(c, "Network & internet");
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let wifi_on = st.settings.get("wifi").map(String::as_str) == Some("on");
            let bt_on = st.settings.get("bluetooth").map(String::as_str) == Some("on");
            let ssid = st
                .settings
                .get("wifi_ssid")
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| mandroid::identity::WIFI_SSID.into());
            row(
                c,
                y0,
                110,
                "Wi-Fi",
                &format!("{ssid} - {} dBm", st.wifi.0),
                ACCENT,
            );
            c.round_rect(
                wi - 130,
                y0 + 36,
                72,
                36,
                18,
                if wifi_on { GREEN } else { DIMMER },
            );
            toggle(c, wi - 130, y0 + 36, wifi_on);
            row(
                c,
                y0 + 110,
                110,
                "Bluetooth",
                if bt_on { "On" } else { "Off" },
                ACCENT,
            );
            toggle(c, wi - 130, y0 + 146, bt_on);
            row(
                c,
                y0 + 220,
                110,
                "Airplane mode",
                if st.airplane_mode { "On" } else { "Off" },

            toggle(c, wi - 130, y0 + 256, st.airplane_mode);
            // the two registered eSIMs, live
            for (i, slot) in [1u32, 2].iter().enumerate() {

                let r = st.radio_now(*slot);
                let sub = if r.registered {

                };
                row(c, y, 110, &format!("eSIM {}", slot), &sub, TEAL);
            }
        }
        2 => {
            app_bar(c, "Battery");
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            c.round_rect(36, y0, wi - 72, 220, 24, SURFACE);
            let bw = (wi - 200) * st.battery as u32 as i32 / 100;
            c.round_rect(60, y0 + 50, wi - 120, 56, 14, [30, 36, 46]);
            c.round_rect(
                60,
                y0 + 50,
                bw.max(12),
                56,
                14,
                if st.charging { GREEN } else { ACCENT },
            );
            c.text_center(wi / 2, y0 + 130, &format!("{}%", st.battery), 6, TEXT);
            c.text_center(wi / 2, y0 + 170, "4700 mAh (Li-Po)", 2, DIM);
            c.text_center(
                wi / 2,
                y0 + 200,
                if st.charging {
                    "Charging (AC adapter)"
                } else {
                    "On battery"
                },
                2,
                DIM,
            );
            let by = y0 + 260;
            c.round_rect(wi / 2 - 140, by, 280, 64, 16, SURFACE_HI);
            c.text_center(
                wi / 2,
                by + 20,
                if st.charging {
                    "Unplug charger"
                } else {
                    "Plug in charger"
                },
                4,
                TEXT,
            );
        }
        3 => {
            app_bar(c, "Display");
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let (ew, eh) = st.effective_size();
            c.text(40, y0 + 6, "Resolution", 3, DIM);
            let res_opts: [(u32, u32, &str); 4] = [

            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let wi = w as i32;
            let installed = crate::os::read_manifest(&st.data_dir);
            c.round_rect(36, y0, wi - 72, 300, 24, SURFACE);
            c.text(64, y0 + 30, "OS image", 3, DIM);
            match &installed {
                Some(m) => {
                    c.text_fit(
                        64,
                        y0 + 60,
                        &format!("Android {} ({})", m.version, m.build_id),
                        5,
                        wi - 140,
                        TEXT,
                    );
                    c.text_fit(64, y0 + 120, &m.fingerprint, 2, wi - 140, DIM);
                    c.text(
                        64,
                        y0 + 160,
                        &format!(
                            "{} files, {} KiB — installed {}",
                            m.files,
                            m.bytes / 1024,
                            {
                                let days = (now_ms() - m.installed_at_ms) / 1000 / 86400;
                                if days <= 0 {
                                    "today".to_string()
                                } else {
                                    format!("{days}d ago")
                                }
                            }
                        ),
                        2,
                        DIM,
                    );
                    c.text(64, y0 + 195, &format!("kernel: {}", m.kernel), 2, DIM);
                }
                None => {
                    c.text(64, y0 + 60, "No OS image installed", 5, RED);
                    c.text(
                        64,
                        y0 + 120,
                        "The handset cannot boot without an image.",
                        3,
                        DIM,
                    );
                }
            }
            let by = y0 + 220;
            c.round_rect(wi / 2 - 170, by, 340, 64, 16, ACCENT);
            c.text_center(wi / 2, by + 20, "Install OS image", 4, [10, 14, 20]);
            let py = by + 96;
            c.text_fit(
                36,
                py,
                "The image is flashed through the bootloader: partition table → extract → \
                 checksum verify → manifest stamp. Root (Magisk 29.0) ships on the image; \
                 the device is rooted out of the box.",
                2,
                wi - 72,
                DIM,
            );
        }
        5 => {
            app_bar(c, "About phone");
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let facts: Vec<(&str, String)> = vec![
                ("Device model", st.identity.model.to_string()),
                ("Device name", st.identity.device.to_string()),
                ("Android version", st.android_release.clone()),
                ("SDK level", st.sdk_level.to_string()),
                ("Security patch", st.identity.security_patch.to_string()),
                ("Build fingerprint", st.fingerprint.clone()),
                ("Build type/tags", "user / release-keys".into()),
                ("Baseband", st.identity.baseband.clone()),
                ("Kernel", st.identity.kernel.to_string()),
                ("IMEI (slot 1)", st.identity.imei.clone()),
                ("IMEI (slot 2)", st.identity.imei2.clone()),
                ("Serial number", st.identity.serial.clone()),
                ("eUICC EID", st.identity.eid.clone()),
                (
                    "SoC",
                    format!("{} ({} cores)", st.identity.soc_model, st.cpu_cores),
                ),
                ("RAM", format!("{} GB", st.ram_mib / 1024)),
                (
                    "Storage",
                    if st.rom_gib >= 900 {
                        "1 TB".to_string()
                    } else {
                        format!("{} GB", st.rom_gib)
                    },
                ),
                (
                    "Root access",
                    if st.rooted {
                        format!(
                            "root (Magisk {}) — su in /system/xbin",
                            crate::os::magisk_version()
                        )
                    } else {
                        "unavailable".to_string()
                    },
                ),
                ("Reboots this session", st.reboots.to_string()),
                ("Uptime", uptime_str(st)),
            ];
            let rh = 86;
            let vis = ((content_h - 120) / rh).max(1) as usize;
            let scroll = ui.scroll.min(facts.len().saturating_sub(vis));
            for (i, (k, v)) in facts.iter().skip(scroll).take(vis).enumerate() {
                let y = y0 + i as i32 * rh;
                c.fill_rect(0, y, wi, rh, if i % 2 == 0 { SURFACE } else { BG });
                c.text(40, y + 10, k, 2, DIM);
                c.text_fit(40, y + 34, v, 3, wi - 80, TEXT);
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn net_sub(st: &OsState) -> String {
    if st.settings.get("wifi").map(String::as_str) == Some("on") {
        "Wi-Fi on".into()
    } else {
        "Wi-Fi off".into()
    }
}

fn display_sub(st: &OsState) -> String {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    format!("{}x{} @{}", w, h, st.effective_density())
}

/// The System update row subtitle — the installed OS image (or its absence).
fn os_sub(st: &OsState) -> String {
    if let Some(m) = crate::os::read_manifest(&st.data_dir) {
        format!("Android {} ({})", m.version, m.build_id)
    } else {
        "install OS image".into()
    }
}

fn uptime_str(st: &OsState) -> String {
    let s = st.booted_at.elapsed().unwrap_or_default().as_secs();
    format!("{}m {:02}s", s / 60, s % 60)
}

fn touch_settings(st: &mut OsState, x: i32, y: i32) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    let content_h = h as i32 - STATUS_H - NAV_H;
    let section = st.app.settings.section;
    match section {
        0 => {
            let entries = 6;
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let rh = 110;
            for i in 0..entries {
                if in_rect(x, y, 0, y0 + i as i32 * rh, wi, rh) {
                    st.app.settings.section = i + 1;
                    st.app.settings.scroll = 0;
                    st.dirty = true;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        1 => {
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            if in_rect(x, y, wi - 130, y0 + 36, 130, 80) {
                let cur = st.settings.get("wifi").map(String::as_str) == Some("on");
                st.settings
                    .insert("wifi".into(), if cur { "off" } else { "on" }.into());
                st.persist_dirty = true;
                st.dirty = true;
                return;
            }
            if in_rect(x, y, wi - 130, y0 + 146, 130, 80) {
                let cur = st.settings.get("bluetooth").map(String::as_str) == Some("on");
                st.settings
                    .insert("bluetooth".into(), if cur { "off" } else { "on" }.into());
                st.persist_dirty = true;
                st.dirty = true;
                return;
            }
            if in_rect(x, y, wi - 130, y0 + 256, 130, 80) {
                st.airplane_mode = !st.airplane_mode;
                st.notify(
                    "Network",
                    if st.airplane_mode {
                        "Airplane mode on — radios off"
                    } else {
                        "Airplane mode off — reattaching"
                    },
                    None,
                );
                st.persist_dirty = true;
                st.dirty = true;
                return;
            }
            // tap an eSIM row to make it the default data slot
            for (i, slot) in [1u32, 2].iter().enumerate() {
                if in_rect(x, y, 0, y0 + 330 + i as i32 * 110, wi, 110) {
                    if st.esim.data_slot != *slot && st.radio_now(*slot).registered {
                        st.esim.data_slot = *slot;
                        st.notify(
                            "SIM manager",
                            &format!("eSIM {slot} set as default for mobile data"),
                            None,
                        );
                        st.persist_dirty = true;
                    }
                    st.dirty = true;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
        2 => {
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            if in_rect(x, y, wi / 2 - 140, y0 + 260, 280, 64) {
                st.charging = !st.charging;
                st.persist_dirty = true;
                st.dirty = true;
            }
        }
        3 => {
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let res_opts = [(PANEL_W, PANEL_H), (1080, 2400), (540, 1200), (720, 1280)];
            for (i, (rw, rh)) in res_opts.iter().enumerate() {
                let ry = y0 + 40 + i as i32 * 80;
                if in_rect(x, y, 0, ry, wi, 80) {
                    if (*rw, *rh) == st.display {
                        st.size_override = None;
                    } else {
                        st.size_override = Some((*rw, *rh));
                    }
                    st.dirty = true;
                    st.persist_dirty = true;
                    return;
                }
            }
            let dy = y0 + 40 + 4 * 80 + 24;
            let dens_opts = [420u32, 340, 480, 560];
            for (i, d) in dens_opts.iter().enumerate() {
                let ry = dy + 40 + i as i32 * 80;
                if in_rect(x, y, 0, ry, wi, 80) {
                    if *d == st.density {
                        st.density_override = None;
                    } else {
                        st.density_override = Some(*d);
                    }
                    st.dirty = true;
                    st.persist_dirty = true;
                    return;
                }
            }
            let ry = dy + 40 + 4 * 80 + 30;
            if in_rect(x, y, 40, ry, wi - 80, 64) {
                st.size_override = None;
                st.density_override = None;
                st.dirty = true;
            }
        }
        4 => {
            // System update: the install button reboots to the bootloader and
            // re-flashes the image (the compositor runs the real installer)
            let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
            let by = y0 + 220;
            if in_rect(x, y, wi / 2 - 170, by, 340, 64) {
                st.inbox.lock().unwrap().push_back(OsEvent::OsInstall);
                st.notify(
                    "System update",
                    "Rebooting to bootloader to flash the OS image",
                    None,
                );
                st.dirty = true;
            }
        }
        5 => {
            // scroll about-phone rows with vertical drag handled as tap-top/bottom
            if y < STATUS_H + 160 {
                st.app.settings.scroll = st.app.settings.scroll.saturating_sub(1);
            } else if y > h as i32 - NAV_H - 160 {
                st.app.settings.scroll += 1;
            }
            st.dirty = true;
        }
        _ => {}
    }
    let _ = content_h;
}

// ── Calculator ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn render_calculator(c: &mut Canvas, st: &OsState) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    c.fill_rect(0, STATUS_H, wi, h as i32 - STATUS_H - NAV_H, BG);
    let ui = &st.app.calc;
    // history + expression + result
    let hist_y = STATUS_H + 40;
    if let Some(prev) = ui.history.last() {
        c.text_fit(
            wi - 40 - Canvas::text_w(prev, 2).max(0),
            hist_y,
            prev,
            2,
            wi - 80,
            DIMMER,
        );
    }
    let expr = ui.expr.clone();
    let disp = if expr.is_empty() {
        "0".to_string()
    } else {
        expr.clone()
    };
    let dw = Canvas::text_w(&disp, 6);
    c.text_fit(wi - 40 - dw.max(0), hist_y + 60, &disp, 6, wi - 80, TEXT);
    if let Some(res) = &ui.result {
        c.text_center(wi / 2, hist_y + 220, &format!("= {res}"), 4, ACCENT);
    }
    // keys
    let keys = [
        ["C", "+/-", "%", "÷"],
        ["7", "8", "9", "×"],
        ["4", "5", "6", "−"],
        ["1", "2", "3", "+"],
        ["0", ".", "⌫", "="],
    ];
    let top = h as i32 - NAV_H - 5 * 150 - 20;
    let cell_w = (wi - 32) / 4;
    for (r, rowk) in keys.iter().enumerate() {
        for (col, k) in rowk.iter().enumerate() {
            let kx = 16 + col as i32 * cell_w + 6;
            let ky = top + r as i32 * 150 + 10;
            let accent = matches!(*k, "=" | "÷" | "×" | "−" | "+");
            let special = matches!(*k, "C" | "+/-" | "%");
            let bg = if *k == "=" {
                ACCENT
            } else if accent {
                mix(ACCENT, SURFACE, 0.75)
            } else if special {
                mix(DIMMER, SURFACE, 0.55)
            } else {
                SURFACE
            };
            c.round_rect(kx, ky, cell_w - 12, 130, 20, bg);
            c.text_center(kx + (cell_w - 12) / 2, ky + 50, k, 5, TEXT);
        }
    }
}

fn touch_calculator(st: &mut OsState, x: i32, y: i32) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    let keys = [
        ["C", "+/-", "%", "÷"],
        ["7", "8", "9", "×"],
        ["4", "5", "6", "−"],
        ["1", "2", "3", "+"],
        ["0", ".", "⌫", "="],
    ];
    let top = h as i32 - NAV_H - 5 * 150 - 20;
    let cell_w = (wi - 32) / 4;
    for (r, rowk) in keys.iter().enumerate() {
        for (col, k) in rowk.iter().enumerate() {
            let kx = 16 + col as i32 * cell_w + 6;
            let ky = top + r as i32 * 150 + 10;
            if in_rect(x, y, kx, ky, cell_w - 12, 130) {
                press_calc_key(st, k);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

fn press_calc_key(st: &mut OsState, k: &str) {
    let ui = &mut st.app.calc;
    match k {
        "C" => {
            ui.expr.clear();
            ui.result = None;
        }
        "⌫" => {
            ui.expr.pop();
        }
        "+/-" => {
            if !ui.expr.is_empty() && !ui.expr.starts_with('-') {
                ui.expr = format!("-{}`", ui.expr.replace('`', ""));
            } else if let Some(rest) = ui.expr.strip_prefix('-') {
                ui.expr = rest.strip_suffix('`').unwrap_or(rest).to_string();
            }
        }
        "=" => {
            let r = eval_expr(&ui.expr);
            if let Some(v) = r {
                let v = fmt_num(v);
                ui.history.push(format!("{} = {}", ui.expr, v));
                ui.history.truncate(6);
                ui.result = Some(v.clone());
                ui.expr.clear();
            } else {
                ui.result = Some("error".into());
            }
        }
        other => {
            ui.expr.push_str(other);
        }
    }
    st.dirty = true;
}

fn fmt_num(v: f64) -> String {
    if v.fract() == 0.0 && v.abs() < 1e15 {
        format!("{}", v as i64)
    } else {
        format!("{v:.6}")
            .trim_end_matches('0')
            .trim_end_matches('.')
            .to_string()
    }
}

/// Straight shunting-yard evaluation with + − × ÷ % and unary minus.
pub fn eval_expr(src: &str) -> Option<f64> {
    let mut s = src.replace('×', "*").replace('÷', "/").replace('−', "-");
    if s.contains('`') {
        // the calculator's +/- key marks a negated group as `-expr…``;
        // honor it as -(expr) instead of deleting the marker
        if s.starts_with('-') {
            s = format!("(-({}", s[1..].replace('`', "))"));
        } else {
            s = s.replace('`', "");
        }
    }
    let mut out: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();
    let mut ops: Vec<char> = Vec::new();
    let chars: Vec<char> = s.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0usize;
    let mut expect_operand = true;
    while i < chars.len() {
        let ch = chars[i];
        if ch.is_ascii_digit() || ch == '.' {
            let start = i;
            while i < chars.len() && (chars[i].is_ascii_digit() || chars[i] == '.') {
                i += 1;
            }
            let tok: String = chars[start..i].iter().collect();
            out.push(tok.parse::<f64>().ok()?);
            expect_operand = false;
            continue;
        }
        if ch == ' ' {
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if ch == '-' && expect_operand {
            // unary minus: a prefix op binding tighter than * and /
            ops.push('~');
            expect_operand = true;
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if ch == '+' && expect_operand {
            // unary plus: no-op
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if ch == '(' {
            // subexpression: the open paren is a floor for the operator
            // stack — nothing to its left folds until the matching ')'
            ops.push('(');
            expect_operand = true;
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        if ch == ')' {
            // fold everything back to the matching '(' (unbalanced input
            // surfaces '(' in apply_op and degrades to None → verbatim)
            let mut matched = false;
            while let Some(top) = ops.pop() {
                if top == '(' {
                    matched = true;
                    break;
                }
                apply_op(&mut out, top)?;
            }
            if !matched {
                return None;
            }
            expect_operand = false;
            i += 1;
            continue;
        }
        match ch {
            '+' | '-' | '*' | '/' => {
                let prec = |o: char| match o {
                    '~' => 3, // unary minus
                    '*' | '/' => 2,
                    _ => 1,
                };
                while let Some(top) = ops.last() {
                    if *top == '(' {
                        break; // never fold across a subexpression boundary
                    }
                    if prec(*top) >= prec(ch) {
                        let op = ops.pop().unwrap();
                        apply_op(&mut out, op)?;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                ops.push(ch);
                expect_operand = true;
            }
            '%' => {
                let v = out.pop()?;
                out.push(v / 100.0);
                expect_operand = false;
            }
            _ => return None,
        }
        i += 1;
    }
    while let Some(op) = ops.pop() {
        apply_op(&mut out, op)?;
    }
    out.pop()
}

fn apply_op(out: &mut Vec<f64>, op: char) -> Option<()> {
    if op == '~' {
        // unary minus
        let a = out.pop()?;
        out.push(-a);
        return Some(());
    }
    let b = out.pop()?;
    let a = out.pop()?;
    let v = match op {
        '+' => a + b,
        '-' => a - b,
        '*' => a * b,
        '/' => {
            if b == 0.0 {
                return None;
            }
            a / b
        }
        _ => return None,
    };
    out.push(v);
    Some(())
}

// ── Clock ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn render_clock(c: &mut Canvas, st: &OsState) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    let content_h = h as i32 - STATUS_H - NAV_H;
    c.fill_rect(0, STATUS_H, wi, content_h, BG);
    // tabs
    for (i, t) in ["Clock", "Stopwatch"].iter().enumerate() {
        let tw = wi / 2;
        let sel = st.app.clock.tab
            == if i == 0 {
                ClockTab::Clock
            } else {
                ClockTab::Stopwatch
            };
        c.fill_rect(
            i as i32 * tw,
            STATUS_H,
            tw,
            88,
            if sel { SURFACE } else { BG },
        );
        c.text_center(
            i as i32 * tw + tw / 2,
            STATUS_H + 28,
            t,
            4,
            if sel { TEXT } else { DIM },
        );
        if sel {
            c.fill_rect(i as i32 * tw, STATUS_H + 86, tw, 3, ACCENT);
        }
    }
    let body_y = STATUS_H + 110;
    match st.app.clock.tab {
        ClockTab::Clock => {
            let secs = crate::state::now_secs() as u64;
            let (ss, hh, mm) = ((secs % 60), (secs / 60) % 60, (secs / 3600) % 24);
            let cy = body_y + 280;
            let cx = wi / 2;
            let r = 230;
            c.circle(cx, cy, r, SURFACE);
            c.ring(cx, cy, r - 4, [80, 92, 110]);
            for i in 0..12 {
                let a = i as f32 * std::f32::consts::FRAC_PI_6;
                let tx = cx + ((r - 34) as f32 * a.sin()).round() as i32;
                let ty = cy - ((r - 34) as f32 * a.cos()).round() as i32;
                c.circle(tx, ty, 8, DIM);
            }
            // hands
            let ha = (hh % 12) as f32 * 30.0 + mm as f32 * 0.5;
            let ma = mm as f32 * 6.0 + ss as f32 * 0.1;
            let sa = ss as f32 * 6.0;
            let mut hand = |ang: f32, len: i32, col: Rgb, wd: i32| {
                let rad = ang.to_radians();
                let ex = cx + (len as f32 * rad.sin()).round() as i32;
                let ey = cy - (len as f32 * rad.cos()).round() as i32;
                c.line(cx, cy, ex, ey, col, wd);
            };
            hand(ha, r - 110, TEXT, 16);
            hand(ma, r - 60, TEXT, 10);
            hand(sa, r - 40, RED, 4);
            c.circle(cx, cy, 14, ACCENT);
            c.text_center(
                cx,
                cy + r + 60,
                &format!("{hh:02}:{mm:02}:{ss:02}"),
                7,
                TEXT,
            );
            let days = crate::state::now_secs() as u64 / 86400;
            let (y, m, d) = civil_from_days(days as i64);
            c.text_center(cx, cy + r + 130, &format!("{y:04}-{m:02}-{d:02}"), 3, DIM);
        }
        ClockTab::Stopwatch => {
            let ms = stopwatch_ms(st);
            let t = format!("{:02}:{:02}.{:03}", ms / 60000, (ms / 1000) % 60, ms % 1000);
            c.text_center(wi / 2, body_y + 120, &t, 8, TEXT);
            let running = st.app.clock.started.is_some();
            // buttons
            let by = body_y + 420;
            let b1 = if running { "Stop" } else { "Start" };
            c.round_rect(
                wi / 2 - 260,
                by,
                240,
                90,
                20,
                if running { RED } else { GREEN },
            );
            c.text_center(wi / 2 - 140, by + 26, b1, 5, TEXT);
            c.round_rect(wi / 2 + 20, by, 240, 90, 20, SURFACE_HI);
            c.text_center(
                wi / 2 + 140,
                by + 26,
                if running { "Lap" } else { "Reset" },
                5,
                TEXT,
            );
            // laps
            for (i, lap) in st.app.clock.laps.iter().rev().take(4).enumerate() {
                let ly = by + 130 + i as i32 * 70;
                let lt = format!(
                    "{:02}:{:02}.{:03}",
                    lap / 60000,
                    (lap / 1000) % 60,
                    lap % 1000
                );
                c.text(
                    80,
                    ly,
                    &format!("Lap {}", st.app.clock.laps.len() - i),
                    3,
                    DIM,
                );
                c.text(wi - 80 - Canvas::text_w(&lt, 3), ly, &lt, 3, TEXT);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn stopwatch_ms(st: &OsState) -> u64 {
    let ui = &st.app.clock;
    let live = ui
        .started
        .map(|t0| t0.elapsed().unwrap_or_default().as_millis() as u64)
        .unwrap_or(0);
    ui.accumulated_ms + live
}

fn touch_clock(st: &mut OsState, x: i32, y: i32) {
    let (w, _h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    // tabs
    if y >= STATUS_H && y < STATUS_H + 88 {
        st.app.clock.tab = if x < wi / 2 {
            ClockTab::Clock
        } else {
            ClockTab::Stopwatch
        };
        st.dirty = true;
        return;
    }
    if st.app.clock.tab != ClockTab::Stopwatch {
        return;
    }
    let body_y = STATUS_H + 110;
    let by = body_y + 420;
    if y >= by && y < by + 90 {
        if x < wi / 2 {
            // start / stop
            if let Some(t0) = st.app.clock.started.take() {
                st.app.clock.accumulated_ms += t0.elapsed().unwrap_or_default().as_millis() as u64;
            } else {
                st.app.clock.started = Some(std::time::SystemTime::now());
            }
        } else {
            if st.app.clock.started.is_some() {
                // lap
                let ms = stopwatch_ms(st);
                st.app.clock.laps.push(ms);
            } else {
                st.app.clock.accumulated_ms = 0;
                st.app.clock.laps.clear();
            }
        }
        st.dirty = true;
    }
}

// ── Messages ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn render_messages(c: &mut Canvas, st: &OsState) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    let content_h = h as i32 - STATUS_H - NAV_H;
    c.fill_rect(0, STATUS_H, wi, content_h, BG);
    let ui = &st.app.messages;
    if let Some(addr) = &ui.open_thread {
        render_thread_view(c, st, addr);
        return;
    }
    if !ui.compose_to.is_empty() || !ui.compose_text.is_empty() {
        // compose screen
        app_bar(c, "New message");
        c.round_rect(32, STATUS_H + 120, wi - 64, 90, 16, SURFACE);
        c.text(
            52,
            STATUS_H + 148,
            &format!("To: {}", ui.compose_to),
            3,
            if ui.field == 0 { ACCENT } else { TEXT },
        );
        c.round_rect(32, STATUS_H + 230, wi - 64, 110, 16, SURFACE);
        c.text_fit(
            52,
            STATUS_H + 270,
            &ui.compose_text,
            3,
            wi - 120,
            if ui.field == 1 { ACCENT } else { TEXT },
        );
        c.round_rect(wi - 200, STATUS_H + 360, 168, 72, 16, ACCENT);
        c.text_center(wi - 116, STATUS_H + 386, "Send", 4, [10, 14, 20]);
        render_keyboard(c, st);
        return;
    }
    app_bar(c, "Messages");
    let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
    if st.sms.is_empty() {
        c.text_center(wi / 2, content_h / 2, "No messages", 4, DIM);
        c.text_center(
            wi / 2,
            content_h / 2 + 50,
            "Send one from a host:",
            2,
            DIMMER,
        );
        c.text_center(
            wi / 2,
            content_h / 2 + 80,
            "adb shell sms send <from> <text>",
            2,
            DIMMER,
        );
        return;
    }
    for (i, th) in st.sms.iter().rev().take(6).enumerate() {
        let y = y0 + i as i32 * 130;
        let last = th.messages.last();
        let (preview, mine) = last
            .map(|m| (m.text.clone(), m.mine))
            .unwrap_or((String::new(), false));
        c.fill_rect(0, y, wi, 130, SURFACE);
        c.circle(wi - 60, y + 65, 26, if mine { GREEN } else { ACCENT });
        c.text_center(
            wi - 60,
            y + 56,
            &address_initial(&th.address),
            3,
            [10, 14, 20],
        );
        c.text_fit(40, y + 20, &th.address, 4, wi - 160, TEXT);
        c.text_fit(40, y + 70, &preview, 2, wi - 160, DIM);
        c.fill_rect(0, y + 129, wi, 1, [16, 20, 26]);
    }
}

fn address_initial(addr: &str) -> String {
    addr.chars()
        .next()
        .map(|ch| ch.to_ascii_uppercase().to_string())
        .unwrap_or("?".into())
}

fn render_thread_view(c: &mut Canvas, st: &OsState, addr: &str) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    c.fill_rect(0, STATUS_H, wi, wi, BG);
    let thread = st.sms.iter().find(|t| &t.address == addr);
    let ui = &st.app.messages;
    let kb_top = h as i32 - NAV_H - if ui.kb.visible { KB_H } else { 0 };
    let input_h = 110;
    // input row at the bottom
    let iy = kb_top - input_h;
    c.fill_rect(0, iy, wi, input_h, SURFACE);
    c.round_rect(24, iy + 20, wi - 190, 70, 20, SURFACE_HI);
    c.text_fit(44, iy + 45, &ui.compose_text, 3, wi - 240, TEXT);
    c.round_rect(wi - 150, iy + 20, 126, 70, 20, ACCENT);
    c.text_center(wi - 87, iy + 45, "Send", 3, [10, 14, 20]);
    // bubbles
    let top = STATUS_H + 120;
    let avail = iy - top - 16;
    let msgs: Vec<&SmsMessage> = thread
        .map(|t| t.messages.iter().collect())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let rendered: Vec<Vec<String>> = msgs
        .iter()
        .map(|m| wrap_text(&m.text, (wi - 220) as usize, 3))
        .collect();
    let heights: Vec<i32> = rendered
        .iter()
        .map(|ls| (ls.len() as i32) * 44 + 40)
        .collect();
    let lines_total: i32 = heights.iter().sum();
    let scroll = lines_total.saturating_sub(avail).max(0) as i32;
    let mut yy = top - scroll;
    for (i, m) in msgs.iter().enumerate() {
        let bh = heights[i];
        if yy + bh > top && yy < iy {
            let bubble_w = wi - 220;
            let bx = if m.mine { wi - 60 - bubble_w } else { 60 };
            let col = if m.mine { ACCENT } else { SURFACE_HI };
            let tcol = if m.mine { [10, 14, 20] } else { TEXT };
            c.round_rect(bx, yy, bubble_w, bh - 24, 24, col);
            for (j, line) in rendered[i].iter().enumerate() {
                c.text(bx + 30, yy + 20 + j as i32 * 44, line, 3, tcol);
            }
        }
        yy += bh;
    }
    // header
    app_bar(c, addr);
    if ui.kb.visible {
        render_keyboard(c, st);
    }
}

pub fn wrap_text(s: &str, max_px: usize, px: u32) -> Vec<String> {
    // The 8x8 bitmap font advances 8 * px device pixels per character.
    let cap = (max_px / (px as usize * 8)).max(4);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for para in s.split('\n') {
        let mut line = String::new();
        for word in para.split(' ') {
            if line.chars().count() + word.chars().count() + 1 > cap && !line.is_empty() {
                out.push(line);
                line = String::new();
            }
            if !line.is_empty() {
                line.push(' ');
            }
            let mut w = word;
            while w.chars().count() > cap {
                // split at a char boundary: a byte index from the char count
                // panics on multibyte text
                let split = w.char_indices().nth(cap).map_or(w.len(), |(b, _)| b);
                out.push(w[..split].to_string());
                w = &w[split..];
            }
            line.push_str(w);
        }
        out.push(line);
    }
    out
}

fn touch_messages(st: &mut OsState, x: i32, y: i32) {
    let (w, h) = st.effective_size();
    let wi = w as i32;
    let ui = &st.app.messages;
    if ui.open_thread.is_some() {
        let kb_top = h as i32 - NAV_H - if ui.kb.visible { KB_H } else { 0 };
        let iy = kb_top - 110;
        if y >= iy {
            if x >= wi - 150 {
                send_composed_sms(st);
            } else {
                st.app.messages.field = 1;
                st.app.messages.kb.visible = true;
            }
            st.dirty = true;
            return;
        }
        if ui.kb.visible {
            if keyboard_touch(st, x, y) {
                return;
            }
        }
        // tapping a thread header does nothing; back handled by nav
        return;
    }
    if !ui.compose_to.is_empty() || !ui.compose_text.is_empty() {
        if in_rect(x, y, 32, STATUS_H + 120, wi - 64, 90) {
            st.app.messages.field = 0;
            st.app.messages.kb.visible = true;
        } else if in_rect(x, y, 32, STATUS_H + 230, wi - 64, 110) {
            st.app.messages.field = 1;
            st.app.messages.kb.visible = true;
        } else if in_rect(x, y, wi - 200, STATUS_H + 360, 168, 72) {
            send_composed_sms(st);
            return;
        } else if ui.kb.visible {
            keyboard_touch(st, x, y);
        }
        st.dirty = true;
        return;
    }
    // thread list
    let y0 = STATUS_H + 120;
    if y >= y0 {
        let idx = ((y - y0) / 130) as usize;
        let threads: Vec<String> = st
            .sms
            .iter()
            .rev()
            .take(6)
            .map(|t| t.address.clone())
            .collect();
        if let Some(addr) = threads.get(idx) {
            let addr = addr.clone();
            st.app.messages.open_thread = Some(addr);
            st.app.messages.field = 1;
            st.app.messages.kb.visible = true;
            st.dirty = true;
        }
    }
}

/// Insert an outgoing SMS into the store (the Messages app's send button).
fn send_composed_sms(st: &mut OsState) {
    let ui = &st.app.messages;
    let addr = ui
        .open_thread
        .clone()
        .unwrap_or_else(|| ui.compose_to.trim().to_string());
    let text = ui.compose_text.trim().to_string();
    if addr.is_empty() || text.is_empty() {
        return;
    }
    push_sms(
        st,
```
