## `crates/server/src/tunnel_cli.rs`

[view on disk](crates/server/src/tunnel_cli.rs)

```rust
//! `romacode-server tunnel …` — headless command line for the built-in
//! TCP tunnel (vendored chisel-rs). Same `run_cli -> Option<i32>` pattern
//! as `db` / `github` / `fetch`.
//!
//! Subcommands:
//!   `tunnel server [--bind 127.0.0.1:8443] [--auth TOKEN] [--reverse]`
//!                  start a chisel server (forwards a remote RomaCode's
//!                  traffic to local DBs)
//!   `tunnel client <server> <remote>... [--auth TOKEN]`
//!                  connect to a chisel server and open forwards
//!   `tunnel forward <profile_id>`
//!                  look up a db profile's `tunnel` field and open a forward
//!                  so the agent can reach that remote DB locally
//!
//! `tunnel forward` is the bridge between `config.databases.profiles[].tunnel`
//! and the db tools: it opens the forward, prints the local `host:port`, and
//! exits (the forward runs in a foreground thread the operator can Ctrl-C).

use crate::config::Config;
use romacode_tunnel::Tunnel;

/// Entry point. Returns `Some(exit_code)` when handled, `None` otherwise.
pub fn run_cli(args: &[String]) -> Option<i32> {
    if args.first()?.as_str() != "tunnel" {
        return None;
    }
    let sub = args.get(1).map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("help");
    let rest = &args[2.min(args.len())..];
    let code = match sub {
        "server" | "listen" => cmd_server(rest),
        "client" | "connect" => cmd_client(rest),
        "forward" | "fwd" => cmd_forward(rest),
        "help" | "-h" | "--help" => { print_help(); 0 }
        other => { eprintln!("tunnel: unknown subcommand '{other}' (try: tunnel help)"); 2 }
    };
    Some(code)
}

fn cmd_server(rest: &[String]) -> i32 {
    let mut bind = "127.0.0.1:8443".to_string();
    let mut auth: Option<String> = None;
    let mut reverse = false;
    let mut it = rest.iter();
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        match a.as_str() {
            "--bind" | "-b" => { if let Some(v) = it.next() { bind = v.clone(); } }
            "--auth" => { if let Some(v) = it.next() { auth = Some(v.clone()); } }
            "--reverse" => { reverse = true; }
            other => { eprintln!("tunnel server: unknown flag {other}"); return 2; }
        }
    }
    eprintln!("tunnel server: listening on {bind} (reverse={reverse}, auth={})",
              if auth.is_some() { "yes" } else { "no" });
    // blocking — runs until Ctrl-C or the listener errors
    match Tunnel::serve(&bind, auth, reverse) {
        Ok(t) => {
            // the server thread runs forever; block this thread on a park
            while !t.is_stopped() {
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
            }
            eprintln!("tunnel server: stopped");
            0
        }
        Err(e) => { eprintln!("tunnel server failed: {e}"); 1 }
    }
}

fn cmd_client(rest: &[String]) -> i32 {
    if rest.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("usage: tunnel client <server> <remote>... [--auth TOKEN]");
        return 2;
    }
    let server = &rest[0];
    let mut auth: Option<String> = None;
    let mut remotes = Vec::new();
    let mut it = rest.iter().skip(1);
    while let Some(a) = it.next() {
        if a == "--auth" { if let Some(v) = it.next() { auth = Some(v.clone()); } continue; }
        remotes.push(a.clone());
    }
    if remotes.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("tunnel client: need at least one remote spec (e.g. 5432:db.host:5432)");
        return 2;
    }
    // open all forwards; keep them alive in this foreground thread
    let mut tunnels = Vec::new();
    for r in &remotes {
        match Tunnel::forward(server, r, auth.clone()) {
            Ok(t) => {
                eprintln!("tunnel client: forwarding {} -> {}", r, t.local_addr());
                tunnels.push(t);
            }
            Err(e) => { eprintln!("tunnel client: {r} failed: {e}"); return 1; }
        }
    }
    // block until all stop
    while tunnels.iter().any(|t| !t.is_stopped()) {
        std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
    }
    0
}

fn cmd_forward(rest: &[String]) -> i32 {
    if rest.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("usage: tunnel forward <profile_id>");
        return 2;
    }
    let pid = &rest[0];
    let cfg = Config::load();
    let profile = cfg.databases.profiles.iter().find(|p| p.id == *pid).cloned();
    let Some(profile) = profile else {
        eprintln!("tunnel forward: no db profile '{pid}'");
        return 1;
    };
    if profile.tunnel.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("tunnel forward: profile '{pid}' has no tunnel target configured (set databases.profiles[].tunnel)");
        return 1;
    }
    // The tunnel field is a chisel remote spec, optionally with a server
    // prefix separated by '@'. Convention:
    //   "server.host:port|5432:db.internal:5432"
    let (server, remote) = match profile.tunnel.split_once('|') {
        Some((s, r)) => (s.trim().to_string(), r.trim().to_string()),
        None => {
            eprintln!("tunnel forward: profile '{pid}' tunnel value must be '<server>|<remote-spec>'");
            return 1;
        }
    };
    // resolve the auth token from the profile's url_env if present (shared
    // secret convention: the env var may hold either a full URL or just the
    // token; we use it verbatim as the chisel auth token when set)
    let auth = if profile.url_env.is_empty() { None }
               else { std::env::var(&profile.url_env).ok() };
    match Tunnel::forward(&server, &remote, auth) {
        Ok(t) => {
            eprintln!("tunnel forward: {pid} -> {} (via {server})", t.local_addr());
            eprintln!("  the agent can now db_use a profile pointing at {} and run queries", t.local_addr());
            // block until the tunnel ends
            while !t.is_stopped() {
                std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_millis(500));
            }
            0
        }
        Err(e) => { eprintln!("tunnel forward failed: {e}"); 1 }
    }
}

fn print_help() {
    println!("romacode-server tunnel — built-in TCP tunnel (chisel-rs)\n");
    println!("USAGE:");
    println!("  romacode-server tunnel server [--bind 127.0.0.1:8443] [--auth TOKEN] [--reverse]");
    println!("      start a chisel server. Other RomaCode instances connect to it");
    println!("      to reach THIS machine's local databases.\n");
    println!("  romacode-server tunnel client <server> <remote>... [--auth TOKEN]");
    println!("      connect to a chisel server and open forwards.");
    println!("      remote spec examples: 5432 | db.host:5432 | 5432:db.host:5432 | R:2222:localhost:22\n");
    println!("  romacode-server tunnel forward <profile_id>");
    println!("      open the tunnel declared by config.databases.profiles[<id>].tunnel");
    println!("      (format: '<chisel-server>|<remote-spec>'); blocks until Ctrl-C.\n");
    println!("AUTH: shared secret between chisel client and server; pass via --auth or");
    println!("      the profile's url_env environment variable (for `tunnel forward`).");
}
```

[view on disk](crates/server/src/webfetch/html.rs)

````rust
//! Tiny forgiving HTML parser + extractors for `web_fetch` (std only).
//!
//! Ported in spirit from webfetch-tui's modes: readable text (Read), Markdown
//! (Md), CSS selection (Scrape) and link listing — without any dependency, so
//! it builds anywhere RomaCode builds. It is not a spec-complete HTML5 parser;
//! it is bounded (node and depth caps) and never panics on malformed input.
//! All truncation is by `char`, never by byte index (the UTF-8 panic class the
//! webfetch-tui 1.0.0 patch fixed).
use super::url::{join, Url};

const MAX_NODES: usize = 200_000;
const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 256;

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Node {
    pub name: String,
    pub attrs: Vec<(String, String)>,
    pub children: Vec<Child>,
    pub parent: Option<usize>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum Child {
    Node(usize),
    Text(String),
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Dom {
    /// `nodes[0]` is the synthetic `#root`.
    pub nodes: Vec<Node>,
}

const VOID: &[&str] = &[
    "area", "base", "br", "col", "embed", "hr", "img", "input", "link", "meta", "param", "source",
    "track", "wbr",
];
const BLOCK_STARTS_P: &[&str] = &[
    "address",
    "article",
    "aside",
    "blockquote",
    "div",
    "dl",
    "fieldset",
    "figure",
    "footer",
    "form",
    "h1",
    "h2",
    "h3",
    "h4",
    "h5",
    "h6",
    "header",
    "hr",
    "main",
    "nav",
    "ol",
    "p",
    "pre",
    "section",
    "table",
    "ul",
];

fn is_void(n: &str) -> bool {
    VOID.contains(&n)
}

/// Truncate to at most `n` chars, appending `…` when something was cut.
pub fn truncate_chars(s: &str, n: usize) -> String {
    match s.char_indices().nth(n) {
        Some((i, _)) => format!("{}…", &s[..i]),
        None => s.to_string(),
    }
}

pub fn decode_entities(s: &str) -> String {
    if !s.contains('&') {
        return s.to_string();
    }
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut rest = s;
    while let Some(i) = rest.find('&') {
        out.push_str(&rest[..i]);
        rest = &rest[i..];
        // an entity is at most ~10 chars; look for ';' within a short window
        let window_end = rest.char_indices().nth(12).map_or(rest.len(), |(i, _)| i);
        match rest[..window_end].find(';') {
            Some(semi) => {
                let name = &rest[1..semi];
                match entity(name) {
                    Some(ch) => {
                        out.push_str(&ch);
                        rest = &rest[semi + 1..];
                    }
                    None => {
                        out.push('&');
                        rest = &rest[1..];
                    }
                }
            }
            None => {
                out.push('&');
                rest = &rest[1..];
            }
        }
    }
    out.push_str(rest);
    out
}

fn entity(name: &str) -> Option<String> {
    if let Some(num) = name.strip_prefix('#') {
        let code = match num.strip_prefix(['x', 'X']) {
            Some(h) => u32::from_str_radix(h, 16).ok()?,
            None => num.parse::<u32>().ok()?,
        };
        return char::from_u32(code)
            .filter(|c| *c != '\0')
            .map(|c| c.to_string());
    }
    let s = match name {
        "amp" => "&",
        "lt" => "<",
        "gt" => ">",
        "quot" => "\"",
        "apos" => "'",
        "nbsp" => " ",
        "ndash" => "–",
        "mdash" => "—",
        "hellip" => "…",
        "lsquo" => "‘",
        "rsquo" => "’",
        "ldquo" => "“",
        "rdquo" => "”",
        "laquo" => "«",
        "raquo" => "»",
        "copy" => "©",
        "reg" => "®",
        "trade" => "™",
        "middot" => "·",
        "bull" => "•",
        "times" => "×",
        "euro" => "€",
        "pound" => "£",
        "yen" => "¥",
        "deg" => "°",
        "larr" => "←",
        "rarr" => "→",
        _ => return None,
    };
    Some(s.to_string())
}

impl Dom {
    pub fn parse(html: &str) -> Dom {
        let mut dom = Dom {
            nodes: vec![Node {
                name: "#root".into(),
                attrs: vec![],
                children: vec![],
                parent: None,
            }],
        };
        let mut stack: Vec<usize> = vec![0];
        let b = html.as_bytes();
        let mut i = 0;
        let mut text_start = 0;

        macro_rules! flush_text {
            ($end:expr) => {{
                if $end > text_start {
                    let t = &html[text_start..$end];
                    if !t.is_empty() {
                        let top = *stack.last().unwrap();
                        dom.nodes[top]
                            .children
                            .push(Child::Text(decode_entities(t)));
                    }
                }
            }};
        }

        while i < b.len() {
            if b[i] != b'<' {
                i += 1;
                continue;
            }
            let rest = &html[i..];
            if rest.starts_with("<!--") {
                flush_text!(i);
                i = match rest.find("-->") {
                    Some(e) => i + e + 3,
                    None => b.len(),
                };
                text_start = i;
                continue;
            }
            if rest.starts_with("<!") || rest.starts_with("<?") {
                flush_text!(i);
                i = match rest.find('>') {
                    Some(e) => i + e + 1,
                    None => b.len(),
                };
                text_start = i;
                continue;
            }
            if let Some(after) = rest.strip_prefix("</") {
                if after.starts_with(|c: char| c.is_ascii_alphabetic()) {
                    flush_text!(i);
                    let end = rest.find('>').map_or(b.len(), |e| i + e + 1);
                    let name: String = after
                        .chars()
                        .take_while(|c| !c.is_whitespace() && *c != '>' && *c != '/')
                        .collect::<String>()
                        .to_ascii_lowercase();
                    if let Some(pos) = stack.iter().rposition(|&n| dom.nodes[n].name == name) {
                        if pos > 0 {
                            stack.truncate(pos);
                        }
                    }
                    i = end;
                    text_start = i;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if rest[1..].starts_with(|c: char| c.is_ascii_alphabetic()) {
                flush_text!(i);
                let (name, attrs, self_closing, end) = parse_open_tag(html, i);
                i = end;
                text_start = i;
                // implied end tags
                implied_close(&dom, &mut stack, &name);
                let top = *stack.last().unwrap();
                if dom.nodes.len() < MAX_NODES {
                    let idx = dom.nodes.len();
                    dom.nodes.push(Node {
                        name: name.clone(),
                        attrs,
                        children: vec![],
                        parent: Some(top),
                    });
                    dom.nodes[top].children.push(Child::Node(idx));
                    let raw_text =
                        matches!(name.as_str(), "script" | "style" | "textarea" | "title");
                    if raw_text && !self_closing {
                        // contents are not markup: find the matching close tag.
                        // Case-insensitive search WITHOUT lowercasing the rest
                        // of the document — every script/style/title/textarea
                        // open tag used to allocate a lowercased copy of the
                        // entire remaining page (~500 MB of churn on a 1 MB
                        // page with scattered scripts).
                        let close = format!("</{name}").into_bytes();
                        let close = match find_ignore_case(&b[i..], &close) {
                            Some(p) => {
                                let gt = b[i + p..]
                                    .iter()
                                    .position(|&c| c == b'>')
                                    .map_or(b.len() - i, |g| p + g + 1);
                                (i + p, i + gt)
                            }
                            None => (b.len(), b.len()),
                        };
                        let (body_end, resume) = close;
                        if name == "title" || name == "textarea" {
                            let t = &html[i..body_end];
                            if !t.is_empty() {
                                dom.nodes[idx]
                                    .children
                                    .push(Child::Text(decode_entities(t)));
                            }
                        }
                        i = resume;
                        text_start = i;
                    } else if !is_void(&name) && !self_closing && stack.len() < MAX_DEPTH {
                        stack.push(idx);
                    }
                }
                continue;
            }
            i += 1; // a lone '<' is just text
        }
        flush_text!(b.len());
        dom
    }

    pub fn attr(&self, n: usize, name: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        self.nodes[n]
            .attrs
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| k == name)
            .map(|(_, v)| v.as_str())
    }

    /// Whitespace-collapsed text of a subtree (scripts/styles excluded by construction).
    pub fn text(&self, n: usize) -> String {
        let mut raw = String::new();
        self.collect_text(n, &mut raw, 0);
        collapse_ws(&raw)
    }

    fn collect_text(&self, n: usize, out: &mut String, depth: usize) {
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH + 8 {
            return;
        }
        for c in &self.nodes[n].children {
            match c {
                Child::Text(t) => {
                    out.push_str(t);
                    out.push(' ');
                }
                Child::Node(i) => {
                    if matches!(
                        self.nodes[*i].name.as_str(),
                        "script" | "style" | "noscript" | "template"
                    ) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    self.collect_text(*i, out, depth + 1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    pub fn find_first(&self, name: &str) -> Option<usize> {
        (1..self.nodes.len()).find(|&i| self.nodes[i].name == name)
    }

    pub fn title(&self) -> Option<String> {
        self.find_first("title")
            .map(|t| self.text(t))
            .filter(|t| !t.is_empty())
    }
}

fn collapse_ws(s: &str) -> String {
    s.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
}

/// Case-insensitive substring search over ASCII (HTML tag names are ASCII).
/// Allocates nothing — the lowercased-remainder scan this replaces used to
/// allocate a full copy of the document tail for every raw-text open tag.
fn find_ignore_case(hay: &[u8], needle: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {
    if needle.is_empty() || hay.len() < needle.len() {
        return None;
    }
    (0..=hay.len() - needle.len()).find(|&i| hay[i..i + needle.len()].eq_ignore_ascii_case(needle))
}

/// Parse `<name attr=...>` starting at `start` (which points at `<`).
/// Returns (lowercased name, attrs, self_closing, index just past `>`).
fn parse_open_tag(html: &str, start: usize) -> (String, Vec<(String, String)>, bool, usize) {
    let b = html.as_bytes();
    let mut i = start + 1;
    let name_start = i;
    while i < b.len() && !b[i].is_ascii_whitespace() && b[i] != b'>' && b[i] != b'/' {
        i += 1;
    }
    let name = html[name_start..i].to_ascii_lowercase();
    let mut attrs = Vec::new();
    let mut self_closing = false;
    loop {
        while i < b.len() && (b[i].is_ascii_whitespace() || b[i] == b'/') {
            if b[i] == b'/' {
                self_closing = true;
            }
            i += 1;
        }
        if i >= b.len() {
            break;
        }
        if b[i] == b'>' {
            i += 1;
            break;
        }
        self_closing = false;
        let ks = i;
        while i < b.len()
            && !b[i].is_ascii_whitespace()
            && b[i] != b'='
            && b[i] != b'>'
            && b[i] != b'/'
        {
            i += 1;
        }
        let key = html[ks..i].to_ascii_lowercase();
        while i < b.len() && b[i].is_ascii_whitespace() {
            i += 1;
        }
        let mut value = String::new();
        if i < b.len() && b[i] == b'=' {
            i += 1;
            while i < b.len() && b[i].is_ascii_whitespace() {
                i += 1;
            }
            if i < b.len() && (b[i] == b'"' || b[i] == b'\'') {
                let q = b[i];
                i += 1;
                let vs = i;
                while i < b.len() && b[i] != q {
                    i += 1;
                }
                value = decode_entities(&html[vs..i]);
                i = (i + 1).min(b.len());
            } else {
                let vs = i;
                while i < b.len() && !b[i].is_ascii_whitespace() && b[i] != b'>' {
                    i += 1;
                }
                value = decode_entities(&html[vs..i]);
            }
        }
        if !key.is_empty() && attrs.len() < 64 {
            attrs.push((key, value));
        }
    }
    (name, attrs, self_closing, i)
}

fn implied_close(dom: &Dom, stack: &mut Vec<usize>, opening: &str) {
    let top_name = |s: &Vec<usize>| dom.nodes[*s.last().unwrap()].name.clone();
    if BLOCK_STARTS_P.contains(&opening) && top_name(stack) == "p" {
        stack.pop();
    }
    match opening {
        "li" => {
            // close an open <li> in the current list only
            if let Some(pos) = stack
                .iter()
                .rposition(|&n| matches!(dom.nodes[n].name.as_str(), "li" | "ul" | "ol"))
            {
                if dom.nodes[stack[pos]].name == "li" {
                    stack.truncate(pos);
                }
            }
        }
        "td" | "th" => {
            if let Some(pos) = stack
                .iter()
                .rposition(|&n| matches!(dom.nodes[n].name.as_str(), "td" | "th" | "tr" | "table"))
            {
                if matches!(dom.nodes[stack[pos]].name.as_str(), "td" | "th") {
                    stack.truncate(pos);
                }
            }
        }
        "tr" => {
            if let Some(pos) = stack
                .iter()
                .rposition(|&n| matches!(dom.nodes[n].name.as_str(), "tr" | "table"))
            {
                if dom.nodes[stack[pos]].name == "tr" {
                    stack.truncate(pos);
                }
            }
        }
        "option" => {
            if top_name(stack) == "option" {
                stack.pop();
            }
        }
        _ => {}
    }
}

// ── readable text / markdown ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

const SKIP: &[&str] = &[
    "head", "script", "style", "noscript", "template", "svg", "canvas", "iframe", "object",
    "embed", "nav", "footer", "aside", "select", "button", "dialog",
];
const BLOCK: &[&str] = &[
    "address",
    "article",
    "aside",
    "blockquote",
    "details",
    "div",
    "dl",
    "dt",
    "dd",
    "fieldset",
    "figcaption",
    "figure",
    "footer",
    "form",
    "h1",
    "h2",
    "h3",
    "h4",
    "h5",
    "h6",
    "header",
    "main",
    "nav",
    "ol",
    "p",
    "section",
    "summary",
    "table",
    "ul",
];

struct Renderer<'a> {
    dom: &'a Dom,
    base: &'a Url,
    md: bool,
    out: String,
    pending_space: bool,
    list: Vec<Option<usize>>, // None = bullet, Some(n) = next ordered number
}

/// Choose the main content root: `<main>`, else a lone `<article>`, else `<body>`.
fn content_root(dom: &Dom) -> usize {
    if let Some(m) = dom.find_first("main") {
        return m;
    }
    let articles: Vec<usize> = (1..dom.nodes.len())
        .filter(|&i| dom.nodes[i].name == "article")
        .collect();
    if articles.len() == 1 {
        return articles[0];
    }
    dom.find_first("body").unwrap_or(0)
}

/// Render the page's main content as plain text (`md = false`) or Markdown.
pub fn render(dom: &Dom, base: &Url, md: bool) -> String {
    let root = content_root(dom);
    let mut r = Renderer {
        dom,
        base,
        md,
        out: String::new(),
        pending_space: false,
        list: vec![],
    };
    // the chosen root itself is never skipped, only its boilerplate descendants
    r.children(root, 0);
    tidy(&r.out)
}

fn tidy(s: &str) -> String {
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(s.len());
    let mut blank = 0;
    for line in s.lines() {
        let l = line.trim_end();
        if l.is_empty() {
            blank += 1;
            if blank <= 1 && !out.is_empty() {
                out.push('\n');
            }
        } else {
            blank = 0;
            out.push_str(l);
            out.push('\n');
        }
    }
    out.trim().to_string()
}

impl Renderer<'_> {
    fn ensure_newline(&mut self) {
        self.pending_space = false;
        if !self.out.is_empty() && !self.out.ends_with('\n') {
            self.out.push('\n');
        }
    }

    fn ensure_blank(&mut self) {
        self.ensure_newline();
        if !self.out.is_empty() && !self.out.ends_with("\n\n") {
            self.out.push('\n');
        }
    }

    fn text(&mut self, t: &str) {
        for ch in t.chars() {
            if ch.is_whitespace() {
                self.pending_space = true;
            } else {
                if self.pending_space && !self.out.is_empty() && !self.out.ends_with('\n') {
                    self.out.push(' ');
                }
                self.pending_space = false;
                self.out.push(ch);
            }
        }
    }

    fn children(&mut self, n: usize, depth: usize) {
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH + 8 {
            return;
        }
        let kids: Vec<&Child> = self.dom.nodes[n].children.iter().collect();
        for c in kids {
            match c {
                Child::Text(t) => self.text(t),
                Child::Node(i) => self.node(*i, depth + 1),
            }
        }
    }

    fn wrap_inline(&mut self, n: usize, depth: usize, mark: &str) {
        let start = self.out.len();
        self.children(n, depth);
        let inner = self.out.split_off(start);
        if inner.trim().is_empty() {
            self.out.push_str(&inner);
        } else {
            let lead = inner.len() - inner.trim_start().len();
            self.out.push_str(&inner[..lead]);
            self.out.push_str(mark);
            self.out.push_str(inner.trim());
            self.out.push_str(mark);
        }
    }

    fn node(&mut self, n: usize, depth: usize) {
        let name = self.dom.nodes[n].name.clone();
        if SKIP.contains(&name.as_str()) {
            return;
        }
        match name.as_str() {
            "br" => {
                self.pending_space = false;
                self.out.push('\n');
            }
            "hr" => {
                self.ensure_blank();
                self.out.push_str(if self.md { "---" } else { "----" });
                self.ensure_blank();
            }
            "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" | "h5" | "h6" => {
                self.ensure_blank();
                if self.md {
                    let level = name.as_bytes()[1] - b'0';
                    self.out.push_str(&"#".repeat(level as usize));
                    self.out.push(' ');
                }
                self.children(n, depth);
                self.ensure_blank();
            }
            "pre" => {
                self.ensure_blank();
                let mut code = String::new();
                self.dom.collect_pre(n, &mut code, 0);
                if self.md {
                    self.out.push_str("```\n");
                    self.out.push_str(code.trim_matches('\n'));
                    self.out.push_str("\n```");
                } else {
                    self.out.push_str(code.trim_matches('\n'));
                }
                self.ensure_blank();
            }
            "ul" | "ol" => {
                self.ensure_newline();
                self.list.push(if name == "ol" { Some(1) } else { None });
                self.children(n, depth);
                self.list.pop();
                self.ensure_newline();
                if self.list.is_empty() {
                    self.ensure_blank();
                }
            }
            "li" => {
                self.ensure_newline();
                let indent = "  ".repeat(self.list.len().saturating_sub(1));
                let marker = match self.list.last_mut() {
                    Some(Some(k)) => {
                        let m = format!("{k}. ");
                        *k += 1;
                        m
                    }
                    _ => "- ".to_string(),
                };
                self.out.push_str(&indent);
                self.out.push_str(&marker);
                self.children(n, depth);
                self.ensure_newline();
            }
            "blockquote" => {
                self.ensure_blank();
                let start = self.out.len();
                self.children(n, depth);
                self.ensure_blank();
                let inner = self.out.split_off(start);
                for line in inner.trim_end().lines() {
                    self.out.push_str(if self.md { "> " } else { "  " });
                    self.out.push_str(line);
                    self.out.push('\n');
                }
                self.ensure_blank();
            }
            "table" => {
                self.ensure_blank();
                self.children(n, depth);
                self.ensure_blank();
            }
            "tr" => {
                self.ensure_newline();
                let cells: Vec<usize> = self.dom.nodes[n]
                    .children
                    .iter()
                    .filter_map(|c| match c {
                        Child::Node(i)
                            if matches!(self.dom.nodes[*i].name.as_str(), "td" | "th") =>
                        {
                            Some(*i)
                        }
                        _ => None,
                    })
                    .collect();
                if cells.is_empty() {
                    self.children(n, depth);
                } else {
                    for (k, cell) in cells.into_iter().enumerate() {
                        if k > 0 {
                            self.out.push_str(" | ");
                        }
                        self.pending_space = false;
                        self.children(cell, depth + 1);
                    }
                }
                self.ensure_newline();
            }
            "a" => {
                let href = self
                    .dom
                    .attr(n, "href")
                    .and_then(|h| join(self.base, h))
                    .map(|u| u.to_string());
                match (self.md, href) {
                    (true, Some(h)) => {
                        let start = self.out.len();
                        self.children(n, depth);
                        let inner = self.out.split_off(start);
                        let label = inner.trim();
                        if label.is_empty() {
                            self.out.push_str(&inner);
                        } else {
                            let lead = inner.len() - inner.trim_start().len();
                            self.out.push_str(&inner[..lead]);
                            self.out.push_str(&format!("[{label}]({h})"));
                        }
                    }
                    _ => self.children(n, depth),
                }
            }
            "img" => {
                let alt = self.dom.attr(n, "alt").map(collapse_ws).unwrap_or_default();
                if self.md && !alt.is_empty() {
                    if let Some(src) = self.dom.attr(n, "src").and_then(|s| join(self.base, s)) {
                        self.pending_space = true;
                        self.text(&format!("![{alt}]({src})"));
                    }
                } else if !alt.is_empty() {
                    self.text(&format!("[{alt}]"));
                }
            }
            "strong" | "b" if self.md => self.wrap_inline(n, depth, "**"),
            "em" | "i" if self.md => self.wrap_inline(n, depth, "*"),
            "code" if self.md => self.wrap_inline(n, depth, "`"),
            _ if BLOCK.contains(&name.as_str()) => {
                self.ensure_blank();
                self.children(n, depth);
                self.ensure_blank();
            }
            _ => self.children(n, depth),
        }
    }
}

impl Dom {
    /// Raw text for `<pre>`: whitespace preserved, `<br>` as newline.
    fn collect_pre(&self, n: usize, out: &mut String, depth: usize) {
        if depth > MAX_DEPTH + 8 {
            return;
        }
        for c in &self.nodes[n].children {
            match c {
                Child::Text(t) => out.push_str(t),
                Child::Node(i) => {
                    if self.nodes[*i].name == "br" {
                        out.push('\n');
                    } else if !matches!(self.nodes[*i].name.as_str(), "script" | "style") {
                        self.collect_pre(*i, out, depth + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// ── links ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// All fetchable links in document order, de-duplicated by URL: `(text, url)`.
pub fn links(dom: &Dom, base: &Url) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
    let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for i in 1..dom.nodes.len() {
        if dom.nodes[i].name != "a" {
            continue;
        }
        let Some(url) = dom.attr(i, "href").and_then(|h| join(base, h)) else {
            continue;
        };
        let url = url.to_string();
        if seen.insert(url.clone()) {
            let mut text = dom.text(i);
            if text.is_empty() {
                text = dom
                    .attr(i, "title")
                    .or_else(|| dom.attr(i, "aria-label"))
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .to_string();
            }
            out.push((truncate_chars(&text, 80), url));
        }
    }
    out
}

// ── CSS selectors (subset) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Supported: `tag`, `*`, `#id`, `.class`, `[attr]`, `[attr=v]`, `[attr*=v]`,
// `[attr^=v]`, `[attr$=v]`, `[attr~=v]`, compounds (`a.btn#x[href]`), the
// descendant (` `) and child (`>`) combinators, and `,` lists.
// Pseudo-classes / `+` / `~` are rejected with a clear error.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
enum Comb {
    Descendant,
    Child,
}

#[derive(Debug, Default)]
struct Compound {
    tag: Option<String>,
    id: Option<String>,
    classes: Vec<String>,
    attrs: Vec<(String, Option<(char, String)>)>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Selector {
    /// Each part carries its combinator relative to the previous part.
    parts: Vec<(Comb, Compound)>,
}

fn ident(chars: &[char], i: &mut usize) -> String {
    let s = *i;
    while *i < chars.len() && (chars[*i].is_alphanumeric() || chars[*i] == '-' || chars[*i] == '_')
    {
        *i += 1;
    }
    chars[s..*i].iter().collect()
}

pub fn parse_selector(src: &str) -> Result<Vec<Selector>, String> {
    if src.trim().is_empty() {
        return Err("empty selector".into());
    }
    if src.chars().count() > 500 {
        return Err("selector too long".into());
    }
    let chars: Vec<char> = src.chars().collect();
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut list = Vec::new();
    let mut parts: Vec<(Comb, Compound)> = Vec::new();
    let mut comb = Comb::Descendant;
    loop {
        while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_whitespace() {
            i += 1;
            if !parts.is_empty() && comb == Comb::Descendant {
                // whitespace = descendant unless a combinator follows
            }
        }
        if i >= chars.len() {
            break;
        }
        match chars[i] {
            ',' => {
                i += 1;
                if parts.is_empty() {
                    return Err("empty selector before ','".into());
                }
                list.push(Selector {
                    parts: std::mem::take(&mut parts),
                });
                comb = Comb::Descendant;
                continue;
            }
            '>' => {
                i += 1;
                if parts.is_empty() {
                    return Err("selector cannot start with '>'".into());
                }
                comb = Comb::Child;
                continue;
            }
            '+' | '~' => return Err(format!("the '{}' combinator is not supported", chars[i])),
            _ => {}
        }
        let mut c = Compound::default();
        let mut any = false;
        if chars[i] == '*' {
            i += 1;
            any = true;
        } else if chars[i].is_alphanumeric() {
            c.tag = Some(ident(&chars, &mut i).to_ascii_lowercase());
            any = true;
        }
        loop {
            if i >= chars.len() {
                break;
            }
            match chars[i] {
                '#' => {
                    i += 1;
                    let id = ident(&chars, &mut i);
                    if id.is_empty() {
                        return Err("expected an id after '#'".into());
                    }
                    c.id = Some(id);
                    any = true;
                }
                '.' => {
                    i += 1;
                    let cl = ident(&chars, &mut i);
                    if cl.is_empty() {
                        return Err("expected a class after '.'".into());
                    }
                    c.classes.push(cl);
                    any = true;
                }
                '[' => {
                    i += 1;
                    while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_whitespace() {
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let name = ident(&chars, &mut i).to_ascii_lowercase();
                    if name.is_empty() {
                        return Err("expected an attribute name after '['".into());
                    }
                    while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_whitespace() {
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let mut test = None;
                    if i < chars.len() && chars[i] != ']' {
                        let op = if chars[i] == '=' {
                            i += 1;
                            '='
                        } else if matches!(chars[i], '*' | '^' | '$' | '~')
                            && chars.get(i + 1) == Some(&'=')
                        {
                            let o = chars[i];
                            i += 2;
                            o
                        } else {
                            return Err(format!(
                                "unsupported attribute operator near {:?}",
                                chars[i]
                            ));
                        };
                        while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_whitespace() {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        let val: String = if i < chars.len()
                            && (chars[i] == '"' || chars[i] == '\'')
                        {
                            let q = chars[i];
                            i += 1;
                            let s = i;
                            while i < chars.len() && chars[i] != q {
                                i += 1;
                            }
                            if i >= chars.len() {
                                return Err("unterminated quote in selector".into());
                            }
                            let v = chars[s..i].iter().collect();
                            i += 1;
                            v
                        } else {
                            let s = i;
                            while i < chars.len() && chars[i] != ']' && !chars[i].is_whitespace() {
                                i += 1;
                            }
                            chars[s..i].iter().collect()
                        };
                        test = Some((op, val));
                        while i < chars.len() && chars[i].is_whitespace() {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                    }
                    if i >= chars.len() || chars[i] != ']' {
                        return Err("missing ']' in selector".into());
                    }
                    i += 1;
                    c.attrs.push((name, test));
                    any = true;
                }
                ':' => return Err("pseudo-classes (':…') are not supported".into()),
                _ => break,
            }
        }
        if !any {
            return Err(format!("unexpected {:?} in selector", chars[i]));
        }
        parts.push((comb, c));
        comb = Comb::Descendant;
        if parts.len() > 16 {
            return Err("selector has too many parts".into());
        }
    }
    if parts.is_empty() {
        return Err("selector is incomplete".into());
    }
    if comb == Comb::Child {
        return Err("selector ends with '>'".into());
    }
    list.push(Selector { parts });
    Ok(list)
}

fn compound_matches(dom: &Dom, n: usize, c: &Compound) -> bool {
    let node = &dom.nodes[n];
    if node.name.starts_with('#') {
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(t) = &c.tag {
        if &node.name != t {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if let Some(id) = &c.id {
        if dom.attr(n, "id") != Some(id.as_str()) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if !c.classes.is_empty() {
        let have = dom.attr(n, "class").unwrap_or("");
        if !c
            .classes
            .iter()
            .all(|w| have.split_whitespace().any(|h| h == w))
        {
            return false;
        }
    }
    for (name, test) in &c.attrs {
        let Some(v) = dom.attr(n, name) else {
            return false;
        };
        if let Some((op, want)) = test {
            let ok = match op {
                '=' => v == want,
                '*' => v.contains(want.as_str()),
                '^' => v.starts_with(want.as_str()),
                '$' => v.ends_with(want.as_str()),
                '~' => v.split_whitespace().any(|w| w == want),
                _ => false,
            };
            if !ok {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    true
}

fn matches(dom: &Dom, n: usize, parts: &[(Comb, Compound)]) -> bool {
    let Some(((comb, last), rest)) = parts.split_last().map(|(l, r)| ((l.0, &l.1), r)) else {
        return true;
    };
    if !compound_matches(dom, n, last) {
        return false;
    }
    if rest.is_empty() {
        return true;
    }
    match comb {
        Comb::Child => dom.nodes[n].parent.map_or(false, |p| matches(dom, p, rest)),
        Comb::Descendant => {
            let mut cur = dom.nodes[n].parent;
            while let Some(p) = cur {
                if matches(dom, p, rest) {
                    return true;
                }
                cur = dom.nodes[p].parent;
            }
            false
        }
    }
}

/// Matching element indices in document order.
pub fn select(dom: &Dom, sels: &[Selector]) -> Vec<usize> {
    // node indices are allocated in document order, so a linear scan is ordered
    (1..dom.nodes.len())
        .filter(|&n| sels.iter().any(|s| matches(dom, n, &s.parts)))
        .collect()
}

/// One-line description of an element: `<a id="x" class="y" href="…">`.
pub fn describe(dom: &Dom, n: usize) -> String {
    let node = &dom.nodes[n];
    let mut s = format!("<{}", node.name);
    for key in ["id", "class", "href", "src", "name", "type"] {
        if let Some(v) = dom.attr(n, key) {
            s.push_str(&format!(" {key}=\"{}\"", truncate_chars(v, 60)));
        }
    }
    s.push('>');
    s
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn base() -> Url {
        Url::parse("https://example.com/docs/page.html").unwrap()
    }

    const PAGE: &str = r##"<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Hello &amp; welcome</title>
<style>body{color:red}</style><script>var x = "<b>not markup</b>";</script></head>
<body><nav><a href="/nav">Navigation</a></nav>
<main><h1>Main  Title</h1>
<p>First <b>bold</b> and <em>soft</em> text with <a href="../other?a=1&amp;b=2">a link</a>.
<p>Second paragraph &mdash; with entity &#169; &#x41;.
<ul><li>one<li>two <a href="#frag">frag</a><li>three</ul>
<ol><li>alpha</li><li>beta</li></ol>
<pre><code>fn main() {
    println!("hi");
}</code></pre>
<table><tr><th>Name<th>Age<tr><td>Ann<td>30</table>
<blockquote>quoted</blockquote>
<img src="/img/a.png" alt="A picture">
<a class="btn big" id="go" href="https://other.org/x">Go</a>
</main><footer>footer junk</footer></body></html>"##;

    #[test]
    fn markdown_rendering() {
        let dom = Dom::parse(PAGE);
        assert_eq!(dom.title().as_deref(), Some("Hello & welcome"));
        let md = render(&dom, &base(), true);
        assert!(md.starts_with("# Main Title"), "{md}");
        assert!(
            md.contains(
                "First **bold** and *soft* text with [a link](https://example.com/other?a=1&b=2)."
            ),
            "{md}"
        );
        assert!(md.contains("Second paragraph — with entity © A."), "{md}");
        assert!(md.contains("- one\n- two frag\n- three"), "{md}");
        assert!(md.contains("1. alpha\n2. beta"), "{md}");
        assert!(
            md.contains("```\nfn main() {\n    println!(\"hi\");\n}\n```"),
            "{md}"
        );
        assert!(md.contains("Name | Age\nAnn | 30"), "{md}");
        assert!(md.contains("> quoted"), "{md}");
        assert!(
            md.contains("![A picture](https://example.com/img/a.png)"),
            "{md}"
        );
        assert!(
            !md.contains("footer junk") && !md.contains("Navigation") && !md.contains("not markup"),
            "{md}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn text_rendering_has_no_markup() {
        let dom = Dom::parse(PAGE);
        let t = render(&dom, &base(), false);
        assert!(t.starts_with("Main Title"), "{t}");
        assert!(t.contains("First bold and soft text with a link."), "{t}");
        assert!(
            !t.contains("**") && !t.contains("](") && !t.contains("```"),
            "{t}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn links_are_resolved_and_deduped() {
        let dom = Dom::parse(PAGE);
        let l = links(&dom, &base());
        let urls: Vec<&str> = l.iter().map(|(_, u)| u.as_str()).collect();
        assert_eq!(
            urls,
            [
                "https://example.com/nav",
                "https://example.com/other?a=1&b=2",
                "https://other.org/x"
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(l[1].0, "a link");
    }

    #[test]
    fn selectors() {
        let dom = Dom::parse(PAGE);
        let q = |s: &str| select(&dom, &parse_selector(s).unwrap()).len();
        assert_eq!(q("a"), 4);
        assert_eq!(q("a.btn"), 1);
        assert_eq!(q("a.big.btn#go"), 1);
        assert_eq!(q("a[href^='https://']"), 1);
        assert_eq!(q("a[href*=other]"), 2);
        assert_eq!(q("main > p"), 2);
        assert_eq!(q("main a"), 3);
        assert_eq!(q("ul li"), 3);
        assert_eq!(q("ul > li"), 3);
        assert_eq!(q("body > li"), 0);
        assert_eq!(q("h1, blockquote"), 2);
        assert_eq!(q("[alt]"), 1);
        assert_eq!(q("nosuch"), 0);
        let m = select(&dom, &parse_selector("#go").unwrap());
        assert_eq!(
            describe(&dom, m[0]),
            "<a id=\"go\" class=\"btn big\" href=\"https://other.org/x\">"
        );
        for bad in [
            "", "a:hover", "a + b", "> a", "a >", "[x", "a[", "a,", ".", "#",
        ] {
            assert!(parse_selector(bad).is_err(), "should reject {bad:?}");
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn utf8_safe_truncation() {
        // the byte-slice panic class fixed by the webfetch-tui 1.0.0 patch
        let s = "日本語のテキスト😀".repeat(40);
        let t = truncate_chars(&s, 61);
        assert_eq!(t.chars().count(), 62); // 61 chars + ellipsis
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("short", 61), "short");
        assert_eq!(truncate_chars("", 0), "");
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_html_never_panics() {
        let nasty = [
            "<",
            "<<<<",
            "<a",
            "<a href",
            "<a href=",
            "<a href='x",
            "<div",
            "</",
            "</>",
            "<!--",
            "<!-- x",
            "<script>",
            "<script>alert(1)",
            "<title>x",
            "&",
            "&#",
            "&#xZZ;",
            "&#99999999999;",
            "&amp",
            "<p>\u{0}</p>",
            "<a/b/c>",
            "<img src=x alt=\"é",
            "<a href=\"é\u{1f600}\">日本</a",
        ];
        for h in nasty {
            let dom = Dom::parse(h);
            let _ = render(&dom, &base(), true);
            let _ = render(&dom, &base(), false);
            let _ = links(&dom, &base());
        }
        // pathological nesting is capped instead of overflowing the stack
        let deep = "<div>".repeat(50_000) + "x";
        let dom = Dom::parse(&deep);
        assert!(render(&dom, &base(), true).contains('x'));
        let wide = "<p>a".repeat(20_000);
        let _ = render(&Dom::parse(&wide), &base(), false);
    }

    #[test]
    fn entities() {
        assert_eq!(
            decode_entities("a &lt; b &amp;&amp; c &gt; d &nbsp;e"),
            "a < b && c > d  e"
        );
        assert_eq!(decode_entities("&unknown; &#65;&#x42; &"), "&unknown; AB &");
        assert_eq!(decode_entities("日本&amp;語"), "日本&語");
    }
}

[view on disk](crates/server/src/webfetch/http.rs)

```rust
//! HTTP plumbing for `web_fetch` (std only): drives `curl` (already a RomaCode
//! requirement), parses the response and decodes the body.
//!
//! * the URL and every option go over curl's stdin as a config, so nothing
//!   appears in the process list;
//! * `-q` ignores any `~/.curlrc` so behaviour is the same everywhere;
//! * redirects are NOT followed by curl — the caller follows them one hop at a
//!   time so each hop can be policy- and SSRF-checked;
//! * the body is read through a hard byte cap and curl is killed beyond it.
use std::io::{Read, Write};
use std::process::{Command, Stdio};

pub struct CurlParams<'a> {
    pub url: &'a str,
    pub user_agent: &'a str,
    pub connect_timeout: u64,
    pub max_time: u64,
    /// Maximum body bytes kept; the rest is discarded and `truncated` is set.
    pub max_bytes: usize,
    /// `host:port:ip` pin so curl connects to the address that was vetted.
    pub pin: Option<&'a str>,
    pub proxy: &'a str,
    pub ca_bundle: &'a str,
    /// `user:pass` basic auth from URL userinfo, if the URL carried any.
    pub auth: Option<&'a str>,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct Response {
    pub status: u16,
    pub reason: String,
    pub headers: Vec<(String, String)>,
    pub body: Vec<u8>,
    pub truncated: bool,
}

impl Response {
    pub fn header(&self, name: &str) -> Option<&str> {
        self.headers
            .iter()
            .find(|(k, _)| k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(name))
            .map(|(_, v)| v.as_str())
    }

    /// Media type without parameters, lowercased (`text/html`).
    pub fn mime(&self) -> String {
        self.header("content-type")
            .map(|v| {
                v.split(';')
                    .next()
                    .unwrap_or("")
                    .trim()
                    .to_ascii_lowercase()
            })
            .unwrap_or_default()
    }

    pub fn is_redirect(&self) -> bool {
        matches!(self.status, 301 | 302 | 303 | 307 | 308) && self.header("location").is_some()
    }
}

fn q(v: &str) -> String {
    v.replace('\\', "\\\\")
        .replace('"', "\\\"")
        .replace(['\n', '\r'], "")
}

pub fn curl_config(p: &CurlParams) -> String {
    let mut c = format!(
        "url = \"{}\"\nrequest = \"GET\"\nuser-agent = \"{}\"\nconnect-timeout = {}\nmax-time = {}\n\
         proto = \"=http,https\"\ncompressed\n\
         header = \"Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/json;q=0.9,text/plain;q=0.8,*/*;q=0.5\"\n\
         header = \"Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.8\"\n",
        q(p.url),
        q(p.user_agent),
        p.connect_timeout.max(1),
        p.max_time.max(1),
    );
    if let Some(pin) = p.pin {
        c.push_str(&format!("resolve = \"{}\"\n", q(pin)));
    }
    if let Some(auth) = p.auth {
        c.push_str(&format!("user = \"{}\"\n", q(auth)));
    }
    if !p.proxy.is_empty() {
        c.push_str(&format!("proxy = \"{}\"\n", q(p.proxy)));
    }
    if !p.ca_bundle.is_empty() {
        c.push_str(&format!("cacert = \"{}\"\n", q(p.ca_bundle)));
    }
    c
}

/// Split a raw `curl -i` stream into status, headers and body, skipping
/// interim (1xx) and proxy-CONNECT header blocks.
pub fn split_response(
    mut buf: &[u8],
) -> Result<(u16, String, Vec<(String, String)>, &[u8]), String> {
    loop {
        let end = buf
            .windows(4)
            .position(|w| w == b"\r\n\r\n")
            .ok_or("malformed response: no end of headers")?;
        let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..end]).into_owned();
        let rest = &buf[end + 4..];
        let mut lines = head.split("\r\n");
        let status_line = lines.next().unwrap_or("");
        let mut parts = status_line.split_whitespace();
        let proto = parts.next().unwrap_or("");
        if !proto.starts_with("HTTP/") {
            return Err(format!("malformed response status line: {status_line:?}"));
        }
        let status: u16 = parts
            .next()
            .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())
            .ok_or("malformed response status code")?;
        let reason = parts.collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
        let connect_ack = reason
            .to_ascii_lowercase()
            .starts_with("connection established");
        if ((100..200).contains(&status) && status != 101) || connect_ack {
            buf = rest;
            continue;
        }
        let headers = lines
            .filter_map(|l| l.split_once(':'))
            .map(|(k, v)| (k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string()))
            .collect();
        return Ok((status, reason, headers, rest));
    }
}

pub fn curl_get(p: &CurlParams) -> Result<Response, String> {
    let mut child = Command::new("curl")
        .args([
            "-q",
            "-sS",
            "-i",
            "--suppress-connect-headers",
            "--config",
            "-",
        ])
        .stdin(Stdio::piped())
        .stdout(Stdio::piped())
        .stderr(Stdio::piped())
        .spawn()
        .map_err(|e| format!("could not run curl ({e}) — install curl to use web_fetch"))?;
    {
        let mut stdin = child.stdin.take().ok_or("curl stdin unavailable")?;
        stdin
            .write_all(curl_config(p).as_bytes())
            .map_err(|e| format!("curl: {e}"))?;
    }
    let stdout = child.stdout.take().ok_or("curl stdout unavailable")?;
    let cap = p.max_bytes + 64 * 1024; // room for headers
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    stdout
        .take(cap as u64 + 1)
        .read_to_end(&mut buf)
        .map_err(|e| format!("read error: {e}"))?;
    let over = buf.len() > cap;
    if over {
        buf.truncate(cap);
        let _ = child.kill();
    }
    let status = child.wait().map_err(|e| format!("curl: {e}"))?;
    if buf.is_empty() {
        let mut err = String::new();
        if let Some(mut s) = child.stderr.take() {
            let _ = s.read_to_string(&mut err);
        }
        let first = err.lines().next().unwrap_or("").trim();
        return Err(if first.is_empty() {
            format!("curl exited with {status}")
        } else {
            first.to_string()
        });
    }
    let (code, reason, headers, body) = split_response(&buf)?;
    let mut truncated = over;
    let mut body = body.to_vec();
    if body.len() > p.max_bytes {
        body.truncate(p.max_bytes);
        truncated = true;
    }
    Ok(Response {
        status: code,
        reason,
        headers,
        body,
        truncated,
    })
}

// ── body helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Decode to text: UTF-8 (lossy) unless the Content-Type says Latin-1/Windows-1252.
pub fn decode_body(body: &[u8], content_type: &str) -> String {
    let ct = content_type.to_ascii_lowercase();
    let latin1 = ct.contains("charset=iso-8859-1")
        || ct.contains("charset=windows-1252")
        || ct.contains("charset=latin1");
    if latin1 {
        body.iter().map(|&b| b as char).collect()
    } else {
        String::from_utf8_lossy(body).into_owned()
    }
}

pub fn is_binary(mime: &str, body: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if mime.starts_with("image/")
        || mime.starts_with("audio/")
        || mime.starts_with("video/")
        || mime.starts_with("font/")
    {
        return !mime.contains("svg");
    }
    if matches!(
        mime,
        "application/pdf"
            | "application/zip"
            | "application/gzip"
            | "application/octet-stream"
            | "application/x-tar"
            | "application/wasm"
            | "application/x-7z-compressed"
            | "application/vnd.microsoft.portable-executable"
    ) {
        return true;
    }
    if mime.starts_with("text/")
        || mime.contains("json")
        || mime.contains("xml")
        || mime.contains("javascript")
    {
        return false;
    }
    body.iter().take(2048).any(|&b| b == 0)
}

pub fn looks_html(mime: &str, text: &str) -> bool {
    if mime.contains("html") {
        return true;
    }
    let head: String = text
        .trim_start()
        .chars()
        .take(64)
        .collect::<String>()
        .to_ascii_lowercase();
    head.starts_with("<!doctype html") || head.starts_with("<html")
}

/// First executable named in `names` found on `PATH`.
pub fn which(names: &[&str]) -> Option<std::path::PathBuf> {
    let path = std::env::var_os("PATH")?;
    for dir in std::env::split_paths(&path) {
        for n in names {
            let p = dir.join(n);
            if p.is_file() {
                return Some(p);
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::net::TcpListener;
    use std::thread;

    /// Serve `n` connections on loopback with `handler(request_line) -> raw response`.
    fn serve(n: usize, handler: fn(&str) -> Vec<u8>) -> u16 {
        let l = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let port = l.local_addr().unwrap().port();
        thread::spawn(move || {
            for _ in 0..n {
                let Ok((mut s, _)) = l.accept() else { return };
                let mut buf = [0u8; 4096];
                let k = s.read(&mut buf).unwrap_or(0);
                let req = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..k]).into_owned();
                let first = req.lines().next().unwrap_or("").to_string();
                let _ = s.write_all(&handler(&first));
            }
        });
        port
    }

    fn params(url: &str, max_bytes: usize) -> CurlParams<'_> {
        std::env::set_var("NO_PROXY", "*");
        std::env::set_var("no_proxy", "*");
        CurlParams {
            url,
            user_agent: "romacode-test",
            connect_timeout: 5,
            max_time: 10,
            max_bytes,
            pin: None,
            proxy: "",
            ca_bundle: "",
            auth: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn fetches_headers_and_body() {
        let port = serve(1, |req| {
            assert!(req.starts_with("GET /hello HTTP/1.1"), "{req}");
            b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8\r\nX-Test: yes\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nhello".to_vec()
        });
        let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}/hello");
        let r = curl_get(&params(&url, 1000)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((r.status, r.reason.as_str()), (200, "OK"));
        assert_eq!(r.header("x-test"), Some("yes"));
        assert_eq!(r.mime(), "text/html");
        assert_eq!(r.body, b"hello");
        assert!(!r.truncated && !r.is_redirect());
    }

    #[test]
    fn reports_redirects_without_following() {
        let port = serve(1, |_| {
            b"HTTP/1.1 302 Found\r\nLocation: /next\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n".to_vec()
        });
        let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}/");
        let r = curl_get(&params(&url, 1000)).unwrap();
        assert!(r.is_redirect(), "{r:?}");
        assert_eq!(r.header("Location"), Some("/next"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn caps_large_bodies() {
        let port = serve(1, |_| {
            let mut v = b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
                .to_vec();
            v.extend(std::iter::repeat(b'x').take(500_000));
            v
        });
        let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}/big");
        let r = curl_get(&params(&url, 1000)).unwrap();
        assert!(r.truncated);
        assert_eq!(r.body.len(), 1000);
    }

    #[test]
    fn error_statuses_are_returned_not_raised() {
        let port = serve(1, |_| {
            b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 4\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nnope".to_vec()
        });
        let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}/missing");
        let r = curl_get(&params(&url, 1000)).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(
            (r.status, r.reason.as_str(), r.body.as_slice()),
            (404, "Not Found", &b"nope"[..])
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn connection_refused_is_a_clean_error() {
        let l = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap();
        let port = l.local_addr().unwrap().port();
        drop(l);
        let url = format!("http://127.0.0.1:{port}/");
        let e = curl_get(&params(&url, 1000)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(
            e.to_lowercase().contains("connect") || e.contains("7"),
            "{e}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn only_http_schemes_are_allowed_by_curl() {
        let e = curl_get(&params("file:///etc/passwd", 1000)).unwrap_err();
        assert!(!e.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn config_cannot_be_injected_through_values() {
        let p = CurlParams {
            url: "http://x/\"\nproxy = \"evil",
            user_agent: "ua\"\nheader = \"X: y",
            connect_timeout: 1,
            max_time: 1,
            max_bytes: 1,
            pin: None,
            proxy: "",
            ca_bundle: "",
            auth: Some("u:}\"\nproxy = \"evil"),
        };
        let c = curl_config(&p);
        assert!(
            !c.contains("\nproxy = \"evil") && !c.contains("\nheader = \"X: y"),
            "{c}"
        );
    }

    #[test]
    fn splits_interim_and_connect_blocks() {
        let raw = b"HTTP/1.1 200 Connection established\r\n\r\nHTTP/1.1 100 Continue\r\n\r\nHTTP/2 200 \r\ncontent-type: text/plain\r\n\r\nbody";
        let (s, _, h, b) = split_response(raw).unwrap();
        assert_eq!((s, b), (200, &b"body"[..]));
        assert_eq!(h[0].0, "content-type");
        assert!(split_response(b"garbage").is_err());
        assert!(split_response(b"NOTHTTP 200\r\n\r\n").is_err());
    }

    #[test]
    fn body_helpers() {
        assert_eq!(
            decode_body(&[0x63, 0x61, 0x66, 0xe9], "text/html; charset=ISO-8859-1"),
            "café"
        );
        assert_eq!(decode_body("café".as_bytes(), "text/html"), "café");
        assert_eq!(decode_body(&[0xff, b'a'], "text/plain"), "\u{fffd}a");
        assert!(is_binary("image/png", b"") && is_binary("application/pdf", b"%PDF"));
        assert!(
            !is_binary("image/svg+xml", b"<svg/>")
                && !is_binary("text/plain", b"a\0b")
                && !is_binary("application/json", b"{}")
        );
        assert!(is_binary("", b"ab\0cd"));
        assert!(
            looks_html("text/html", "")
                && looks_html("", "  <!DOCTYPE html><p>")
                && !looks_html("text/plain", "hello")
        );
    }
}
